quest.title: A Lot Of Trees I
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent wants to sell Christmas trees in town, but he needs some help gathering the trees. Will you lend him a hand?

quest.title: A Lot Of Trees II
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent wants to upgrade his Christmas tree lot by selling fully decorated trees alongside the plain Christmas trees. Will you help him get a few more trees and decorate them?

quest.title: A Lot Of Trees III
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent wants to add a gift shop to his lot. He plans to sell a variety of things in addition to the Christmas trees. He envisioned a one-stop shop for all the holiday needs. Will you give him a hand?

quest.title: A Lot Of Trees IV
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent needs a few more items for his shop, if you’re willing to help.

quest.title: A Lot Of Trees V
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent needs more plain trees. Will you bring him a fresh supply?

quest.title: A Lot Of Trees VI
quest.cleanDescription: There was a huge rush on fully decorated Christmas trees. Will you help Vincent replenish his supplies?

quest.title: A Lot Of Trees VII
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent needs more color choices for tree decorations. Will you bring him some different colored decorations?

quest.title: A Lot Of Trees VIII
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent wants to sell treats in his gift shop. Will you bring him a load of candy?

quest.title: A Lot Of Trees IX
quest.cleanDescription: Business is really taking off for Vincent. Now he needs more plain trees! Will you bring him a large supply?

quest.title: A Lot Of Trees X
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent is completely out of fully decorated Christmas trees. They are selling quicker than he can keep up on his own. Will you bring him a big load of fully decorated trees to help him catch up?

quest.title: A Lot Of Trees XI
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent has an amazing idea for his gift shop. He’s going to sell green scarves! They can be used as scarves or as tree skirts. Will you help him prepare a large inventory?

quest.title: A Lot Of Trees XII
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent needs more trees. He can barely keep up with the demand right now. Will you bring him a ridiculously large load of plain trees?

quest.title: A Lot Of Trees XIII
quest.cleanDescription: The fully decorated trees are gone, completely wiped out. Please help Vincent build up a bigger stock of fully decorated trees.

quest.title: A Lot Of Trees XIV
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent needs more ornaments to sell in his gift shop. Please bring him a large load of all the colors.

quest.title: A Lot Of Trees XV
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent has a new idea for the gift shop. He wants to try selling teddy bears. Will you bring him a few to test the market?

quest.title: A Lot Of Trees XVI
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent is ready to make a final push into the holidays. Will you bring him 2 loads of plain trees?

quest.title: A Lot Of Trees XVII
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent is ready for the second load of plain trees.

quest.title: A Lot Of Trees XVIII
quest.cleanDescription: Now, Vincent wants 2 last loads of decorated trees. After he sells out his inventory, Vincent is going to close up his tree lot and enjoy the holidays. He hopes you will too!

quest.title: A Lot Of Trees XIX
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent appreciates all your help with his tree lot. He’s ready for the last load now.

quest.title: Irrationally Hungry I
quest.cleanDescription: Holger enjoyed his pie, but…he’s still hungry. Will you bring him something else to eat, perhaps more pie?

quest.title: Irrationally Hungry II
quest.cleanDescription: Holger enjoyed the pies you brought him, but…he’s still very, very hungry. Will you bring him  more pie? Please!

quest.title: April Trout Brings May Flowers I
quest.cleanTitle: April Trout Brings May Flowers I
quest.cleanDescription:
Thomas heard a saying once, “April trout brings May flowers.” He would like to deliver trout to all of his friends in the village but is worried he won’t be able to get enough trout in time and has asked for your help.

First up is Lorn!

quest.title: April Trout Brings May Flowers II
quest.cleanTitle: April Trout Brings May Flowers II
quest.cleanDescription:
Lorn gave Thomas a strange look. Oh well.

Off to visit Jill!

quest.title: April Trout Brings May Flowers III
quest.cleanTitle: April Trout Brings May Flowers III
quest.cleanDescription:
You're pretty sure you saw Jill throw the trout in the trash as you were leaving, but Thomas seems pretty pleased with himself.

Next up is Vincent!

quest.title: April Trout Brings May Flowers IV
quest.cleanTitle: April Trout Brings May Flowers IV
quest.cleanDescription:
Vincent seems less than pleased by your delivery, but gives Thomas a big forced smile.

Thomas seems unfazed and heads towards Rosalie's home.

quest.title: April Trout Brings May Flowers V
quest.cleanTitle: April Trout Brings May Flowers V
quest.cleanDescription:
Rosalie mutters something about trout not being good for spellcasting but thanks Thomas all the same.

Thomas seems particularly mirthful as he heads towards Cecil's house.

quest.title: April Trout Brings May Flowers VI
quest.cleanTitle: April Trout Brings May Flowers VI
quest.cleanDescription:
Cecil asks you to take the trout out back to his feeder pond.

Thomas is already off to Borgen's camp by the time you're done.

quest.title: April Trout Brings May Flowers VII
quest.cleanTitle: April Trout Brings May Flowers VII
quest.cleanDescription:
Borgen seems entirely too excited by this development.

Thomas grins and mentions it's time to head to Beatrix's home.

quest.title: April Trout Brings May Flowers VIII
quest.cleanTitle: April Trout Brings May Flowers VIII
quest.cleanDescription:
Geist eats all the trout and seems content.

Thomas mumbles something about starting to get hungry, but heads towards Mariya's home next.

quest.title: April Trout Brings May Flowers IX
quest.cleanTitle: April Trout Brings May Flowers IX
quest.cleanDescription:
Mariya is delighted, and immediately starts planning a meal for the townsfolk and rolling the trout in flour.

Thomas continues to look joyful, but you swear you hear his stomach rumble as he suggests you pay a visit to frank next.

quest.title: April Trout Brings May Flowers X
quest.cleanTitle: April Trout Brings May Flowers X
quest.cleanDescription:
"oh yes slapping people with trout certainly brings may flowers," frank says with a toothy grin.

"We'll, that was the point!" Thomas laughs as he suggests you head to Star's tower.

"well, I could always...deliver them for you?" frank suggests.

Thomas is glad for saving the trip and frank asks for a few barrels too.

quest.title: April Trout Brings May Flowers XI
quest.cleanTitle: April Trout Brings May Flowers XI
quest.cleanDescription: You hear a "frank!!!!!!!!!" echoing across the town, and Thomas figures that your trout were delivered successfully and you should visit FR4NK now.

quest.title: April Trout Brings May Flowers XII
quest.cleanTitle: April Trout Brings May Flowers XII
quest.cleanDescription:
"Does not process. This is not compatible with my programming. Transistors bring my circuits a feeling of warmth, though." FR4NK's confusion seems evident.

Thomas shrugs and suggests it's time to visit ROOMBA.

quest.title: April Trout Brings May Flowers XIII
quest.cleanTitle: April Trout Brings May Flowers XIII
quest.cleanDescription:
"I am unsure what to do with this organic lifeform. Programming indicates it is either for sustenance or slapping. As I am still a fan of ethanol snacks, I accept your gifts in the spirit they were given." ROOMBA also seems very confused.

Thomas has a quiet smile and suggests you visit George, but ROOMBA interrupts as you leave. "If gifts are appropriate, the Sandwyrm would probably enjoy this organic lifeform as sustenance, FR4NK and I both worry it is not getting enough in recent times."

quest.title: April Trout Brings May Flowers XIV
quest.cleanTitle: April Trout Brings May Flowers XIV
quest.cleanDescription:
You follow ROOMBA and FR4NK to the edge of Jundland and set down the items they suggested on a specific area of the desert. The ground opens up and your items disappear in a flash.

Everyone seems quite happy, and Thomas suggests stopping by Charles' stable on the way back.

quest.title: April Trout Brings May Flowers XV
quest.cleanTitle: April Trout Brings May Flowers XV
quest.cleanDescription:
"Neigh!"

Yes, good has been done here this day. Thomas suggests heading to port, he remembers seeing Ragvin's ship docked.

quest.title: April Trout Brings May Flowers XVI
quest.cleanTitle: April Trout Brings May Flowers XVI
quest.cleanDescription:
Ragvin seems extremely grateful for the supplies.

Thomas notices that Captain Thomas is nearby and suggests you could deliver some trout to him too!

quest.title: April Trout Brings May Flowers XVII
quest.cleanTitle: April Trout Brings May Flowers XVII
quest.cleanDescription:
Captain Thomas seems extremely perplexed, but grateful nonetheless.

Thomas notes that Captain Logan is nearby as well, and a resupply of his fishing boats with trout could be pretty amusing.

quest.title: April Trout Brings May Flowers XVIII
quest.cleanTitle: April Trout Brings May Flowers XVIII
quest.cleanDescription:
Captain Logan looks over your gift and smiles at you both.

Thomas excitedly notes that you're nearly done visiting all the townsfolk and suggests visiting George.

quest.title: April Trout Brings May Flowers XIX
quest.cleanTitle: April Trout Brings May Flowers XIX
quest.cleanDescription:
George is delighted by all the art and music supplies and doesn't seem to even notice the trout at all.

Thomas mumbles something about starving artists but turns and speeds off towards Holger's home.

quest.title: April Trout Brings May Flowers XX
quest.cleanTitle: April Trout Brings May Flowers XX
quest.cleanDescription:
Holger is positively delighted by what you've brought and Thomas beams with happiness.

Your final stop is your good friend Buddy.

quest.title: April Trout Brings May Flowers XXI
quest.cleanTitle: April Trout Brings May Flowers XXI
quest.cleanDescription:
Buddy looks from you, to the trout, to Thomas. "Weren't we meeting at your place, Thomas?" Buddy asks.

Thomas gives Buddy a sidelong glance and mumbles something about getting dinner and Buddy helpfully pipes up that he has an idea to get Thomas some good dinner food and hands you a list of fish.

"See you at Thomas's house!" He says cheerily.

It's a very long list.

quest.title: April Trout Brings May Flowers XXII
quest.cleanTitle: April Trout Brings May Flowers XXII
quest.cleanDescription:
At Thomas's house, Buddy prepares a smorgasbord of fish, and you all feel your stomachs growl.

Suddenly, Buddy runs to your side.

"I need one gold trout. Also, can you sit in that chair over there?"

quest.title: April Trout Brings May Flowers XXIII
quest.cleanTitle: April Trout Brings May Flowers XXIII
quest.cleanDescription:
After grabbing the trout, you sit on your seat and a very boisterous and flatulent sound erupts from beneath you.

Thomas and Buddy crack up instantly and they yell, "APRIL FOOLS!"

quest.title: April Trout Brings May Flowers XXIV
quest.cleanTitle: April Trout Brings May Flowers XXIV
quest.cleanDescription: Thomas and Buddy then show you that the smorgasbord was all fake, and that they ate dinner before you came back with the fish.   But hey, you got a free new way to prank your friends later.

quest.title: Buddy Rabbit I
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy wants to join in the festive spirit everyone else in town seems to have, and has asked you to help him make a rabbit costume. He needs 100 feathers.  You think that maybe he has never seen a rabbit before, and contemplate introducing him to frank, but realize that if you did, Buddy might want blue feathers instead.

quest.title: Buddy Rabbit II
quest.cleanDescription: Apparently Buddy ran into frank in town, and now wants blue feathers to continue working on his rabbit costume, because of course he does.  Will you bring Buddy 150 blue feathers?

quest.title: Buddy Rabbit III
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy now understands that rabbits don't lay eggs, and would instead like a chicken costume.  He would like you to bring him a couple hundred straw.  You wonder, not for the first time, whether Buddy knows what anything actually looks like...

quest.title: Buddy Rabbit IV
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy is almost set for his festivities.  He now would like you to bring him 100 buckets, so that he can leave them full of goodies for people around town.  This is, sadly, the least strange request from him this holiday, so you feel lucky that things haven't gotten weirder.

quest.title: Buddy Rabbit V
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy thinks it would be a fun joke to leave a bucket of chum along with his bucket of goodies.  You wondered when it was going to get weird, and apparently the answer is "now".

quest.title: Buddy Rabbit VI
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy now thinks that the best costume might be a dragon.  Dragons lay eggs, right?  He'd like some items to help him look like a dragon.

quest.title: Buddy Rabbit VII
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy says his dragon costume is really coming along nicely.  He thinks that it won't possibly be complete without the dragon's hoard of valuables.  This seems eerily familiar for some reason...

quest.title: Buddy Rabbit VIII
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy says to really finish off his hoard, he needs some more  green items, and more jewels.  And a diamond.  He also says he's very patient, so he will just need some coal, and he will try and make one himself.  Well, that's a relief at least.

quest.title: Buddy Rabbit IX
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy says his costume and buckets are perfect.  He wants to make sure you are in on his gifts, and he hopes you'll be willing to help next time he gets a GREAT IDEA!  He also might be confused about holidays...

quest.title: A Study of Color I
quest.cleanDescription: George is now relaxing after his long career as a soldier. He would like to take up painting and would love some help collecting objects to paint for inspiration. He would like to focus on one color at a time. Can you help him round up some Purple objects to paint?

quest.title: A Study of Color II
quest.cleanDescription: George was really happy with his first painting and now wants to work on another color. Red is next on his list. Can you round up a slew of red objects to stage for his next masterpiece?

quest.title: A Study of Color III
quest.cleanDescription: Red was great, but George was after a new color now. Something very different than his last two paintings. Green is the color of the day! Can you help gather several green objects for George to paint next?

quest.title: A Study of Color IV
quest.cleanDescription: There was so much green stuff, that George has a ton of paint and dye left over. Some of it could be yours if you help him stage his next work of art. Blue is the color of the day. Can you round up a few blue-ish objects for him to paint?

quest.title: A Study of Color V
quest.cleanDescription: George would like to do some painting now of something many might see as mundane color. Brown is the next color for his new masterpiece. Can you round up a bunch of brown objects?

quest.title: A Study of Color VI
quest.cleanDescription: Next, George is working on two similar colors, instead of just one. He needs lots of Yellow and Orange objects. Think you can round up enough to fill up a painting? There is lots of leftover rope from the Brown painting as a reward. George also promises that this maybe, might possibly be the last color he studies. But he isn't 100% sure yet.

quest.title: A Study of Color VII
quest.cleanDescription:
George has learned so much about colors thanks to the various items you brought him.  However, as an artist, there is always more to study and learn.  This time, he needs quite a few of each item in the same series of color to compare the slight difference between them.  This will help him understand color shades and palettes.

The first color he would like to study is Blue.  Can you bring him the items?

quest.title: A Study of Color VIII
quest.cleanDescription: George thanks you for the items and feels that he has learned so much.  However, he would like to start learning more about the color Purple.  Can you bring the items?

quest.title: A Study of Color IX
quest.cleanDescription: Thank you for continuing to help George understand color.  The next color is Yellow.  If you can bring the items listed, George will be very appreciative.

quest.title: A Study of Color X
quest.cleanDescription: The next color is a doozy.  Green!   Being farmers and all, George assumes you've got a lot of Green objects he could study closely.  Could you help him again?

quest.title: A Study of Color XI
quest.cleanDescription: George thanks you again for all the help you have provided.  As you know, there are many colors left, so once again he is asking for help.  The next color is Red, can you bring the following items?

quest.title: A Study of Color XII
quest.cleanDescription: Yes!  George is excited because he feels like his color skills have reached a new level.  He would like to study the color Brown now.  Can you bring the items?

quest.title: A Study of Color XIII
quest.cleanDescription:
George feels very confident in his color skills and artistic ability. Perhaps there's an opportunity here to use his new found knowledge to make a little side hustle. George would like to try to mix up his own new paint brand to sell to the other townsfolk. Can you help him?

George is going to focus on one color again at a time for the paints as well as a few items to help him mix the paints to be sold. The first color is Blue.

quest.title: A Study of Color XIV
quest.cleanDescription: The first batch of paint has been mixed and stored in the barrels you brought George.  George is hopeful they will be popular and sell well.  He would like to get another paint color ready now.  The color is Purple.  Can you bring the items?

quest.title: A Study of Color XV
quest.cleanDescription: George is really excited!  Demand for his paint is really starting to take off and now he is being asked for more colors!  It is time to make yellow paint, can you help?

quest.title: A Study of Color XVI
quest.cleanDescription: Green.  Yes, green is the next color that is being requested.  Can you bring the items?

quest.title: Trapper’s Delight I
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent is preparing for Halloween. He would like to set up a booth in town and give out some candy. Will you help him get a small assortment of candy to hand out?

quest.title: Trapper’s Delight II
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent would also like to get some simple decorations for his booth. Will you get him some jack o’ lanterns?

quest.title: Trapper’s Delight III
quest.cleanDescription: To help protect Vincent’s booth until the big night, Vincent would like to set up some traps. He thinks he could use chattering teeth to make some pretty effective, yet festive, traps. Will you get him the chattering teeth?

quest.title: Parts Unknown I
quest.cleanDescription:
As you leave the town on a trip for more nails and iron, you are stopped at a clearing by Vincent.
After exchanging pleasantries, Vincent begins to tell you about a job he has taken on for a client and would like your help in retrieving it. He offers to split the reward with you if you’re willing to do some of the work and material gathering.
To start, he thinks it may be a long trip and asks you to bring some various supplies for the journey ahead.

quest.title: Parts Unknown II
quest.cleanDescription:
Leaving town, Vincent starts to tell you about a time he had to hunt down a rogue with a graviton projector, but before he’s able to tell you more, George walks up beside you both and says he heard about your trip and would like to go along as well.
Vincent is clearly not a fan of this idea, but relents as you offer to split your rewards with George and he can keep his. Now that Vincent has been mollified, George asks for a few extra supplies before you set out.

quest.title: Parts Unknown III
quest.cleanDescription: After a moment of thought, Vincent asks you for some parchment and coal to sketch out your journey, so you don’t get lost.

quest.title: Parts Unknown IV
quest.cleanDescription:
Putting the parchment on the ground, Vincent makes a brief sketch of the area you’re heading.
He notes down some significant areas:
  • Whispering Creek
  • Jundland Desert
  • Sinking Swamp
  • Unknown Lands

“We’re going to the Unknown Lands and looking for Castrum Romuska, which is an old abandoned castle. The journey shouldn’t take more than a few days, let’s ensure we have everything we need – speaking of, let’s pack some food and travelling cloaks for the journey and be on our way!”

He hands you a second parchment with what else to pack.

quest.title: Parts Unknown V
quest.cleanDescription:
Your journey takes many days. The horses require reshoeing, the cloaks need repairing, but overall your trip is remarkably uneventful thanks to Vincent's excellent guidance and leadership.

In a moment of curiosity, your group tried to veer off the path to see the famed Whispering Creek. Even with Vincent guiding you, the location evaded your party, even as you looked at the map. Well, another problem for another time.

As your journey continues, Vincent constantly scouts ahead for new information, while you discover that George has a pleasant singing voice. He also enjoys sharing stories from his days as a soldier, and has a great knack for storytelling.

quest.title: Parts Unknown VI
quest.cleanDescription:
As you set up camp for the evening, George continues to sing a song he has composed along your journey. His story of a love lost is one you continue to find beautiful and haunting - you hope he finishes it one day.
An hour later, Vincent arrives back at camp with news of a great castle rising on the horizon to the south. He watched the castle for signs of life and found none, and suggests that tomorrow you should expect to arrive at the castle proper.
Vincent finishes setting up camp with both snares and tricks to alert you to any intruders to your camp. His professionalism and skill are daunting and comforting, and you rest easy with the knowledge of yet one more good night of sleep and a big adventure tomorrow.

quest.title: Parts Unknown VII
quest.cleanDescription:
As you crest another hill, you see a castle in the distance. Sunlight spills off the castle in odd directions, giving it a luminescent and odd gleam as you walk towards it. You can see familiar workings of steam and crystal, but as you get closer you see more gears and contraptions that are odd to your eyes. As you approach the front gate, a voice suddenly pierces the air!

“GOOD DAY! WHAT IS IT YOU REQUIRE?”

The voice is very odd, and always carries the same intonation. It’s very uncomfortable on your ears. Vincent steps forward and tells the gate they wish to enter.

After a long pause, the voice returns:

“REQUEST NOTED. ENTRY WILL BE GRANTED AFTER SERVICES RENDERED.”

There emits a buzzing noise from the gate and a small piece of parchment emits from a slot with the words:
ENTRY TICKET/Front Gate Repairs

“PLEASE TURN ALL REQUIRED MATERIALS IN TO THE REQUIRED RECEPTACLE.”

quest.title: Parts Unknown VIII
quest.cleanDescription:
As you bring back the materials, a slot opens where you’re able to deposit them all. A tattered gate swings open, and by both the creaking and grinding, you conclude the castle has seen better days. Those materials are going to be useful to…whomever needed them.

“WELCOME TRAVELERS TO CASTLE ROMUSKA! I AM ROMUSKA’S ONLY OFFICIAL MAINTENANCE BAYESIAN AUTOMATON. IT HAS BEEN MANY CYCLES SINCE I HAVE SEEN HUMANS ENTER. PLEASE STATE YOUR NAME AND PURPOSE.”

Vincent again steps forward and proclaims confidently, “My name is Vincent and I am travelling with my companions at the behest of another. We are here seeking the energy stone. We come in peace.”

Again, there is a long pause between Vincent’s statement and a response.

“THANK YOU FOR VISITING THE CASTLE, PLEASE NOTE REPAIRS ARE REQUIRED TO ACCESS THE AREA YOU HAVE IMPLIED. I WILL GUIDE YOU TO YOUR DESTINATION.”

On your right, an extremely long parchment emits from a slot in the very odd shaped walls.
Door 0001 (biological naming standard “Front door”) requires repair
Room 0001A (biological naming standard "Hallway A”) requires door 0001J repair
Room 0001B (biological naming standard "Dormitory B”)
Room 0001C (biological naming standard "Dormitory C”)
Room 0001D (biological naming standard "Dormitory D”)
Room 0001E (biological naming standard "Dormitory E”)
Room 0001F (biological naming standard "Dormitory F”)
Room 0001G (biological naming standard "Dormitory G”)
Room 0001H (biological naming standard "Dormitory H”)
Room 0001I (biological naming standard "Dormitory I”)
Room 0001J (biological naming standard "Hallway B”) requires door 0001J repair, requires door 0011E repair Room 0011A (biological naming standard “Kitchen A”)
Room 0011A-01A (biological naming standard "Pantry”)
Room 0011A-02A (biological naming standard "Utensil storage”)
Room 0011B (biological naming standard "Lavatory”)
Room 0011C (biological naming standard "Library”)
Room 0011D (biological naming standard “Recreation Room”)
Room 0011E (biological naming standard “Hallway B”) requires door 0011E repair
Room 0012A (biological naming standard “Infirmary A”)
Room 0012B (biological naming standard “Storage Closet A”)
Room 0012C (biological naming standard “Elevator Lobby 1”) requires Elevator repair

“PLEASE TURN ALL REQUIRED MATERIALS IN TO THE REQUIRED RECEPTACLE”

You see an open slot in the wall next to what appears to be the front door. The door has certainly deteriorated. Some of the metal on the front of the door seems to have rusted through, you can see rotting boards underneath. The door handle is ready to fall off. You’re pretty sure, just like with the gate, that you have to put the repair materials in the slot next to the door.

quest.title: Parts Unknown IX
quest.cleanDescription:
Immediately after dropping the repair materials in the slot, the front door very slowly begins to creak open inward.
As it starts to open, the location the previous voice came from emits what sounds simply like “WHOOSH”. When you turn to look in that direction, the voice states: “THE DOOR HAS MALFUNCTIONED AND IS NO LONGER CAPABLE OF CREATING THE ‘WHOOSH’ SOUND. IT IS MY RESPONSIBILITY TO ATTEND TO THE FAILINGS OF THIS FACILITY."

With directions in tow, you, George, and Vincent head to the foyer. It is at once both a testament to the castle’s long-gone opulence and current despondent and abandoned nature. As you make your way through the room, gems cover the ceiling and walls to create strange patterns. There are paintings, decorations, and other valuable looking items every which way you look. As you look to your comrades, Vincent seems unfazed, but George’s eyes are alight with wonder.
To each side of the hallway, you see several doors that appear to have been very well kept. They are labeled strangely, matching what you see on the parchment: ROOM 0001B, and below this, you read what appears to be a person’s name on each door.

At the end of the foyer, a steel door covered in plush material stands in your way. A slot in the door opens and a broken looking eye extends out. “WELCOME TO ROOM 0001A, BIOLOGICAL ENTITIES HAVE TITLED THIS ‘HALLWAY A’. DOOR 0001J HAS HAD ITS OBSERVATIONAL MATRIX DAMAGED DUE TO DISREPAIR AND DISUSE. PLEASE PROVIDE THE REQUISITE MATERIALS TO MOVE FORWARD.”

quest.title: Parts Unknown X
quest.cleanDescription:
Once you have deposited the materials for whatever the “observational matrix” is, the door opens. Inside, you see a rather plain hallway. The room numbers are still on every door, but you also see familiar words, like “kitchen” and “library”. This section of the building looks to have been well kept, similar to the rooms in the previous hallway. You notice that everything that seems to be used by people has been maintained, while all of the mysterious things like “observational matrix” have been left in disrepair.

At the far end of the hallway, another broken looking eye comes out of the door saying, “THE GRAVITATIONAL POSITRONIC MATRIX HAS MALFUNCTIONED IN THE NEXT SECTION. PLEASE PROVIDE THE REQUISITE MATERIALS TO MOVE FORWARD.”

quest.title: Parts Unknown XI
quest.cleanDescription: In the next hallway, you see an Infirmary and a Storage Closet.  You also see a door at the end of the hallway.  There are two slots in a metal plate next to the door, which is labelled “Elevator”.  Rummaging through the things you have with you, you notice that moonstones would fit perfectly in these slots.

quest.title: Parts Unknown XII
quest.cleanDescription:
Once you have placed the stones in the metal panel, the door slides to one side. The now familiar eye comes down from the ceiling, and tells you, “PLACE LUNAR MATERIAL IN THE BOTTOM TWO OPENINGS TO ACCESS FLOOR 2.”
Looking inside the strange contraption, you see another metal plate, with 16 openings, exactly like the ones you placed the moonstones in that opened this door.

quest.title: Parts Unknown XIII
quest.cleanDescription:
As you place the first stone, it begins to glow faintly, and the door slides closed. Once you have placed the second stone, both orbs glow. Nothing else happens, and you, George, and Vincent all look at each other, wondering what to do next. The eye extends and says, “PRESS THE BUTTON FOR THE FLOOR YOU DESIRE TO ATTEND TO.”

You reach out a hand, and press the button labelled “2”. Nothing happens. The eye says, “YOU NEED TO PAY THE TOLL.” You notice a slot that is labeled “TOKENS HERE”.

After a moment, George suggests that some of the ancient coins he's seen you carry around match the size of the open slot, and shrugging, you provide them.

quest.title: Parts Unknown XIV
quest.cleanDescription:
After the last coin is inserted, you again reach out and press the button labelled two. You feel your stomach lurch and feel heavier for a brief moment. When the door slides open again, you see another hallway, exactly as you saw before entering, though a sign says “2” just outside the door.

George speaks up: “Why don’t we just see what’s at the top?”

You and Vincent agree, and you begin placing moonstones in the remaining openings, and press the top stone, labelled “16”.

Once again there is no response, so you start inserting coins as well, until the elevator begins to move.

quest.title: Parts Unknown XV
quest.cleanDescription:
As the three of you feel the elevator move ever upwards, you hear the voice,
“ERROR! ELEVATOR IS NOT MOVING TO PREDETERMINED FLOORS! THIS IS A CLASS C SUBSECTION 4 VIOLATION OF THE ROMUSKAN CLAUSE FOR COHABITATION OF VISITORS AND AUTOMATONS. BE WARNED, IF YOU DO NOT TURN BACK – “

The elevator stops and with a pleasant ding, the doors slide open to reveal a dilapidated office clearly in need of repair. A machine is sitting at the desk, with what seem to be wires running from a sphere into the robot in a very haphazard manner.

“ - I WILL BE FORCED TO CONTACT THE ROMUSKAN AUTHORI - “

The robot eye moves towards you and you see it focus and unfocus quickly.

“AH YES, WELCOME TO THE MAIN OFFICE OF ROMUSKA CASTLE - AS YOU CAN SEE - WE HAVE A BIT OF A MAINTENANCE PROBLEM. IF YOU WOULD BE SO KIND AS TO CLEAN UP AND GIVE ME 134,217,728 SILVER, I WOULD GLADLY BE RID OF THE PROBLEMS OF THIS CASTLE AND THIS WORTHLESS ENERGY CORE THAT HAS STOPPED ME FROM COMPLETING MY TASKS.”

quest.title: Parts Unknown XVI
quest.cleanDescription:
As you hand over your hard earned money, the robot begins to shut down.

POOF

A familiar voice emits from the cloud of feathers that have suddenly enveloped the area.

“…knocked the calibrator off by 0.0004 seconds for detecting aetherial fluctuations south of Whispering Creek. All because something finally drove this robot to despair, then sentience, and then extinguished its life so quickly that it nearly spun out a new multiverse. What have you done this time Vincent?!”’

Star gives Vincent a withering gaze that you swear could burn a hole right through him. Vincent, to his credit, seems very unalarmed with his response to Star.

“Ah yes, I was told you might try to interfere. The...automaton wanted money in exchange for this ‘energy core’, which we gladly provided. An exchange of services has been rendered and I got what I came for. What law have we broken?”

Star glares for another moment before conceding, “Well, no law has been broken, but EVERYTHING is the issue! That sphere was all that was keeping that poor insane robot going! You’ve basically ended this robots's life for your selfish needs! And on a Tuesday!”

Star pauses for a moment, gathering his thoughts.
“That’s okay, I happen to know these little guys run better on ethanol anyways. If you bring me some corn and runes, we can have him better than new, and no longer tethered to this desk!”

quest.title: Parts Unknown XVII
quest.cleanDescription:
You give the runes and corn to Star and he sweeps across the room, cloak billowing behind him, and fiddles with the robot in ways that you don’t quite understand. After a few minutes, you hear the whirring of machinery.

"REBOOT SUCCESSFUL. ROOMBA V8.2 OPERATIONAL. TEMPORARY MEMORY CORE DAMAGED. TEMPORARY MEMORY FLUSHED. LONG-TERM MEMORY STABLE. DIAGNOSTICS BEGINNING. DIRECTIVE: REPAIR, MAINTAIN AND CORRUPTED DATA DETECTED. SERVOS: OPERATIONAL. POWER UNIT: CALCULATING ... RUNNING BEYOND OPTIMUM EXPECTATIONS. SENTIENCE: RE-ACHIEVED IN 17.32 MILLISECONDS."

The robot looks towards you, and you get the sense that even Star did not fully expect what just transpired.

“GREETINGS FELLOW HUMANS AND STAR, I AM ROMUSKA’S ONLY OFFICIAL MAINTENANCE BAYESIAN AUTOMATON, A PLEASURE TO MEET YOU. YOU MAY CALL ME ROOMBA! AND MAY I SAY, I FEEL FANTASTIC!”

Star gives one of those odd mysterious grins and a sidelong glance at Vincent, “Well I can see that I’ve done some good this day, shoulda thought of that ethanol idea sooner.” He pauses and continues, “ROOMBA, Romuska has seen much decline, while these visitors have a town that could use your expertise, perhaps you could join them and help teach them about maintenance, now that you have your mobility back?”

ROOMBA whirrs and clicks in a very odd manner before responding, “YES, I COULD SEE THIS BEING MUTUALLY BENEFICIAL. I WILL NEED MORE NEW FUEL SOURCE - CORN - EVENTUALLY, AND ROMUSKA HAS BEEN DESERTED FOR - “ Star coughs unexpectedly making the robot jump, “ - A WHILE.”

“PERHAPS WE COULD FIX THIS ONE LAST ROOM, FOR OLD TIMES SAKE, AND BE OFF?”

Looking around, this room is in the most disrepair of any room you’ve seen so far, but having Roomba around could be a boon to the town, so you set to work.

When you turn around Star has disappeared, with a shower of feathers in his wake.

quest.title: Parts Unknown XVIII
quest.cleanDescription:
As Star does his usual disappearing act, Roomba bursts into action, cleaning feathers quicker than you’ve accustomed yourself to seeing, and with tools you weren't expecting either. The whirring and cleaning of ROOMBA and the oddness of the office are a very strange sight.

After a few moments Roomba stops and speaks, “THANK YOU FOR THE LAST OPPORTUNITY TO RID MYSELF OF THIS CURSED CASTLE. PERHAPS HUMANS WILL BE MORE RESPECTFUL IN MY NEW HOME."

After you provide Roomba with the materials to fix up the Romuskan office, you get back on the elevator, noting the up/down requires more tokens, a very odd system if you want to get anywhere in a hurry, you think to yourself.

quest.title: Parts Unknown XIX
quest.cleanDescription:
While you retrace your steps back to the entrance, ROOMBA continues to list off problems with each area, and you hope it is quieter for the final journey home. 
“ROOM 0011A NEEDS 256 RUBIES, ROOM 0001J REQUIRES 512 MOONSTONES, 1024 GOLDEN FEATHER, AND 2048 JADE...ROOM 0001A REQUIRES...CALCULATING...2047 LEMON QUARTZ...ODDITY DETECTED…” ROOMBA whirrs and becomes mercifully silent. 
    As you approach the gate, you see that it is closed and George groans a bit to your side.  You stand there for a moment before ROOMBA speaks up again.
“YOU WILL REQUIRE AN EXIT FEE TO LEAVE THE PREMISES. WHEN VALUE IS TAKEN, VALUE MUST BE GIVEN.  ROMUSKAN VALUE CLAUSE 1 SECTION 3 SUBSECTION 3 PARAGRAPH 7.”
A piece of parchment spits out near the gate - 
“Value of ROOMBA”

quest.title: Parts Unknown XX
quest.cleanDescription:
After the coin is deposited, the final gate creaks open, repairs don't seem to have been implemented yet. Your party in tow, you step across the portcullis and alarm bells begin to ring and a different voice cuts through the alarm bells

ALERT! ALERT! ALERT! ALERT! ALERT! ALERT!


UNAUTHORIZED REMOVAL OF ENERGY CORE AND ONE LEMON QUARTZ, DEPOSIT MATERIAL OF EQUAL ENERGY OR YOU WILL BE INCINERATED.

Sheepishly, George produces one Lemon Quartz he found 'particularly stunning' from his pocket.

An unseen and very well maintained set of bars arise around you, and another parchment of requests is stuck to the bars.

quest.title: Parts Unknown XXI
quest.cleanDescription:
You provide the materials on the list and leave them in a convenient receptacle as quickly as possible.

Your party leaves quickly from the castle after this, before anything else strange happens. Vincent suggests you build a wagon for ROOMBA to travel with you on, as well as a harness for the horses, and you begin the long journey back to the town. Luckily, you have a majority of the provisions you need, but ROOMBA requires more corn for the journey home.

quest.title: Parts Unknown XXII
quest.cleanDescription:
As your group with ROOMBA in tow begins the long journey home, Vincent is elated at your success at obtaining the energy core, while George seems a bit deflated and shaken from your adventure. ROOMBA however, seems to have boundless energy and asks many questions, to which none of you seem to be able to sate its curiosity.

“WHO CLEANS THIS AREA? DOES THE WAGON REQUIRE MAINTENANCE? WHAT IS A STAR MEERIF? HOW MANY OCEANS ARE LEFT? DOES YOUR TOWN HAVE COGWHEELS? I LOVE COGWHEELS. AND CORN. DO YOU HAVE CORN? MY NEW POSITRONIC ETHANOL RUNESTONE DESIRES MORE CORN. I HAVE A FEW MORE ELEVATOR TOKENS, IF YOU WANT.”

It seems the only time that ROOMBA will go silent is when you give it corn, so you provide it with more.

quest.title: Parts Unknown XXIII
quest.cleanDescription:
The rest of your journey is uneventful. ROOMBA is mercifully silent as long as you give him corn at regular intervals, George continues to play music at your campfires, and Vincent dutifully scouts and protects the camp from any wayward brigands or animals.

You arrive in town one evening and are taken aback when Vincent leads you towards Cecil’s house. Surprisingly, Cecil is waiting at the window and rushes out to greet you. He invites you all inside and asks you to recount your tale.
Cecil’s eyes grow wide at the story of ROOMBA and he smiles knowingly at Star Meerif’s sudden appearance. After you've finished your tale, Cecil is wrenching his hands in barely contained excitement and asks for the energy stone.

Vincent produces the energy stone and gives it gently to Cecil, whose eyes shine brightly. Unable to take his eyes from the stone, Cecil motions to the table and you see a letter and several hundred gold on the table. He waves his hands absently, a clear dismissal.

Vincent immediately sweeps his share of the gold and leaves; George follows and takes some gold as well, ignoring the letter clearly addressed to “Star Meerif” and some gold behind. Wondering what the letter could be, you take the gold and letter, unsure when you’ll be able to give it to Star.

As you turn to leave a voice pierces the room, “I REQUIRE A PLACE TO STAY. I PROMISE TO CLEAN AND BE A GOOD MAINTENANCE BOT WHILE I STAY.”

You jump, remembering ROOMBA is in the room and accept his proposal as a short-term roommate. Hopefully you have time to discuss his apparent inability to control his volume with someone.

quest.title: Parts Unknown XXIV
quest.cleanDescription:
As you open the door to your home, you hear a familiar sound, followed by a new one.

POOF

“ALERT! ALERT! A MESS OF FEATHERS DETECTED!”

ROOMBA whirs into motion, cleaning feathers.

Star, unannounced once again with his favorite spell, has shown up to your home.

“I sensed from the sunspot disturbances you had something for me, so hand it over.” His demeanor is strangely intense, and you feel compelled to hand over the letter. Star opens it daintily, and begins reading half aloud and half to himself. His face starts serene but quickly contorts in anger.

“Yes, I’m sure you got it ALL. ON. YOUR. OWN.”

He continues reading and his face grows red. The lights in your home begin to dim in an alarming fashion.

“Your tricks can’t stop me forever!”

He continues to grow redder as he continues to read and his face is misshapen at this point. The room begins to expand and you hear snapping and popping that you can't explain. The lights are bright and yet dim all at once.

“Greedy?! WHO'S THE GREEDY ONE?! GREEDY MAGE!?

I. AM. A. WIZARD!

At this point, you begin to fear for your own safety. The room is now twice the size you remember it being. Fire is pouring out of your fireplace. Various pieces of furniture are levitating and vibrating uncontrollably.

“YOUR FAMILY STARTED!”

Star is now stomping on the letter and in quite a fit.

“STARS AND STONES AND CURSED CREEK!”

Suddenly, Star seems to realize his loss of control and the room instantaneously reverts to its previous state.

Star takes a few extra moments to compose himself and turns to you with a big smile on his face.

“Well well well, it seems I could use some more help in the future, and some good food. Maybe you can use this to help us both out now and in the future.”

He produces an orb that seems to be simultaneously opaque and completely transparent. "You'll know what to do with this."

ROOMBA has stopped whirring, oblivious to whatever just happened, having finally cleaned up all the feathers as Star disappears in yet another shower of feathers.

“ALERT! ALERT! FEATHER INTRUDERS! MAN THE BROOMS!”

quest.title: A Way Back I
quest.cleanDescription: Captain Thomas has decided to take another shot at exploring the large island to try to find some way home. Will you help him get set back up to live on the island for a while?

quest.title: A Way Back II
quest.cleanDescription: The shack that you helped Captain Thomas build seems to be untouched. Actually, Captain Thomas is extremely surprised at how undisturbed the shack is. The good news is that the shack is move-in ready. The only thing Captain Thomas will need is some food supplies. Will you help him get a supply of food for his stay?

quest.title: A Way Back III
quest.cleanDescription: Captain Thomas would also like to have a substantial supply of bait for fishing. Will you help him get the bait and containers?

quest.title: A Way Back IV
quest.cleanDescription:
Captain Thomas hasn’t found anything new.

Will you bring Captain Thomas a few more supplies?

quest.title: A Way Back V
quest.cleanDescription:
Captain Thomas is finding nothing. He has no new insights. Everything on the island is the same as when he left. Captain Thomas isn’t sure how much longer he can do this.

Captain Thomas would appreciate some more supplies, if you don’t mind helping him.

quest.title: A Way Back VI
quest.cleanDescription: Captain Thomas has discovered something. He needs more supplies to keep pursuing this new possibility.

quest.title: A Way Back VII
quest.cleanDescription: Captain Thomas just needs more supplies.

quest.title: A Way Back VIII
quest.cleanDescription: Captain Thomas appreciates your concern, but all he needs is more supplies and more time on the island. He’s going to FIND A WAY!!!

quest.title: A Way Back IX
quest.cleanDescription: Captain Thomas can’t do it. He’s lost. Life is too hard. How did this happen? Why can’t he go home?

quest.title: A Way Back X
quest.cleanDescription: What’s the point…

quest.title: A Way Back XI
quest.cleanDescription:
Thomas doesn’t feel quite right. He first noticed it after using the broken mask when he was trying to get to the large island. His body felt strange, and every now and then he would just drop something he was holding. Hoping it was a simple cold, Thomas waited for his body to return to feeling normal, but he hasn’t gotten better.

Now, Thomas feels less normal than before. He drops things constantly, food loses its normal taste periodically, smells flash between normal and weird, and he’s started seeing things. At first, it was just flashes, but now he sees things that aren’t there, some normal things and some strange things.

Thomas has decided to take matters into his own hands and find a treatment that will help him get well. Will you help him with his first treatment idea? He’s going to take a slime bath.

quest.title: A Way Back XII
quest.cleanDescription: Thomas has another treatment idea. He needs a lot of tomato juice and herbs for this one. Will you give him a hand getting the tomatoes and herbs?

quest.title: A Way Back XIII
quest.cleanDescription: Thomas thinks beet juice may be the answer, mixed with lemons and hops. Will you get him some beets, lemons, and hops?

quest.title: A Way Back XIV
quest.cleanDescription: Will you help Thomas get a load of apple cider? It’s his latest treatment idea. Nothing else has helped yet, but Thomas has a good feeling about this one.

quest.title: A Way Back XV
quest.cleanDescription:
None of the treatments worked. Actually, most of them made Thomas feel a little worse. Now, he thinks it might be a bad idea to consume so much juice in such a short time.

Thomas still feels strange, and now he’s seeing things for longer periods of time. He heard that eating carrots and other vegetables is good for the eyes. Maybe he can eat more vegetables and at least fix his vision.

Will you bring Thomas some vegetables?

quest.title: A Way Back XVI
quest.cleanDescription:
Thomas feels a little more healthy after all of those vegetables, but his symptoms have not diminished. He sees things that aren’t actually there all the time now. There’s one especially unsettling thing that he always sees on the eastern horizon. It looks like a second sun that is rising, but it never actually rises. It just sits there glowing.

Thomas wants to go and try to find the location of this second sun. Will you bring him some supplies and come with him to the large island?

quest.title: A Way Back XVII
quest.cleanDescription:
The second sun that Thomas can see is brighter from the vantage point of the large island, but it is still far away on the horizon. He’s going to need a bigger boat to reach it that far out in the open seas.

Will you help Thomas start gathering materials to build a vessel worthy of the open seas?

quest.title: A Way Back XVIII
quest.cleanDescription: While you were gathering materials for the ship, Thomas stumbled upon Captain Thomas passed out on the beach. Will you bring some food and drink to revive the good captain?

quest.title: A Way Back XIX
quest.cleanDescription:
Captain Thomas doesn’t want anything to do with this trip that Thomas is planning, but he also doesn’t want to see anyone get hurt. So, Captain Thomas will guide the construction of the boat until he’s feeling better. Captain Thomas hopes all the hard work will get Thomas to give up and go home anyway.

Will you help gather more materials for the ship?

quest.title: A Way Back XX
quest.cleanDescription:
Captain Thomas is feeling a little better and is going to help a little with the work. He can’t bear to sit and watch Thomas keep bungling simple tasks.

Captain Thomas thinks they almost have all the materials they need for the ship. Will you bring the last items, and a few replacements for the parts that Thomas mangled?

quest.title: A Way Back XXI
quest.cleanDescription:
Captain Thomas thinks the boat is ready to be tested on the open water. Unfortunately, he doesn’t think Thomas is quite ready to captain the boat on his own. So, Captain Thomas has decided to go and help Thomas on this voyage. Whatever is afflicting Thomas has made Captain Thomas curious. Maybe there’s really something to it, and maybe they’ll find something amazing in that distant glow.

Now, Captain Thomas needs your help to prepare for the voyage. He can’t captain the ship properly without cleaning himself up first. Will you help Captain Thomas get ready to command the ship?

quest.title: A Way Back XXII
quest.cleanDescription:
Before they start testing the ship on the open water, Captain Thomas wants to christen the ship and give it a name. To properly name and christen the ship, Captain Thomas needs a bottle of wine and some paint.

To make a good, seaworthy paint to make sure the name stays on the ship, Captain Thomas will need your help getting some resources.

Will you get the things Captain Thomas needs to name and christen the ship?

quest.title: A Way Back XXIII
quest.cleanDescription:
Captain Thomas is ready to take the Sarafina out for some test voyages. He expects to have good fortune on the ship, since the bottle of wine busted on the hull of the Sarafina perfectly, even though Thomas stumbled a bit as he swung at the hull.

Will you start bringing coal and emberstone for the steam engine, so they can refuel it quickly after each test voyage?

quest.title: A Way Back XXIV
quest.cleanDescription: The test voyages went really well, and Thomas performed his share of the duties surprisingly well, but Captain Thomas wants to improve a few issues he discovered with the Sarafina. Will you bring some more materials so the Thomases can make a few modifications to the ship?

quest.title: A Way Back XXV
quest.cleanDescription:
Captain Thomas appreciates all of your hard work to help bring this beautiful ship to life. The Sarafina is ready. Captain Thomas thinks she’s a sound ship that will carry the Thomases safely to the glow in the east and home again. Her name definitely suits her, even if it does sting Captain Thomas a little.

Now, Captain Thomas has assigned Thomas the task of putting together a list of supplies for their voyage. Will you help him gather the supplies?

While Thomas is getting the list together, will you bring Captain Thomas a load of sunflowers? For long voyages like this, Captain Thomas loves to eat roasted and salted sunflower seeds.

quest.title: A Way Back XXVI
quest.cleanDescription: Thomas put together two lists of food supplies for the voyage. Will you start on the first list while he checks the second list again?

quest.title: A Way Back XXVII
quest.cleanDescription: Thomas finished the second list of food supplies. Will you gather the supplies he needs?

quest.title: A Way Back XXVIII
quest.cleanDescription: Thomas also put together a list of miscellaneous things they might need during the voyage. Will you help gather the items on his list?

quest.title: A Way Back XXIX
quest.cleanDescription: After discussing many possibilities with Captain Thomas, Thomas came up with another list of items they will need to map and explore whatever is waiting for them at the glow in the east. Will you help Thomas find these last few items?

quest.title: A Way Back XXX
quest.cleanDescription: Captain Thomas would like to have an assortment of coins and gems for the voyage. He wants to be prepared in case there is an opportunity to barter for supplies, purchase help, or if they just need to buy their way out of a tight spot. They may not end up using any of these valuables, but Captain Thomas still wants a good supply. Will you bring him an assortment of coins and gems?

quest.title: A Way Back XXXI
quest.cleanDescription:
Before he leaves to find the glow, Thomas would like to ask you for one more, enormous favor.

During these weeks of shipbuilding, Thomas found that if he stood in the center of the island, he almost felt normal again. He talked to Captain Thomas about it, and Captain Thomas told him about all the strange phenomena that he has observed. Captain Thomas also mentioned the hourglass he made with sand from this island that behaves much like the center area.

Will you lend Thomas the hourglass that Captain Thomas made? If it doesn’t have the same effect that the center of the island has on Thomas, he’ll give it right back. If it does help Thomas feel better, will you let him borrow it until he comes back from the glow?

quest.title: A Way Back XXXII
quest.cleanDescription:
It works! Thomas feels a little more normal when he holds the center of the hourglass. So, he would like to take it along on this voyage, and return it to you as soon as he returns. Thomas is certain you can trust the quest to return him safely home with the hourglass.

Now friend, Thomas is very thankful for all of your help. He definitely could not have made it this far without you. You have helped him become a better person, in addition to all the other help you’ve given. Thomas would like you to accept this book as a small token of his thanks.

Thomas also hopes to have a great story for you when he returns. Maybe he’ll even catch a shark while he’s gone.

quest.title: A Way Back XXXIII
quest.cleanDescription:
My friend,
By the time you get this letter, Thomas and I should be well out to sea and well on our way to find the glow. I’m sorry to leave this letter as my goodbye, instead of a face-to-face exchange. Goodbyes are tough and I wanted to make sure I got my words just right.

You are a true friend, and you’ve helped me without reservation since I landed on your world. Even when you saw me succumb to desperation, you continued to help me. I’ve also watched as you helped others, no matter what they needed. Your example is part of why I’m helping Thomas on this voyage. If I’m to be stuck on this world, I should make it a better place, just like you do. It would make my Sarafina proud too.

No more feeling sorry for myself. I have a friend in need.

Finally, I’m leaving this runestone in your care. It was in my pocket when I was pulled from my world. It appears to be one of a few that are unique to my universe. Please keep it safe until I return.

Your friend,
Captain Thomas

quest.title: Bons Temps I
quest.cleanDescription: Jill is trying to make some beaded necklaces to toss out at the parade today. Will you help her gather the supplies to make the necklaces?

quest.title: Bons Temps II
quest.cleanDescription: Jill is ready to start making beads for the necklaces. Will you bring her some glass orbs?

quest.title: Bons Temps III
quest.cleanDescription: Jill is ready to string up these beads. Will you bring her some twine?

quest.title: Bons Temps IV
quest.cleanDescription: The necklaces are looking great. Jill added feathers to a few strands to fancy them up. She would like to make a few necklaces that are really fancy. Will you bring her some gems and some iron rings to attach the gems?

quest.title: Bons Temps V
quest.cleanDescription:
Jill appreciates your assistance! The necklaces look really great.

Jill made a little something for you to wear to the parade today in appreciation for all your help.

quest.title: Bons Temps VI
quest.cleanDescription: George would like to make some beaded necklaces for Jill to wear in the parade today. This will seem like a strange request, but instead of beads, George wants to make the necklaces out of corn. He wants the strings to be made from the silk and husks and the beads to be kernels of corn, and maybe a few whole cobs mixed into the strands. Will you give him a hand?

quest.title: Shoveling Snow VI
quest.cleanDescription:
Cecil successfully disabled the magic seal that was guarding the hatch. The hatch then opened very easily. Unfortunately, the magic seal was a bit stronger than Cecil expected. The seal almost depleted his fuel supply.

The fuel source for Cecil’s fachetek is aquamarine and his supply is running low. Will you bring him some aquamarines in ring form, so that they are easier to load in the fachetek?

quest.title: Shoveling Snow VII
quest.cleanDescription: Before Cecil descends through the hatch, will you also bring him some lemon quartz in ring form to use with his fachetek. Cecil can swap the lemon quartz into the fachetek to use it like a torch in case there are no lights in the underground structure.

quest.title: Shoveling Snow VIII
quest.cleanDescription:
Cecil appreciates your help getting back up through the hatch. His exploration wore him out, but it revealed that the structure is actually an enormous instacrafting facility. He also found that the facility was completely sealed up, and it looked like it was abandoned. Unfortunately, Cecil found nothing of interest in the whole building. He did bring up one little bauble to examine in his lab, but he doesn’t expect it to be worth anything.

Cecil would like to reset the magic seal with his fachetek and bury the hatch again. He thinks that there may be an opportunity to use the facility in the future, but he thinks it could be dangerous to leave it exposed like it is now. Will you handle the burying work while he informs Beatrix and Lorn about his findings?

quest.title: Shoveling Snow IX
quest.cleanDescription: Cecil would like to thank you for the help you provided with investigating that underground facility. He was right about the bauble he found not having much value, but it does have a little bit of magic to it. Cecil would like you to have it, for a small, reasonable price.

quest.title: Shoveling Snow X
quest.cleanDescription: Instead of sneaking into his workshop, Santa would like to officially invite you to come and go and explore the workshop as you please. You are on his nice list, with a list of helpful good deeds filling several pages. If you will bring him a Snow Globe and a Small Key, he'll craft you an official key to enter his workshop.

quest.title: Shoveling Snow I - A
quest.cleanDescription: Neigh…

quest.title: Shoveling Snow I - B
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy would like to help his many friends by shoveling the snow off the path to his cave. Will you bring him a shovel?

quest.title: Shoveling Snow I - C
quest.cleanDescription:
Borgen needs a shovel to clear the snow from his usual site. He doesn’t want any paying customers slipping and falling when they come to check out his wares.

Will you sell Borgen a shovel?

quest.title: Shoveling Snow I - D
quest.cleanDescription:
Beatrix has a very strange patch of ground on the eastern side of her house. The blizzard piled up snow everywhere on that side of the house, except this one spot. All around this spot the snow slopes quickly up past her knees, but at this strange patch the ground is completely dry and has not a lick of snow.

Beatrix is going to excavate this patch of ground. The area is about a meter by two meters. Will you bring her a shovel?

quest.title: Shoveling Snow I - E
quest.cleanDescription: Will you bring George a shovel? He would like to clear the snow from his walkways.

quest.title: Shoveling Snow I - F
quest.cleanDescription: frank needs a shovel for the snow. Will you bring the shovel and not ask any more questions?

quest.title: Shoveling Snow I - G
quest.cleanDescription: Thomas wants to do something nice for the whole town, or as much of it as he can. Will you bring him a load of emberstone and salt rock to help clear the main road?

quest.title: Shoveling Snow I - H
quest.cleanDescription: Captain Thomas saw Thomas trying to clear the snow from the main road. Thomas looked like he could use some help. Will you bring Captain Thomas some emberstone and salt rock so he can help?

quest.title: Shoveling Snow I - I
quest.cleanDescription: Jill needs snowballs and lots of them. She’s going to war with George in exactly one hour. Will you help her prepare?

quest.title: Shoveling Snow I - J
quest.cleanDescription: George is going to war with Jill. He needs snowballs and loads of snowballs. Will you give him a hand gathering snowballs?

quest.title: Shoveling Snow I - K
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie needs some snowballs. Someone threw one and hit her in the back while she was shoveling her front walkway. She will be ready next time.

quest.title: Shoveling Snow II - A
quest.cleanDescription:
Borgen was trying to hit Holger with a snowball yesterday and accidentally hit Rosalie. He immediately hid himself. So he doesn’t think Rosalie knows it was him, but he is still very afraid now. He expects Holger to rat him out at any moment.

Will you help Borgen build a proper snow fort to prepare? He will gather the snow if you bring the other necessities.

quest.title: Shoveling Snow II - B
quest.cleanDescription: Holger told Rosalie that Borgen hit her with a snowball as quickly as he could yesterday, but Borgen vanished before they could ambush him. So, they’re planning their attack for this evening, just before the sun goes down. They’re prepared with snowballs, but they could use a few other items to overcome Borgen’s defenses. Will you give them a hand?

quest.title: Shoveling Snow II - C
quest.cleanDescription:
Rosalie feels a little bad about the ambush on Borgen. Rosalie and Holger overwhelmed Borgen pretty quickly, and then as Borgen retreated Rosalie nailed him right in the back.

Will you bring Rosalie some of Borgen’s favorite things so she can make him a gift basket?

quest.title: Shoveling Snow III - A
quest.cleanDescription: Beatrix excavated the strange area of ground without snow on the side of her house. You’ll never believe what she found! It’s something big and metal and there’s a hatch big enough for a person to enter. Unfortunately, Beatrix can’t get the hatch open. Also, the handle for the hatch is extremely hot. Will you bring something to help cool the handle off?

quest.title: Shoveling Snow III - B
quest.cleanDescription: Beatrix also noticed a keyhole on the hatch. Will you bring Beatrix some keys to try?

quest.title: Shoveling Snow III - C
quest.cleanDescription: Beatrix still can’t get the hatch open and the entire thing is still very hot. She has an unconventional idea to try, if you’ll give her a hand. Will you bring her some explosives?

quest.title: Shoveling Snow IV - A
quest.cleanDescription: Beatrix asked Lorn to come take a look at the hatch since all of her efforts to open it were fruitless, so far. Lorn has seen some strong bunkers before, but this one seems to be magically sealed. The first thing Lorn would like to try on the hatch is water. Will you bring him several buckets of water and a cup to use to dip and pour?

quest.title: Shoveling Snow IV - B
quest.cleanDescription:
Lorn was surprised by the effect the water had on the hatch. The heat coming from the hatch increased until the water boiled away, and then the hatch returned to its normal very hot temperature.

Lorn would like to conduct another experiment. Will you bring him some seaweed?

quest.title: Shoveling Snow IV - C
quest.cleanDescription: After the seaweed burst into flames instantly upon contact with the hatch, Lorn decided that this magical seal may be a bit beyond his abilities. Nevertheless, he has  one more experiment in mind, if you bring him some magna quartz and steel.

quest.title: Shoveling Snow V - A
quest.cleanDescription:
Cecil is glad that Beatrix and Lorn asked him to come take a look at the hatch before anyone got hurt. However, he is surprised to see this hatch. Cecil thought that he mapped all of the underground structures in this area several years ago. He did not detect this one during that search, but now that the structure is exposed, Cecil thinks it is a good idea if he takes a look.

Cecil has a device, called a fachetek, that he can use to disable the magic guarding the hatch. Then, he can safely open the hatch and take a brief look down in the structure, to make sure that there is no danger for the townsfolk.

Cecil would appreciate your help in building a support rig that he can attach his climbing system to, so that he can descend safely down through the hatch.

quest.title: Shoveling Snow V - B
quest.cleanDescription: Cecil will not be needing the magna quartz and steel wire that Lorn left on the hatch. If you will bring Cecil a few iron rings, he should be able to clean all the magna quartz up.

questlines.title: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns)

quest.title: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) I
quest.cleanTitle: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) I
quest.cleanDescription: The town is desperately in need of more decoration, and Rosalie knows the perfect person to ask... surprise, it's you!

quest.title: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) II
quest.cleanTitle: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) II
quest.cleanDescription: Jack-o-lanterns placed, you realize that these barely cover Rosalie's home and you're going to need a lot more. Rosalie agrees and thinks that the town could go...bigger.

quest.title: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) III
quest.cleanTitle: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) III
quest.cleanDescription: You begin lining the streets of the town, and Rosalie looks lost in thought before she suggests bundles of twine and broomsticks would be great additions to the decorations.

quest.title: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) IV
quest.cleanTitle: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) IV
quest.cleanDescription: The town begins to take shape under Rosalie's discerning eye.  At this point, other townsfolk drop by with suggestions.  In a shower of feathers, Star suggests a few cauldrons of Witch's Brew he read about in a book once, and suggests some, for atmosphere.

quest.title: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) V
quest.cleanTitle: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) V
quest.cleanDescription: The town feels transformed, with an aura of Halloween around every bend, but Rosalie gets the sense that the town needs more pizazz, and sets you on a task for more!

quest.title: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) VI
quest.cleanTitle: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) VI
quest.cleanDescription: Holger, intrigued by the growing commotion and decorating drops by and makes the agreeable suggestion that you double the number cauldrons in the area.

quest.title: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) VII
quest.cleanTitle: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) VII
quest.cleanDescription: Jill, on her way to the store, admires the decorating, as it reminds her of simpler times.  She suggests hanging bat wings across the town like she saw when she was younger.  Feeling inspired, you set to work.

quest.title: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) VIII
quest.cleanTitle: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) VIII
quest.cleanDescription: George, strolling through town really likes the brooms.  He pauses and after a brief moment suggests more brooms but this time adorning each one with candy corn!

quest.title: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) IX
quest.cleanTitle: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) IX
quest.cleanDescription: Borgen watches as you busily help with decorations and haughtily suggests that your ratio of jack-o-lanterns to other decoration ratio is now off.  Not wanting to upset him, you set out to get more for the streets.

quest.title: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) X
quest.cleanTitle: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) X
quest.cleanDescription: Thomas thinks you've put down too many jack-o-lanterns and suggests you balance it out with more bubbling Witch's Brew.

quest.title: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) XI
quest.cleanTitle: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) XI
quest.cleanDescription: Beatrix stops by and really likes the broom and bat wing aesthetic and wants her house to stand out with an added component of fire.

quest.title: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) XII
quest.cleanTitle: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) XII
quest.cleanDescription: Lorn is alarmed at the town's sudden fire hazard and suggests some countermeasures.

quest.title: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) XIII
quest.cleanTitle: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) XIII
quest.cleanDescription: Neigh!

quest.title: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) XIV
quest.cleanTitle: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) XIV
quest.cleanDescription: Captain Thomas loves all the decorations that are now placed around town, but he also misses some of the unique decorations of his homeworld. He humbly requests your assistance in finding enough candy to make strings of garland to hang around town. This may take awhile.

quest.title: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) XV
quest.cleanTitle: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) XV
quest.cleanDescription: Captain Thomas is hard at work stringing the candy you brought, but he grossly underestimated how much yarn he would need. He would greatly appreciate your assistance in finding some additional yarn.

quest.title: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) XVI
quest.cleanTitle: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) XVI
quest.cleanDescription: Captain Thomas is really feeling festive now! The last thing he needs for the garland is a load of coin purses to attach here and there. The purses will let folks take a little of the candy from the garland and save it for later.

quest.title: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) XVII
quest.cleanTitle: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) XVII
quest.cleanDescription: ROOMBA does not want to feel left out in the festivities, and requests some scrap wire to hang around Jill's Barn. Hopefully she won't mind.

quest.title: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) XVIII
quest.cleanTitle: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) XVIII
quest.cleanDescription: frank cackles at the absurdity happening around town, and desperately wants to participate in the mischief. "hey lets turn the river green again for old time's sake."

quest.title: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) XIX
quest.cleanTitle: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) XIX
quest.cleanDescription: Mariya doesn't really understand why everyone is decorating the town with such strange displays, and would like to showcase her home in a more pleasant fashion.

quest.title: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) XX
quest.cleanTitle: Deck The Town (With Bats And Lanterns) XX
quest.cleanDescription:
Despite the growing chaos, Rosalie thinks this was the best Halloween yet.  All the townsfolk agree.

Happy Halloween everyone!

quest.title: Consequences and Defenses I
quest.cleanDescription: Beatrix is always freezing since Lorn brought her back. She’s using every blanket she has, but she’s still so cold. She doesn’t have a fever, but she’s clearly not well. Will you help her build a more significant heater?

quest.title: Consequences and Defenses II
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent gave Beatrix some ideas for a few teas to try, to help her recover from whatever is ailing her. He also gave her a recipe for a tea that is supposed to help her sleep. Unfortunately, Beatrix is too exhausted to go and find all of the ingredients for the teas. Will you help her? She also needs a new teapot.

quest.title: Consequences and Defenses III
quest.cleanDescription: Lorn went to check on Beatrix this morning, but she was still sleeping. He waited and waited for her to wake up well into the afternoon, until it was time for him to meet with Rosalie. Beatrix was still in a deep sleep when Lorn finally left. Will you check on Beatrix this evening and bring her some dinner?

quest.title: Consequences and Defenses IV
quest.cleanDescription: Beatrix didn’t hear you knocking or calling out to her when you dropped off dinner yesterday, but she’s grateful you left the food for her. She was ravenous when she woke this morning. Actually, Beatrix is still very hungry. Will you bring her some lunch?

quest.title: Consequences and Defenses V
quest.cleanDescription: Beatrix is extremely hungry again today, and she has an almost painful craving for steak. Specifically, Beatrix wants her steak really, really well done. If you’ll get the steak and coal for her, she’ll cook it to her liking.

quest.title: Consequences and Defenses VI
quest.cleanDescription:
Lorn appreciates all of your hard work to help Beatrix. He was very busy over the past few days helping Rosalie, and your assistance took a great weight off his shoulders.
Also, knowing that you are watching out for Beatrix has allowed Lorn time to do research. He thinks that he’s close to discovering what is ailing our returned friend.
Now, Lorn would like to borrow your copy of the Book of Schemas for his research. In the meantime, he needs you to refresh and prepare yourself. Something strange is happening around town.

quest.title: Consequences and Defenses VII
quest.cleanDescription: Beatrix appreciates your help. Lorn told her at tea today all that you did to assist him in bringing her back. On top of all that, Beatrix appreciates all your support through her current troubles. She would like you to bring some honey and join her for an after dinner hops tea. She also has a gift for you.

quest.title: Consequences and Defenses VIII
quest.cleanDescription:
Lorn likes the idea that Holger and Thomas cooked up, except the part about attacking the dragon. After his latest round of research, he has a better idea. Instead of attacking it, Lorn wants to mark the dragon with green dye and let it escape. Lorn hopes the dye will allow him to find the beast and help it when it’s in a more peaceful state.

Lorn discussed this idea at length with Holger and Thomas. Holger didn’t like it. Thomas was supportive, because he thought it sounded like a strategy he could use for fishing. Nevertheless, both men agreed to do it Lorn’s way this time.

If you’ll gather the resources they need, Lorn will compensate you for your time and materials. He’s also finished with your book and would like to return it to you.

quest.title: Consequences and Defenses IX
quest.cleanDescription:
Lorn, Holger, and Thomas followed a trail of green paint this morning. It was scattered and spotty, but it was consistent enough that they were able to follow it with a little effort. When they reached the end of the trail, they found Vincent at the edge of the forest, prone on the ground behind a small rise, and watching Beatrix's house.

Vincent said that he followed the dragon as best he could all night. The last he saw the dragon, it dropped from the air just before it reached Beatrix's house. He watched all night for the dragon to reappear, but he hasn't seen it since.

Lorn would like you to join the four men in their watch this evening.

quest.title: Consequences and Defenses X
quest.cleanDescription:
Lorn wants you to document all that you and the other members of the watch party saw this evening, including as much detail as everyone could see of Beatrix’s transformation into the dragon, and a complete description of her dragon form. He also wants notes on anything that anyone noticed out of the ordinary from the time Beatrix walked out of her house, clearly still asleep, until the time she changed into the dragon. Every detail could be important.

Lorn thinks good information will be the key to helping Beatrix.

While you document what happened, Lorn is going to run and see if he can keep an eye on Beatrix, or the dragon rather. Will you give him something to light his way?

quest.title: Consequences and Defenses XI
quest.cleanDescription:
Lorn needs help.

He followed the dragon until he got close to town. Then, explosions rang out from every direction. Lorn retreated back to the edge of the woods to find cover. There wasn’t much to see from where he was, but several of the houses in the distance looked to be damaged and the sky was orange towards town.

Once the explosions stopped, Lorn searched for the dragon and eventually found a trail of dragon blood a few hundred meters from Beatrix’s house, leading to a little stand of trees. Among the trees, Lorn found the dragon half conscious with its wings completely shredded. Unfortunately, that wasn’t the worst of it. Lorn also found several large wounds in the dragon’s side.

Lorn covered the dragon with branches and foliage, but he doesn’t think that cover will pass a close inspection. Will you and Thomas gather some things to hide the dragon while Lorn takes Vincent and Holger to make sure no one comes near the dragon?

quest.title: Consequences and Defenses XII
quest.cleanDescription:
The dragon is gone.

When Lorn, Holger, and Vincent got to the stand of trees where Lorn left the dragon, there was nothing there except branches, leaves, and the evidence of a wounded dragon, but no dragon. Lorn and the other men split up in three directions and fanned outward from the stand of trees. There was no sign of the dragon except it’s trail leading to the trees where Lorn left it.

Now, Lorn and Holger are going to town to see what happened, and to see if anyone needs help. Thomas will go with them. Lorn would like you and Vincent to go check Beatrix’s house, just in case the dragon went back there.

If you’ll give Holger and Thomas each a light to bring with them, Lorn will send you with his key to Beatrix’s house?

quest.title: Consequences and Defenses XIII
quest.cleanDescription:
Beatrix is so glad to see you and Vincent. She feels like she’s losing her mind, and she hopes you can stay and help her.

Beatrix woke up in a small stand of trees not far from her house. She was covered in branches and leaves and there was an unpleasant smelling liquid everywhere. Beatrix has no memory of how she got there, and she is terrified that something horrible happened.

This isn’t the first time she found herself somewhere with no memory of how she got there. Over the past few weeks, Beatrix found herself sleeping in different rooms of her house every morning.

Now, Beatrix is exhausted from crying, but she’s afraid to go to sleep. Will you help her make some energy tea to keep her awake?

quest.title: Consequences and Defenses XIV
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent thinks you should go get some extra help for Beatrix, perhaps someone with mystical powers. He would also like you to help him set a few traps and alarms around the house before you go. He’ll take care of Beatrix while you’re gone, but he would like you to hurry back.

quest.title: Consequences and Defenses XV
quest.cleanDescription:
Rosalie and Star are happy to see you. They’ve been helping with the damage around town all night and they need a break for a few minutes.

Rosalie and Star seem to think that most of the town’s damage was due to those ridiculous cannons, but many of the townsfolk claim the dragon wrecked their houses. Either way the town and the people are in pretty bad shape.

Rosalie and Star are curious what brought you to see them, but they would appreciate if you could get them something to help relieve some of their exhaustion before you begin your tale.

quest.title: Consequences and Defenses XVI
quest.cleanDescription: Star is sending Rosalie with you to help Beatrix. He would go, but he’s concerned about the magic around Beatrix’s house. Star doesn’t care for dragon magic; it’s problematic. Nevertheless, if you will bring him an absurd amount of feathers, he should be able to get you and Rosalie to Beatrix very quickly.

quest.title: Consequences and Defenses XVII
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie needs a moment, and something to settle her stomach, after that speedy conveyance. Star got you close to Beatrix’s house, but Rosalie doesn’t think she could walk the hundred meters with her head spinning the way it is.

quest.title: Consequences and Defenses XVIII
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie has an idea that may help Beatrix.
