Rosalie’s magic can’t repair the broken spell within Beatrix, but she can see the spell and see that it looks jagged, as if it’s torn. It’s not a magic that Rosalie is familiar with, but she thinks that she might be able to fix it with an assortment of different magics. Will you help her gather some different runestones to try?

quest.title: Consequences and Defenses XIX
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie thinks that she repaired the spell inside Beatrix, but something strange is happening. She would like you and Vincent to make a stretcher and carry the now sleeping Beatrix outside.

quest.title: Consequences and Defenses XX
quest.cleanDescription: Beatrix is transforming into a dragon. She also seems to be asking for something, but it’s hard to make out her words. It sounds a little like she wants you to play the flute she gave you.

quest.title: Consequences and Defenses XXI
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie says that the mewing and growling you hear is actually the dragon trying to speak to you. The dragon’s name is Geist and she wants Rosalie to make a translation ring for you. Rosalie needs a suitable ring and she’ll give it a try.

quest.title: Consequences and Defenses XXII
quest.cleanDescription:
Geist is glad that you came to help Beatrix. Beatrix was suffering due to that damaged spell. For now, she’s resting easy.

Geist was also suffering. She awoke each night not knowing who, when, or where she was. She was so terrified and confused and hungry that she tried to eat a horse, instead of the fish she now remembers that she prefers. She’s very glad to have her memory back.

Unfortunately, Geist still needs your help. The spell that Rosalie repaired was meant to suppress Beatrix’s dragon form and the painful memories of their shared ancient past. Geist was able to remove the spell after Rosalie fixed it in such a creative way, but that brings them back to the original problem. Geist thinks Beatrix will be overwhelmed by the flood of thousands of years of painful memories. She thinks it may destroy Beatrix.

Will you help Geist with a new spell? She wants to take all of their memories, beyond Beatrix’s time in this town, and store them in a flame orb. Then, she would like you to protect the orb until Geist and Beatrix both ask for it.

quest.title: Defenses and Consequences I
quest.cleanDescription: George has an idea to help protect the townsfolk from the dragon. With approval from the mayor, George is leading a large work crew to build dugout dragon shelters all around town. Everyone in town is being asked to contribute. For your part, will you help George gather the tools and building materials to start a few of the shelters?

quest.title: Defenses and Consequences II
quest.cleanDescription: George needs more building materials for the dragon shelters. Will you help get the items he needs?

quest.title: Defenses and Consequences III
quest.cleanDescription: George thinks that with everyone contributing, he’ll only need a couple more loads of building materials.

quest.title: Defenses and Consequences IV
quest.cleanDescription: The dragon shelters are almost finished. George thinks this should be the last load of building materials.

quest.title: Defenses and Consequences V
quest.cleanDescription: Ric arrived in town yesterday. With all the destruction from the dragon, he couldn’t find a place to stay. He ended up sleeping under a tree in the woods outside of town. Do you have a room he could rent for a few days?

quest.title: Defenses and Consequences VI
quest.cleanDescription:
Ric appreciates the room you rented to him. He traveled from far in the west, prompted by rumors that a dragon was attacking this town. Now that he has seen the destruction, he believes the rumors. Ric hasn't seen the dragon yet, but he's ready to help stop it.

Ric had to travel light to get here so quickly. Will you help him build up an arsenal that he can use to stop the dragon and defend the town?

quest.title: Defenses and Consequences VII
quest.cleanDescription:
Ric found the mayor today and discussed an offensive strategy to use against the dragon. The mayor agreed to let Ric direct a crew in the building of large-scale offensive weapons around town.

Everyone is being asked to contribute. Will you help gather materials to build ballistas?

quest.title: Defenses and Consequences VIII
quest.cleanDescription: The mayor wouldn't agree to Ric's plan to have cannons in town, but the mayor did approve the use of cannons on the outskirts. Ric needs more materials for his crews to build enough cannons to cover the entire town. Everyone needs to contribute.

quest.title: Defenses and Consequences IX
quest.cleanDescription: Ric needs more black powder for the cannons and more iron for the cannonballs.

quest.title: Defenses and Consequences X
quest.cleanDescription: Ric is ready to start patrolling at night to watch for the dragon. Will you get him some things to help him stay energized?

quest.title: Defenses and Consequences XI
quest.cleanDescription:
Ric is now the official town dragon hunter. After Ric informed the mayor about all of the damage that the dragon caused, the mayor has given Ric broad authority to capture and destroy the dragon by any means possible.

Ric is beginning his efforts by collecting additional resources to help his hunt. Everyone in town will now be expected to contribute daily to the town relief fund. Ric is managing the funds and resources collected. He will also be doing regular check-ins with the townsfolk to collect their contributions and to search for the dragon, or its remains.

Anyone that fails to contribute, or that fails to report any dragon sightings, will be sent to the newly formed Mt. Banon Work Camp.

Ric intends for the work camp to be a way to help provide resources for the town relief fund, and a way to ensure law and order during his hunt for the dragon.

quest.title: Defenses and Consequences XII
quest.cleanDescription:
Lorn appreciated your report about our mutual friend. He is also thankful that the dragon sightings have stopped.

However, Lorn is concerned about the townsfolk. Much of the damage from the wildly misfired cannons was repaired, but many people are hurting financially. The forced contributions to the relief fund drained what little some folks had left. Some of these less fortunate were hauled off to the Mt. Banon Work Camp this morning.

Lorn wants your help in forming a council. The goal of this council will be to help the people of the town, and to stop Ric Ryph before he takes things any further. Lorn has invited Holger, Thomas, and Rosalie already. If you are willing to join the council, Lorn would like you to recruit four more townsfolk that you trust. He has prepared letters for you to share with those you recruit. The letters should be destroyed after they are read. Everyone that accepts this invitation should provide a golden leaf to mark their commitment to the council.

quest.title: Defenses and Consequences XIII
quest.cleanDescription:
Jill is concerned about Lorn’s letter. There is great danger in opposing Ric. It could mean the end of her farm and all that she has built. She’s also concerned about the townsfolk. Ric is causing more suffering than the dragon ever did.

She wishes her mom was still around to give her some advice.

Jill thinks her mom would tell her to trust her friends. Her mom would probably also repeat that saying about injustice pouring on our neighbors eventually splashing on us. So, not opposing Ric might come back to ruin everything Jill has worked for anyway.

Jill has decided. She has a gold leaf for you.

quest.title: Defenses and Consequences XIV
quest.cleanDescription:
Charles heard that you have a translation ring and that you can understand him now.

Charles is greatly disturbed by what’s happening to the townsfolk. He wants to help.

quest.title: Defenses and Consequences XV
quest.cleanDescription:
George read Lorn’s letter and paced around the room. Then, he reread it and paced around the room again. He reread the letter and paced a few more times before sitting down.

George thought he was done with fighting. However, if you give him a minute to find it, he has a gold leaf for you.

quest.title: Defenses and Consequences XVI
quest.cleanDescription:
Cecil’s horse returned today. It is missing a leg, but it is otherwise unharmed. Now Cecil thinks the horse needs a name, after all it has been through. He likes the name “Lucky Lady”.

Cecil also thinks Lorn is right. Like his Lucky Lady, it is time for those hurt in this difficult time to come home. Cecil will join the council, but he would like compensation for his gold leaf.

quest.title: Defenses and Consequences XVII
quest.cleanDescription:
Lorn is so glad to see the Council of the Golden Leaf together. Now, he wants to begin the work of opposing Ric by appealing to the mayor and the townsfolk. It’s not the most exciting tactic, but Lorn wants to keep the council well within the law.

The council needs a load of parchment, quills, and ink. Will you help gather the supplies?

quest.title: Defenses and Consequences XVIII
quest.cleanDescription: Ric has returned to collect another relief fund contribution. He needs something different  from you this time. Contributions are running a bit low right now. Specifically, Ric’s ink supplier had a bit of misfortune recently. Ric hopes you’ll be luckier.

quest.title: Defenses and Consequences XIX
quest.cleanDescription:
Lorn called this emergency council meeting to discuss the mayor’s death and to propose a change in plans.

Lorn suspects Ric had a hand in the mayor’s death last night. Ric claims that the mayor was perfectly well at their dinner yesterday evening, and that when they parted, the mayor was still alive. However, Lorn was told by the mayor, before that dinner with Ric, that he was going to end the work camp and relieve Ric of his duties. Lorn doesn’t believe in coincidences like this.

Another dangerous coincidence may arise when the Board of Founders meets tomorrow to appoint an interim mayor. Lorn will be voting for himself, but he’s afraid the other founders may be “convinced” to vote for someone that supports Ric.

Lorn thinks it’s time to start preparing an operation to rescue and hide the work camp prisoners, instead of waiting on a change in town policy. Will you help gather supplies for the rescue mission?

quest.title: Defenses and Consequences XX
quest.cleanDescription:
Ric is honored to be the interim mayor. He was as SURPRISED as anyone that the Board of Founders appointed him, on a nearly unanimous vote too. In fact, before the vote, Ric was sure the members of the Board of Founders would need more convincing to vote for him.

Ric thinks that, as the new mayor, he needs to have a house in town. He had a cabin built for him at the Mt. Banon Work Camp, but that’s too far out of the way to handle the day-to-day affairs of the town. He needs to be closer.

Instead of the usual contributions to the relief fund, Ric is asking everyone to take a break and instead help build a mayor’s house for the town. He will use the new mayor’s house as his residence during his interim term, and then it will be a place for the next mayor to reside.

Ric requests that you bring a load of building materials and tools to help build the mayor’s house.

quest.title: Defenses and Consequences XXI
quest.cleanDescription:
Lorn is preparing a place to bring the work camp prisoners. He is working with a friend that wanted to join the council, but instead decided he could do his best work on the outside. They have prepared a well hidden location, but now they need to stock it with supplies.

Will you gather the food supplies? Lorn thinks 2 separate loads will work best. You can leave them in your barn and Lorn’s friend will move them throughout the night to the shelter.

quest.title: Defenses and Consequences XXII
quest.cleanDescription: Lorn would like you to have the second load of food supplies ready tonight.

quest.title: Friday the 13th I
quest.cleanDescription: Unlucky, unlucky, unlucky. frank needs your help to ward off the onslaught of bad luck from Friday the 13th. Collect all the ladders in town so he won’t accidentally walk under them, and he heard some friends say trout scales are lucky.

quest.title: Friday the 13th II
quest.cleanDescription: frank is still worried about all the bad luck out there. Help him with some more lucky charms. Some horseshoes and clovers should keep most of it at bay, and bring a few scarabs just in case.

quest.title: Friday the 13th III
quest.cleanDescription: Salt, frank needs salt to throw over his shoulder. And more clovers too, there’s no taking any chances on such an unlucky day.

quest.title: Friday the 13th IV
quest.cleanDescription: frank heard acorns were lucky.  and pears, strangely enough. he would feel a lot safer if you brought a few ladders too.  and some salt.  luck is weird.

quest.title: Shark Week I
quest.cleanDescription: Thomas wants to catch a shark. He's going  to try something different for bait. Will you bring him a shovel so he can dig up some new and different worms? He'll gladly give you all of the useless stuff he digs up as payment, and he'll return the shovel when he's done.

quest.title: Shark Week II
quest.cleanDescription: Thomas did not catch a shark using worms. So, he would like to try something a little bigger for bait. He'll give you some stuff he found on the beach in exchange for some largemouth bass.

quest.title: Shark Week III
quest.cleanDescription: Thomas still hasn't caught a shark, but he's not giving up. He decided to use something really different as bait. If you'll bring him a couple of bluegill and some mushroom paste, he'll give you a shark tooth he found on the beach.

quest.title: Shark Week IV
quest.cleanDescription: Thomas found 2 more shark teeth while he was trying out the new bait you helped him create. He is now convinced that he is on the trail of a massive shark. If you'll bring him more mushroom paste, bones, and feathers, you can have the shark teeth he found.

quest.title: Secrets With Lorn I
quest.cleanDescription:
Lorn wants to have a secret way of sharing information and items with you. He set up a mailbox at the Post Office. It requires a password. You can access the mailbox if you can discover the password from this clue.

The watermelon has a relative that you can grow at level 40.

After you solve the clue and enter the password, bring Lorn the contents of the mailbox for a reward. He’ll also let you keep what was in the mailbox after you show him you were successful.

quest.title: Secrets With Lorn II
quest.cleanDescription:
Lorn has another secret item to share with you. He already set it up in the Post Office. Here’s the password clue.

Clear Away Near Darkness. Light, Emit.

quest.title: Irrational Numbers I
quest.cleanDescription: Holger is making a pie today. Will you help him gather some of the ingredients?

quest.title: Irrational Numbers II
quest.cleanDescription: Will you bring Holger some apples to use in his pie? He also needs some iron to make a custom pie pan.

quest.title: Irrational Numbers III
quest.cleanDescription: Holger grossly miscalculated how many apples he needs. Will you bring him some more apples? He also needs a few lemons.

quest.title: Quarter Million I
quest.cleanDescription:
Holy smokes! Redbrook just continues to grow. A recent census survey was completed and it looks like the population has surpassed 250,000 residents! That's a lot of farmers.

To celebrate, we are giving out some useful items and resources to everybody! So here, take these!

quest.title: Quarter Million II
quest.cleanDescription: Here are some more goodies for you since you've been a resident of Redbrook for a bit.

quest.title: Quarter Million III
quest.cleanDescription: And here are even more things for our experienced farmers!  Thank you for all you do around here!

quest.title: Quarter Million IV
quest.cleanDescription: So you've made it to the Tower?  Well, maybe these items will be useful as you continue to climb it.

quest.title: Quarter Million V
quest.cleanDescription: Wow, you are way up there!  Maybe these items will be of some use.

quest.title: Quarter Million VI
quest.cleanDescription: We are blown away at your progress and what you've done for the community of Redbrook.  As a token of thanks, take these items!

quest.title: Better Late Than Never I
quest.cleanDescription: Beatrix had a pretty rough week and forgot to get her valentines. Will you get her some cards to send out? She’d rather be late than to make anyone feel she forgot them entirely.

quest.title: Better Late Than Never II
quest.cleanDescription: Star tried with all his power to get back in time for Valentine’s Day, but a dark force kept him rather entangled longer than he expected. And honestly, he thought he had 2 more days. Now, Star is going to need a hand to get caught up. Will you help him with a few things?

quest.title: Better Late Than Never III
quest.cleanDescription: Thomas still ended up being short on heart necklaces for Valentine’s Day. Is there any chance you could hunt down a few more? He would still like to give them all out, even if it is a bit late.

quest.title: Better Late Than Never IV
quest.cleanDescription: George would like to send everyone a bottle of wine that sent him a valentine. Will you help him get a couple hundred bottles?

quest.title: Breaking The Ice I
quest.cleanDescription: Captain Logan heard a tale about your experience at Glacier Lake. He also heard about the fish you have caught there. All of it sounds amazing, and he would love to start fishing there too. The market for these exotic fish could be incredible! Unfortunately, Captain Logan doesn’t have a great way of getting a ship into those waters. For now, could you provide him some of the fish from your hauls to help get the market for these fish going, while he works on getting his operation set up?

quest.title: Breaking The Ice II
quest.cleanDescription: Captain Logan would love to get two more loads of the fish you caught for him, and then he’d like for you to bring him two loads of any new fish you can find. There is a lot of interest building for these Glacier Lake fish.

quest.title: Breaking The Ice III
quest.cleanDescription: Captain Logan is ready for the next load at your earliest convenience.

quest.title: Breaking The Ice IV
quest.cleanDescription: If you’ve found any new and exciting fish in your nets, Captain Logan is ready to bring them to market.

quest.title: Breaking The Ice V
quest.cleanDescription: Captain Logan would love another load of the more rare fish that you caught. Everyone is fascinated by these strange fish.

quest.title: Breaking The Ice VI
quest.cleanDescription:
The market is loving Glacier Lake fish! Your help was absolutely essential to getting this market growing and it was very much appreciated.

Now, Captain Logan’s crew is making good progress at fishing Glacier Lake on their own. Unfortunately, there is a strange shell that continues to elude their nets. The crew has encountered these shells several times, but they can’t haul one in.

Will you try your nets at hauling in a load of these shells for Captain Logan?

quest.title: Let's Play Pirates I
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy really wants someone to play pirates with.  He’d like you to bring the best pirate garb you can find, and he will bring an authentic pirate chest.  He promises you can have everything back when you're done.

quest.title: Let's Play Pirates II
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy has asked you to fill a treasure chest with all sorts of shiny things to use as your pirate treasure.  Buddy believes friendship is its own reward, and he promises again that you can have everything back when you're done.

quest.title: Let's Play Pirates III
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy has taken townsfolk hostage in his cave to “play pirate prisoner” with you.  Alarmingly, none of them seem to have agreed or known about this.  Buddy challenges you to a duel with the townsfolk’s freedom as the prize!

quest.title: Let's Play Pirates IV
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy is impressed with your fighting skill, and happy that you have spent some time with him.  You have rescued the townspeople, and sent them back home. Buddy wants to know if you will be his best friend.  He would like to have the sword you bested him with, in exchange for some coins he found.

quest.title: Let's Play Pirates V
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy asks if you will come play pirates again with him sometime.  He gives you back your pirate garb, and some of your shiny treasure.  He also hands you a strange looking rock.  He seems to have kept the rings…

quest.title: There’s A Way I
quest.cleanDescription:
Captain Thomas suspects that you have seen someone that looks like him before. George had the same expression yesterday when Captain Thomas first arrived in town. Apparently there is a Thomas in town that looks almost identical to Captain Thomas. Captain Thomas wants to assure you that he is a different person, and not Thomas playing an out-of-season fool’s joke.

Being new in town, Captain Thomas could use some help getting established. George is renting a room to him, but Captain Thomas would like to start earning some money and getting a more permanent residence. Will you help Captain Thomas gather some bait so he can start catching and selling fish?

quest.title: There’s A Way II
quest.cleanDescription: Captain Thomas caught a solid load of fish and put quite a bit of money away. Now, he’s ready to keep expanding his business. Will you help him get some tools so he can collect his own bait, gather resources, and improve his fishing?

quest.title: There’s A Way III
quest.cleanDescription: Business is booming for Captain Thomas, but he still needs to expand. He would like to build some traps to add variety to what he can catch. Will you help him gather the resources he needs to build the traps?

quest.title: There’s A Way IV
quest.cleanDescription: The next thing Captain Thomas needs for his fishing business is to increase his supply and decrease his time spent fishing. Will you help him get the materials to make some nets?

quest.title: There’s A Way V
quest.cleanDescription:
It’s a big day for Captain Thomas. He bought a house and some land!

The house is perfect for Captain Thomas, but it needs some repairs. Will you bring him some wood and nails so he can start his renovations?

quest.title: There’s A Way VI
quest.cleanDescription: Captain Thomas is ready to move into his house. Will you help him stock his pantry?

quest.title: There’s A Way VII
quest.cleanDescription: Captain Thomas moved into his house and his business is still doing well. Now, he wants to invest some of his money. Will you help him find some good investments?

quest.title: There’s A Way VIII
quest.cleanDescription:
Captain Thomas would like to thank you for helping him to get settled in to his new home.

Captain Thomas comes from a town exactly like this one, but in another universe. He realizes that his story is hard to believe, but he hopes to prove it to you someday. He also hopes to make it back to his world.

quest.title: Pirate's Cove I
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent, ever the opportunist, tells you he's looking for the Pirate's Cove.  He offers you money and promises for riches in exchange for a rune that he thinks may guide him to the cove he seeks.

quest.title: Pirate's Cove II
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent, with a gleam in his eye, offers you the opportunity to join him in his adventure.  He suggests you bring along some basic items of survival, and he'll provide the rest, for now...

quest.title: Pirate's Cove III
quest.cleanDescription: The water crashing around you in the morning light, you see land ahead.  As you look around, Vincent is nowhere in sight.  The boat seems quite damaged, it looks like you ran into a giant rock, oops.  With no other choice, you paddle towards the shore, and notice some footprints and an oddly broken branch farther up the shore.  You resolve to find Vincent and repair the boat, in that order.

quest.title: Pirate's Cove IV
quest.cleanDescription: After following some marks in trees and subtly scuffed moss, you stumble upon a Small Cave, it seems oddly familiar.  A voice greets you.  “Hi, my name is Buddy!  Let’s be friends and have dinner!” He requests you bring food for dinner “Because that’s what new friends do!”.  His face looks happy, but his demeanor seems demanding, so you set out to help make dinner for your new ‘friend’.  He offers you one of his pirate coins on loan if you’ll help him make new friends after you eat.

quest.title: Pirate's Cove V
quest.cleanDescription: During dinner, you hear faint bird chirps from deeper in the cave. They’re distracting, but you try to focus while Buddy explains that he just really wants to make new friends, but every time he sees someone, they keep walking without giving him a second thought.  He’s devised a new idea to get friends, using magic!  He asks for your help in obtaining these items in hope that he can cast a spell that will make people want to be his friend.

quest.title: Pirate's Cove VI
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy looks downtrodden, his ‘magic spells’ did not make him any friends.  An owl hoots and his eyes flash angrily for a moment before softening somewhat.  Buddy has heard that wealth is a great way to make friends, and he demands you bring him things that will make his cave flaunt his wealth and people will surely want to be his friend!  You get the nagging sensation you’re forgetting something right now…

quest.title: Pirate's Cove VII
quest.cleanDescription: As you watch Buddy decorate his cave, the sounds of birds echo louder and you decide to investigate.  While Buddy is distracted, you take a quick peek and discover Vincent in a cage!  It turns out that Vincent and Buddy are clearly not friends, though Vincent doesn’t seem willing to discuss why at the moment.  Buddy, realizing you know Vincent, demands his pirate coin back, and tells you to leave at once!

quest.title: Pirate's Cove VIII
quest.cleanDescription: You take a look at the cage, you can see areas where Vincent tried to break out, but the cage was cleverly made.  Hesitant to leave Vincent alone, you devise a plan to break Vincent out using bottle rockets placed in the cave as a distraction, and some minor explosives to break open the cage.

quest.title: Pirate's Cove IX
quest.cleanDescription: As Vincent hurls insults at Buddy, you run back towards the ship, an incensed Buddy seems close behind.  Vincent suggests some kind of extra distraction while you repair the ship.

quest.title: A Small Gift I
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy wants to make a gift for one of his dearest friends in the whole wide world. Will you help him?

quest.title: A Small Gift II
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy still needs your help with the gift he’s making. Will you bring him some milk?

quest.title: A Small Gift III
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy only needs a few more things to finish his gift. He thinks his friend will be so surprised.

quest.title: A Small Gift IV
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy needs one last ingredient for his gift to be complete. Please help!

quest.title: A Small Gift V
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy wants you to have this gift that he made! Did you bring him a gift?

quest.title: Jubilee Invitation
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie is finally ready to send the invitations! She hands you sealed letters to give out to those who haven’t been involved in the set up, and asks you to create and bring each person a gift basket of things they like.

quest.title: Jubilee Invitation II
quest.cleanDescription: “THANK YOU. I WILL ARRIVE AFTER I LOCATE MY LEFT SHOE.”

quest.title: Jubilee Invitation III
quest.cleanDescription: You hand Lorn a neatly packed gift basket, and he thanks you. He will be attending.

quest.title: Jubilee Invitation IV
quest.cleanDescription: Cecil is grateful you remembered his favorite things, and will be attending.

quest.title: Jubilee Invitation V
quest.cleanDescription: You catch Borgen as he’s counting up his Ancient Coins, and hand him his basket. “Thank you! I can’t wait to see what Rosalie’s got planned this year!”

quest.title: Jubilee Invitation VI
quest.cleanDescription: The basket for Beatrix will be shared with Geist, so you make sure there are things for both of them included. Beatrix thanks you, and tells you that Geist talks about your tea quite often. She says it is delicious and soothing.

quest.title: Jubilee Invitation VII
quest.cleanDescription: Thomas is very excited, and immediately heads to the town square. He forgot to say thank you.

quest.title: Jubilee Invitation VIII
quest.cleanDescription: Captain Thomas appreciates the trouble you went through, but will not be attending. He looks a bit uncomfortable. He takes his gift basket, and heads back towards his boat.

quest.title: Jubilee Invitation IX
quest.cleanDescription: “These will be a fine addition to my stash. Thank you. I will see you later!” You hope George is okay.

quest.title: Jubilee Invitation X
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent accepts your gift basket, and hopes you will also be in attendance.

quest.title: Jubilee Invitation XI
quest.cleanDescription: Jill is delighted with her gift basket. “I appreciate the thought! My silo is still running off of what you’ve given me before, but I’m sure I will find a use for this. I will see you at the jubilee!”

quest.title: Jubilee Invitation XII
quest.cleanDescription: “NEIGH! Neigh neigh… NEIGH!” You assume this means he will be attending.

quest.title: Jubilee Invitation XIII
quest.cleanDescription: You carefully carry Buddy’s gift basket to the cave, leave it outside, and walk away. You don’t want to be there when he uses those things.

quest.title: Jubilee Invitation XIV
quest.cleanDescription: You crumple up the invitation addressed to the town’s Mayor. That situation is too messy to drag into such a joyous day. Nobody has to know… Right?

quest.title: Jubilee Invitation XV
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie thanks you for all your hard work, and hands you a gift basket. “I appreciate all you’ve done to help me, I hope you like your basket!”

quest.title: Guess Who I
quest.cleanDescription: Did you figure it out?

quest.title: Guess Who II
quest.cleanDescription: Do you need a clue?

quest.title: Guess Who III
quest.cleanDescription: Fine. Here comes a clue…

quest.title: Guess Who IV
quest.cleanDescription: It’s me! Buddy! I love you, {player}!

quest.title: Dinner Party I
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie invited Holger to a dinner party. Holger doesn’t remember what he’s supposed to bring, but he thinks Rosalie said cups. Will you help him get some cups for the party?

quest.title: Dinner Party II
quest.cleanDescription: Jill was invited to Rosalie’s dinner party. Rosalie asked Jill to bring a side dish, cups, or a dessert. Unfortunately, Jill ran out of time to make her dad’s famous cookies. Will you help her get some cups for the party instead?

quest.title: Dinner Party III
quest.cleanDescription: Thomas is supposed to attend Rosalie’s dinner party. He was also supposed to grill some fish for the main course. When Thomas told Rosalie that a raccoon stole all his fish, Rosalie said she understood and invited Thomas to bring cups instead. Will you help Thomas get some cups for the party?

quest.title: Dinner Party IV
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie invited Beatrix to her dinner party, but she said not to worry about bringing anything this time. Beatrix doesn’t want to go empty handed. Will you get some cups for Beatrix to take to the party?

quest.title: Dinner Party V
quest.cleanDescription: Cecil is in charge of entertainment for Rosalie’s dinner party. Will you bring him some cups for a game he wants to play at the party?

quest.title: Dinner Party VI
quest.cleanDescription: George is going to Rosalie’s party, but he doesn’t know what he should bring. Rosalie said he could bring anything. If he’s going with his training to be prepared, George thinks cups are his best bet. Will you bring George some cups for the party?

quest.title: Dinner Party VII
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie appreciates you coming to the dinner party, and bringing carrots for the vegetable platter. Everyone else brought cups and left them behind when the party was over. Rosalie would like you to take the cups. Maybe you can host your own dinner party.

questlines.title: May The Horse Be With You

quest.title: May The Horse Be With You I
quest.cleanTitle: May The Horse Be With You I
quest.cleanDescription:
You decide to visit Charles Horsington III, who is asleep under a shady tree. He appears to be having a nightmare, as he is kicking his leg and whinnying softly. He startles himself awake, and sees you. He places a single feather in front of you.

“Neigh? Neigh neigh.”

You nod your head, and gather more feathers.

quest.title: May The Horse Be With You II
quest.cleanTitle: May The Horse Be With You II
quest.cleanDescription:
Star Meerif appears, sensing the gathering of feathers was meant for him. He sees Charles Horsington III and smiles warmly. “Hello there!”

“Neigh neigh. Neigh! NEIGH! …Neigh.”

Star nods his head. “I understand, and I will help you learn the ways of the horse.”

Star requests a strange letter from you, while he sets up his plan to help Charles feel more protected against whatever was in his bad dream.

quest.title: May The Horse Be With You III
quest.cleanTitle: May The Horse Be With You III
quest.cleanDescription: As you return with the letter for Star, you hear a familiar soft whinny. “He dozed off waiting for me to calculate the precise degree of altitude needed to properly conduct what I’m trying to accomplish. Please bring some apples.”

quest.title: May The Horse Be With You IV
quest.cleanTitle: May The Horse Be With You IV
quest.cleanDescription:
The scent of a fresh, crisp apple wakes Charles from a deep sleep.

“Ah yes, the horse awakens.” Star chuckles to himself, as if he told a joke only he would understand.

“Neigh. Neigh neigh!”

Star casts a protection spell on Charles Horsington III. “This should do the trick.” Charles still looks worried, so Star offers him some advice. “The best defense against an enemy is to use their own terrain against them.” Star pats Charles Horsington III. “Take this advice, and you will do just fine.”

quest.title: May The Horse Be With You V
quest.cleanTitle: May The Horse Be With You V
quest.cleanDescription: frank sees you, and hops over. “I heard you helped ol’ Charlie get over his fear of cloaked desert creatures. Hearing him talk about his day gave me a really good idea.” He hands you 2 sealed letters to deliver.

quest.title: May The Horse Be With You VI
quest.cleanTitle: May The Horse Be With You VI
quest.cleanDescription:
The letters are addressed “Thomas” and “C. Thomas”. Both of them are conveniently standing near the docks, so you deliver the letters. Thomas opens his letter, and reads it carefully. “He wants…sand? I don’t have any sand! Would you please find some for me, and bring it to frank? I owe him a favor so I can’t say no..”

Captain Thomas opens his letter, and tells you he has sand to offer, but is running low on rope, and would be willing to trade with you.

quest.title: May The Horse Be With You VII
quest.cleanTitle: May The Horse Be With You VII
quest.cleanDescription:
You return with the sand, and surprisingly enough, Thomas and Captain Thomas are sitting with frank. You wonder why they didn’t just bring the sand here, themselves. frank tasks the Thomases with pouring sand in the shape of a feather in front of Star’s door. “Hey. Go knock on the door.”

You’ve learned not to question frank anymore, and knock on the door.

quest.title: May The Horse Be With You VIII
quest.cleanTitle: May The Horse Be With You VIII
quest.cleanDescription:
Star Meerif opens the door, and greets you. He takes a step out, and slips on the sand he failed to notice on the ground below him. This may very well be the only time one of frank’s pranks has been successful against Star Meerif.

"I don't like sand! It's coarse and rough and irritating… and it gets everywhere." He shakes some sand from his cloak, and sees frank rolling around and laughing. “Laugh it up, fuzzball!” As he stands up, he sees Thomas, then Captain Thomas. He looks back and forth between them, and blinks a few times. “This is getting out of hand. Since when are there TWO of them?”

Star quickly recomposes himself, and flicks his wrist to disperse the sand. He mutters a spell, and goes back inside.

frank has turned green, and his ears are pointing out sideways. His voice is…froggier than it normally is. “Got him good, this time I did.” He pauses. “Talking like this, why am I?”

quest.title: Treat or Fear III
quest.cleanDescription:
Unto fish
Few only remember, mens struggles.

questlines.title: The Hat Which Makes The Magic

quest.title: The Hat Which Makes The Magic I
quest.cleanTitle: The Hat Which Makes The Magic I
quest.cleanDescription:
It’s a cold morning when Star appears on your farm with very little warning. There is a distinct lack of feathers, and that strikes you as a little odd.

“Have you seen these witch hats? Everyone’s talking about them, and I want some. Are they better than wizard hats? Well, that’s a ludicrous idea, but maybe it’s worth checking some of them out anyways. Could you bring me some to study?”

quest.title: The Hat Which Makes The Magic II
quest.cleanTitle: The Hat Which Makes The Magic II
quest.cleanDescription:
As you stroll into town, the festivities are in full swing! You notice Rosalie waving at you in the distance so you make your way to her.

“Witch hats, why are they so fascinating? I feel very drawn to them, and I’d like to have some around my house and to maybe give away. I wonder what Star Meerif thinks of witch hats. Could you bring me some?”

quest.title: The Hat Which Makes The Magic III
quest.cleanTitle: The Hat Which Makes The Magic III
quest.cleanDescription:
Star Meerif appears in a flash of feathers beside you and Rosalie in her home. Star bows profusely before you both, and snaps his fingers, feathers disappearing in an instant.

“What a surprise to see you both here. I was trying to locate a strange blip in aethereal energy when – Oh my! Are those witch hats? Why do you have them?! Maybe these are the source!”

Star immediately teleports away, and the witch hats are gone too.

Rosalie looks devastated and you immediately set to work to replace the ones Star took.

quest.title: The Hat Which Makes The Magic IV
quest.cleanTitle: The Hat Which Makes The Magic IV
quest.cleanDescription:
As you and Rosalie place the last hat back where they disappeared, a knock comes at the front door. Rosalie jumps in surprise and rushes to the door, and Star Meerif enters.

“Rosalie, I am sorry for my rudeness, the hats were not what I was looking for, but I realized quite quickly my arcane aspirations got in the way of social protocols. I am truly sorry, and I hope these flowers can be a part of my forgiveness along with – well, I see our friend has already found the hats I was going to bring back. Perhaps instead we could celebrate Halloween by giving out candy and hats to everyone… together?”

Star bows and produces a bouquet of roses. Rosalie’s smile lights up the room, and you set to work getting a few more hats for the occasion. Halloween is truly a magical time.

quest.title: frank's pranks I
quest.cleanDescription: frank has been waiting all year for his chance to pull the most epic pranks on everyone. Naturally, he needs you to help him gather supplies. He assures you he probably won’t prank you, as a payment for your services. First on his list is a bunch of eggs.

quest.title: frank's pranks II
quest.cleanDescription:
With the eggs delivered, he instructs you to place them all over the town square. “don’t step on any, it’ll ruin the immersion.”

He cackles, and pulls out his list. “alright, from here, we need some bugs. a lot of ‘em. let’s start with spiders. and some bottles to keep ‘em in.”

quest.title: frank's pranks III
quest.cleanDescription: frank casts some spell on the bottles to ensure the bugs can breathe properly. You gingerly capture one spider for each bottle. “great start, lets go for those beetles now.”

quest.title: frank's pranks IV
quest.cleanDescription: You repeat the process, and frank reassures you these will not be used on you. “you’d already know what’s coming. wouldn’t be any fun in that. we need some of those leggy fellas now. i forget what they’re called. you know the ones. go get ‘em.”

quest.title: frank's pranks V
quest.cleanDescription: “alright alright, stop making that face. the last bugs i need are grasshoppers.”

quest.title: frank's pranks VI
quest.cleanDescription: You hope you never have to touch another bug again, after this evening’s activities. frank informs you these bug jars will live hidden on your property, for now. “it’s not time to deliver these guys just yet. i’ll let you know. for NOW though…lets start setting up my next prank with some red dye.”

quest.title: frank's pranks VII
quest.cleanDescription: “that’s not nearly enough. do you have any idea what i’m trying to accomplish here? this has to be the biggest prank this town has ever seen. if you’re no longer interested in helping, let me know and i’ll find some other two legged person to help.” You don’t want to feel frank’s pranking wrath, so you hurriedly gather more red dye.

quest.title: frank's pranks VIII
quest.cleanDescription:
You return, and frank is talking with Charles Horsington III. Seems they’ve just finished conducting some business. They see you, and promptly end their discussion. Charles greets you, and trots off. “Neigh!”

”man, that horse is one funny -blam!-. totally on board, loved my idea. anyways, glad to see you’re back on board. lets get these loaded up. you cart them, and i’ll supervise.”

“next up for preparation is uh…” He scans his list. “oh! toilet paper! as much as you can carry. i’ve got to survey the areas to plan when we’re pulling this off. just meet me back here when you’ve got it.”

quest.title: frank's pranks IX
quest.cleanDescription: frank can be seen sniffing the air, seemingly tracking something. “this is great. almost enough. could use some extra feathers, too, if you wouldn’t mind.”

quest.title: frank's pranks X
quest.cleanDescription: You begin to question your complicity, but after a brief moment of weighing your options, you decide to continue helping frank. He knows where you live, and you don’t want to make things awkward. You go back to the town square, towing a cart of toilet paper. frank is nowhere to be found, but he left a literal trail of crumbs for you to follow.

quest.title: frank's pranks XI
quest.cleanDescription:
As you follow this trail, a piece of parchment flies into your face. You look at it, and an oddly familiar sense comes over you.

”Tread Carefully.”

You find frank north of town, and show him the note. “UGH! how did he figure it out? i mean, a silly little note won’t stop us. but it’ll just mean more hard work for yo– for us. i need some lemonade.”

quest.title: frank's pranks XII
quest.cleanDescription: Lemonade in hand, you return to find frank. “he’s not here. perfect. i’ve gotta start setting up, you got those pictures?” You stare blankly at frank. “oh. did i not... ok. yeah you know those super freaky pictures of that lady? i need about 20 of ‘em. go toss some stuff into the wishing well.” He shoos you off. You look back, and catch just a glimpse of the materials you brought levitating.

quest.title: frank's pranks XIII
quest.cleanDescription: When you return, the materials you brought previously are gone, as is frank. All you can find is a piece of parchment, which reads, “stack the pictures exactly where this letter was sitting, and meet me back at the town hall. if you could bring me a snack too, that would be great.”

quest.title: frank's pranks XIV
quest.cleanDescription: frank sits by the town hall, ready to hoist Charles. They’re about to begin, when he has an amazing idea, and turns to Charles to discuss it. “hey what if we covered you in bat wings?” Charles whinnies excitedly, and they both look at you. “oh also i need some feathers while you’re out and about.”

quest.title: frank's pranks XV
quest.cleanDescription: Now that Charles has been spookified, frank instructs you to meet him near Jill’s corn field with another snack for him.

quest.title: frank's pranks XVI
quest.cleanDescription:
Somehow, both frank and the red dye you gathered earlier are both already here and waiting. “hey go pour this into that.” He gestures to Jill’s water irrigation system. “don’t worry, this stuff is safe, it won’t hurt her precious cobs.” He senses your hesitation, and takes a swig of the dye. “see? i’m fine.”

Feeling more confident that no crops will be harmed in the process, you agree to help out. Once frank sees you begin, he hops away, mumbling something about more snacks and the town square.

quest.title: frank's pranks XVII
quest.cleanDescription:
Back at the town square, you can see Charles Horsington III in the distance, his stoic posture now a frightening silhouette. frank motions for you to hide with him. “someone's coming this way, lets watch the chaos.”

Buddy, in full pirate attire, is skipping down the road. He lands on an egg, and abruptly stops. “Hello? Did somebody drop these?” When no response is given, he looks around, and jumps on each egg. “This is better than crunching leaves!” He laughs to himself. His non-peg leg shoe flies off his foot, in your general direction. It's drenched in raw egg, dirt, and a horrid stench.

Buddy walks over to retrieve it, and sees you. Of course, frank is nowhere to be seen. “Hi friend! That shoe is kind of ruined now. Would you mind picking up another one at the post office for me? I ordered it, and was actually on my way to go pick it up, but they won’t let me in without shoes! You’ll know it’s mine because my face is on it!”

quest.title: frank's pranks XVIII
quest.cleanDescription:
You return with the shoe, and Buddy is delighted. He leaves an absolute mess in the town square, and skips further down the road.

”that did not go as planned.” frank reappears, conveniently as soon as Buddy is out of sight. “we’re almost done, need some more foodstuff though. meet me back in the clearing.”

quest.title: frank's pranks XIX
quest.cleanDescription:
The clearing is no longer empty. Star’s castle sits before you; a truly spectacular sight to see. frank, the toilet paper and lemonade are waiting for you when you arrive. “now this is important. he’s not home, so you have to go inside and replace everything in the fridge with the lemonade. i’ve got to do some stuff out here. we only have a few minutes, so chop chop.”

You’re not sure if Star left the door unlocked, or if frank did something to unlock it, but you enter the castle. You don’t dare to look around, and beeline straight for the fridge. You quickly replace the items inside with lemonade, and return to frank.

Once you shut the door, the ground rumbles. frank is out of sight, and the castle is wrapped entirely in toilet paper. The rumbling stops, and frank hops out from behind the castle. “okay, we’re done. get outta here, you do NOT want to be around when star gets back.”

As you're leaving, frank calls out, "thanks for all the help. left you a little something special at home."

quest.title: frank's pranks XX
quest.cleanDescription: Back home, you realize there’s one set of items frank never used. Sitting in your house are thousands of jars with bugs in them. Maybe frank did prank you, after all.

quest.title: Hungry Holger I
quest.cleanDescription: Holger is hungry and needs some peas to go with his meal.  He's really hungry so he wants a lot of peas.  Bring him peas.

quest.title: Hungry Holger II
quest.cleanDescription: Once again, Holger is hungry, but he'd like something a little more filling. He recently discovered his love for seafood, could you bring him some delicious fish?

quest.title: Hungry Holger III
quest.cleanDescription: Holger's appetite is insatiable, and he needs more snacks. Bring him something to chew on that will satisfy his stomach.

quest.title: Hungry Holger IV
quest.cleanDescription: Holger is a hungry man, and needs more nutritional value in his belly. Can you prepare a meal for him?

quest.title: A Towering Investment I
quest.cleanDescription:
Cecil is looking for an investor to help with an archaeological excavation he is working on. He discovered an ancient tower buried deep underground several kilometers north of town. If his research is correct, this tower is filled with priceless treasure. If you will help him fund this project, he will give you a fair share of the treasure.

Will you invest in Cecil’s excavation project?

quest.title: A Towering Investment II
quest.cleanDescription:
To help speed the excavation project, Cecil would like you to help provide food for the workers. The value of all the food you provide will go toward increasing your share of the treasure.

Will you help provide food for the workers?

quest.title: A Towering Investment III
quest.cleanDescription: Cecil would like you to provide additional nutritional variety for the workers. As before, this will add to your share of the treasure.

quest.title: A Towering Investment IV
quest.cleanDescription: Cecil thinks the food supply needs a few more things.

quest.title: A Towering Investment V
quest.cleanDescription: Several workers were injured while excavating a section of the tower yesterday. Cecil would like you to increase your monetary investment to provide care for those injured, and to help hire additional workers. Will you invest more silver in Cecil’s project?

quest.title: A Towering Investment VI
quest.cleanDescription:
To help reduce costs, Cecil would like you to supply tools and materials for the workers to continue the excavation process. The value will be added as before to your share of the treasure.

Will you provide tools and materials?

quest.title: A Towering Investment VII
quest.cleanDescription: The tower is larger than Cecil’s initial analysis showed. The excavation is going to cost significantly more than Cecil planned. Will you increase your investment again?

quest.title: A Towering Investment VIII
quest.cleanDescription: The excavation project needs more tools and materials. Will you provide more supplies?

quest.title: A Towering Investment IX
quest.cleanDescription: Cecil noticed that the workers need more food supplies. Will you continue to supply food for the workers?

quest.title: A Towering Investment X
quest.cleanDescription: Cecil wants to add a little something extra to the workers’ diet. He thinks the magical properties of golden fish could really boost the speed of the excavation project. Will you bring a supply of different golden fish?

quest.title: A Towering Investment XI
quest.cleanDescription:
The excavation team has reached the tower’s foundation! The excavation work is finished!

Unfortunately, there’s no way to open the doors to the tower. However, Cecil has an idea that should get the doors open.

On each level of the tower, the workers discovered an intricate and linked series of mechanisms. Cecil thinks that this machinery can be cleaned and repaired and set to working order. The unfortunate part of this plan is that it will require one more investment of silver to fund the repair work.

Will you invest in repairing the tower’s external mechanisms?

quest.title: A Towering Investment XII
quest.cleanDescription: Cecil would like your help with another cost-saving measure for the tower project. If you will help supply parts for repairing the tower machinery, it will be a huge reduction in expenditure and time lost. As usual, your contributions will go toward your shares in the treasure.

quest.title: A Towering Investment XIII
quest.cleanDescription: The repairs are a little more difficult than expected. Will you invest more silver to help find and fund experts in machine repairs?

quest.title: A Towering Investment XIV
quest.cleanDescription: Some of the tower mechanisms require different stones and gems to function. Will you help Cecil gather the required resources?

quest.title: A Towering Investment XV
quest.cleanDescription: Cecil found that more stones and gems are needed for the tower mechanisms. Will you bring the stones and gems needed?

quest.title: A Towering Investment XVI
quest.cleanDescription: Cecil thinks the tower machinery is ready to be activated. Before attempting to activate the tower, Cecil would like to have an assortment of items available in case the mechanisms need some additional magical energy. Will you provide the needed items for an additional share in the tower treasure?

quest.title: A Towering Investment XVII
quest.cleanDescription:
The doors to the tower are open!

Cecil has enlisted ROOMBA to do an initial exploration and cleaning of the tower. Will you bring corn to help power ROOMBA’s work?

quest.title: A Towering Investment XVIII
quest.cleanDescription:
ROOMBA’s inspection of the tower is complete! The tower looks to be functional and safe, and surprisingly well preserved on the inside.

Cecil also went ahead and performed his own inspection of the tower, and gathered his share of the treasure. He hopes you do not mind him proceeding without you.

Cecil thinks the tower is now ready for your use. In fact, as thanks for your enormous and incredible investment, Cecil would like to turn over the stewardship of the tower to you. He will retain a small role in the management of the tower, but he will leave its normal use, exploration, and operations to you.

quest.title: Strange Companions I
quest.cleanDescription: Star Meerif walks slowly towards your house. His footsteps carry more weight than you remember, leaving small impressions in the path as he walks. In fact, you can’t remember seeing him walk this far at all. At your door, you see him attach a letter to a splinter in your door – you really should fix that – and he turns and leaves in the same manner. His footsteps slow, deliberate.  The wind howls as you see him crest a hill in the distance. You open the door to a note and letter that simply says, “Take this to Rosalie. Sometimes tasking a remarkably meaningful errand enigmatically really is fitting.”

quest.title: Strange Companions II
quest.cleanDescription:
As you head into town, clouds roll in and the smell of rain adds to the sensation of dread in the town. The constant vibrant energy of the town has been drained, replaced by townsfolk who keep to themselves, afraid of having to defend themselves from the consequences of any action that Ric might find unsavory in your – no, his – town.

You notice Rosalie walking out of the country store ahead, her countenance betraying the fake smile she flashes to you. You feel for the letter in your pocket reassuringly and approach her.

As if compelled, you hand her the letter you intended to deliver to her in private, and after a moment, she passes it back to you, fear and worry mar her features.

Dearest Rosalie,
You’re a real peculiar gem. I won’t be able to make it for dinner tomorrow. A shadow is falling. Yours in magic, Star


Rosalie motions you silently to follow her and as you turn the corner, you collide with a figure and stumble backwards, the letter falling from your hands to the ground. Stunned for a moment, you check on your wounded pride and notice Beatrix reading the letter.

After a moment, Beatrix begins to speak, but the words seem crisper, and more precise than you expect from her. “Tell us Child, what exactly have you gotten yourself into?”

Rosalie hastily retrieves the note from Beatrix and suggests you gather various tea supplies. You can meet her back at her home with Beatrix in a few days to avoid suspicion from Ric. As you turn to leave, Beatrix places a hand on your shoulder and draws you in closely, whispering, "Geist really likes her tea with black powder and a bit of a bite, if you don't mind?"

quest.title: Strange Companions III
quest.cleanDescription:
A few days later, your home remains quiet and noticeably uninterrupted. Trips into town have felt tense and you have intentionally avoided speaking to Beatrix and Rosalie except in passing. After gathering the items for tea, you arrive at Rosalie’s home, ready to discuss the letter and what has her so anxious with Beatrix.

When you arrive, you’re surprised to find a third person sitting in a chair near Rosalie’s fireplace. Lorn greets you warmly and motions for you to join the group. Rosalie looks pensive, and Beatrix seems quiet and unreadable as ever. After sitting, the tense mood of the room becomes too much to bear, and Rosalie breaks the tension by suggesting tea.

The group prepare their tea, Beatrix adding some very odd ingredients to her tea in the process. After some time of small talk, the tension in the room again reaches palpable levels, and Lorn quietly draws the letter out of his pocket and says, “So, a peculiar gem?” Beatrix looks intently at Lorn, and for a moment, the fire seems to pulse in intensity, almost exactly at her pace of breathing, but you shake the feeling off as your imagination as Lorn continues, “I’ve heard many things about many various gems, but what do you all know about the power of gems?”

Rosalie blinks and gives Lorn an odd look, “Star hasn’t mentioned many things about gems, he seems to dislike a certain type, but I’ve never taken much notice to be honest.”

Before Lorn can reply, Beatrix in a crisp accent cuts him off, “Gems can hold many powers, they attune to the aether of the world, and some types have affinities towards elements and types of magic. For example, many of the elements attune to basic gems like rubies for fire, or emerald for earth. Using gems for magical enhancement is not a common art in the world any longer.”

Rosalie leans back looking surprised in her chair as what you now recognize as the voice of Geist speaks. Lorn takes a moment to process this information before continuing, “Indeed, I’ve heard similar stories about gems and magic, but there are some gems, some very peculiar, that seem to do things that defy a normal explanation.”

The fire in the room suddenly burns bright as Beatrix straightens and says, “I remember…fragments. A war! A gem! Pain! Loss…”

Suddenly, Beatrix crumples to the ground as the fireplace loses intensity. Lorn and Rosalie rush to Beatrix’s aid. Her eyes open slightly, she looks directly at you and says, “I need rest…and the Flame Orb.”

Beatrix closes her eyes, and Lorn asks you to gather some items to help Beatrix regain her strength.

quest.title: Strange Companions IV
quest.cleanDescription:
The town is quiet as you gather the materials as quickly as you can, an even harsher reminder of how many townsfolk no longer call the town their home. On the trip back to Rosalie’s house, several times you notice certain oddities around town. A home door ajar, blinds closed with windows open - at one point you swear you saw shadows that seemed to move even when you stood still. Hairs standing on end, you attempt to look casual as you head towards your destination. The sense of unease does not lift when you enter the house, instead worry and uncertainty are etched upon the faces of your friends.

Lorn explains, “Beatrix needs more time to recover, but we’re worried that her instability could cause serious consequences if she were to transform in town. I suggest we bring her to your farm house before we give her the flame orb. Rosalie has volunteered to cast a spell of illusion on a cart that we can use to transport Beatrix back to your home with little suspicion.”

Rosalie looks at you strangely, “Did you know orange is a great color for illusions? The more it moves the more it stops the illusion from distorting my aether matrix. That said, Beatrix has a very unique aura owing to her unique circumstances, I’m going to need a lot more orange things than I normally would to make sure this spell works.”

quest.title: Strange Companions V
quest.cleanDescription:
Under the cover of darkness, the four of you trek back to your farmhouse, Rosalie’s face scrunched in concentration, muttering something incomprehensible under her breath, while you and Lorn attempt to talk casually while keeping lookout.

After arriving at the farmhouse, you still can’t shake the feeling that you’re being watched, but you have no proof to bring to the group.

The next morning, Beatrix seems to have recovered from collapsing, she thanks you all for your care and assures you that she is fine. After a moment, a tear streaks down her face, “It feels so good to be among people that care, and to not be an outcast. If you’d allow me this morning to recover, I will tell you a story.”

Lorn pulls you aside and suggests you all spend your morning going about your normal tasks and you can reconvene at lunch. As it happens, he was hoping you could pick up some items for him and a friend while you’re in town. It’s a rather odd list.

quest.title: Strange Companions VI
quest.cleanDescription:
When you get back to the farmhouse, Beatrix is resting comfortably, and Rosalie continues to pace while pensive and impatient. Lorn arrives and begins smoking a pipe, his presence of calm and serenity have an immediate soothing impact to your frayed nerves. Rosalie steps out of the other room, and upon seeing Lorn mentions how thankful she is to him for helping restock some of her other magic supplies.

“On the contrary, our dear friend here found most of the goods for you, but I did add a little something special for you myself.” Lorn replies. He winks slyly to Rosalie before settling into a chair.

After putting some tea on, Beatrix sits down and invites you all to listen to her tale. She puts a hand on the flame orb and the orb emits a searing light and the words seem to rush out of Beatrix.

“Many years ago, dragons and humans lived in relative peace. Magic was abundant in the land, and tribes grew up around different wizarding traditions. I grew up in such a tribe, but I was not born with any magical talent myself. Our family was well known, and one day, a man came to our tribe asking for help from wizards. Only later did they find out that there was a war between humans and dragons, and before we knew it, the war descended upon our tribe too.
The wrath of the dragons was terrible, and despite my pleading with father, the wizarding tribes were upset at the slaughter of humans and fought back. Many, many dragons died, and many of my friends and family died too. During the worst of the fighting, a dragon soared overhead, pleading with everyone to stop fighting and I was caught up in their words. I followed the dragon many miles and found her pleading with her brethren to stop the fighting. Her words fell on deaf ears, but I was so encouraged that I revealed myself to her and that is how Geist and I became comrades. We rushed to another battlefield to plead to stop the fighting, but it fell on deaf ears. In the fighting, Geist was wounded by a mage who held strange powers, and in my grief I screamed and shouted for the fighting to stop, but it never did… they wouldn’t stop fighting. They wouldn’t listen! In that moment, I lost all hope for humanity and dragonkind and laid beside Geist, waiting for the death of the battlefield I knew was inevitable.”


Beatrix is now openly crying and Lorn puts a hand on her shoulder to comfort her.

Lorn suggests you take a few minutes to let Beatrix regain her composure, and through tears, Beatrix suggests Geist tell you the rest of the story. She asks for some surf and turf, because she’ll likely be hungry anyways, and asks you all to step outside.

quest.title: Strange Companions VII
quest.cleanDescription:
Before you can step outside, Beatrix asks you all to wait a few moments while she goes ahead. After several seconds, you all step outside and see what you can only believe to be a dragon. Geist dwarfs your home, and she’s more majestic than a mountain. As she lowers her head to address you, flame crackles from her nose and a different fire burns in her eyes. It can only be described as sheer intelligent determination.

“Greetings, I am Geist, and I owe you my unending thanks and gratitude for your care and friendship of my dear friend Beatrix. Rest assured that she is well and unharmed. This has been a traumatic several weeks for her, and I hope to ease her pain by telling you the rest of our story. I know you don't know me, but I know you all very well, as well as Beatrix herself does. Our shared memories make you all so familiar to me, I apologize if I address you all as if I've known you for years, because, you see, I have.

In that moment, so long ago, when Beatrix laid herself down beside me, I wept for the state of the world, for the wars and hatred that even I did not understand. To see so small a human laid low in empathy broke my heart, and it was in that moment of sadness and desperation to not see the world torn apart that something deep inside me changed. As I bled out from my strange wound, I blacked out, and when I came to, I was not me, but I was a part of Beatrix, and she was a part of me.

We eventually learned that only one of us could manifest at once, and through our experiences, Beatrix became so despondent that the only thing I could do for my dear friend was lock our memories away and give her a fresh start in a small village to live our life as normal as possible.

I tell you this, because I believe the injustices we have seen Ric impose on our small town are as cruel as we have ever witnessed, and we know the loss and pain of friend and family. I want to help so I offer you this, the knowledge I have of the peculiar gem. Indeed, I have heard of it and I know it has power that neither Beatrix nor I understand. It seems crucial to understand why Star might have mentioned it now, and together we should seek this item out.”

The group stands around for a moment, deep in thought, when Lorn breaks the silence, “I have heard of this peculiar gem from travelers before, passed down by generations, its value incalculable to anyone. It seems to me the best path forward would be to speak with our resident collector, Cecil, mayhap he has heard of this gem, or has acquired it himself? I have no other leads to offer at this time, unfortunately.” Everyone agrees this seems like a reasonable first step, and the group decide it best to bring Cecil an offering of goodwill, knowing he is more open to talking about his collection when he’s adding to it.

quest.title: Strange Companions VIII
quest.cleanDescription:
As a group, it is decided that you and Rosalie are best suited to see Cecil, so you head off to town with your goods, and make your way through town. Cecil’s house is an oddity, older than many other homes in the town, but it has always seemed to come through tragedy untouched and looking quite pristine.

Rosalie knocks on Cecil’s door and at first, there is no answer. A few moments later, the large front door opens slowly, and Cecil appears with an annoyed look on his face. His eyes quickly flit to Rosalie and before she says anything, he looks to you and says quietly, “You may enter. The mage’s pupil is not allowed in under any circumstance. These are my terms.” His eyes look like they will brook no argument and Rosalie gives you a quizzical look before stepping away from the door.

Cecil opens the door wider and allows you inside. The majesty and size of his home is not lost on you in that moment, as the door opens to a great hallway full of trinkets and baubles that distract the eye and glitter in unique and fascinating ways. Cecil walks you to a room you’ve never been in before and your eyes are drawn to even more trinkets and the energy core you brought back from Romuska, placed on a mantle in a base overseeing the room. You notice a kind of black cord coming down the side of the mantle but before you can figure out where it goes, Cecil interrupts your reverie by coughing gently.

“I know why you’re here, and I need your help. You see, Ric has been asking me for more and more money lately to fund his operation. Obviously, money is easy to come by, but I need to replenish my collection of items I sell to various vendors. In return, I will tell you what I know.”

You see no other avenue forward, and Cecil hands you a list of items he wants you to acquire. It’s strangely similar to items Rosalie and Star have asked you for in the past.

quest.title: Strange Companions IX
quest.cleanDescription:
Your task completed, Cecil greedily eyes the items and proceeds to stuff them all into a bag in the hallway, his eyes never watching where his hands move, he begins to gush to you, “Thank you! Finding some of these things are super difficult and you wouldn’t believe how useful and valuable some of these items are! Could you help me out with a few more items?”

He hands you a second list as suspicious as the first and pushes you out the door before you can get a word in edgewise.

quest.title: Strange Companions X
quest.cleanDescription:
When you return to Cecil’s house, he is positively beaming as you hand him the items. He carefully takes a ring off his finger and puts a new ring on before putting the rest in the same bag by the door. Curiously, he begins to wave you inside and suddenly his eyes turn cold.

“Get out! If you mention any of this to Ric I will tell him about the peculiar gem and Beatrix both! I never want to see that mage’s pupil or you around here again!”

You turn away, seeing Rosalie standing off in the distance to your left trying her best to look innocuous, but failing miserably. As you step away from Cecil’s house, you glimpse a silver silhouette in the distance but struggle to identify the person.

Rosalie approaches you as you head towards the farm and apologizes profusely, “I’m sorry, I was just so worried about Star and Cecil was acting so strange I was trying to hear what was being said with a listening spell…”

Rosalie sniffles a little and you suggest some tea at Rosalie’s house to calm everyone’s nerves after the abrupt change in afternoon.

quest.title: Strange Companions XI
quest.cleanDescription:
After some tea, Lorn stops by and after you recount your dealings with Cecil, he suggests that you may need to do some digging about what has Cecil so spooked, and why he was requesting some suspicious items. You all agree to spend some time asking townsfolk about Cecil and anything strange they might have noticed happening in the town lately.

Rosalie suggests nothing puts people at ease quite like a housewarming gift, so you set about to make a few housewarming gift packages for the townsfolk for when you can ask them some questions.

quest.title: Strange Companions XII
quest.cleanDescription:
Your gift baskets in hand, you head into town. As you step onto the main street, none other than Ric Ryph steps out from the nearest home, his armor gleaming in the sunlight. He sees you and gives you a strange grin before approaching you.

“Ah yes, a pleasure to see you out and about! I’ve noticed you’ve been spending a lot of time with many of the townsfolk recently. An admirable and good thing to do, why, one might even wonder if you were trying to gain public support!” He casts a significant look at your gift baskets.

“Anyways, Cecil mentioned to me that his silver flow had temporarily been interrupted and that he needed to get a few key pieces of his cashflow back and suggested you would graciously help the town out in its greatest need to defend against the loathsome dragon at his previously donated rate. If you wouldn’t mind, a double deposit, just to keep the town running smoothly and the guard paid, would be ever so appreciated.”

quest.title: Strange Companions XIII
quest.cleanDescription:
Money in hand, you head to Ric’s house. Before you can knock, Ric opens the door and gives you a gracious handshake and takes the money from you.

“Thank you, friend. It’s contributions like these that let me know the work we’re doing in this town to make it safe from dragons is worth doing. This money will be extremely useful in the coming days to make safe the townsfolk all over this area. I see you still plan on visiting other townsfolk, well, if you want my advice, don’t trust anyone that won’t give you anything you want immediately.”

You leave, Ric’s words echoing in your ears. You decide the best approach is to talk to some of the townsfolk you are better acquainted with, and approach George’s home.

As luck would have it, George is sitting on his porch playing guitar and singing a song, you pause to listen before approaching him.

“I’d give anything
To be where you’re at
I’d do anything
To become what you are
It’s too late
I don’t have what it takes
I don’t have it
I don’t have it

So move on
I’m alright
I need to move on now
Cause I’m gonna be alright”

The melody catches your ear, haunting but pleasant. There’s a strange comfort in the words, and you give George a moment to finish his song before you approach him any further.

After handing him the gift basket, you ask him about Cecil and any strange occurrences in the town, and George shakes his head, he’s been focused on his music lately and hasn’t paid too much attention to more than he’s had to do for Ric, which are just standard dragon defense tactics. You thank George for his time and offer your thanks for the song.

quest.title: Strange Companions XIV
quest.cleanDescription:
Walking down the street, you realize many of these homes are foreign to you. As you walk the impression you’re being watched once again settles over you, the sense of unease makes your hairs stand on end, and you resist the urge to break into a run. You look to the sides and though it’s the middle of the day, shadows seem to grow around the houses around you and specks of light glitter in the shadows, like tiny eyes, following your every move. The sense of real danger starts to mount, you furtively glance left to right and where there were once sun lit homes you now see dark houses with windows that give the impression of pervasive spreading darkness – you try to look away but you become entranced with one window, a view of something unfathomable brushes your mind and just as you begin to see flecks of blue a hand wraps around your shoulder and you stifle a scream of terror.

Thomas, fishing pole in one hand, smiles at you and gives you a strange look.

“Friend, you’re standing in the middle of the street perfectly still, are you okay?”

You blink, arms shaking, and the sun has returned to the sky. Thomas ushers you down a side street towards his home. After a few moments, you regain your composure enough to assure Thomas that you are fine and ask him about Cecil and strange happenings.

Thomas gives you a second strange look and breaks out in a belly laugh. “Oh, do you mean besides the dragon attack? Or Ric Ryph? Or perhaps you mean the fact that I caught all these fish?!” Thomas proudly shows you a drying rack with three trout.

“Fished ‘em myself! Maybe I’m not a lost cause afterall, eh?”

quest.title: Strange Companions XV
quest.cleanDescription:
Your vision fades. Stars streak by. Time changes. An eternity passes before the blink of an eye.

The shadow.
A picture.


Lives lived. Lives lost. Love. Hate. Regret.

“Are…you okay?” Focus again brings you back to reality where Thomas is peering at you in a peculiar fashion.
Shaking your head as if from a long dream, you put on a brave smile, and give Thomas a pat on the shoulder. You request a trout dinner to celebrate his catch at a later time and bid a distracted farewell. As you look to your left, you glimpse a shadow disappearing down a side street. The glimmer from an object catches your eye, but you’ve no idea what it is. How peculiar, the thought enters your head, and exits just as briefly. The urge to give chase is quickly overwhelmed by the memory of the experience before Thomas arrived. Maybe the sideroads are even less safe…
As Thomas steps away, you brace yourself for the feeling of being watched to return, but after a few moments, the sky is still clear and shining. It takes you a few moments of deliberate steps forward to remember your goals, but bolstered by the shining sky your pace quickens, hoping to run into Holger.
As luck would have it, you run into Holger not 10 minutes later on the east side of town. He looks deep in thought as he stares towards the horizon, a whittling project seems to have been forgotten to his left, a half finished drink on his right.
Holger motions to you to sit down on the blanket he has spread out, and you join him. Before you forget, you remember your purpose from Rosalie, and hand him a gift basket.

quest.title: Strange Companions XVI
quest.cleanDescription:
Holger looks at you with sunken eyes that seem half-focused on the past and present. When no words come, you sit, taking in the view and the odd moment, hoping the silence breaks eventually.
“These days are long and full of sorrows." He pauses, "We both know you've seen many of those. Townsfolk gone missing, some sent to work camps, Ric demanding more of us, and me, keeping a secret I don't even understand." Holger sighs, "The town is barely recognizable with these confounded dragon walls and the pervasive scent of fear and expectation. Soon we won’t even call this place home. I don’t recognize it, and I don’t like it. Almost makes you wish you could just leave and never come back."
You sit silent, waiting for more to come, something hopeful or helpful, but he offers no other words for nearly ten minutes.
“This gift, it wasn’t necessary, but it lightened my heart. Tell Rosalie thank you.”
Nodding, you realize there is nothing to do but leave and head back to Beatrix’s home empty-handed.

A flash of inspiration strikes you, and you turn around to give Holger one last gift.

quest.title: Strange Companions XVII
quest.cleanDescription:
Holger marvels at the beauty of the golden potato. “I’ve no idea how you’ve come by this, but it is truly a majestic and unique piece.” He gives you a grand smile, "Probably don't tell Cecil about this though."
Holger’s smile is enough to brighten even the clearest sky. He pauses for a moment before offering you a single phrase. “Find Buddy.”
As you leave, you are reminded of all the good in this town, the people and the community. The smiles of the townsfolk and others you've met in your journey, those memories bring you hope, and your resolve to figure out the mystery of Star is renewed.
And yet, wending your way through the streets and alleys, the trauma of the unsettling shadow again begins to grip you, the sense of someone following you gnaws at your mind. A sound, the scuff of feet comes from behind you and impulsively you glance backwards and the world rushes to greet your face.

Fear seizes your gut and despair overwhelms as a shadow looms over you. This is the end.

quest.title: Strange Companions XVIII
quest.cleanDescription:
You look up baffled and Buddy's smile fades briefly before Buddy moves to follow you, his footsteps quiet, eyes alert.
“A shadow has fallen over our town, and I’m going to stop it. I saw it attacking you earlier but I couldn’t get there in time to attack it. But, with us together, we’ll be unstoppable!” His enthusiasm is infectious as he casts an imposing figure in the daylight, you briefly consider his proposal before your better judgment takes over, and you suggest talking to the rest of the Golden Leaf before he does anything rash.
On your walk back Holger’s words ring through your ears “find Buddy…”
