Peculiarly, no more episodes of shadow occur on your trip back. Sometimes, you get the sense of being watched, and even catch a glimpse of a (the?) shadow in the window and a glint of light, but before you can react it’s gone from your vision.
Buddy notices your nerves and puts a hand on your shoulder, “Nothing will hurt you while I’m here, friend.”
You trudge back to Beatrix’s home, feeling strangely comforted on the journey. Arriving back at Beatrix’s you find you’re the first to arrive in her home. Rosalie is nowhere in sight, and neither is Lorn. Nothing to do but drink tea and wait for Buddy’s story when the rest of the golden leaf arrive.

quest.title: Strange Companions XIX
quest.cleanDescription:
The tea helps to calm your nerves, and Rosalie’s presence radiates a serenity that belies the discomfort on her face. Beatrix is the picture of radiant intensity. Lorn seems to be resting peacefully in a chair nearby quietly. The entire combination is at once discomforting and soothing. Peculiar. It takes a moment before you realize that Cecil is not there.
“Well,” Beatrix breaks the silence with an irascible look, “Tell us why you’re here, Buddy.”
Buddy looks at the assembled group, a smile on his face. “A few weeks ago, I noticed a weird blob of black moving around the town. It was really creepy and unfriendly, so I started tracking it, and when I started tracking it, it would simply...go away.”
“This happened several more times over the next few days, and I saw several townsfolk touched by this…thing…for a moment, but then it would leave quickly. Obviously, it knew I was there and I was coming to protect them.”
The assembled group is nonplussed by this revelation and ask for a few moments to gather their thoughts.

quest.title: Strange Companions XX
quest.cleanDescription:
After the assembled Golden Leaf members have had a chance to compose themselves, Lorn stands up and confronts Buddy. “Buddy you insensitive clod, there’s no way you did that, and there’s no way some semi-intelligent blob of,” Lorn stumbles over his words momentarily, “whatever, is going around attacking townspeople. Don’t jest. Are you making up children’s tales? This is serious.”
Buddy gives the assembled group a hurt look, and spurred by your own experiences, you quickly speak up, recounting your encounter from earlier that day. Looking at you, Buddy nods enthusiastically along with your recounting, but his expression quickly becomes baffled.
“Well, I wasn’t there for that, I was on the other side of town eating tacos.”
Rosalie seems startled out of her intense thought by this peculiar admission from Buddy.
“Then, it must be someone or something else dealing with this situation, and we’ve got to figure it out. Let’s go do some digging Buddy, we’ll all meet back in a week.”
Buddy begins to protest but Rosalie heads towards the door before anyone else can speak and Buddy rushes to follow her.
Those two are strange companions, you think to yourself as you walk home.

quest.title: Strange Companions XXI
quest.cleanDescription:
The night of observing Ric and Cecil, your fitful sleep is interrupted by peculiar dreams. Far off lands that look familiar but feel foreign. Always a shadow and a glint haunt your steps as you explore. A man who follows you but does not speak. A hooded figure in the distance, lights flashing before they disappear.

When you wake, the dawn has already passed and given way to a beautiful clear morning. As you open your door, a familiar figure stands up, hand on their side. Buddy gives you a lopsided smile, “Rosalie told me you were in danger before she sprinted off, she muttered something about magical infetterance and transformational diagetic conventions…something or other. Anyways, I came here as fast as I could. She kind of sounds like Star sometimes now.”

For a moment, you’re taken aback by Buddy’s tone of caring before he continues, “Anyways, Rosalie and I had a few leads and good conversations. I’m really good at getting townsfolk to talk, on account of me being so friendly! We talked to a few more townsfolk who asked to stay anonymous and we think we can identify where the shadow is going to show up next. So later today, we are gonna find that thing and win! Rosalie needs a little help with the spell she’s preparing, so meet us later today in town with this stuff!”

Before you can explain what you saw last night, Buddy bounds off.

quest.title: Strange Companions XXII
quest.cleanDescription:
You’ve brought what Buddy requests into town. Halfway to town, Charles joins you whinnying persistently, but seems to have forgotten you don’t have the ring you normally have. You’ve no idea what he is trying to communicate with you, but it’s probably not important. Rosalie’s home is empty when you get into town as Charles stamps impatiently behind you. There’s no note or markings outside her home, so you decide it might be best to keep searching around town. On your way towards Beatrix’s house, you stumble across Ric Ryph, who is inspecting some of the town's defenses.

“Ah yes, good to see you!” Ric’s cheer is evident from behind his helmet, “I want to thank you for some of your donations during these trying times, and remind you that we’re all doing our part to make Redbrook safer than it has ever been, and you’re a big part of that!” He lowers his voice so only you can hear, “Just don’t get too involved in things you have no business being a part of, alright? I like you well enough but any friend of a dragon is not a friend of mine…” As Ric stands back up again, you can see his attention move towards the items you planned on giving to Rosalie, “And these items, thank you for the donation to the town, you continue to be one of my greatest supporters!”

Right before you can respond, you notice a peculiar glimmer and a shadow around the next corner and you excuse yourself quickly as Ric hands you a paper receipt.

quest.title: Strange Companions XXIII
quest.cleanDescription:
You race down the sidestreet, the strange glimmer stuck in your mind’s eye. Cecil? The connections run through your brain in an instant, connecting the two images. You come to a back alley but something feels very wrong about this situation. You step forward only to find your foot mired in a substance black as the night. The shadow is here. The thought enters your mind as despair courses through your entire body. You’re not prepared. You’re not ready.

The shadow begins to creep up your legs and your mind is filled with images of spite and hatred. Dragons dying. Spells you don’t understand explode around you, and hideous laughter, a smile you can’t quite place.

“VENTAS LUX PROVIA!”


A cascade of light envelops you and the Shadow recoils immediately.

You recognize the familiar faces of Rosalie, Beatrix, and Buddy momentarily before taking in your surroundings. Rising to your feet, you turn towards the Shadow. To your left, Buddy draws his sword looking past you and Beatrix widens her stance slightly, her eyes dilating in a strange pattern.

Glancing to your right, a wide-eyed Rosalie looks to you, one hand reaching out to you, in the other a staff gleaming bright white, yet emitting the colors of the rainbow.

“Quick! The materials!”

quest.title: Strange Companions XXIV
quest.cleanDescription:
As Rosalie stands, another silhouette appears from behind the Shadow. The staff you recognize from last night appears from underneath the cloaked figure’s robe as a voice calls out.

“Put your staff away, Rosalie. Do you not realize who you face? Senca the Meticulous. Skugga the Inexorable. Yes, I know who you are, Trickster.”

Cecil steps forward, his cloak billowing out behind him as he slams his staff to the ground. The impact of his staff echoes like a thunderclap in a spring storm. The sound stuns you, and the crystal on the staff emits an iridescent white light that focuses into a tight beam aimed at the center of the Shadow.

"Ah, lowly mage, come back for another tussle with gifts undeserved and changed? You delay…nothing…"
The words echo in your mind unlike anything you’ve ever experienced. As the voice speaks, the Shadow grows and coalesces, a barrier of pure black meets the light from Cecil.

Determination evident on Cecil’s face, he levels his staff at the shadow and the beam of light grows more intense. Pressure builds in the area around you, power beyond what you can see but rather feel gathers between the two figures, the light intensifies and shadows play across Cecil's face in a dizzying array of color. The air crackles around the two as cracks appear on the barrier of black and light begins to pierce the Shadow itself. Moments later, the Shadow disperses in a brilliant explosion of color. Silence reigns.

Before anyone can speak, Cecil sweeps his staff in a circle and as Rosalie tries to speak, no words come out of her mouth. Buddy crosses his eyes in confusion as his mouth moves for a moment with no discernable sound before Cecil addresses the assembled members of the Golden Leaf.

“You have meddled far too much in something you do not understand, fools! Only a student of Meerif would do something so reckless and foolish. From this moment forward, you will put your heads down and ensure this town’s safety. I know your secrets, and I won’t let you interfere any longer.” He pauses, looking at each of you for a moment with unnerving intensity. “Were I a dragon, or a sorceress out of her league, or even a wanted pirate, I certainly would not wish to let my secrets be known to a certain town mayor. I trust we can all agree? Now, leave these pathetic weapons behind, you have no need of them anymore.”

quest.title: Strange Companions XXV
quest.cleanDescription:
“As an added gesture, I forbid you from discussing this matter further until I deem it so.”

Cecil waves his staff, muttering something incoherent and instantly, you feel the inability to grasp thoughts about this evening or the…incident? Was it food you came on this trip for? You can’t quite remember what it was you were doing.

“All of you go home and have a nice rest, all will be better in the morning. Charles, I expect you won’t be at my home seeing your…friend later?”

All of you part ways in a daze, the events of the past few days feel hazier and hazier. Maybe Cecil is right and a good night’s sleep will clear you right up. You head back to your home in a fog.

When you arrive a note is already on your door. You are a little tired of getting notes on your door, but can’t remember why.

“I summon the Golden Leaf to my home tomorrow morning.

Beatrix”

quest.title: Strange Companions XXVI
quest.cleanDescription:
Morning comes, and once you’ve accomplished your morning chores, you run into Charles on the way to Beatrix’s home. He gives you a polite neigh and you realize you don’t have your Ring of Renthisj. How peculiar, you think to yourself. You don’t remember leaving it at home.

The walk to Beatrix’s house takes almost no time at all. You can’t quite remember the last time you were there, but it’s a lovely house. Charles whinnies at you as you stop to admire her home and briefly wonder what he’s on about.

Beatrix welcomes you to her home, and she indicates Charles can walk around to the back. Stepping through Beatrix’s home, its precisely placed ornamentation sticks out to you like never before. The precision is both jarring and peaceful. Relics you didn’t know exist line her walls, but as you’re ready to ask about them, you find yourself on the porch, Lorn and Rosalie already sitting in chairs. No Cecil though, how peculiar. You think to yourself.

Rosalie gives you an odd look as Beatrix speaks to the assembled group, “Refreshments, anyone?”

quest.title: Strange Companions XXVII
quest.cleanDescription:
Lorn and Rosalie engage in a lively debate about water speeds of various fish during the first parts of their refreshments, but Beatrix looks at the group with a growing intensity. Charles has taken up a position right off the porch and has been very quiet.

“My dear Rosalie, there is simply no way a pond trout could outswim a river trout. Clearly you’re unfamiliar with the patterns of the northern fjord trout…in my younger days I even - “

At this moment, Beatrix slams her drink on the table, a disgusted look on her face. All drinks go flying as everyone looks at Beatrix in bewilderment. “Beatrix! Explain yourself!” Lorn’s face is twisted up in an angry look you’re confident is typically reserved for particularly bad Buddy pranks.

“Golden Leaf! Are you content to whittle the days of your life away knowing what we know of Cecil? The shadow? Are you all content to move on with life knowing something is *out there* threatening our lives? To say nothing of Cecil threatening to expose Geist to Ric?” You can feel the heat in the air as Beatrix’s indignation rises. “We must act!!”

Beatrix seems ready to burst before she sees the clear confusion on the faces of the rest of the group. She pauses a moment, “Oh? Oh. He didn’t. Yes, this is beyond me, if we must. For the Leaf.”

Beatrix calmly steps away from the group, “We will need you all to go inside for a moment, come back outside in about 5 minutes. Charles, please keep watch at the front of the house. We’ll be hungry when you get back.”

quest.title: Strange Companions XXVIII
quest.cleanDescription:
Before long, you all step back outside and before you is what you can only believe to be a dragon. Geist dwarfs her home, more majestic than a mountain. As she lowers her head to address you, flame crackles from her nose and a different fire burns in her eyes that can only be described as sheer intelligent determination. A single ring hangs off a chain on her neck. As Charles steps back, you see his ears pin back, a wild terror gleams in his eyes and for a moment, he stands still, before bolting past Geist and towards the town proper.

“It is clear by your countenance that you do not remember the events of the past few days. Let me remind you. Do not worry about Charles, I should have considered seeing a dragon might affect him, he will return soon, I’m sure.”

You all stand for a moment, struck by Geist’s majesty. She first meets Rosalie’s gaze, then Lorn, and finally her eyes rest on you. For a moment, you are dumbfounded, transfixed by the sheer otherworldly nature of a dragon in the flesh. You feel yourself get lost in Geist’s eyes, a swirling vortex of fire, time and yet something deep in her eyes hypnotizes you when suddenly like a shattered mirror, your memory of the past few days snaps into focus, like a bad dream made reality you stumble backwards only to see your comrades all gasping for air.

“Cecil’s magic is strong, but he is simply a novice. Please, step inside again for a few moments and we will decide what course of action is appropriate.”

quest.title: Strange Companions XXIX
quest.cleanDescription:
“First, I’m sorry I wasn’t able to recognize and stop Cecil’s mind wipe. I do not have the…aptitude Geist has for recognizing magical influences. Perhaps our first order of business is discussing with Cecil why he would use magic on members of the Golden Leaf?”

You all agree this is a good first step, and set out towards Cecil’s home together.

Buddy suggests you cut through the middle of town, so he can stop and grab lunch at Mariya’s. As you round the corner, you all realize that there has been no one on the streets to greet you. In the town square, a figure in armor stands addressing a sizable crowd.

“Our town will not be safe until this dragon is brought to heel. Your families, your friends, your livestock, they can never feel true security! We must bring Beatrix to justice for the terror she has reigned upon this town! Are you with me?”

Beatrix quickly moves, wide-eyed behind Buddy attempting to hide herself, but it’s too late. You hear cries of “There she is! The evil dragon!”

Ric turns abruptly towards you and your friends and realizing there’s no quick way out of this, you all set yourself up for a confrontation with Ric Ryph.

quest.title: Strange Companions XXX
quest.cleanDescription:
Ric slowly removes his helmet, and for the first time, you see more than his scheming eyes. A wicked smile spreads across his face, a host of townspeople gathered behind him in anticipation. Beatrix stands before the assembled crowd - "He's fooled you! He killed the mayor! He sent many of you to work camps! He’s the enemy! A Shadow has sent him against us!"

Ric lets out a laugh, it echoes through the streets, a hollow laugh that never touches his eyes. "Oh my dear, but you forget, you are the monster here, and the town, they want revenge. And safety. Safety only a dragon hunter can provide.”

As he is speaking, Ric takes slow deliberate steps towards Beatrix, and before you can blink, Ric darts forward, a glint of steel as a dagger appears in his hand as he stabs Beatrix in the stomach.

The townsfolk break into a raucous cheer.

Time slows.

Beatrix crumples.

Lorn gasps.

Rosalie cries out.

Buddy draws his sword.

The mob spills towards you.

A shadow grows in the window.

One word echoes above all the others.

“RUN!”

quest.title: Strange Companions XXXI
quest.cleanDescription:
The sound of steel striking steel rings above the riotous chorus of the crowd and Vincent stands, sword crossed with Ric’s dagger, glinting in the sun. Ric’s face is a mix of rapturous glee and determination as the two begin to fight in earnest, trading blows in a display of skill you can’t help but admire for a moment.

Vincent, sweat appearing on his brow looks to you, “What are you doing {player}, get out of here! Buddy, keep them safe!”

Gathering your wits, you see the mob descend upon the rest of the Golden Leaf. Helplessly, you heed the words of Vincent and make your way through the pack as Buddy flanks you with a sword drawn.

quest.title: Strange Companions XXXII
quest.cleanDescription:
“This. Is. My. Friend.” Each word punctuated by a swing of his sword, the steely warning in his voice and actions seem to hold back the crowd. As the mob parts, you glance behind to see all of your friends kneeling before Ric Ryph, restrained.

“The dragon is wounded, her compatriots are captured and will be sent to camp to serve the town until they have shown their contrition! A victory for Redbrook! Our town will be safe once again!”

Inching towards the back of the crowd, you can feel the nerves and frenzy building. As you break past the edge of the crowd, Buddy grabs you by the shirt and shoves you into an alleyway.

A figure stands, cloaked and imposing in front of you both, and you prepare for them to call out for the mob. A moment passes with no noise and you take a second harder look at the figure. Cecil stands before you both, leaning heavily on his staff, worry creases his features, which turn to relief as he sees you and Buddy.

The cheers of the crowd echo down the alleyway, a stark reminder of the events of the morning as you make haste out of the town into the wilderness beyond, Buddy and Cecil flanking you.

quest.title: Strange Companions XXXIII
quest.cleanDescription:
Panting, legs burning, feet weary, you stop in the forest outcropping near your farm, furtively glancing around you for any sign of followers. Cecil pulls his staff from underneath his cloak and as he strikes the ground you hear his voice utter something unintelligible and the peculiar gem lights the area, a pulsating glow that casts away shadows.

“We are safe for the moment, but I fear the citizens of the town may be too far under Ric’s influence that they might come for us any moment. We need to get Beatrix some healing, and we need a safe place to gather our thoughts and move forward.”

Buddy spins around, sword pointed at Cecil, “You are not our friend, you wiped our memories! Very un-friend-like. Why should we trust you?”

Cecil, ignoring Buddy's aggressive stance gives a weary sigh, “You’re right Buddy, I’ve made some mistakes, and I'm sorry for that. Right now, you and I are the only ones who can save the Golden Leaf, so you’re just going to have to trust in me for now. All will become clear in due time.”

Buddy nods thoughtfully, “You sound like Star, but less confusing silly words, still mysterious though. Like I always say, 'Better to have too many friends than too few.'" Buddy pauses and gives you a look, "Guess we'll have to trust Cecil for now. And the best place for friends and trust is my house."

Cecil nods to you and Buddy. “Well, we could walk there, or there are…faster ways. Got any gold feathers?”

Wizards. Wizards never change, it seems.

quest.title: Strange Companions XXXIV
quest.cleanDescription:
Cecil gathers the materials before himself and there’s an odd hum in the air as he raises his staff. Gold glows around him and the world begins to shimmer. A moment of discomfort and flashing lights later, you arrive in a familiar cave. Adorned with treasure chests and pirate coins, Buddy’s home seems a welcome respite from the chaos of the moment.

“Beatrix will need a piece of heart. I’ve not seen a wound like that in a while, but with a spell, we can make sure she will survive. Ric will want to make a grand gesture of it all, so we will have a day before he does anything too rash with her or the others, I hope.”

I’m going to need to save all my energy for teleportation, so I’ll need both your help with some of the more - “ Cecil looks to you tiredly, “- logistical and tangible details. Buddy, could you find out where Vincent and the others were taken?” Buddy looks eagerly at Cecil, “A chance to find another friend? Consider it done. I’ll just need a few…things.”

quest.title: Strange Companions XXXV
quest.cleanDescription:
A few hours later, you return to hear echoes of a conversation further into Buddy’s cave.

“...and that wasn’t even the first time he’d gotten himself in trouble! Ragvin was a great first mate, but he ran his mouth one too many times in a Sinoan port. Had to organize a jailbreak and everything. Of course, by the time we got there, he’d already nearly won his freedom playing cards with the guards! What a friend and mate…”

“...was this the prison in Celtrica?”

“Yeah! How would you know that?”

“Well, funny story, you see, before I settled here in Redbrook, I did a shameful stint as a court wizard and jester for Jamire.”

“Wait, that was you who did the fireworks in 1342?”

“Well, I had some help…”

You step into the room and see the two smiling and conversing, before you can ask them to keep going Cecil turns to you as if he knew you were in the room.

“It’s time to start this then. Buddy quickly found that our friends are being held in a newly made jail cell just off of the Town Hall. Luckily, our friend here seems to have some experience with jailbreaks. We’ll have to be quick about it though.”

Cecil details a plan involving explosives, fireworks, and some ideas that seem very Buddy inspired.

“I have everything I need to teleport our friends to safety when the moment comes, but the setup will all be on you two. We should all rest, we begin at nightfall.”

“And it will be called, operation nightfall!” Buddy chimes in.

quest.title: Strange Companions XXXVI
quest.cleanDescription:
As a chilly night falls, you follow Buddy into town. It’s a circuitous path, through areas you haven't considered as a way to get into town. The walls Ric constructed seem particularly ineffective, when considering some of the gaps and areas of weakness Buddy seems to have naturally exploited.

Buddy quickly and efficiently distributes the various distraction tools and sets timers for the morning hours. You follow behind closely, amazed at his deft movements and quick thinking - he’s clearly done this before, and you make a personal note to talk to Buddy more about his adventures later.

About halfway through placing the eggs, Buddy’s hand goes up and you both stop immediately. In the distance, you see a figure holding a torch in one hand, a lantern clipped to their hip, light glinting off their steel armor as they walk slowly and methodically. You watch Ric Ryph slowly patrolling towards the bush you and Buddy are both hidden behind.

quest.title: Strange Companions XXXVII
quest.cleanDescription:
Ric’s methodical pace gives you the impression that it’s an inevitability that he will find your hiding place. Looking at Buddy, he shoots you back a look of mixed concern and confidence. Suddenly, he shrugs his shoulders and whispers, “Sorry, not sorry, {player}.”

Buddy reveals a diamond the size of a small coin in his other hand and with a quick graceful gesture he throws the diamond and it strikes Ric’s torch, knocking it from his hand. Darkness envelops the area as Ric exclaims, “Hey! Who dares!?”

Buddy pulls you to your feet and gestures to you to run towards the middle of town. He straightens up and emits a booming laugh followed by a sing-song taunt. “Whoever it is, I’m not your frieeeeend!”

As you take off towards the town center, you look behind you to glimpse Buddy in full stride heading the opposite direction he pointed you in, a figure in metallic armor chasing after him.

quest.title: Strange Companions XXXVIII
quest.cleanDescription:
The town is eerily quiet as you tread quietly away from the din that Buddy is making in the distance. The sense of being utterly alone is both terrifying and comforting, no Shadowy presence haunts the back of your mind.

The center of the town is ringed by lit torches and poles with lanterns hung around them. A makeshift lean-to has been constructed in the town center where your friends are being kept under guard. A small fence has been erected and some barbed wire runs across the top. It occurs to you that Geist would not be bothered by these circumstances even in the worst of times.

There are two townsfolk you don’t recognize sitting in makeshift chairs chatting idly.

“Imagine - being a dragon and thinking Ric wouldn’t find you,” the first seems to spit out the word dragon like a bad piece of food.

“Yeah, and imagine being friends with a dragon. Filthy people, more interested in dragons than the town's well-being!” the other seems to feed off the first, uncomfortably so.

After taking a moment, you gather yourself and try to come up with a good distraction when you notice Vincent staring directly at you. You lock eyes for a moment and he motions for you to back away.

A plan forms in your mind and you slink off to gather the materials you will need.

quest.title: Strange Companions XXXIX
quest.cleanDescription:
Stepping back into the town in the dead of night, you approach the center and find Ric Ryph, out of breath talking to the two guards heatedly.

“The clumsy thumb was here, I know his remaining compatriot will be here too. {player} can’t help being far behind riding the coattails of the so-called Golden Leaf…” he trails off for a moment before pointing at the guards. “You and you! Double the guards! Rally the militia! Tomorrow morning, we will rid Redbrook once and for all of this dragon and my…our…town will be rid of this menace and we can move towards our glorious future!”

At this, the guards give a poor imitation of a salute and head towards the north of town.

“And you friends…”, Ric kicks some dust and sand at the makeshift prison of your compatriots. “This town,” Ric raises his hands and spins around slowly proclaiming to the group and the air, “is mine now. The Golden Leaf is finished, and this dragon will meet her end in the morning. There is no one left to oppose me. I’ve beaten your mayor, your wizard, your soldier, your dragon, your sorceress and your erstwhile pirate.” His laugh echoes across the square, “And I barely had to lift a hand to do it. Trusting folk, the lot of you.” He stops again, his chuckle turning malicious. “I’ve killed many dragons before, and I’ll kill more yet this branch. And someday, maybe even with your help Beatrix, Alghavaz will be in my grasp.”

quest.title: Strange Companions XL
quest.cleanDescription:
You clench your fists, ready to enact your plan, when in the distance, you hear a faint whistle. And another. And another. Suddenly, a cacophony of whistles and explosions wash across the town. Fireworks begin to encircle the whole town when suddenly explosions shake your feet. Buddy did it!

Ric looks to the sky, a moment of confusion as townsfolk begin to light their homes and look through their windows.

In the sky, a symbol appears in the fireworks. A giant golden leaf.

“We are more than the sum of our parts, Ric,” Beatrix's voice can be heard clear as day through the chaos. She stands, blood on her shirt, clearly wounded.

“We are one. I am Beatrix but I am also no mere dragon…” A golden light emits from Beatrix’s eyes and the night glows as bright as noon, followed by a blinding flash, before you all, Geist in all her glory radiates energy and hope.

Ric stands, a stunned look in his eyes and seems unable to move.

“...I am also Geist, and your time in Redbrook terrorizing its citizens will meet its end soon enough.”

Geist lowers her wing and your companions clamber on her back before she leaps in the air and flies away into the crackling darkness, backlit by the flashing fireworks and chaos around the town.

Mariya's famous Hickory Omelette has been perfected, but a good cook never rests on her laurels! She wants to try to capture a seasonal flavor with her omelet now.

Could you bring her a few ingredients to try out as variations?

quest.title: Eggstremely Delicious II

quest.title: Blooming Thaw Already I
quest.cleanDescription: Borgen is looking for an assortment of wildflowers for a customer. Unfortunately, the cold weather seems to be delaying the normal blooms he finds this time of year. If you happen to find any flowers, especially blue flowers, Borgen would be happy to trade you for some useful goods.

quest.title: Blooming Thaw Already II
quest.cleanDescription: The blue flowers were perfect! If you find any more, Borgen is looking for white flowers now.

quest.title: Blooming Thaw Already III
quest.cleanDescription: If you happen to find any orange flowers, Borgen is ready to trade for them.

quest.title: Blooming Thaw Already IV
quest.cleanDescription: Since the weather is still too cold for the flowers to bloom in the wild, Borgen sent off for some flower seeds to grow on his own. They arrived today. However, Borgen doesn’t want to wait for the flowers to grow now. It will be much quicker if you continue to help him. Will you go ahead and bring more flowers? Borgen is ready for yellow flowers now.

quest.title: Blooming Thaw Already V
quest.cleanDescription: Perfect! Borgen only needs red flowers to complete the order. Will you bring him red flowers?

quest.title: Blooming Thaw Already VI
quest.cleanDescription: Borgen appreciates your help finishing the flower order up so quickly. As a token of his gratitude, he’d like to give you the seeds he ordered. He also wouldn’t mind if you kept a few flowers ready to go for future orders, if it’s not too much trouble.

quest.title: Eggstremely Valuable I
quest.cleanDescription:
Many times during his travels, Vincent heard tales of people finding decorated eggs hidden in strange places. The eggs were similar in size and heft to normal chicken eggs, but they were decorated with colors and designs. The eggs also seemed to be completely indestructible, at least the one Vincent saw couldn’t be cracked.

These decorated eggs always appeared in the early spring, and many of the legends said there were only 12 eggs that could be found. When spring ended, the eggs vanished until the following year. Then, the eggs reappeared, hidden in new locations.

A few of the legends spoke of a 13th golden egg that held vast powers or wealth or something like that. No one ever found the 13th egg in any of the stories.

Vincent would like you to keep an eye out this spring for mysteriously decorated eggs in strange places. If the two of you can find the 12 springtime eggs, maybe you can find the golden egg too. Vincent would be happy to evenly split any profit that could be made from the golden egg.

If you’re interested, just bring any strange eggs you find to Vincent to prove and secure.

quest.title: Eggstremely Valuable II
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent hasn’t found any more eggs, yet. Have you?

quest.title: Eggstremely Valuable III
quest.cleanDescription:
Vincent finds it strange that you have found 2 eggs and he has found none.

Have you found more eggs?

quest.title: Eggstremely Valuable IV
quest.cleanDescription: Any more good fortune?

quest.title: Eggstremely Valuable V
quest.cleanDescription:
Vincent still hasn’t found a single egg.

You clearly have the better luck. Have you found another egg?

quest.title: Eggstremely Valuable VI
quest.cleanDescription:
If you continue to find all the eggs, Vincent thinks his share of the profit may have to be revised downward.

Did you find another egg?

quest.title: Eggstremely Valuable VII
quest.cleanDescription:
Vincent finds his lack of success at finding eggs to be very disturbing.

What do you have?

quest.title: Eggstremely Valuable VIII
quest.cleanDescription:
Vincent wonders what the odds are that he can find a single egg.

Which one did you find?

quest.title: Eggstremely Valuable IX
quest.cleanDescription:
Vincent is prepared to now accept a smaller percentage of the profit made from selling the eggs. He thinks his share should be equivalent to the percentage of the eggs he finds plus 5%, for coming up with the idea. He still hasn’t found any eggs, but he’s still searching.

How is your search going?

quest.title: Eggstremely Valuable X
quest.cleanDescription:
Vincent’s chances of finding an egg are really slim now. Even though it’s a bit depressing to be so thoroughly defeated at searching for eggs, Vincent is completely amazed to see these legends turning out to be true. It may be enough to just have his curiosity satisfied. Nevertheless, he’s not giving up his search.

Have you found a new egg?

quest.title: Eggstremely Valuable XI
quest.cleanDescription:
Vincent can’t wait to see all 12 eggs now. You’re so close!

Will you continue and finish the search?

quest.title: Eggstremely Valuable XII
quest.cleanDescription:
Vincent hopes the legend of the golden egg is true. Even if you find it, Vincent just wants to see it.

Did you find the last decorated egg?

quest.title: Eggstremely Valuable XIII
quest.cleanDescription:
You’re not going to believe this! Vincent found the golden egg!

He put all of the 12 decorated eggs together on a plate and they began to glow a soft red glow. The eggs glowed for hours and did nothing else. Confused, Vincent picked up the plate of eggs and moved toward his table. The eggs started glowing a soft green, but turned red again when he put the plate down.

Vincent picked the plate up again and started walking outside. The eggs glowed green whenever he was moving and got brighter when he moved toward the highland hills. So, he kept walking with the eggs right up to the center of the hills.

Somewhere near the center of the hills, the eggs flashed like noonday sun. Vincent immediately stopped and sat down with the eggs while he waited for his eyes to readjust after the flash. When he finally looked around, Vincent saw something shiny in a knot of grass. It was the golden egg!

The decorated eggs stopped glowing after that flash, and nothing more happened when Vincent added the golden egg to the plate of decorated eggs. Whatever magic was at work in the eggs seems to be at rest now.

Now, Vincent doesn’t know what to do with the eggs. He would love to make some money from them, but he feels like it isn’t really earned for his part. He’s also plenty satisfied just seeing legends he heard come to life.

Vincent thinks you should take the eggs. He appreciates all your hard work and figures that you deserve the reward for your efforts.

quest.title: You Must Build A Boat I

quest.title: You Must Build A Boat II
quest.cleanTitle: You Must Build A Boat II

quest.title: You Must Build A Boat III

quest.cleanTitle: You Must Build A Boat IV

quest.title: Fire in the Belly I
quest.cleanDescription:
Holger heard a noise outside near his smokehouse. It was loud enough that it woke him. By the time he put his prosthetic leg on, grabbed his axe, and got to the smokehouse, all of his smoked fish were gone. He saw something big flying away in the moonlight, but he could only make out a silhouette. Whatever it was, it blasted the door to ashes before it took all his fish.
Will you help Holger restock and repair his smokehouse?

quest.title: Fire in the Belly II
quest.cleanDescription:
Holger is not happy.

He didn’t hear anything this time, but something broke into his smokehouse and emptied it again. Whatever is stealing Holger’s food destroyed the door again too. All that’s left of the door is the steel reinforcements he added, but they were warped and bent away.

After talking it over with Thomas, they came up with an idea, and they want you to help. They want to rebuild the door, and then fill the smokehouse from floor to ceiling with fish. They don’t need anything fancy or delicious just lots of fish. They’re hoping whatever is breaking in will return and start in on the fish. Then, when it’s really, really full they can get the drop on it.

quest.title: Strange Stones I
quest.cleanDescription: Beatrix has heard rumors about stones with unique properties. Specifically, she heard about a unique stone somewhere on Mount Banon. Unfortunately, she's never been able to find it. Will you help her find this unique stone?

quest.title: Strange Stones II
quest.cleanDescription: Beatrix heard about another strange stone from Lorn. He said it's somewhere in the Ember Lagoon area. Beatrix tried to get Lorn to help her find the stone, but he's too busy helping all of the new folks that have come to town. Will you help Beatrix find another strange stone?

quest.title: Strange Stones III
quest.cleanDescription: Beatrix is still searching for strange stones. Recently, she caught a promising lead from Holger, after emptying her pantry to feed him. Holger said that he found 2 strange stones in Black Rock Canyon, but he doesn't remember where, although he did remember eating beef jerky when he found the stone with 4 runes on it. After searching for several days, Beatrix found the stone with 4 runes on it, but it doesn't react with the other stones you found for her. Can you find the other stone?

quest.title: Strange Stones IV
quest.cleanDescription: While Beatrix was experimenting with the strange stones yesterday, Thomas stopped by to talk about shark bait ideas. Thomas recognized the stones and said that his parents used to search for a runestone, like the ones Beatrix has, on the Highland Hills. His parents never found it, but they were sure it was out there. Beatrix wants that runestone.

quest.title: Strange Stones V
quest.cleanDescription: Beatrix got another clue about runestones. Jill said that her family found a few runestones when they grew certain crops when she was a kid. She said that they found one stone among eggplants and another in their cornfield. Beatrix would like you to try harvesting eggplants to see if Jill's tale is true.

quest.title: Strange Stones VI
quest.cleanDescription: Jill was right! Beatrix would like you to try to get a runestone from harvesting corn now.

quest.title: Strange Stones VII
quest.cleanDescription: Beatrix got another clue. It's secondhand and unverified, but Vincent really believes it. So it should be as good as the clues for the other stones. Vincent heard from a brewer, sometime during his travels, he wouldn't say where, that the secret to his incredible ale was a stone that he found in a bag of hops. Vincent said the ale was easily the best he ever had. Beatrix would like you to try harvesting some hops.

quest.title: Strange Stones VIII
quest.cleanDescription: A few weeks ago, Beatrix hired a fishing charter for Lake Tempest. She asked the crew about strange stones before they left. A couple of the older hands said that they found a few strange stones on a variety of fishing trips. After a lot of disagreement, Captain Logan suggested the best strategy would be to follow the flow of the water and search the lake, the river, and the ocean. Since then, Beatrix has fished and hired charters every day with no success. Will you try the lake?

quest.title: Strange Stones IX
quest.cleanDescription: With the addition of that 8th runestone, something strange happened. The runestones started glowing. Beatrix really wants to see if there are any more runestones. Will you try the river?

quest.title: Strange Stones X
quest.cleanDescription: Nothing changed with the addition of the 9th runestone. Beatrix expected something more to happen, but the stones are just glowing. Beatrix thinks there must be another runestone. Will you try the ocean?

quest.title: Giamics' Jubilee
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie is planning the annual Giamics’ Jubilee, which celebrates the town’s founding, and its first mayor, Andrew Giamics. She thanks you for being so helpful to everyone in town in the short time you’ve lived here, and asks if you would be willing to help her gather some of the items she needs for the jubilee, while she continues planning. She promises to compensate you for your time and offers you a list of items she needs.

quest.title: Giamics' Jubilee II
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie thanks you for bringing her supplies. She now wants to organize some party games everyone can play. She hands you another list, and uses the blue feathers you brought to cast a levitation spell. The barrels start shifting into neat, organized lines.

quest.title: Giamics' Jubilee III
quest.cleanDescription: You’ve just finished dragging over the last batch of apples, and you hear Rosalie shout, “I still need a few more apples, please!” Now apples are floating through the air and plopping into the barrels. You’re impressed, and bring her more apples.

quest.title: Giamics' Jubilee IV

quest.title: Giamics' Jubilee V

quest.title: Giamics' Jubilee VI
quest.cleanDescription: After you share some words with Holger, he promises to not eat any more apples, until the celebration. He says that he is still hungry, and if you bring him something to eat it will help him remember his promise.

quest.title: Giamics' Jubilee VII
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie tells you that this celebration needs a little bit of magic to make it special. You look at the floating apples from her active levitation spell, and she shakes her head. “Not my magic.” She tasks you with finding Star Meerif, and hands you a sealed letter to give him. She tells you there’s a big, open clearing near the river, and that you can probably find him there.

quest.title: Giamics' Jubilee VIII
quest.cleanDescription: You head to the clearing, and see nothing but emptiness, and a few scattered feathers. Trying to call for Star seems pointless, until you say you have a letter from Rosalie. Before your eyes, Star’s tower appears. He rushes out, and holds his hand out for the letter. He looks disheveled, and seems to be in a big hurry. You hand him the letter, and he runs back inside, mumbling something about "the penumbra of the equator." He and his tower are gone as quickly as they appeared.

quest.title: Giamics' Jubilee IX
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie would like to give a special job to frank, who told her earlier that he will be busy taking a nap. You find frank nestled in a pile of carrot tops, basking in the sun. Calling his name does not wake him up, nor does jostling him lightly. You decide to harvest some carrots, and chop them up very finely. You sprinkle the carrot shavings in a trail, leading to Rosalie, and wait.

quest.title: Giamics' Jubilee X

I feel like that was a trick to get me to come do something.” Rosalie smiles, and pats frank. She asks you to bring her some more materials while she updates frank on his part in her celebration.

quest.title: Giamics' Jubilee XI

quest.title: Giamics' Jubilee XII

Rosalie is baffled that she forgot such an integral part of the event: EGGS!
Nobody can quite remember when the tradition started, but the town’s celebration has always involved colorful eggs.

quest.title: Giamics' Jubilee XIV

quest.title: Which Wizard Hats And Which Witch Hats I
quest.cleanTitle: Which Wizard Hats And Which Witch Hats I
quest.cleanDescription:
The festivities in full swing, you walk the streets. Déjà vu strikes you as you stumble upon Rosalie in a witches hat.

“These hats, they’re magical, the bring me such joy and connection! Perhaps you could bring me a few? The Haunted House gives me some weird vibes, or I’d do it myself.”

Shrugging, you set off. What Halloween is this again?

quest.title: Which Wizard Hats And Which Witch Hats II
quest.cleanTitle: Which Wizard Hats And Which Witch Hats II
quest.cleanDescription:
In a flash of feathers in Rosalie’s home, Star Meerif appears in full wizard garb. He bows in a strange fashion you’re not familiar with, and extends a hand towards Rosalie.

“Witch Hats, they’re so hot right now. Did you notice how when you have them in proximity to…you…that the solar ley lines shift subtly towards the past?”

Rosalie takes Star’s hand with a big smile and replies, "You know what? Not only that, but if you hang a bat wing from it, it makes for an excellent fashion statement.”

Sensing you’re going to need more hats, you dutifully leave the two of them to their chatter.

quest.title: Which Wizard Hats And Which Witch Hats III
quest.cleanTitle: Which Wizard Hats And Which Witch Hats III
quest.cleanDescription: Leaving the Haunted House, you approach the town to find a dejected Star sitting on a log.  You could swear you hear something approaching a sniffle from his direction.  Approaching, he takes the hats and bat wings from you and shuffles sadly in the direction of his tower.  He mutters something about solar ley lines and candy corn.  Maybe Rosalie can help explain…?

quest.title: Which Wizard Hats And Which Witch Hats IV
quest.cleanTitle: Which Wizard Hats And Which Witch Hats IV
quest.cleanDescription:
Rosalie sits on her porch, a single Wizard Hat in her hand. The sad look on her face, and the context clues from earlier make you think something has gone terribly wrong.

She looks at you and takes the delivery. Her soft voice barely reaches you over the sounds of the festivities around you.

"Trick -"

quest.title: Which Wizard Hats And Which Witch Hats V
quest.cleanTitle: Which Wizard Hats And Which Witch Hats V
quest.cleanDescription:
Flowers suddenly appear around you, Rosalie’s home seems to make the sound like the popping of a cork, and witch hats with bat wings appear lining her roof and porch.

“or treat!”


Star appears next to you, “Oh, you should have seen the look on your face! Solar ley lines? What even are those?”

Rosalie and Star burst out in laughter, much to your amusement. Halloween is truly a magical time.

quest.title: Unlikely Pair I
quest.cleanDescription: A letter from Jill has been delivered. After your last encounter with Jill, you’re wary of what she may say. You open the letter, and…She’s requesting corn. The word “URGENT” is written at least 4 times, so you’d better bring some fast.

quest.title: Unlikely Pair II
quest.cleanDescription:
You arrive at Jill's property with her requested corn. Her barn doors are open, which is unusual. You head that way. Once inside, you’re greeted by Jill. “Oh my, thank you. Where is the rest? Is it outside?” Your lack of response answers her questions. She takes what you’ve brought and sets it down.

Looking around, you notice this barn is 1/3 filled with machinery you’ve never seen before, and 2/3 filled with corn. “Bring as much as you can, you can just leave it outside the barn and my associate will collect it. Your payments will be at the drop off spot when you return.” She waves you off.

quest.title: Unlikely Pair III
quest.cleanDescription:
CORN FACT: Only one percent of corn planted in Redbrook is sweet corn. The other 99 percent of corn grown in Redbrook is “Field Corn”. Not the delicious sweet corn you might enjoy on the cob or in a can.

Field corn is the classic big ears of yellow dented corn you see dried and harvested in the fall. It’s called “dent corn” because of the distinctive dent that forms on the kernel as the corn dries.

quest.title: Unlikely Pair IV
quest.cleanDescription: CORN FACT: While a small portion of “Field Corn” is processed for use as corn cereal, corn starch, corn oil and corn syrup for human consumption, it is primarily used for livestock feed, ethanol production and manufactured goods. It’s considered a grain.

quest.title: Unlikely Pair V
quest.cleanDescription: CORN FACT: Sweet corn is what people purchase fresh, frozen or canned for eating. It’s consumed as a vegetable. Unlike “Field Corn”, which is harvested when the kernels are dry and fully mature, sweet corn is picked when immature.

quest.title: Unlikely Pair VI
quest.cleanDescription: CORN FACT:  Corn can be produced in various colors including blackish, bluish-gray, purple, green, red and white but the most common color grown is yellow.

quest.title: Unlikely Pair VII
quest.cleanDescription: CORN FACT: The number of kernels per ear can vary from 500 to about 1200, but a typical ear would have 800 kernels in 16 rows.

quest.title: Unlikely Pair VIII
quest.cleanDescription: CORN FACT: There is one silk for every kernel that grows in an ear of corn.

quest.title: Unlikely Pair IX
quest.cleanDescription: CORN FACT: Popcorn is a type of maize (or corn), a member of the grass family, and is scientifically known as Zea mays everta.

quest.title: Unlikely Pair X
quest.cleanDescription: CORN FACT: Popcorn differs from other types of maize/corn in that it has a thicker pericarp/hull. The hull allows pressure from the heated water to build and eventually bursts open. The inside starch becomes gelatinous while being heated; when the hull bursts, the gelatinized starch spills out and cools, giving it its familiar popcorn shape.

quest.title: Unlikely Pair XI
quest.cleanDescription: CORN FACT: Popcorn pops in two basic shapes, butterfly and mushroom. Butterfly popcorn has a very irregular shape with large bumps. It has a light crispy texture but can break easily. Mushroom-shaped popcorn has a spherical center with a rough surface. This shape makes it sturdy enough to stir when adding flavorings or coatings.

quest.title: Unlikely Pair XII
quest.cleanDescription: CORN FACT: Corn is an ingredient in fireworks.

quest.title: Unlikely Pair XIII
quest.cleanDescription: As you unload the last of the corn, you notice one of the giant stacks inside the barn is rumbling. You go to inspect, and a piece of corn is hurled your way. It misses, and this sentient corn pile is rumbling even harder. You should probably come back with some protective gear.

quest.title: Unlikely Pair XIV
quest.cleanDescription: Now that you’re armed, you approach the corn beast again. Again, a cob is forcefully thrown in your general direction. You block it successfully, and continue on. As you get closer, you hear beeping, and can just make out a glowing light coming from deep within the corn mass. You poke at it with your sword, and the rumbling stops. A few cobs tumble to the ground. You start to dig, and the light disappears. You continue to dig through this corn, determined to find the source.

quest.title: Unlikely Pair XV
quest.cleanDescription:
At last, you see something shiny buried deep within the corn. You manage to pull out ROOMBA, who appears to be powered down. Just as you pull him free, Jill returns. She looks at you, ROOMBA, and the once-organized-but-no-longer-organized corn. Your continued efforts have made quite a mess in Jill’s barn.

“Do you have ANY idea how long it took to organize each cob by kernel size? ROOMBA was going through to toss imperfections my eyes missed, and now he’s powered himself down? I told him he would be undisturbed.” Jill seems upset. “Just get these imperfections and take them out of my sight. I still need your help, so report back when you’re finished, and bring some buckets with you.”

quest.title: Unlikely Pair XVI
quest.cleanDescription: You return after disposing of the bad corn, even though it all seemed just fine to you. ROOMBA has re-reorganized the corn, so now it’s the once-organized-but-then-not-organized-but-now-is-re-organized corn. “GREETINGS. I WAS INFORMED YOUR PRESENCE WOULD BE NECESSARY. I REQUIRE…” ROOMBA pauses, and hands you a list. “THESE ITEMS TO CONTINUE.”

quest.title: Unlikely Pair XVIII
quest.cleanDescription:
“Finally! I mean, thank you, but I’m not sure if I stressed the urgency of what I’m trying to do here.” Jill has you place the items on a large, metal table in the center of the barn. All sorts of metal shapes surround you.

“I’m trying to optimize corn oil to be longer lasting and more efficient. ROOMBA has been helping me, and also is my test subject. I almost had it figured out, but i’ve been missing something that I can’t quite figure out. ROOMBA made a list of calculated statistical matches, which we can try out now.” Jill starts tinkering with some machinery, and has ROOMBA test the oil.

“PROCESSING… ANALYZING… PROOFREADING… THEORIZING… CONTEMPLATING…” He does this for several minutes. Jill offers you some iced tea while you wait together.

quest.title: Unlikely Pair XIX
quest.cleanDescription:
“ANALYSIS COMPLETE.” Jill looks at ROOMBA, and he doesn’t continue. “And the results were…?” ROOMBA takes a step back.

“INCONCLUSIVE. INSUFFICIENT MATERIALS.” Jill seems just a little too calm when she turns to you, and asks you to bring more of those materials, and a few other things as well.

quest.title: Unlikely Pair XX
quest.cleanDescription:
ROOMBA is ready to process the corn oil again. “PROCESSING… ANALYZING… PROOFREADING… THEORIZING… CONTEMPLATING… CALCULATING…”. Again, this takes several minutes.

“CALCULATIONS COMPLETE.”. ROOMBA begins listing off each sample that was run, and corresponding efficiency levels. “SAMPLE 001 EFFICIENCY: 0.32%... SAMPLE 142 EFFICIENCY: 24.25%...”. This again, continues for several minutes. “...CURRENT SAMPLE COMPARISON COMPLETE. SAMPLE 974 EFFICIENCY: 99.98%. THIS COMBINATION HAS BEEN RECORDED. SUCCESSFUL EFFICACY IMPROVEMENT.”

Jill lets out a sigh of relief. “This was only the first step, there’s much more we have to get done. But that’s for another day. Thank you.” She’ll be in touch soon.

quest.title: Ring King I
quest.cleanDescription:
One of George’s favorite foods is onion rings. For the past ten years he’s been perfecting a recipe that he created. Now, George thinks that it’s finally time to share his onion rings with the world.

During the big anniversary jubilee, George wants to set up a stand to sell his onion rings. While he’s setting up his stand, will you help him gather the ingredients he needs for the onion ring batter?
