quest.title: Ring King IV
quest.cleanDescription:
George is ready for the onions, but before you bring them, he wants to make sure that you know that they will make him cry. If seeing a grown man cry while cooking makes you uncomfortable, George understands. He won’t be offended if you drop off the onions and quickly leave.

Will you bring him as many onions as you can?

quest.title: Ring King V
quest.cleanDescription: George appreciates all of your help with his onion rings stand. His onion rings cooked up perfectly, and everyone seems to love them! Would you like to try George’s onion rings?

quest.title: To Quench The Worst Thirst
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy is incredibly thirsty.  He has a very special drink that he would like to make and, if he doesn’t drink it all, share with the town during the annual celebration.  He will need some fruits for a lovely cool concoction.  Will you bring him some fruit to start a batch?

quest.title: To Quench The Worst Thirst II
quest.cleanTitle: To Quench The Worst Thirst II
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy says his drink is coming along well, but he needs something to store it in.  Can you bring some bottles?  He also says not to worry about the caterpillars he’s offering, and promises that they aren’t used in the drink in any way.  He’s… probably telling the truth?  Otherwise, he’d be keeping them to use them, not giving them away.  Right?

quest.title: To Quench The Worst Thirst III
quest.cleanTitle: To Quench The Worst Thirst III
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy believes the last thing he needs to perfect this drink is some tea leaves.  If you bring some, he will share his drink with you.

quest.title: To Quench The Worst Thirst IV
quest.cleanTitle: To Quench The Worst Thirst IV
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy thinks he might be able to improve the blue spritz if he adds some things to help with the color.  This doesn’t seem like something that anyone should be drinking...

quest.title: To Quench The Worst Thirst V
quest.cleanTitle: To Quench The Worst Thirst V
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy is pretty sure that he’s getting close to the right color, but he needs some blue feathers to help boost it just a little more.  Those definitely can’t be healthy to drink, can they?

quest.title: To Quench The Worst Thirst VI
quest.cleanTitle: To Quench The Worst Thirst VI
quest.cleanDescription: The color is almost perfect.  Maybe some Moonstones might help get it just right?

quest.title: To Quench The Worst Thirst VII
quest.cleanTitle: To Quench The Worst Thirst VII
quest.cleanDescription: Blue gel is the last thing Buddy can think of that would help get the color just right.  Can you bring some from Whispering Creek?

quest.title: To Quench The Worst Thirst VIII
quest.cleanTitle: To Quench The Worst Thirst VIII
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy has decided that adding everything to his blue spritz really took away from the taste, so he’s keeping it just like it was.  He’d like to give you some more as a thank you for helping him try everything out.

quest.title: Far Away I
quest.cleanDescription:
Ragvin arrived in town yesterday with an empty ship and a hungry crew. He’s ready to fill his cargo holds with all manner of goods to trade throughout the isles of the Vast Ocean.

It’s been many years since Ragvin has returned to these parts. He barely recognizes Redbrook now. Ragvin could use an experienced guide to navigate these unfamiliar waters. Would you be willing to help him get reacquainted with Redbrook and fill his ship to the brim with goods to trade?

Ragvin would like to start with a sizable load of cotton.

quest.title: Far Away II
quest.cleanDescription: Before moving onto the less robust goods Ragvin wants to fill his ship with, will you bring him tools and supplies for carrying cargo safely across the seas?

quest.title: Far Away III
quest.cleanDescription: Ragvin could also use some supplies to do maintenance and repairs on his ship before filling it to the gills with goods. Will you bring him this list of items?

quest.title: Far Away IV
quest.cleanDescription: Now, Ragvin would like a few large loads each of salt, flour, and sweet root.

quest.title: Far Away V
quest.cleanDescription: Ragvin is ready for the next load of flour, salt, and sweet root.

quest.title: Far Away VI
quest.cleanDescription: Ragvin is well pleased with the goods you’ve found for him so far. He’d like to keep working with you to fill his boat. Will you bring him a large load of rice and a large load of potatoes?

quest.title: Far Away VII
quest.cleanDescription: There’s still plenty of room! Ragvin would like another load of rice and potatoes, if you please.

quest.title: Far Away VIII
quest.cleanDescription: Now for some variety! Ragvin would like you to bring a large load of each of these items.

quest.title: Far Away IX
quest.cleanDescription: Ragvin has decided that he has found in you a competent guide to help with his business here in Redbrook. If you’ll help him fill the last of his hold, he and his crew will be on their way. If their trades are successful across the isles, Ragvin will return and call on you again for assistance.

quest.title: Far Away X
quest.cleanDescription:
Lorn thinks you were right to come to him with your suspicions. It is very strange that Ragvin had the treasures you sent with Thomas and Captain Thomas on their voyage. Nevertheless, Lorn would like to proceed diplomatically and discuss the matter directly with Ragvin, should he return to Redbrook.

For now, Lorn has asked Captain Logan to search for any sign of the Sarafina or its crew. Lorn also sent out a request to all the ships working the coast to keep an eye out for Ragvin’s ship and anything out of the ordinary.

To help Captain Logan and his crew with the search, will you help fill their orders for fish?

quest.title: Far Away XI
quest.cleanDescription: Captain Logan’s crew hasn’t found anything, but they are continuing their efforts. Lorn would like your help to continue to fill their orders.

quest.title: Far Away XII
quest.cleanDescription: Lorn doesn’t have any more information for you, but he could use your help getting more fish to keep Captain Logan’s orders filled.

quest.title: Far Away XIII
quest.cleanDescription: Lorn would like to get ahead of some of Captain Logan’s regular orders. Will you give Lorn a hand?

quest.title: Far Away XIV
quest.cleanDescription:
Captain Logan took his ship to some of the more distant, populated islands to search for Thomas and Captain Thomas. Unfortunately, no one has seen the Sarafina or the Thomases. However, everyone that Captain Logan’s crew talked to knew Ragvin. They said he and his crew were fair traders and often gave goods away to the less fortunate. Some folks also wondered how Ragvin could stay in business at his prices. The people of the islands that Captain Logan visited expected Ragvin to return within the next few months.

Lorn suspects Ragvin and crew may return to Redbrook after they return to the distant islands Captain Logan visited. He thinks it may be time to wait to talk to Ragvin. Sometimes when we’re lost it’s best to stand still and wait for opportunity to come to us.

Lorn appreciates all of your help supporting Captain Logan and his crew. He couldn’t have done it without you. Now, to show thanks to Captain Logan and his crew for their efforts, will you help Lorn gather another load of fish?

quest.title: Far Away XV
quest.cleanDescription:
Ragvin found some friends of yours. They were stranded out in the open ocean with their engine malfunctioning and their sails shredded by a storm. Other than the troubles with their boat, and the one lad looking pale as a sheet, Ragvin thought they were in high spirits. Ragvin offered to tow them to the nearest port so they could repair their boat and make for home, but the boys wouldn’t hear of it. Instead, they asked for some materials to repair their engine and sails, so they could continue on to some glowing island…

Ragvin has more of the story to tell you, but he could use a drink before continuing. Will you bring him something refreshing?

quest.title: Far Away XVI
quest.cleanDescription:
After helping the boys get back up and running, Ragvin intended to continue on his route, but curiosity got the better of him and his crew. Your friends seemed so eager and sincere. So, Ragvin offered to accompany Thomas and Thomas on their search for the glowing island for a few days.

Just before sundown the following day, an island was spotted and the pale Thomas got really excited. Ragvin called for a halt of both ships. He loaded a dinghy with the Thomases, himself, and a couple of his crew, and they launched for the shore. As soon as the pale Thomas set foot on the island, he passed out…

Ragvin is feeling a bit parched again. Will you get him something else to drink? The cider didn’t quite refresh him.

quest.title: Far Away XVII
quest.cleanDescription:
When the pale Thomas finally woke, he was no longer pale. He also said the glow was gone, or at least he couldn’t see it anymore. Ragvin left the no-longer-pale Thomas with his two crewmen to recover himself while Ragvin and the healthy Thomas took a short look around the island.

Ragvin and the healthy Thomas didn’t find anything particularly noteworthy as they searched the island, but your friend looked surprised anyway. When Ragvin addressed the surprised look, Thomas said that the island they were exploring was exactly the same as an island he and the other Thomas set sail from, rock for rock and tree for tree.

Ragvin found that claim extremely curious, but with a pressing need to continue his trade route, Ragvin couldn’t remain on the island for much longer. The next day, Ragvin brought more of his crew to the island to help explore. Like the night before, they couldn’t find anything valuable…

Ragvin could use another drink. The telling of this story is really drying out his throat.

quest.title: Far Away XVIII
quest.cleanDescription:
Ragvin informed the Thomases that he would be leaving at sunrise the next morning. He also invited the boys to join his crew and leave the island. As if they had already discussed the prospect, both Thomases said no at the same time. They decided to remain on the island and continue exploring, but they expressed their gratitude for Ragvin’s kindness.

The next morning, Ragvin and his crew left behind some supplies for the Thomases and then left the island for their ship. They continued on their trade route until they were nearly to Redbrook. As they approached the coast, they met Captain Logan and his crew. Captain Logan informed Ragvin of the missing Thomases and requested that Ragvin find you or Lorn if he had any information on their fate.

Unfortunately, that’s all Ragvin can tell you of the fate of your friends.

However, if you’ll bring Ragvin one more drink, he’d be happy to discuss what he and his crew can do to help check on the Thomases as they continue on their trade route.

quest.title: Far Away XIX
quest.cleanDescription:
Ragvin would be glad to go and check up on your friends. The only thing he asks is that you’ll help him refill his boat so he can feed his crew and keep them from hardship on the long voyage to that remote island. He’ll still pay you for the goods you supply. Once Ragvin and his crew reach the island and check on the Thomases, they will immediately turn back for Redbrook with an update, or if your friends are ready to make for home, Ragvin will escort them the whole way.

If you’re inclined to agree with his plan, Ragvin will get his ship loaded as quickly as you can bring the goods he needs.

quest.title: Far Away XX
quest.cleanDescription:
Lorn agrees with your suspicions, but he doesn’t understand why Ragvin paid you with items you clearly gave to Thomas and Captain Thomas during his last visit, and then said that he met them after that last visit to Redbrook. Ragvin has to know that you know he’s lying. But why?

Lorn has a plan. If you’re willing to help, Lorn is going to ask Ragvin if he can join his crew for the trip to check on Thomas and Captain Thomas. Will you help him prepare for the voyage?

quest.title: Far Away XXI
quest.cleanDescription: Ragvin is ready for another load. His crew is working as quickly as possible to load the ship and make sail.

quest.title: Far Away XXII
quest.cleanDescription:
Ragvin did not agree to let Lorn join his crew. He did, however, offer to guide another ship to the island, if Lorn could find one willing to make the long journey.

Captain Logan is willing to lease out one of his ships, and some of the crew that work the ship are willing to work the vessel for this voyage. However, the ship will require a few extra hands to fully function. Lorn has volunteered to go and he asked George and Mariya to also come along. If you would be willing to join the crew, Lorn would be very grateful and he would feel more confident that this crew can handle any chaos that may come blowing on the wind.

quest.title: Far Away XXIII
quest.cleanDescription: Ragvin is ready for the next load to fill his boat. He thinks three more loads should fill it after this one.

quest.title: Far Away XXIV
quest.cleanDescription: Ragvin’s crew is working quickly. They’re ready for another load.

quest.title: Far Away XXV
quest.cleanDescription: Ragvin’s crew is ready for the next load.

quest.title: Far Away XXVI
quest.cleanDescription:
After talking more with Lorn, Captain Logan has decided to command the ship that Lorn leased. He wants to make sure that you all make it safely home after you find Thomas and Captain Thomas. Also, he doesn’t trust this Ragvin. There’s something off about his story, specifically the route he claimed to take.

Captain Logan has prepared his crews to continue their fishing operations in his absence, but he would like to make sure they have more resources than they need to keep things running smoothly while he’s gone. Will you sell Captain Logan some additional supplies for his crews?

quest.title: Far Away XXVII
quest.cleanDescription: Ragvin is ready for the final load. Some of these items may seem strange, but he has a buyer looking for these very specific items. So, he will need all of them.

quest.title: Far Away XXVIII
quest.cleanDescription: Once again, Ragvin thanks you for your help. You have become an absolute boon to his business. And that’s why he’d like to request that you not embark on this voyage you’ve signed onto. He’d prefer that such a valuable partner would not endanger themself on such a perilous journey. Ragvin hopes that you’ll accept this special gift and stay home.

quest.title: Far Away XXIX
quest.cleanDescription:
The Voyage Log for the Captain of the Two Fishers
Day 144 of Leaf 84 of Branch 1342

I, Captain Logan, have taken command of the Two Fishers to lead a chartered voyage to a remote island far to the east. The Two Fishers regular commander, Lieutenant Lizotte, will be commanding the Zefurea in my absence.

In addition to the Two Fishers’ regular crew, we have aboard the following passengers.

Lorn, of Redbrook
George, of Redbrook
Mariya, of Redbrook
{player}, of Redbrook

I have requested that each passenger volunteer to assist with the labors associated with such a long voyage. For the first leg of the trip, Lorn will be assisting with keeping our vessel tidy, George and {player} have volunteered to help with fishing, and Mariya volunteered to assist with meals. With this additional help, we should be able to comfortably make this voyage and still keep up with the vessel guiding us, a merchant ship called Balstar, commanded by Captain Ragvin.

Evening update:
Mariya is a welcome addition to our regular cook. We enjoyed three hearty and delicious meals today. The crew was quite pleased.

George and {player} helped catch a record haul for this vessel! That farmer sure can fish!

Lorn is doing a fine job of keeping the ship tidy, but some of the crew have complained already that he is a bit too zealous. I’ll encourage Lorn to go a little easier on them.

quest.title: Far Away XXX
quest.cleanDescription:
The Voyage Log for the Captain of the Two Fishers
Day 145 of Leaf 84 of Branch 1342

Overnight update:
The night crew reported that everything ran smoothly and the Balstar kept their lights glowing throughout the dark hours. Navigation was easy and all systems functioned properly. Then, the rest, and the bulk, of their report focused on appreciation for Mariya’s thoughtful, and apparently quite delicious, meals. The food was a significant step up from the usual leftovers of the day. I need to thank Mariya at breakfast this morning.

Midday update:
We are still following the Balstar closely, and we’re on schedule to reach Nonir Island within four days. Our passengers have expressed their hopes that they might get to see some of the famous turtles of Nonir, but I reminded them that the turtles typically inhabit the opposite side of the island from where we’ll be docking. Nevertheless, if we have time I would like to try to get them within sight of the turtles.

Evening update:
Once again, George and {player} have pulled in an incredible haul! It is a sight to behold these two pulling in net after net brimming with fish. It is tempting to offer them both a job when we return home. If the fishing continues at this pace, our preservation hold will be completely full well in advance of our arrival at Nonir Island.

quest.title: Far Away XXXI
quest.cleanDescription:
The Voyage Log for the Captain of the Two Fishers
Day 146 of Leaf 84 of Branch 1342

Overnight update:
Mariya’s meals for the overnight crew were once again the main topic of their report. When I reported this praise and gave my thanks to Mariya, she seemed surprised, but she graciously accepted the praise and gratitude. She then shooed me out of the galley so she and Mr. Ecsil could get back to work.

The overnight crew also mentioned that their regular chores are easier than usual with Lorn still leading the cleaning efforts. I may need to speak to Lorn about easing up a little more.

Midday update:
Our fishing efforts are still exceeding my expectations. I don’t know how George and {player} are doing it. Maybe it’s just a case of really good fortune.

Evening update:
Another day is done. We are still keeping up with the Balstar and making swift progress.

quest.title: Far Away XXXII
quest.cleanDescription:
The Voyage Log for the Captain of the Two Fishers
Day 147 of Leaf 84 of Branch 1342

Overnight update:
After more praise of Mariya’s meals, the overnight crew reported that all the lights on the Balstar went out for 20 to 30 seconds and then came back on. We’ll signal to them this morning to check if they’re having issues with their lightworks.

Midday update:
The Balstar reported that they had a temporary issue with their lights caused by a minor maintenance task on their lightworks system. Everything looks to be in working order now.

Evening update:
If every voyage could run this smoothly and with such magnificent fishing hauls, not to mention the near perfect weather, I would have more money than Cecil. Ha! Just imagine!

quest.title: Far Away XXXIII
quest.cleanDescription:
The Voyage Log for the Captain of the Two Fishers
Day 148 of Leaf 84 of Branch 1342

Overnight update:
The Balstar had a lightworks outage overnight again. This time it lasted closer to a minute, according to the night crew’s best estimate. They weren’t as sure about the duration this time because they were at their ease after another grand meal.

We’ll check in with the Balstar again today about their lightworks issues.

Midday update:
The reply from the Balstar was that the outage overnight was caused by the maintenance on the lightworks of the previous night. They have made some temporary repairs, but they will need to spend extra time on Nonir Island making more permanent changes. It is an unfortunate delay, but it should give us time to take our passengers to see the Nonir turtles.

Evening update:
I have an uneasy feeling, without any clouds around to cause it. It feels like the calm before a big storm.

We arrive at Nonir Island tomorrow afternoon, if all goes well. I will advise my crew and passengers to be extra cautious the next few days. I will also be rotating the work assignments for everyone after we finish our time at Nonir. New jobs will help everyone to stay watchful. I will miss Mariya’s meals, Lorn’s immaculate cleaning, and the best fishing hauls I’ve ever seen, but perhaps fortune will continue to favor us.

quest.title: Far Away XXXIV
quest.cleanDescription:
The Voyage Log for the Captain of the Two Fishers
Day 158 of Leaf 84 of Branch 1342

Overnight update:
We left Nonir’s main port yesterday evening, after the final repairs were completed on the Balstar’s lightworks. The night crew reported that the Balstar’s lights functioned properly all through the nighttime hours, and that all was quiet.

The crew members assigned to the night shift for the new rotation seem to be doing quite well after our long break on Nonir Island. Everyone else will start their new jobs for this rotation after breakfast.

Midday update:
Lorn joined me at lunch today to express his thanks, as well as the thanks of his friends, for the turtle sightseeing tour that I and some of the crew led on the day before we left Nonir. We saw more turtles than any of my previous visits. Maybe it was somehow related to the insect migration that was also more excessive than usual. Whatever it was, the abundance of turtles was quite a treat for all of us.

{player} joined Mr. Ecsil in handling meals for this rotation. They started with a hearty meal for lunch today and set the bar quite high for this leg of the voyage. Mariya’s cooking will be dearly missed, but so far {player}’s efforts look very promising. We’re getting a bit spoiled for life after this voyage.

Evening update:
Mariya and Lorn made quite the haul today with our fishing crew. It wasn’t anywhere near the loads that George and {player} pulled in, but it was a successful day by any other measurements.

George’s training as a soldier is shining brightly in his efforts to keep the ship clean and orderly. Additionally, the crew seems to have a natural respect for George and they follow his commands as if I was standing there beside him.

Everything ran smoothly today despite the rotation of jobs. I expect to maintain this duty rotation until we reach the main island of Ginkow.

quest.title: Far Away XXXV
quest.cleanDescription:
The Voyage Log for the Captain of the Two Fishers
Day 159 of Leaf 84 of Branch 1342

Overnight update:
Everything was quiet overnight, and the Balstar’s lightworks continued to function properly. The only item noted by the crew was that, after her long day of fishing, Mariya still made some snacks that were very much appreciated.

Midday update:
All signs point to bad weather coming soon. We’re making good progress right now, but a big storm is going to slow us down for a day or two. I signaled to the Balstar to make sure their captain was aware of the weather coming. They signaled back that they were already preparing the ship for a wild ride. My crew will also be spending the rest of the day making the Two Fishers storm ready.

Evening update:
Despite our interruptions for storm preparations, Mariya and Lorn made another excellent haul. They’re inching, fish by fish, toward being as good as my own crews.

{player} and Mr. Ecsil provided excellent meals throughout the day, but sadly we’re all still spoiled from Mariya’s amazing cooking. I even found myself craving a slice of Mariya’s banana cream pie after lunch.

George was amazing today! He lead the crew in weather preparations as if he’d been sailing his whole life. He noticed and addressed things that were even missed by our most senior crew members. None of it was ship threatening, but all of it will make for a smoother cruise through the storm.

quest.title: Far Away XXXVI
quest.cleanDescription:
The Voyage Log for the Captain of the Two Fishers
Day 160 of Leaf 84 of Branch 1342

Overnight update:
I couldn’t get any sleep. The threat of trouble coming soon nagged and nagged every time I closed my eyes. Eventually, I gave up on sleep and joined the night crew.

Apparently, George couldn’t sleep either. He came up on deck a few minutes after I gave up on sleep and joined the night crew. George brought his guitar with him and played a few songs to try and cheer the group. Unfortunately, the sense of dread seemed to be infecting all of us and the songs were barely able to cut the tension.

George must have felt it too. Instead of trying to fight the dread, he leaned another direction and played a dreary ballad of lost loves and lost homes. Just when all hope was lost, the song changed and became more hopeful. Like a small break in the clouds letting the sun peek through, this song managed to stir all of us and relieve us for a moment from our feelings of unease.

Midday update:
The Balstar signaled for us to pull alongside first thing this morning. Then, Captain Ragvin called over for a brief consultation. We discussed preparations for the storm, which had already begun to show signs of its arrival, and then we agreed upon a location to reunite the ships in case we were separated by the storm. Before returning to his ship, Captain Ragvin asked if he could tie a rope to the prow of our ship with a small storm totem at the end that hangs down to float on the water. He explained that it was for good fortune through the storm. I took a quick poll of the crew’s thoughts and all were happy for any extra luck. With that, Captain Ragvin secured the totem and returned to the Balstar.

The rest of the morning consisted of the storm growing more ferocious and Lorn losing his battle with seasickness. The increased rocking from the storm pushed him past his tolerance. Fortunately, we’re not doing much fishing today and he can try all of the crews’ ideas for managing seasickness. Hopefully something helps the poor guy.

Evening update:
We are weathering the worst of the storm now. The waves have grown mountainous and the wind is coming from everywhere. The crew is doing their best, but we are at the mercy of the sea.

quest.title: Eggstra Lucky I
quest.cleanDescription:
After turning that river green, frank feels luckier than ever, but he also feels a little strange. Every morning lately, he wakes up and finds himself hugging a decorated egg. The eggs appearing wouldn’t be a big deal if they were something that frank could eat, but these eggs aren’t really useful at all.

So, frank has been hiding these decorated, huggable eggs all over town, as a fun surprise for people that like decorated, huggable eggs. He meant to ask if you like decorated, huggable eggs, but he forgot.

If you’ll bring him some good eats, he’ll try to remember to give you the next decorated, huggable egg that he wakes up hugging.

quest.title: Eggstra Lucky II
quest.cleanDescription: frank found another egg this morning and remembered that he promised it to you. Would you mind getting him some breakfast to fill the hole that giving up this huggable egg will create?

quest.title: Eggstra Lucky III
quest.cleanDescription:
frank only has one decorated, huggable egg left. He hasn’t woke up hugging an egg for days now.

He saved this last one because he couldn’t decide where to hide it. Do you want it? Would you be willing to make frank an amazing meal for it? frank means REALLY amazing.

quest.title: Eggstra Lucky IV
quest.cleanDescription: frank would like a few more ingredients added to his amazing meal, if you don’t mind. It’s almost perfect, like a decorated, huggable egg.

quest.title: Hare Handler
quest.cleanDescription:
You hear a soft crunching sound. A familiar fat rabbit is lounging in your favorite chair, eating your freshly grown leeks. The rabbit hops down so you can sit, knocking leeks all over the floor. You sit and stare as this very strange rabbit eats your produce. For a moment, he looks like he’s starting to choke, and a chunk of chewed up leek lands at your feet.

“Hey.” He clears his throat. His voice is gravelly, and he has a strange accent. “Sorry, these things do NOT go down like carrots. Name’s frank. All lowercase.” He pauses to take another bite. “Let’s make a deal. I’ve got some pranks to pull, but no thumbs. Makes things difficult sometimes.” He doesn’t elaborate further, and crunches down on the last of your daily harvest. “I don’t even like leeks very much. Why’d you grow these things?” He tells you what he needs, and you put some lemons in a barrel. As soon as you put the lid on, the rabbit vanishes. He leaves some strange seeds behind.

quest.title: Hare Handler II
quest.cleanDescription: There’s a strange, creaking sound coming from the roof. You go outside to investigate, and smell something foul. You need to find the source, so you climb up to the roof and see a familiar blue fur ball, now dripping wet and mumbling to himself. You’re feeling compelled to take him inside to dry off, but he is far too heavy to carry. You build a makeshift pulley system, and hoist this rabbit down. He hops his way into your house, drenched, and scoots right onto your favorite chair…You realize you will have to replace your chair, the smell of wet rabbit is unbearable.

quest.title: Hare Handler III
quest.cleanDescription:
frank sneezes, and his fur poofs out. Suddenly, he’s dry, and the odor is gone. He looks annoyed and deep in thought. He looks at you, and his beady eyes make you feel a bit uneasy. You can’t seem to look away while he stares into, what feels like, your soul. After a few moments, he looks away and releases your gaze.

“BONES!”. He flops down, waddles to your trash can, and starts making a huge mess. You try to let him know your spare bones are kept in a barrel outside, but he insists on searching every inch of your home.

You go grab a bag of bones, and as soon as you set them down, they poof away. You expect the rabbit to be gone at this point too, but he stays. Staring at you. With those beady eyes.

quest.title: Hare Handler IV
quest.cleanDescription:
You’re in a staring contest with a rabbit. So many questions. You start to ask something, and get cut off. Right, he can talk.

“I can’t BELIEVE he got me with that. What to do, what to do...” He starts muttering about fire ants and “the perfect prank”, and starts hopping back and forth. He hops over to you and sits on his hind legs. “We made a deal. WE MADE A DEAL! You’ll help me, won’t you?”

He rummages through your things some more, stuffs a few items in a barrel, and looks back at you. He gestures with his tiny paws for you to reach into your pocket. Inside your pocket is a piece of ordinary, blank parchment. You look up, and he’s gone.

quest.title: Hare Handler V
quest.cleanDescription:
frank has let himself into your home, again. He hops onto your chair, and you notice his back is covered in slime. So now, your chair is also covered in slime.

“Help me get this goop off of me, will ya?” You set to work and scrub frank’s fur.

quest.title: Hare Handler VI
quest.cleanDescription:
Once frank is clean, he thanks you for your help. He blows a big puff of air and somehow, your chair is clean. The whole thing looks ridiculous. How does a rabbit have that much lung capacity?

“Okay, so here’s my plan.” frank leads you outside, and hops around in the dirt. He’s made a complex diagram in the dirt, and you have no idea what any of it means.

“Just get me these things.”

You put the items into a barrel, and frank disappears, once again.

quest.title: Hare Handler VII
quest.cleanDescription:
As you’re tending to your field of corn, you notice a rather large weed has sprouted up, and you gear up to pull it out. You touch it, and it’s...furry? In the blink of an eye, the plant you plucked becomes too heavy to lift, so naturally, you drop it.

“Ow! Ain’t that a little rude?”. Your new rabbit friend has the strangest ways of greeting you. “Well, anyways…” he sniffs at your corn stalks. “I need a bunch of yellow stuff. No time for questions. Fill a barrel with yellow for me.”

Once again, as you add the final contents to the barrel, it and the rabbit poof away, leaving goodies in their place.

quest.title: Hare Handler VIII
quest.cleanDescription:
You go home, very ready for a nap. Of course, you have a visitor rifling through your kitchen.
“Something blue. Lots of blue.” The rabbit starts throwing various things from the cabinets on the floor.
You start to offer to find whatever he’s looking for, when he pulls a wooden barrel that definitely would not have fit in your cabinets, climbs in, and...says nothing. quest.title: The Otipeg Line I
quest.cleanDescription:
Thomas helped a lovely couple move into their farmhouse yesterday afternoon. When the last crate was unloaded from the wagon, Thomas bid his new friends farewell and began to make his way to the edge of town. He was on a mission to update the town population sign along the main road. The mayor said this update was long overdue, and that 175 thousand is a number to celebrate.

Before Thomas made it more than a few dozen steps along the road, something strange happened. Thomas thought he saw a fairy. So, he followed it. A small, floating glimmer continued to stay just out of his reach for nearly a kilometer, until he arrived at an old stone wall.

As Thomas got close to the wall, the fairy vanished. Thomas continued to search for the vanished glimmer, but eventually gave up after several fruitless minutes. Instead, he turned his attention, reluctantly, to examining the wall.

The wall was about knee high and made of intricately locked stones. The stones were worn and smooth and showed no sign of decoration, except at the top of what appeared to be a post. On the top of the stone at the top of the post, Thomas found these words engraved.

“Otipeg Line”

Thomas has no idea what Otipeg Line means, but he would love to learn more about it. He’s going to ask Lorn if he knows anything. Thomas is going to catch some fish to bring as a gift to Lorn, in exchange for Lorn helping Thomas figure this mystery out. Will you help Thomas catch a few extra fish to really impress Lorn?

quest.title: The Otipeg Line II
quest.cleanDescription:
Lorn told Thomas that an Otipeg Line is a wall constructed to keep certain magical creatures away from a farmer’s crops. After Thomas told Lorn about the fairy he saw, Lorn said that there must be a break in the Otipeg Line that Thomas found.

Thomas is curious now to find the break in the wall. Will you help him gather some stone and mushrooms to repair the wall, if Thomas finds the break?

quest.title: The Otipeg Line III
quest.cleanDescription:
Thomas found the break in the wall.
The rift was surprisingly small.
He started to repair the stony breach,
but then he saw a glimmer just out of reach.
He wondered how bad it could be
to let such a creature roam free.
Thomas decided to go home
and left the broken wall alone.
For all of your help today,
Thomas found gifts on his way.
One more small request
would be for his best.
Will you restore his will power?
Please bring him a purple flower.

quest.title: The Otipeg Line IV
quest.cleanDescription: Thomas isn’t sure what happened, but he’s not going back to that wall. He appreciates you breaking whatever curse was upon him. Please accept these tokens of his appreciation.

quest.title: Buddy's Christmas Adventure I
quest.cleanDescription:
It’s Christmas-time, Buddy’s favorite time of year. Santa gave him a task, to find someone on the naughty list and help them believe in Santa again.

First, Buddy and Santa searched through many, many books to find all the names of people in Redbrook when he was shocked to find his very good friend, Vincent, on the naughty list!

Buddy and Santa parted ways and Buddy claims he rode an iceberg pushed by a narwhal who was sad to see him leave. “Bye Buddy, hope you find your friend!”

quest.title: Buddy's Christmas Adventure II
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy loves eating candy, candy corn, candy cane and syrup!  Maybe you could help him gather some of his favorite candy (and some healthier stuff too) to help him have the energy to find his very good friend when he returns to Redbrook?

quest.title: Buddy's Christmas Adventure III
quest.cleanDescription:
Buddy loves exploring the streets of Redbrook, there’s so many colorful objects! He briefly remember’s Santa’s advice.

“I’ve been to Redbrook tons of times, but there are some things you should know. If you see gum on the streets, leave it there, it’s not candy. Second, there are, like thirty, Jill’s Corn, but the original is on the outside of town. And finally, if you see an advertisement for free gold, it’s probably a rick roll.”

quest.title: Buddy's Christmas Adventure IV
quest.cleanDescription:
As Buddy wanders the streets, he realizes the perfect way to convince his friend Vincent to reform his ways is with a gift that he picks out, to really give him some Christmas spirit. Buddy spent so long in the store and was so intent on looking for a gift that the store closed with him inside it!

Buddy saw a sign near the front that says “Santa Tomorrow” and in excitement, he decides to decorate the whole store overnight.

quest.title: Buddy's Christmas Adventure V
quest.cleanDescription:
In the morning, the store opens and Buddy is very excited to see Santa! In moments, the store is full of excited parents and children when who should arrive but someone that looks suspiciously not like Santa.

Buddy jumps in front of the line and confronts Santa-Lorn, “Who the heck are you?”
Santa-Lorn gives Buddy an odd look, “What are you talkin’ about? I’m Santa Claus!”
“No, you’re not.”

“Uh, why of course I am! Ho, ho, ho, ho, ho.”
“Well, if you're Santa, what song did I sing for you on your birthday this year? “
“Um, Happy Birthday of course.”
Buddy gives a momentary look of frustration.
“You sit on a throne of lies! You’re a fake!”
Santa-Lorn gives Buddy a look of confusion and scorn. “I’m a fake?”
“Yes! You stink! You smell like beef and cheese, you don’t smell like Santa!”
As the commotion grows louder, some of the store security drag Buddy away, and put him in the town jail.

quest.title: Buddy's Christmas Adventure VI
quest.cleanDescription:
After a few hours Buddy is visited by none other than Vincent, just the person Buddy was looking for! Vincent offers to take Buddy home to make sure he doesn’t cause anymore trouble.

On the way home, Buddy tells Vincent about Santa Claus, but Vincent shakes his head. “Santa isn’t real, Buddy!” Before Buddy can reply, a snowball zings by the two of them, and before long, Vincent and Buddy are in the snowball fight of their life against a bunch of the town children!

quest.title: Buddy's Christmas Adventure VII
quest.cleanDescription: It was a really epic snowball fight!

quest.title: Buddy's Christmas Adventure VIII
quest.cleanDescription:
After a victorious battle, Buddy and Vincent complete their journey home. Buddy again implores Vincent to reconsider his belief in Santa and get off the naughty list. This time, before Vincent can respond a knock comes at the door but Buddy, quick as lightning, answers. “Buddy the Thumb, what’s your favorite color?”

It’s a package of letters, but no one’s at the door. It says “To” but the rest of the address is completely illegible. Buddy decides that the best way to spread Christmas cheer is to go to the post office and figure out who this Christmas letters are for!

quest.title: Buddy's Christmas Adventure IX
quest.cleanDescription:
At the post office, Buddy is shocked to find the most efficient post office he’s ever seen! One particularly knowledgeable individual offers him a cup of coffee and puts some syrup in it. “Syrup in coffee? Why didn’t I think of that!” Buddy exclaims.

It turns out Buddy is extremely good at sorting mail, and spends most of the rest of the day helping the post office catch up from the extreme volume of mail (along with a few dance breaks) in Redbrook before Buddy realizes the time and shows his friend the letter.

“Oh, these letters are for Vincent, what a grinch!”

Buddy is saddened by his new friend’s opinion of Vincent, but a sound from the other room distracts Buddy, by the time he looks back, his friend has disappeared.

quest.title: Buddy's Christmas Adventure X
quest.cleanDescription:
Buddy heads back to Vincent’s house, when along the way he sees a streak, a sparkle, and suddenly Santa’s sleigh colliding in a snowbank north of town! He gasps and sprints towards the explosion of snow. When he arrives he finds Vincent already on the scene, swords at the ready.

“Whoa Vincent, this is SANTA!” Buddy cries out.

“Ho ho ho, it is me, the real Santa!” the real Santa bellylaughs!

“If you’re the real Santa, then why are Ric Ryph’s Redbrook Rangers after you?” Vincent replies skeptically.

“I put them on the naughty list and they never forgave me.” Santa looks to Vincent. “Can you both help me fix my sleigh tonight, before they find me?”

quest.title: Buddy's Christmas Adventure XI
quest.cleanDescription:
Repairs finished, Buddy and Vincent watch Santa and his reindeer take off. Vincent looks to Buddy as you walk back into town. “The best way to spread Christmas cheer is singing loud for all to hear!”

Buddy and Vincent enter the town singing “Santa Claus is Coming to Town” at their loudest volume, and one by one, the rest of the townsfolk (minus Ric) join them.

End.

quest.title: Covert Santa I
quest.cleanDescription:
One of the traditions that Lorn loves most this time of year is doing Covert Santa with his friends. They all pull names from a Santa hat and get a gift for the person whose name they pulled. They also put a secret gift in a password protected mailbox at the post office. That gift is for any clever individual that figures out each of the pairings for Covert Santa.

Lorn could use a hand getting a gift for the friend whose name he pulled this year. He won’t tell you who it is, but Lorn would like to gift his friend a fairly substantial load of food. Will you help Lorn?

quest.title: Covert Santa XI
quest.cleanDescription: Borgen is happy to participate in Covert Santa this year, but he dislikes his recipient.  However, in the spirit of the season, he will still do his best.  He'd like for you to bring him something to help remind this person that there can be consequences for actions.

quest.title: Covert Santa XII
quest.cleanDescription:
Captain Thomas has been invited to Covert Santa in the town. He knows it by a different name where he’s from, but it’s heartwarming to know traditions can be anywhere.

While getting to know townspeople, Thomas has noticed his Covert Santa is very bad at expressing themselves to others directly. Lucky for his Covert Santa, Captain Thomas is always looking to help out a townsfolk in need. He has also noticed a tradition in this world his Covert Santa follows that he’d like to support, but was thinking a tradition from his world could help his Covert Santa express themselves to a certain someone better too.

quest.title: Covert Santa XIII
quest.cleanDescription:
Vincent rarely participates in Covert Santa, because he isn’t very good at connecting with others, but in the spirit of the holidays he tells you he wanted to give it another shot, much to his obvious chagrin.

Unfortunately, his Covert Santa and he have a long history and haven't been the best of pals, but Vincent learned earlier this winter that maybe fences can be mended and is warming up to them. Vincent is heating up some cocoa and asked if you could bring him some yarn to make a warm scarf for his Covert Santa, it might be cold for them later.

quest.title: Covert Santa XIV
quest.cleanDescription:

His Covert Santa is someone he really admires and wants to give them a gift that will really make an impression! Will you help Ric Ryph?

quest.title: Covert Santa XV
quest.cleanDescription: Beatrix can't believe it's time for Covert Santa already.  She thinks some fish might be exactly the right thing to get her Covert Santa partner.  Will you bring a variety of fish so she can make this the best holiday for her recipient?

quest.title: Covert Santa XVI
quest.cleanDescription: Holger is very excited for Covert Santa this year.  He's hoping to get some yummy food.  He's glad that his match for Covert Santa isn't likely to want any of his food.  Can you help Holger get some fishing supplies for his surprise gift for this year's Covert Santa?

quest.title: Covert Santa XVII
quest.cleanDescription: Cecil is happy to be part of this common-folk tradition of Covert Santa.  He thinks he has the perfect gift in mind this year.  Will you bring some corn to Cecil so he can become the best Covert Santa ever?

quest.title: Covert Santa XVIII
quest.cleanDescription:
Star loves that the town invited him to be a part of Covert Santa this year. He mentions to you that it’s been a long time since he felt like he belonged anywhere and it warms his heart. The tradition of giving part of the gift now, and part of the gift through the mailbox passwords sounds fun and mischevious.

Star could use a little help with his gift though, he’s very nervous about getting his Covert Santa the right thing. It’s important because giving less than three of anything is not how he normally expresses himself. He mentions three things, and asks if you'll help him.

quest.title: Gourd Intentions I
quest.cleanDescription:
There’s a knock at your front door. Much to your surprise, Mariya is standing there. She’s grinning from ear to ear, and holding a gigantic pumpkin.

“Hope I didn’t catch you at a bad time, friend. I need an extra set of hands to prepare a very special dessert.” You agree to help out, and she seems elated. This is the most excited you’ve seen Mariya.

“Great! Bring over some cooking pots when you’re ready and we’ll get started!”

quest.title: Gourd Intentions II
quest.cleanDescription:
Mariya’s kitchen is very chaotic, but she seems to know exactly where everything is. “Hey, when you ask a pumpkin how it’s feeling, what does it say?”

”I’m vine, thanks for asking.” She busts out laughing for a moment, composes herself, and remembers the task at hand.

”Oh, right. I need a LOT of butter, so please churn some while I carve out this pumpkin!”

quest.title: Gourd Intentions III
quest.cleanDescription:
Exhausted from churning for what felt like ages, you return to the kitchen. Mariya is humming to herself. She’s moving so efficiently, handling food so skillfully, and for a moment you imagine what she could do with a larger space.

”Perfect timing! Hey, what do you get when you drop a pumpkin? A squash!” She laughs, and again, quickly recomposes herself. She puts the finishing touches on her desserts, and sticks them in the oven. “Now, we wait.”

Mariya offers some refreshments and the two of you talk to pass the time. “My sister and I would bake these every year, and we would always think up the best puns. I’m thankful that you came today.” She takes a sip of her drink. “I miss her, and keeping up our traditions just warms my heart.”

Another hour passes, and the aroma is unlike anything you’ve smelled before. Mariya removes the desserts, and quickly chills one. She wraps it up for you to take home. “I hope you enjoy this as much as I’ve enjoyed making it with you!”

Captain Thomas isn’t from here. On his world they do Halloween a little differently. Instead of children going door-to-door and being given candy, children go door-to-door and give candy. Then, the Halloween reveler at the door either gives the candy-giving-child a trick or a treat in return.

In the spirit of his homeworld, Captain Thomas invited a few occupants of the haunted house to celebrate Halloween his way. He would like you to bring some candy and get ready for tricks and treats.

quest.title: Unexpected Visitor I
quest.cleanDescription: Another letter from Jill arrives, inviting you over for dinner. She asks that you bring a few things if it’s not too much trouble.

quest.title: Unexpected Visitor II
quest.cleanDescription:
Jill and ROOMBA greet you at the door. She’s prepared a platter of savory meats and cheeses and makes a fruit salad with what you’ve brought. She offers you a selection of drinks, and asks you to prepare some corn so she can have corn oil for ROOMBA to enjoy.

As you’re about to take a bite of some crispy bacon, a loud thud can be heard at the front door. ROOMBA goes to investigate. About 2 minutes go by, when ROOMBA returns with a pile of metal pieces, and drops them on the table. Your heart sinks as you watch your dinner covered by dirty, metal pieces.

“ROOMBA! Take this to the barn!”

Jill looks like she’s 50% furious and 50% excited, and the three of you head to the barn.

quest.title: Unexpected Visitor III
quest.cleanDescription: ROOMBA arranges the pile of pieces, stops, and rearranges them again. “REPAIR NECESSARY FOR THIS UNIT. MATERIALS REQUIRED.” A few tools and supplies are scattered around the barn, but ROOMBA asks that you retrieve anything else that you think may be useful.

quest.title: Unexpected Visitor IV
quest.cleanDescription:
You return with the requested items. ROOMBA gets to work, and you go back inside with Jill.

As the two of you are cleaning up the dinner mess, she thanks you again. “It’s a strange feeling, having another person here with all of this going on. I apologize if I’ve been short with you. Having ROOMBA as my only company for a while has been, well, challenging. Don’t get me wrong, his usefulness is unparalleled. As far as conversations though, you have to be very direct with robots.”

A few hours pass, and the two of you go to check on ROOMBA. It looks like your robot friend has been assembling another automaton, though several parts are still missing or disconnected.

quest.title: Unexpected Visitor V
quest.cleanDescription:
“RESTORATIONS 23.11% COMPLETE. ADDITIONAL MATERIAL REQUIRED TO CONTINUE.” ROOMBA has pieced together a very makeshift torso, with one arm and two legs. The head has been placed on a separate, smaller worktable, as it looks more damaged than the rest of the parts.
  • “DATABANK SCANS SHOW MINIMAL NON-CORRUPTED INFORMATION."
  • “LOCATION ORIGIN: 46% DATA CORRUPTION. JUNzqaD hwSEbT”
  • “PRIMARY FUNCTION: 100% DATA CORRUPTION. dQw4w9WgXcQ”
  • “TIME SINCE LAST ACTIVITY: 10 HOURS.”
ROOMBA can’t make further progress without some more materials. He hands you a list of items to retrieve while he tries to process through the data corruption.

quest.title: Unexpected Visitor VI
quest.cleanDescription:
You return with the list of items, and ROOMBA returns to the semi-formed robot. “LOCATION ORIGIN DECORRUPTION COMPLETE. LOCATION ORIGIN: JUNDLAND DESERT.” Jill gasps. “From everything I’ve read about it, that’s a very dangerous place. Not to mention the heat.” ROOMBA interjects.
  • “JUNDLAND DESERT. DATA COLLECTION COMPLETE.
  • SAFETY CONCERNS: SANDSTORMS - CHANCE TO AVOID: 13.46%.
  • HUMAN CONSUMABLE RESOURCES - MINIMAL.
  • NAVIGATION - BARREN WASTELAND WITH FEW LANDMARKS. VERY FEW OPTIONS FOR SHELTER AGAINST ELEMENTS.
  • RESOURCE MATERIALS - ABUNDANT. NECESSARY MATERIALS FOR REPAIR LOCATED IN JUNDLAND DESERT.
  • NAVIGATION DEVICE REQUIRED FOR HUMANS.
  • END OF REPORT.”
“RECOMMENDED ACTION: PREPARE FOR A DANGEROUS JOURNEY. ADDITIONAL HUMAN REQUIRED FOR OPTIMAL CHANCE OF SURVIVAL.” Jill writes letters to Vincent and Borgen, hoping at least one of them is willing to join your group.

quest.title: Unexpected Visitor VII
quest.cleanDescription:
Jill’s letters reach both Vincent and Borgen, explaining the journey ahead. Vincent politely declined, saying he had some other obligations. Borgen, however, has agreed. He arrives at Jill’s farm and thanks you all for the invitation. “I’ve always wanted to go out that way, never had a reason to before that seemed worth the risk.” “RISK ASSESSMENT COMPLETE: SURVIVABILITY PERCENTA-”

Borgen interrupts ROOMBA. “Maybe for the best you keep that number to yourself.”

“CURRENT GROUP IS OPTIMAL WITH ALL GIVEN PARAMETERS.”

And with that, you finish packing for the trip, and head south.

quest.title: Unexpected Visitor VIII
quest.cleanDescription:
Your party easily traverses Black Rock Canyon, as you’ve done many times before. Borgen happily pockets some hidden stashes of Ancient Coins. “You should pick up some supplies and interesting items you find here. Could come in handy.” Continuing on, you cross the bridge that allows passage over Crystal River. The sun will set soon. You look across the bridge, and discuss where to set up camp.

“Misty forest is eerie.” Jill states. “No raptors there, though.” Borgen chimes in. You ask ROOMBA to decide, as it’s been a long day and you just want to rest somewhere.

“CALCULATING. MISTY FOREST WILL ADD 7.2 HOURS OF TRAVEL DUE TO LIMITED VISIBILITY AND DISTANCE FROM DESTINATION.” The group decides to rest for the evening at Whispering Creek.

quest.title: Unexpected Visitor IX
quest.cleanDescription:
You think back fondly about your first venture to Whispering Creek. You never would be able to navigate this place without a compass. The group continues on, again, picking up anything useful along the way.

“RAPTOR DETECTED. COURSE OF ACTION: LOCATE SHELTER IMMEDIATELY.” You’ve been here often enough to know all the safe spots from raptors. You lead your friends to safety. There’s a cliff that reaches out above you, and trees and bushes provide plenty of cover should the raptor pass by. Jill seems rather worried, as you hear a screech approaching from your right. You let her hold your compass, which seems to help her relax.

You and Borgen watch the raptor spring after something. Whatever it was must have run off, and the raptor quickly pursues. You see something fall from the raptor’s foot as it disappears further into the forest. “Whatever that thing dropped, I want it.”, Borgen says confidently. “Once we get that, we can keep moving.”

quest.title: Unexpected Visitor X
quest.cleanDescription:
The party continues south, and soon you arrive at the entrance to the Jundland Desert. There are a few signs placed along the edges of the desert.
    “DANGER!”

    “DO NOT ENTER!”

    “NO TRESPASSING”

    “Ahead: Sand”
Borgen fashions some interesting layering, in an attempt to keep sand from his boots. Jill covers her head in a scarf, and double checks her water supply. You’ve done all the preparations you can, it’s time to move on.

The Jundland Desert is beautiful, if not blindingly bright. The sand looks almost golden, and a gentle wisp of wind carries a few golden specks to new dunes. Aside from that though, there’s nothing else to see. It’s not quite as hot here as Ember Lagoon, but it’s a close second while the sun is out. The group walks until the greenery is no longer visible. There are small bits and pieces of things hidden within the sand, but otherwise, there are no landmarks you can find. Each dune looks the same. You hold your compass, thinking maybe it will be useful here. The arrow just spins around and around. “I WILL GUIDE. FOLLOW.” ROOMBA marches towards, well, more sand.

quest.title: Unexpected Visitor XI
quest.cleanDescription: The sun hangs low in the sky, and you, Jill, and Borgen are moving significantly slower than you were a few hours ago. ROOMBA doesn’t seem to be affected. “WALKING THROUGH SAND TAKES MORE STAMINA FOR HUMANS. AT THE CURRENT PACE, WE ARE APPROXIMATELY 3.1 HOURS FROM DESTINATION. IF WE REFUEL AND REST FOR A SHORT WHILE, IT WILL TAKE 1.2 HOURS TO ARRIVE WHEN WE DEPART.”

quest.title: Unexpected Visitor XII
quest.cleanDescription:
ROOMBA continues to guide you, Jill, and Borgen. The sun has set, and you notice the temperature drop. The desert is even more beautiful at night. The stars shine bright. Borgen points out a few constellations, and Jill asks Borgen how he knows about them. “Well, that’s how I do most of my traveling when I don’t know the way. The stars point me where I need to go, especially on the open sea.” While the three of you are walking and looking up, ROOMBA stops. First Jill, then you, then Borgen, all bump, and end up falling down. The three of you start laughing.

ROOMBA turns to face you. “QUIET. DO NOT MOVE.” ROOMBA dims his eye-light and crouches down to join you. A few minutes pass, and nothing happens. Borgen starts to get restless, and ROOMBA places his cold, metal hand on Borgen’s shoulder. Another minute goes by, and a very soft rumbling deep in the sand passes by. Sand shifts, and your eyes follow the direction of the rumbling. Dunes rise and fall. You stay there, waiting. ROOMBA fixes his light, and stands up. “WE WILL CONTINUE NOW.”

quest.title: Unexpected Visitor XIII
quest.cleanDescription:
“What WAS that?” Jill asks. “And how did you know where it was?”

“DATA DESCRAMBLE COMPLETE. DEFENSE MECHANISM. DETECTS UNNATURAL MOVEMENT FROM ABOVE AND BELOW. I HAVE UPGRADED MY RADAR USING INFORMATION FROM DAMAGED AUTOMATON. PROBABILITY OF SUCCESS WAS LOW. WE HAVE ARRIVED AT THE LOCATION.”

You look at a small, crumbling building. During the day, this would have easily been missed. The outside walls are caked in sand, and the blinding light of the sun would hide this place from anyone who came looking. The closer you look, the more you think there’s more of the building below the sand than above. You all walk the perimeter, looking for a way in. “Got something!” You hear Jill around the corner. You all gather in front of a door. There’s no knob, knocker, or anything on it. A small, shiny orb is near the top. You, Jill, and even Borgen all press the glass orb. Nothing happens. Pushing on the door does nothing. ROOMBA looks at the door, and it swings open. “WE ARE HERE.”

quest.title: Unexpected Visitor XIV
quest.cleanDescription:
The interior of this building is nothing like you would expect. It’s nearly spotless inside, and dimly lit by tiny orbs strung across the walls. You, Jill, and Borgen begin to explore this room. “ONLY PERMITTED TO RETRIEVE ITEMS FOR REPAIRING UNIT.” ROOMBA points to a screen on the wall filled with 0’s and 1’s. “DO NOT REMOVE UNNECESSARY ITEMS FROM PREMESIS.”

“Well, how do we know what we’re looking for?” Jill asks. The screen on the wall changes to a different arrangement of 0’s and 1’s. “I WILL RETRIEVE THE ITEMS. YOU CHOOSE ITEMS OF CULTURAL SIGNIFICANCE AND VALUE TO LEAVE AS EXCHANGE.” ROOMBA ventures further into the building, and is soon out of sight.

The three of you look at each other, then start digging through your bags. You leave a pile of non-essential items in the center of the room. ROOMBA returns. “EXCHANGE COMPLETE. WE WILL DEPART AT SUNRISE.”

quest.title: Unexpected Visitor XV
quest.cleanDescription: You depart this building after resting for a while. Your eyes have a hard time adjusting to the blinding sun, but your group is soon on track to head home. You pick up some things along the way, and the journey home is fairly uneventful.

quest.title: Unexpected Visitor XVI
quest.cleanDescription: You’re finally back at Jill’s farm. Jill and ROOMBA head to the barn. You thank Borgen again for joining on the trip, and offer him some Ancient Coins as payment. “It was my pleasure! Always on the hunt for more unique items to sell at the shop.” You chat for a few minutes, and wave him off.

quest.title: Unexpected Visitor XVII
quest.cleanDescription: Back at the barn, Jill and ROOMBA are arguing about which parts go where, what order to replace them in, and the best tools to use. Jill asks you to craft her some upgraded tools and gather materials she overlooked.

quest.title: Unexpected Visitor XVIII
quest.cleanDescription: Minutes turn to hours, and Jill and ROOMBA work together in perfect harmony. Your main role is to run items back and forth across the barn, and refill ROOMBA’s corn oil supply occasionally.

quest.title: Unexpected Visitor XIX
quest.cleanDescription: The final part is ready to be placed in the heart of this robot. Jill and ROOMBA allow you to do the honors. It clicks right into place, and almost immediately you can hear a quiet hum emanate from this new robot. It sits up and looks around. “Greetings. I am Friendly Robot 4: Now Kinder. It is recommended to refer to me as FR4NK for optimized communication. As the beings who repaired me, you are deserving of a reward. What is it that you seek?”

quest.title: Unexpected Visitor XX
quest.cleanDescription:
ROOMBA continues to run diagnostic testing on FR4NK while Jill hurls questions at your new acquaintance. “Why did you show up at my house? How did you break? What was that building in the desert? What do you know about the monster in the desert? Can you help us continue to research the desert?”

FR4NK's manner of speaking is eerily human like. If you closed your eyes you wouldn't think this was an automaton. “My memory core is not fully restored. I will share the information I have available. The guardian of the sands protects the remaining inhabitants of Jundland in tandem with the legacy of Castrum Romuska. Avoiding certain death is impressive for humans."

Suddenly, FR4NK's tone shifts from friendly to monotone. "Per your request, I will provide a device blueprint to aid safe navigation through Jundland if you release the Langstaff Crest into my possession."

"If you choose to return to Jundland after building the device, please do not disturb the inhabitants. It would not be wise of you.”

quest.title: Hard At Work I
quest.cleanDescription: Jill asks you for some broccoli. This isn’t the first time she’s asked for things a well off farmer like herself shouldn’t need help with. You decide to deliver the broccoli to her doorstep, instead of meeting up like you usually do. Her farm looks magnificent from a distance, but up close you notice some things. Her crops are wilted, soil doesn’t look properly taken care of, and there are weeds everywhere. Jill hears you calling for her and rushes out of her barn. Her face is covered in soot. She thanks you and hurries you on your way. Strange, right?

quest.title: Hard At Work II
quest.cleanDescription: Jill has again asked you for some basic farming goods, and a list of other materials that seem a bit unusual. You focus on the crops for now, and bring them to her house. You feel compelled to check on Jill’s wellbeing after your last interaction.

quest.title: Hard At Work III
quest.cleanDescription: Jill’s door has been left ajar, and curiosity gets the better of you. You enter her home, and there are…strange tools everywhere. You have no idea what any of them are for, or where Jill is. You hear some clanging metal and a strange whirring noise, coming from somewhere below. You leave the tools on her list at the door, and continue on with the rest of the items she’s asked for.

quest.title: Hard At Work IV
quest.cleanDescription: You search for the source of the mysterious sounds, and find a door leading to a basement. The walls of this stairwell are adorned with costumes, including the one you helped Jill make. There’s a basket at the top of the stairs with space for some of the other things she’s asked for, so you leave them and descend. The steps are a sleek material you don't recognize, and as you get closer to Jill’s basement, you smell…Burning? It’s not any kind of fire you recognize. How strange.

quest.title: Hard At Work V
quest.cleanDescription:
You’re met with another door, once you reach the bottom of the stairs. It’s very shiny, and much sturdier than your doors at home. You open the door, and are met with a plume of smoke. You cough, and wave away the fumes, and search for Jill. Her basement is filled with half built gizmos, tools, and… Corn. Her corn silo feeds directly into a huge barrel in her basement.

You maneuver through piles of gadgets and gizmos, and find Jill, mumbling to herself. Her back is to you, and she’s hammering away at some device. “Why won’t you WORK?” You accidentally kick a bucket of nails, and they scatter. She hears you, and whips a handful of nails in your direction. Luckily, she’s not very good at aiming. “WHAT ARE YOU DOING HERE?!?!?!” Jill grabs you by the arm and drags you upstairs.

quest.title: Hard At Work VI
quest.cleanDescription: “You can’t tell anyone about this.” Jill hangs her head in shame. “I come from a long bloodline of farmers, and I came here to continue their legacy. I just… I really hate farming, and farming really hates me.” She gestures vaguely to a window planter with very sad, wilted crops. “I tried, for years even. But eventually, I realized I’m better at making things. Once you moved to town, I admired your flourishing farmland. I was hoping if I had help with my crops from you, nobody would notice how lackluster my land was.” She laughs uncomfortably, and offers you some extra supplies, hoping you will keep her secret safe.

quest.title: A Better Understanding I
quest.cleanDescription: “Many of the parts we found in the desert are fascinating. I can’t wait to put them to use. Now I wish I had more fully functioning pieces of Romuskan technology to study. To that end, if you’ll let me borrow your compass to analyze and study, I would be glad to compensate you for loaning it to me.”

quest.title: A Better Understanding II
quest.cleanDescription: “I have some bad news. I ran out of time to put your compass back together, and now I’m behind on a million other things. To reduce your time waiting on me, I’m giving you the compass parts back, if that’s ok with you. Also, please accept this gift as token of my thanks and my sincerest apology.”

quest.title: Blizzard Warning I
quest.cleanDescription:
Lorn received word that bad weather is coming. He expects an exceptional blizzard and a massive accumulation of snow from Mount Banon all the way to the coast.

Will you help Lorn make signs to warn people around town to prepare? Lorn will bring the ink if you bring the parchment.

quest.title: Blizzard Warning II - A
quest.cleanDescription: Cecil would like your help boarding up his many windows. He expects this blizzard to bring very strong winds that might damage his home.

quest.title: Blizzard Warning II - B
quest.cleanDescription:
Star needs some emberstone to help keep his tower warm. He has some experiments running in the loftier portions of his tower that could be thrown out of multiversal alignment without the proper temperature controls in place. Star thinks this blizzard is going to wreak havoc on the entire thermal alignment of the town.

Will you bring him a massive load of emberstone, and some feathers just in case he needs them?

quest.title: Blizzard Warning III - A
quest.cleanDescription: Holger is concerned he may not have enough food if he gets snowed in for a few days. Will you help him gather a few additional food items?

quest.title: Blizzard Warning III - B
quest.cleanDescription: Cecil wants to make sure that his horse is well prepared for the coming blizzard too. Will you help him get a few extra items for his horse?

quest.title: Blizzard Warning III - C
quest.cleanDescription:
Star also needs a few grocery items, if you wouldn’t mind getting them for him. He can’t leave his experiments right now since it’s the middle of a nebular Friday.

For grocery items, Star just needs the standard snowstorm fare.

quest.title: Blizzard Warning III - D
quest.cleanDescription: Jill needs your help. With the blizzard coming, she needs some extra crops to turn into feed for her animals. She would like to get a variety of crops so her animals get all the nutrients they need to stay healthy. Unfortunately, there isn’t enough time remaining for her to do it alone. Will you help her get a few more varieties of crops to turn into feed?

quest.title: Blizzard Warning IV - A
quest.cleanDescription:
Vincent is certain that Lorn is right about a terrible blizzard coming. He has seen the signs in the sky of an approaching storm, and the wildlife around his camp are behaving like they know a severe storm is coming.

Normally, Vincent would get a room in an inn to weather the worst of the storm, but all of the inns are full right now. Will you rent a room out to Vincent, just until the worst of the storm passes?

quest.title: Blizzard Warning IV - B
quest.cleanDescription: Neigh neigh!!! Neigh!?

quest.title: Blizzard Warning IV - C
quest.cleanDescription: Thomas doesn’t need any necessities to prepare for the blizzard, but he would like to be ready to try ice fishing after the storm passes. Will you bring him a few things he can use to go fishing in the ice?

quest.title: Blizzard Warning IV - D
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent would also like to rent some space in your barn to store his wagon. Unfortunately, he also needs a few new wheels for his wagon to get it over to your barn. Will you rent him the space and help him get some wagon wheels?

quest.title: Blizzard Warning IV - E
quest.cleanDescription: Holger is still not sure he has enough food to make it through the blizzard. Will you bring him a little more food?

quest.title: Blizzard Warning IV - F
quest.cleanDescription: Jill needs a little more feed for her animals, to feel completely prepared for the blizzard, but her feed mill is already running at full capacity. Will you bring her a few more bags of feed from your mill?

quest.title: Blizzard Warning IV - G
quest.cleanDescription: Beatrix thought she was completely prepared for the blizzard, but as she was preparing tea for Lorn today, she realized that her tea supplies are running awfully low. Will you help her gather a few things to ensure she has tea for the duration of the storm?

quest.title: Blizzard Warning IV - H
quest.cleanDescription: George expects to have a bit of quiet time on his hands during the blizzard. He thinks it will be a good opportunity to challenge himself musically. He would like to try playing a left-handed guitar. Will you bring him a left-handed guitar?

quest.title: Pet Spider I
quest.cleanDescription: George thinks it might be neat to have a pet spider.  Can you bring him one?

quest.title: Pet Spider II
quest.cleanDescription: George loves the spider you gave him.  He's decided that spiders make great pets and wants to expand how many he can hold.  Can you help him with the resources?

quest.title: Pet Spider III
quest.cleanDescription: George is ready for more spiders to put into his new spider habitat he has built.  Can you get him some more?

quest.title: Pet Spider IV
quest.cleanDescription: Turns out there is a market for spiders and George thinks he can make some major silver selling them.  He'd like to expand his habitat even more with your help.

quest.title: Pet Spider V
quest.cleanDescription: George is ready for more spiders for his improved habitat.  George will share a cut of the profits he is making.

quest.title: Remember To Be Thankful I
quest.cleanDescription:
Holger loves this time of year. He and Borgen grew up with lots of friends and family gathering for the harvest feast. Holger’s dad was a fisherman and always exchanged fresh fish for a variety of harvest produce. Because of these exchanges the harvest feast always showcased a wide variety of delicious dishes.

One year, when Holger was thirteen, the fishing haul was abnormally meager. Holger’s dad wasn’t sure if they would have enough food to get through the winter, much less trade for the harvest feast. Holger prepared himself for the worst. The day of the feast came and friends and family gathered. One by one all of Holger’s favorite dishes appeared, and in more abundance than usual. Somehow, that harvest feast tasted better than any before.

Holger isn’t sure if his friends and family knew that Holger’s family was in need, but he’s never forgotten their kindness.

Will you help Holger gather some harvest produce to share with others?

quest.title: Remember To Be Thankful II
quest.cleanDescription:
Cecil does not typically share stories from his past, but he feels a great nostalgia today. If you do not mind listening, he would love to reminisce for a moment. There is a strange power in telling a memory to an audience.

The place where Cecil grew up was very different from Redbrook. It was a place where dreams seemed to spring to life, almost as if by magic, and the people were so densely packed into the city that they had to start constructing enormously tall buildings, including underground.

Nevertheless, many of the customs of the rural areas were brought into the city and stirred into the amalgamation of the city’s own customs. So, they still celebrated a harvest festival even though one would have to travel many kilometers to actually see a field being harvested.

Because of Cecil’s family’s position within the city, Cecil’s mother would invite seemingly random families to join their harvest feast. The family joining them could be extremely wealthy, extremely poor, from a far off land, from a few blocks away, a small family, or a large family. This exposure to such a variety of different people and conversations during the meal taught Cecil much about the world and its people. He quickly began to recognize, despite the obvious differences, the many similarities between all people, for better and worse.

At one of theses harvest feasts, a fisherman and his family brought a small gift for young Cecil. No one had ever done that before. Many brought gifts for his parents and many brought gifts for the entire family, but no one had ever brought something just for Cecil. Not only that, but the gift was something Cecil had not seen before. It was a beautiful spiked shell. The fisherman told Cecil it was very rare and was used for magical spells long ago. It was amazing to young Cecil.

Unfortunately, that shell was lost in a terrible disaster many years ago. Cecil would love to have another spiked shell, as fine as that one from his youth. If you could find a spiked shell for Cecil, he would be very grateful.

quest.title: Remember To Be Thankful III
quest.cleanDescription: Jill wants your help and tells you a small story in the process. When she was young, her parents had a tradition.  Every year around this time, they would take some gathered crops from the year’s harvest and offer thanks to the farmers in the surrounding area and try to give back to those who had helped them.  Will you help gather some of the crops her family used to gather to give to others around town?

quest.title: Remember To Be Thankful IV
quest.cleanDescription:
Borgen just wants mashed potatoes. Unfortunately, just like when they were kids, Holger keeps eating the entire bowl. It is maddening.

Will you help Borgen get enough mashed potatoes to finally fill Holger?
