quest.cleanDescription:
There once was a ghost who fishes
He asked you for what he wishes

quest.title: Limerick or Treat II
quest.cleanDescription:
Only first letters
Mailboxed from debtors

quest.title: Limerick or Treat III
quest.cleanDescription: A name who left candy dishes

quest.title: New Neighbor I
quest.cleanDescription: You notice a young woman pushing a cart past your farm. It hits a hole, and tips over. You walk over to offer some help, and hear an exasperated sigh. Several planks are splintered, and the cart is immovable. “Oh, thank you for the offer but it’s alright. I can’t offer any payment for services right now. I’ll just carry what’s usable and come back to dispose of the rest. If you could help me move this off the road though,  that would be greatly appreciated.” The two of you clear the road, and she gathers what she can carry, she thanks you, and walks off.

quest.title: New Neighbor II
quest.cleanDescription: After she’s out of sight, you head to your workbench to repair the broken pieces of the cart.

quest.title: New Neighbor III
quest.cleanDescription: You hammer together some wooden planks, gather some other materials, and pack them in her cart.

quest.title: New Neighbor IV
quest.cleanDescription: She returns a few hours later with some tools. When she realizes what you’ve done, she’s nearly speechless. “You…How did you…” She begins to get teary-eyed, but quickly clears her throat and reaches out a hand. “Thank you, neighbor. Come see me in a few weeks once I’m settled in here, and I’ll make this up to you. I’m Mariya, by the way.” You shake her hand, and she takes the supplies down the road.

quest.title: Fooled I
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy would like to play a prank on his very dear friend, Vincent. For the prank, Buddy wants to make ice cream that looks great, but tastes terrible. Will you help Buddy get the ingredients he needs to make the prank ice cream?

quest.title: Fooled II
quest.cleanDescription: The next ingredient Buddy needs is eggs. Will you help him get some eggs?

quest.title: Fooled III
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy is now ready for the secret ingredient to make the ice cream taste terrible. Will you bring Buddy some orange juice?

quest.title: Fooled IV
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy forgot that he needs ice to make ice cream! Do you have anything he could use to freeze his ice cream?

quest.title: Fooled V
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy’s prank went perfectly! Vincent was hesitant to eat the ice cream at first. Then, he smiled politely, said it was good, and finished the entire bowl. Vincent even asked for a little more. Buddy appreciates your help on this successful prank.

quest.title: Beach Bum I
quest.cleanDescription: Borgen is going to spend a week or two at the beach. It’s not a vacation though. He’s going to set up a stand and sell keepsakes to the folks vacationing at the beach. Will you help him find some beach themed items to sell?

quest.title: Beach Bum II
quest.cleanDescription: Borgen would like you to keep the beach keepsakes coming. Can you find him some more shells?

quest.title: Beach Bum III
quest.cleanDescription: Keep the shells coming! Borgen says they’re selling as fast as he can get them on display.

quest.title: Beach Bum IV
quest.cleanDescription: Borgen knows what the people really want from his souvenir stand. Will you help him find some shark teeth?

quest.title: King of Cakes I
quest.cleanDescription: Mariya wants to make a table filled with very special cakes for the end of the parade. She has most of the ingredients that she needs to get started, but she’s going to need much more than what she has on hand to make enough for everyone. Will you help gather what she needs?

quest.title: King of Cakes II
quest.cleanDescription: Mariya is ready to make icing for all of the cakes she made. She has all the ingredients she needs, except for some items to make natural dyes. Will you help bring her these items so she can color the icing?

quest.title: King of Cakes III
quest.cleanDescription: In appreciation for all your help, Mariya made one of the cakes just for you!

quest.title: Donation For Education I
quest.cleanDescription: Cecil believes very strongly in the power of knowledge. Accordingly, Cecil would like to help the new school by contributing some of the necessities it uses daily. He will gladly pay you to produce and deliver individually packaged servings of milk for use during the school’s lunch breaks.

quest.title: Donation For Education II
quest.cleanDescription: Cecil thought of another daily necessity for the school that he would like you to produce and deliver to the school. He will pay you handsomely for your continued efforts.

quest.title: Donation For Education III
quest.cleanDescription: Cecil would like you to keep the deliveries coming for the school. He will continue to compensate you at a generous rate.

quest.title: Donation For Education IV
quest.cleanDescription: Cecil appreciates your efforts thus far and he would like for you to continue the deliveries.

quest.title: Donation For Education V
quest.cleanDescription: Cecil thinks the school could use another large delivery. Please fulfill this larger order.

quest.title: Donation For Education VI
quest.cleanDescription: Cecil is almost satisfied with the inventory that you have built up at the new school. Will you make an additional delivery to ensure a lasting supply for the school?

quest.title: Donation For Education VII
quest.cleanDescription: Cecil appreciates all of your efforts. He expects this will be the last delivery... for now...

quest.title: Return Our Lost Friend I
quest.cleanDescription: Lorn appreciates your efforts to try to find Beatrix, but he found a passage in The Book of Places that leads him to believe she's not at Lake Minerva. Instead of endlessly searching that fiery place, Lorn would like your help gathering a few items that he believes will help return our lost friend.

quest.title: Return Our Lost Friend II
quest.cleanDescription: Lorn needs some steel to continue constructing his rescue apparatus. He also needs a new hammer.

quest.title: Return Our Lost Friend III
quest.cleanDescription: Lorn is still working on the rescue device, but he wants to go ahead and have the materials ready for the gravitational array. Will you gather the items he needs?

quest.title: Return Our Lost Friend IV
quest.cleanDescription: Lorn needs Rosalie’s mystic ring. He’s not sure how it happened, but Rosalie’s mystic ring is holding the magic spark needed to activate his machine and return Beatrix. Hopefully, Rosalie will trade you for it.

quest.title: Return Our Lost Friend V
quest.cleanDescription: The time has come. Now Lorn needs the Lava Sphere Beatrix crafted. While the machine is working he wants you to get as far away as you can, in case something goes wrong. He would also like you to to hold on to a letter for him. If everything goes well, you can return it to him, otherwise Lorn would like it delivered to Rosalie.

quest.title: Free Candy I
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie found a bag of candy on the ground.  It's probably fine and she doesn't eat much candy.  Do you want it?

quest.title: Free Candy II
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie found another bag of candy with some taffy.  Would you like it?

quest.title: Free Candy III
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie found another bag of candy with some candy corn on the ground.  Who keeps throwing their candy out?  It's probably safe to eat.  Do you want it?

quest.title: Free Candy IV
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie found a Jack-o-Lantern full of candy this time.  However, she would like a little bit more in return for this.  Can you help her out?

quest.title: Free Candy V
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie has a few more Jack-o-lanterns with candy in them.  She was making them to give to the other townsfolk, but made a few extra. Rosalie is working on a scary Halloween mask to wear.  If you can bring her a few things she will give you the Jack-o-lanterns.

quest.title: BFF <3 I
quest.cleanDescription: Roses are red…

quest.title: BFF <3 II
quest.cleanDescription: Violets are blue…

quest.title: BFF <3 III
quest.cleanDescription: Somebody loves you…

quest.title: BFF <3 IV
quest.cleanDescription: You’ll never guess who!

quest.title: Big Boom I
quest.cleanDescription: Beatrix needs 10 Barrels. The barrels should be large enough to hold at least 10 explosives each.

quest.title: Big Boom II
quest.cleanDescription: Beatrix is ready to fill her barrels with explosives.

quest.title: Big Boom III
quest.cleanDescription: Beatrix needs a few more things to finish setting up. This could get messy.

quest.title: Big Boom IV
quest.cleanDescription: Beatrix needs one final component to make sure she's not in the blast radius, and maybe a shield.

quest.title: Big Boom V
quest.cleanDescription: Beatrix finally launched the greatest fireworks display this town has ever seen, but now she has a big mess to clean up. If you can give her a hand one more time, she'd like to give you a big reward for all of your help.

quest.title: Our Patron of Refreshment I
quest.cleanDescription:
Do you realize the time?! We have an approaching merger of two streams. Like two refreshing beverages coming together to form one refreshing beverage, the time stream of our universe is merged with another for a single refreshing second. Can you imagine the possibilities that could emerge from such a union?

I’ll need feathers!

You have my gratitude, as always.

quest.title: Our Patron of Refreshment II
quest.cleanDescription:
Ugh!! I didn’t realize that the alternate time stream would be so…so lemony…

We’re going to need some amethyst, and more feathers of course.

quest.title: Our Patron of Refreshment III
quest.cleanDescription:
There’s only one way to make this work, and I absolutely hate it…

I can’t even say it. Please bring me more feathers…and some quartz that is yellow like a citrus fruit that I loathe to the next epoch and beyond. Ugh….

quest.title: Our Patron of Refreshment IV
quest.cleanDescription:
It was unbearable, but I did it. I distilled a single vial of magic from the other time stream. Who knows what amazing developments may come from this! Coronal mass ejections may soon be our playthings! You deserve all my thanks.

Could you spare a few more feathers?

quest.title: Befriending Buddy I
quest.cleanDescription:
Your daily ventures have you traveling near the small cave, and you hear an odd sound coming from within. You peer inside to see Buddy, holding his pirate costume. As soon as he hears you calling to him, the sound stops. “Oh! What are you doing here?” Buddy does not face you. You offer him some flowers to see if that cheers him up.

He seems unsure of what to do with the flowers, and leaves them on the ground. He stands, and comes over to you. You notice his eyes are red and he looks like he's angry. “I just wanted to play pirates. I saw Ric earlier and asked if he would play with me. He called me some really bad words that weren’t my name, and broke my peg leg. I just wanted to play pirates with him.”

quest.title: Befriending Buddy II
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy looks absolutely defeated, drops the broken toy, and retreats back into his cave. You’re determined to help fix this peg leg. You gather the necessary materials, and get to work.

quest.title: Befriending Buddy III
quest.cleanDescription:
You return a while later, and Buddy is laying face-down on the floor. “I don’t want to play any more.” he mumbles through the dirt. You poke him with the peg leg. Buddy peeks over at you. “You fixed it? I thought you didn't like playing pirates with me.” Buddy hugs his peg leg.

“Some people don’t want to play with me because I am different from them. You play with me just to make me happy. Is it okay to call you my best friend?”

quest.title: Befriending Buddy IV
quest.cleanDescription:
Buddy has been so happy since you repaired his peg leg. A few days have passed, and he knocks on your door.

"Hi best friend! Best friends give each other things, right? I have some things I want to give you! Do you have any things for me?"

:D BEST FRIENDS FOREVER :D

quest.cleanDescription: Cecil is building something and needs some resources.  He won't say what it is yet, but will pay in gold.

quest.title: Mystery Contraption II
quest.cleanDescription: Cecil is continuing to work on his secret project, and is in need of more materials. He still won't tell you what he's working on though...

quest.title: A Way Forward I
quest.cleanDescription:
Captain Thomas is researching ways to get back to his homeworld.

On his world there were stones that appeared in a variety of mundane locations. His parents found some of them, and he overheard them discussing the magical properties of these runestones. He thinks the runestones may be able to help him return home.

Will you help Captain Thomas find the runestone that appears in the forest pond?

quest.title: A Way Forward II
quest.cleanDescription:
Captain Thomas remembers his parents finding one of the runestones in a small cave. Will you help him search for the cave and the stone?

Be wary. Captain Thomas heard tales of a frightening creature living in one of the caves nearby.

quest.title: A Way Forward III
quest.cleanDescription: The last runestone that Captain Thomas remembers his parents finding came from growing cucumbers in their garden. Will you grow some cucumbers along with Captain Thomas? He hopes one of you will find a runestone.

quest.title: A Way Forward IV
quest.cleanDescription: Captain Thomas isn’t sure where any other runestones are, but he remembers some possibilities from his parents searching. Will you try growing leeks with Captain Thomas? His parents were convinced there was a stone connected to the vegetable although they never found it.

quest.title: A Way Forward V
quest.cleanDescription: Captain Thomas remembers his parents exploring Black Rock Canyon on a regular basis. They didn’t find a runestone, but he’s sure they were searching for one. Will you help him search the canyon?

quest.title: A Way Forward VI
quest.cleanDescription: Captain Thomas is really uncertain about this next location. His family used to fish regularly at a small pond just outside of town. His parents never said specifically that they were looking for a runestone, but they always looked for interesting rocks in and around the pond. Will you help him search the small pond for a runestone?

quest.title: A Way Forward VII
quest.cleanDescription: Captain Thomas would like you to help him try to get a runestone from radishes. His father couldn’t stand radishes, but his mother was sure that a stone could be collected from them. Unfortunately, they never found a radish runestone, but it was probably because his dad rarely planted the hated vegetable.

quest.title: A Way Forward VIII
quest.cleanDescription:
There is only one more runestone that Captain Thomas has a clue about. His parents suspected there was a runestone in the Misty Forest, but between the large rodents and the spiders, Captain Thomas’s family never spent much time searching for it.

Will you explore the forest and see if there is a runestone to be found? Captain Thomas would go with you, but he seems to have inherited a bit of that fear of spiders, unfortunately.

quest.title: A Way Forward IX
quest.cleanDescription: The runestones are reacting with each other, but they’re not doing anything except glowing. While Captain Thomas continues to experiment with them, will you check your farm for more runestones? Captain Thomas thinks you must have incredible luck after finding all of the stones his parents searched so hard to find. Maybe you could check the pond on your farm for a runestone.

quest.title: A Way Forward X
quest.cleanDescription:
Captain Thomas is amazed by the good fortune that follows you.

The runestones are glowing more brightly now, but he still can’t coax anything else from them. Will you try your luck at finding one more stone? Maybe you could grow some quick crops like carrots.

quest.title: A Way Forward XI
quest.cleanDescription:
After all that effort, Captain Thomas is frustrated. The stones do open a gateway, when they are merged together, but the gate leads to a wasteland. From what Captain Thomas could tell from his visits, there was nothing in that fiery waste that could help him get home.

Captain Thomas would like you to get the fused stones out of his sight.

quest.title: Lost Reindeer I
quest.cleanDescription:
Santa needs your help. Someone disabled the security magic that sealed and protected his local present crafting facility, #815. The spell was disabled just long enough for Santa’s reindeer to get out of one of the side entrances that manifest around town and around the countryside. When Santa went to check on the reindeer they were all gone. The magic seal was also set back in place. So, the reindeer couldn’t get back in, even if they returned.

Will you help Santa find his reindeer? Santa thinks Rudolph might be the easiest to spot. So start your search with Rudolph.

quest.title: Lost Reindeer II
quest.cleanDescription: Santa suspects that Dasher may be the hardest to find. Dasher is quick and cunning. You may need help from the whole community to find Dasher.

quest.title: Lost Reindeer III
quest.cleanDescription: Santa thinks he may have some tips that can help you find Dancer. Dancer is the most wise of the reindeer. Dancer loves to be clean.  He is also known to seek out fresh well water.

quest.title: Lost Reindeer IV
quest.cleanDescription: Santa is willing to trade you a Prancer for a Rudolph, if you're lucky.  Try giving Santa some Rudolphs at his mailbox.

quest.title: Lost Reindeer V
quest.cleanDescription: Santa doesn’t have any great clues to help you locate Vixen. A temporary market, of some sort, might attract Vixen’s attention, but Santa isn’t completely sure about that.

quest.title: Lost Reindeer VI
quest.cleanDescription: It's going to be an adventure to find Comet, isn't it?

quest.title: Lost Reindeer VII
quest.cleanDescription: Cupid will be really tough to find. Santa thinks you’ll need your friends to help find Cupid.

quest.title: Lost Reindeer VIII
quest.cleanDescription: Santa wants you to find some stockings. If you find stockings, you’ll find Donner. Donner loves stockings.

quest.title: Lost Reindeer IX
quest.cleanDescription: Blitzen is a little backwards sometimes. Santa thinks Blitzen might be hanging around the post office. That reindeer loves mailboxes.

quest.title: Lost Reindeer X
quest.cleanDescription:
Santa was correct. You were just the person to help him find his reindeer. He appreciates all your hard work.

Will you bring Santa some milk for the road?

quest.title: A Wall In The Way I
quest.cleanTitle: A Wall In The Way I
quest.cleanDescription:
Dark clouds on the horizon, you check your mailbox and find a letter.

I hope this letter finds you well. It burdens my heart to write you this, but I think our dear friend Thomas is not well. He has seemed distant of late, and complained of various ailments that my books cannot identify. Would you be so kind as to join me for dinner tomorrow night with our esteemed friend? Since you’ll be in the area, could you help me restock my stores as well?

A list of ingredients and fish follow.

quest.title: A Wall In The Way II
quest.cleanTitle: A Wall In The Way II
quest.cleanDescription:
The evening approaches and you head to Lorn’s home. The sky is peaceful, almost serene after looking dark previously. Your steps feel light and you take a deep breath of the evening air. Lorn is on his porch, chatting amiably with Thomas when you arrive. You catch the tail end of their conversation.

“…estimated! I just have to prove to you I can be better.”

Lorn chuckles as you walk up his porch steps, “Hello there! Won’t you join us for dinner? The supplies can all be stocked later tonight.” As Lorn stands, he seems older, more frail than you remember. Maybe it’s a trick of the evening light, you think to yourself.

At dinnertime, you all enjoy a well prepared meal out of some of the ingredients you brought, and some strange fish you don’t recognize. Thomas and Lorn again begin to talk spiritedly. Lorn’s eyes positively gleam the entire time, returning the youthful countenance you view in him, despite his advancing age.

“You just gotta let me prove to you that I’ve gotten better! Our friend here has seen it firsthand! Look at the haul we’ve made at Pirate’s Cove! I was a part of that, you know…” Before Thomas continues, you notice a slight hitch in Thomas’s arm as he winces, spearing a piece of fish. “What is this fish anyways?”

“It’s extremely rare. In fact, no one I know could find or identify it, but the trader called it a Glassback, it’s not native to our oceans or lakes, so I’ve no idea how they came across it, but I paid a pretty penny for the privilege. I bought it a few months ago but never had the right time to share it, but now seems as good as any, eh?”

You mention how good the fish is, and Thomas agrees. Lorn suggests you reconvene on the deck.

“Would you like to hear about a lake encircled in ice?”

quest.title: A Wall In The Way III
quest.cleanTitle: A Wall In The Way III
quest.cleanDescription:
Thomas can hardly contain himself as you sit on the porch, he squirms uncomfortably and impatiently, between odd winces. Lorn looks at the sunset and smiles, seeming unhurried by the circumstances he has created.

You take a sip of tea, knowing that good things come to those who wait.

“Before Thomas wears a hole in my porch, let me tell you what I know…” Thomas stares at Lorn with rapt attention.

“In the days before, legend tells us the guardians of the world were sent forth to oversee the land, to give it a final shape and form. To walk amongst the people and care for them as one might care for a flock. Among them was Zho, though you might know them as Zholice or perhaps Shva, their ancient name is written in books I have read. Zho was the guardian of water and sapphire and they made their home among the people. There are legends of an unending cold known as Shva’s Playground, and within it lies Zho’s Lake. The lake is as clear as day, and it’s said you can walk on the lake and ice will form under your feet as you walk.” Lorn guffaws, “Fairy tales, I tell you…” After another pause, he continues “Other legends say that there is but one stream that leaves the lake, and that is how a fish from that mythical place could be found in the ocean. These fish are so rare, their value would be greater than anything you’ve seen so far. I didn’t believe it myself until I discovered the one from tonight a few months back.”

Thomas, leaning over the balcony, looks back to you both. “I’m gonna find that Lake, and I’m gonna fish up the best fish you’ve ever had Lorn, on my honor!” He looks to you and says, “Pack your things, we’re going north!” As he strides away, Lorn carries a wistful but knowing smile as he turns back to his house. “But I haven’t finished my story…”

You wonder if Lorn hadn’t planned this all along, but in the meantime, you realize you need to prepare for a trek to the north.

quest.title: A Wall In The Way IV
quest.cleanTitle: A Wall In The Way IV
quest.cleanDescription:
You wake up the next morning to a loud banging at your door. Groggily, you find Thomas, looking full of energy and excitement standing in front of you.

“We can’t leave today, I know, you need to make plans, so I have an idea too. Maybe we should use some parts from the rest of your journeys to make our current journey easier. I’ve asked Jill for a little help in the designs…”

quest.title: A Wall In The Way V
quest.cleanTitle: A Wall In The Way V
quest.cleanDescription:
After delivering the requested items to Jill, you gather a few more things before setting forth. Of extreme importance is food, clothing, and general traveling supplies.

The day of the trip you agreed on with Thomas comes and Thomas is nowhere to be found. You find him later in his cabin, collapsed on the floor.

Lorn looks to you, “He seems to have taken a nasty spill. I noticed him acting oddly lately, but didn’t expect anything like this. I suggested the trip because I suspected a goal might help with whatever ails him, but it doesn’t seem to have made much difference.”

After a moment of consideration, you suggest that it has in fact invigorated him, as you noticed in his interactions less of the odd behavior. Between the two of you, you decide not to talk to Thomas more about this incident and proceed as planned after Thomas awakens.

quest.title: A Wall In The Way VI
quest.cleanTitle: A Wall In The Way VI
quest.cleanDescription:
The trek north is slow but steady progress. The carts carrying your snow machines are well prepared thanks to the weight balancing steel plates and large tyres with treads Jill added. They also work off a strange system of wheel propulsion you nor Thomas understand, but they lighten your trek significantly and make obstructions significantly easier to navigate.

A week of traveling, past Cane Pole Ridge and farther north, you’re surprised to find rolling hills that never seem to break into a flatland or a mountain range. On the break of the ninth day, you see in the distance a bright gleam of sun, dazzling your eyes, you realize this might be the direction you seek. You change tack to the northwest and the temperature begins to drop precipitously. Ice begins to take over the landscape, and yet to the east and west, you see nothing but clear skies and green fields.

“This feels right,” Thomas says excitedly, “We’re gonna find this place and I’m gonna be the greatest fisherman slash explorer in Redbrook!”

You both make camp for the night and prepare for a journey into frozen lands in the morning.

Thomas seems somehow brighter through this experience, and you haven’t noticed any of the odd ticks from the previous days. Maybe Lorn was right, you think to yourself.

You both spend the better part of the morning trying to figure out exactly how Jill got these contraptions *on* the cart to begin with. While looking over the machines more thoroughly, you spy a big red button labeled “Start”.

Exhausted, you hop on and when you press the start button, the snow machine comes whirring to life. Gears begin turning and before you know it the treads on the backs of the machine start spinning slowly and you begin inching forward.

Thomas laughs triumphantly and yells, “It’s working! It’s working! Well, at least I think that’s what Jill might say.”

After a moment of revelry, you press the button again and the machine abruptly stops. You notice at that point a letter from Jill taped to the side of the machine with specific unloading instructions as well as operating instructions.

“Friends,

Here are my new creations, schematics I had only dreamed of until I heard of the parts you’d found in the Jundland Wastes – please take care of them, I’d be ever so sad never to see them again.

Your friend, Jill

(not a farmer)”

quest.title: A Wall In The Way VII
quest.cleanTitle: A Wall In The Way VII
quest.cleanDescription:
After half an hour, you both feel comfortable enough with the machinery to start traveling with it, so you set off. The machines are not very noisy, but the occasional clang and ping is quite jarring in the quiet intensity of the growing cold and snow as you travel further north. For each minute that passes, you grow more and more unsettled. Distinctly to the east and west you can still see green. The area slowly grows more forested in all directions but only in the small swathe of land you travel is there snow as it slopes gently upwards. Slowly over the next hour the snow-covered land expands on both sides, greenery becoming overtaken by white, making you believe you started near the point of this mysterious phenomenon.

Thomas seems determined to trek onward, and his determination is met suddenly by a fierce blowing wind. Snow begins falling from the sky at a rapid pace, though no clouds appear overhead. The effect of wind, snow, and bright sun are disorienting, the light glinting off the snow crystals creating beautiful fleeting patterns of reflected light all around you.

You both lean forward, almost willing your machines to traverse the snow faster as the winds intensify until suddenly, you reach a barrier of snow, ice, and wind. “It’s too dangerous!” you shout to Thomas. The roaring maelstrom in front of you fills you with terror and a hint of sorrow. “We must go back!”

Thomas looks to you, a mad gleam in his eye, “No!”

You try to call out again, but Thomas lurches forward. His machine begins to enter the maelstrom and as he enters you hear an unearthly roar from all around you as Thomas and the snow contraption are both lifted into the air. Ice covers the machine and Thomas is thrown viciously backwards. He crumples to the ground unnaturally and the storm subsides as you run towards Thomas.

quest.title: A Wall In The Way VIII
quest.cleanTitle: A Wall In The Way VIII
quest.cleanDescription:
Thomas is cold and lifeless as you approach him. He seems to have faded in some ways. Frost creeps up his fingers unnaturally. It seems slow, almost imperceptible, but after a quick check he is breathing. You pick up Thomas as gingerly as possible, the cold seems to emanate from his body, penetrating all the layers of covering you’re wearing. Gingerly, you put Thomas in front of you on the snow machine and rush back the way you came.

Lorn will know what to do, the thought crosses your mind.

You return to the edge of the phenomenon and quickly fashion a makeshift cart for Thomas. Jill's going to be very mad at me as well, you think to yourself as you leave the snow machine behind. You grab the cart, make sure Thomas is safe, and rush back to Redbrook. The trip takes less time, as you skip breaks, traveling on minimal sleep, you travel recklessly to get back sooner. Each time you check on Thomas, you see the frost has crawled farther up his arms and legs.

Exhausted, you reach Redbrook after seven days of hard, almost ceaseless travel and caring for Thomas the best you can, you find yourself collapsing on Lorn’s doorstep.

Lorn opens his door as you weakly gesture towards the cart and even though you are pointing towards the cart, you don’t understand why Lorn is trying to help you to a chair.

“You fools. You bloody fools!” The words come from Lorn's mouth, but you hear Star Meerif's voice.

quest.title: A Wall In The Way IX
quest.cleanTitle: A Wall In The Way IX
quest.cleanDescription:
You feel something tickle your nose and startle you back to consciousness, but your eyes won’t open despite your best efforts. “YOU SENT THEM TO SHVA’S PLAYGROUND!? In the name of Tvas, why would you do that, Lorn?”

“Sometimes, people need a push. You, of all people should respect this given your long history. It was not my choice, but theirs. I just… gave them a little nudge out the door. It was for his own good.”

“…It’s enchanted, and powerfully so. Every book and being I’ve ever spoken with, including text from the Golden Leaf tell us to stay away! Even I am not stupid enough to try and penetrate Shva’s Wall.”

“Be that as it may, you’re obligated to help these two now, you’ve heard Thomas’ plight, it is beyond their abilities.”

“I am obligated to do no such thing. You think I'm a fool? Yes, and before you say it, that business before was different. Shva is not to be trifled with and I…am not knowledgeable enough, not by half in some of those realms to do what you seek.”

A pause.

“Cecil, then?”

A long, uncomfortable pause follows.

“If you must continue this folly.”

You feel another tickle on your nose.

“He won’t get better if we avoid the problem, Star.”

There is no response, and you lose consciousness again.

quest.title: A Wall In The Way X
quest.cleanTitle: A Wall In The Way X
quest.cleanDescription:
You awaken the next morning, and Lorn gives you some more medicine, with orders to take things slow and try not to overdo it over the next few days. You are quickly escorted out of the room and as you leave, you catch a glimpse of Thomas, pale but no longer covered in frost.

“He needs rest, but you and Star saved his life, no thanks to me.” He says softly. A look of remorse passes his features quickly.

After a week of taking things easy, returning to your normal routine has helped your recovery immensely. A balanced diet of orange juice, lemonade, tea, and occasionally lemonade and tea mixed have helped re-hydrate you, and a balanced meal has restored your strength.

quest.title: A Wall In The Way XI
quest.cleanTitle: A Wall In The Way XI
quest.cleanDescription:
Each day during this week, you have checked on Thomas and his health has returned much more quickly than you or Lorn have anticipated. Lorn has spent much time researching the effects of the item Star requested for healing, but he seems to refuse to want to ask for more information, content to find old parchments in his basement and mutter to himself from beside Thomas’ bed. Thomas on the other hand has been pressing Lorn for as much information on Shva and Shva’s Wall. On one occasion, Lorn let slip that Star or Cecil might know more about it.

After two weeks, despite both you and Lorn’s protests to the contrary, Thomas’ inquiries into Shva’s Wall have only grown more persistent and with begrudging consent from Lorn, and Thomas’ insistence that he would pursue this with or without you, you’ve found yourself joining Thomas on a trip to Cecil’s manor.

Before the third knock, the door opens, and Cecil appears before you both. His clothes are different from what you remember, more like robes than his typical business attire and he seems quite irate. “What do you want? I’m very busy.”

Thomas shuffles his feet, clearly not expecting this rough welcome. He mumbles through a greeting before clearly stating, “I want to get through Shva’s Wall.”

Cecil was clearly not expecting this forward statement from Thomas and his face breaks out into a broad smile. “My dear fellow, why didn’t you say that sooner? Come in, come in.”

You step inside Cecil's home. Somehow, the opulence of his home continues to amaze you, the large hall, filled with baubles, gems and other devices always takes your breath away. You recall the room you visited with the energy core, but Cecil instead takes you to his dining room, where three sets of cups, a tea kettle, milk, and sugar are in the middle of the table. Before you can ask how Cecil had these ready, he begins speaking as you sit down.

“I heard rumors that hooligan Star wouldn’t help you out, so I’ve been doing a little research of my own and found I might already have something to help you with your journey, if you’re willing to pay the price.”

Thomas looks intensely at Cecil, “I’ll pay any price.”

Cecil looks to you both, “Great, let’s have some tea and discuss the…tea.” Cecil laughs to himself, but you don’t quite understand why.

quest.title: A Wall In The Way XII
quest.cleanTitle: A Wall In The Way XII
quest.cleanDescription:
“Zho was the guardian of water in our world. Their Playground is where they experimented with their Power and where their followers gathered in tribute and followed Zho’s teachings. As the years went on, Zho shared what they learned of Power with others, and the Playground eventually grew into a temple. Zho explored the world, and many knew of their name, until one day Zho returned to their Playground, only to find their temple destroyed and their followers murdered. It was at that moment Zho’s Wall was born, Zho poured their sorrow and pain into this Wall, and then disappeared.”

Cecil pauses for a moment before pulling a plain case out from underneath his robes. The case has writing on it you don’t recognize and a golden leaf adorns the latch. Considering the splendor of Cecil’s home, the box seems positively ordinary in comparison.

“We know this story thanks to ancient wizards of the Golden Leaf who traveled to the Playground – few survived, but this – this is the only relic we have from that time.”

Cecil opens the case and before you can see what’s inside, a powerful shock wave unlike anything you’ve ever experienced hits you. The sound of the ocean, the roar of the wind, the frigidness of snow, and the scalding heat of boiling water overwhelms your senses. You fall off your chair and see Thomas sitting, staring rapturously at the box. Cecil abruptly closes the box and the sensation is immediately gone. “I should have warned you, this is an item of immense Power. I call it Zho’s Dagger, and it most certainly is the item that killed Zho.”

A quietness covers the room as the enormity of Cecil’s words wash over you.

“I gather now, you understand the enormity of what I am about to suggest. I want you to revisit Zho’s Playground, bring this dagger with you and use its power to counteract the Power of Zho’s Wall and go inside and understand what happened, and bring me back something.”

Thomas blinks, “And fish.”

Cecil smiles, “Yes, and fish.”

Thomas looks at you and without hesitation blurts out, “We’ll do it! What do you want in return?”

Cecil shakes his head and looks away for a moment, “A safer world for us all, and some information I’ve long pondered. Consider this journey the favor I ask of you…and maybe a few rare things I’ve misplaced. But mostly the first thing.”

Cecil hands the box to Thomas. “Keep it secret, keep it safe, and when you approach the wall open the box and hold onto that dagger with all your will. Now, I have important things to be doing.” Cecil looks expectantly at you both and you get the impression it’s your time to leave.

quest.title: A Wall In The Way XIII
quest.cleanTitle: A Wall In The Way XIII
quest.cleanDescription:
You both leave Cecil’s house in a rushed fog. Thomas has the plain case close to him.

“Well, that was…interesting. I’m not so worried about all the high-falutin god stuff, but think of the riches! The fame! The prestige! Lucky for you, I happen to have a backup store, in case I need to get out of town a second time in a hurry. Let’s go tomorrow! Skip town before Lorn and anyone else realize we’ve gone. They’ll only try to stop us anyways…”

You cautiously agree, remembering the argument between Lorn and Star. You put your misgivings aside for your friend, and you prepare yourself for another long trek north in the morning.

quest.title: A Wall In The Way XIV
quest.cleanTitle: A Wall In The Way XIV
quest.cleanDescription:
As you prepare for sleep, a knock at the door interrupts your evening routine. You quickly stash your cookies and your accounting books in the drawer and answer the door.

Lorn swings the door wide open, followed by Star who immediately begins speaking to you animatedly, “Good sir, I must protest. I cannot in good conscience allow you to go forth with this journey. Whatever Cecil has told you, I’m sure it is well intentioned, but you are messing with powers you cannot possibly understand. He has sent you to your death. How very Langstaffian of him, to send others to do his bidding.”

Lorn rolls his eyes towards you, “Star, why are you here, exactly? You refuse to help, you refuse to not help, and you refuse to keep to yourself. Are you not the town mage…”

“Wizard.” Star mumbles absentmindedly.

“...that we have trusted all these long years? Either speak plainly, or kindly stop speaking at all.”

Star looks to Lorn for a moment, and you can see his internal struggle before he smooths his robes and takes a deep breath.

“There are powers in this world even I do not dare trifle with, but if I cannot convince you to change your mind, I shall share with you the only helpful legend I know regarding Zho. His followers were known to be extraordinarily kind, and when in his domain you had but to ‘speak the ancient word for friend’. What happens beyond that is something only the gods know now.” Star pauses for a moment before practically pleading with you. “Consider once last time staying home and safe - ignore this fools errand.”

You shake your head, intent on ensuring Thomas’ safety.

Star looks quietly to Lorn and disappears in a cloud of feathers but words echo, “Friendship. More enriches life, less offers nothing.”

Lorn looks quietly to you, “Whatever ails Thomas, he seems inextricably bound in all this, in ways I don’t understand and no one will explain to me, for better or worse. I…don’t want either of you to go. I’m a fool - I believed Thomas having a goal would help heal him, instead I’ve put you both in terrible, terrible danger.” Lorn pauses a moment, and a single tear runs down his left cheek. “Even now, I realize I’m not too old to have new regrets, new follies. Be safe. Bring my friend back safely.”

Lorn lingers a moment longer, seemingly wanting to say more but he turns slowly and steps out of the house and you are left alone, feeling as though you’re on the precipice of something bigger than you understand.

quest.title: A Wall In The Way XV
quest.cleanTitle: A Wall In The Way XV
quest.cleanDescription:
The morning is clear, and you wake up to finish your final chores before Thomas arrives. Thomas’ enthusiasm is apparent, he practically runs and skips as you depart. With no cart and the food in your packs, you expect to make excellent time.

With no significant rain, and having recently traveled this way, you are able to pick your way back north faster than you expected. After a few days on the journey, Thomas seems quieter than usual. You reflect, for a moment before realizing he seems almost unrecognizable from the man you met when you moved to Redbrook. His drive, confidence, intensity and joy for adventure are far removed from the nervous, novice fisherman you met all that time ago.

As you approach the snowy phenomenon, you find Jill’s snow machine waiting for you, looking worn and covered in a few weeks of outdoor weather, but otherwise in good working order.

“What luck! This will cut down our snow travel considerably!” You press the big red start button and the machine sputters and whirs to life briefly before it dies.

“Must be out of corn oil.” Thomas quips.

Luckily, you brought some spare.

quest.title: Feathers I
quest.cleanDescription: As you're tending to your peppers, you nearly trip over a small boulder you don't remember being there before. You look down and see a piece of balled up paper. You look around, confused, as nobody is there but you. You open the paper, and it says one word. "Bucket." You're not sure why, but you feel compelled to head to your workshop and build a bucket for this piece of parchment.

quest.title: Feathers II
quest.cleanDescription: You're woken up in the middle of the night by a loud THUD. You go investigate, and find a very rotund rabbit sitting on your workbench. You turn on the lights, and notice a scroll of paper tied around a strange collar he's wearing. You take a step towards him. He bolts across the room faster than your eyes can follow. Think, think... You hear a soft whine and look to see this fat, fat rabbit is comically rubbing its own belly. You must have some carrots left over somewhere. You notice that same old bucket from earlier in the day on the floor, when you're positive you left it outside, and you wonder if you should use that to capture this very strange bunny.

quest.title: Feathers III
quest.cleanDescription: You've finally caught the rabbit, and manage to slip the parchment from under his collar. As soon as you do this, he dashes out of your home, just as fast as he came in, bucket still on his head and carrot dangling from his mouth. You open the folded note, and it says "Feather. In. Bucket." You've never found any loose feathers before, and don’t know what this letter is talking about. The words on the paper swirl away, and new words appear. "Chickens have feathers." You guess it's time to get a chicken coop, you wanted to make yourself some scrambled eggs anyways. Without even thinking, you decide to construct a new bucket, and find a feather for this piece of paper.

quest.title: Feathers IV
quest.cleanDescription: As you walk through the Small Spring, you have this uncomfortable feeling that you’re being watched. You turn around, and nobody is there. You shrug, and continue onward. A gust of wind nearly knocks you over, and a piece of parchment is blown into your face. As you study the paper in your hands, you notice the letters don’t quite sit still. “More feathers.”

quest.title: Feathers V
quest.cleanDescription: As you contemplate buying that orchard that recently went up for sale, a familiar gust of wind smacks another piece of parchment into your face. You try to catch it before it hits, but you just wind up falling down instead. You already know what it’s going to say, but you look anyways. “Feathers.” You debate crumpling the paper, tossing it aside, and moving on with your day. As soon as the thought enters your mind, the letters swirl and the paper turns a light shade of red. “DON’T LITTER! (also please include some apples)”. You sigh and decide it’s probably for the best to listen to the angry letter before it bursts into flames.

quest.title: Feathers VI
quest.cleanDescription: You clean up the remnants of frank’s mess, and set to work planting the new seeds you’ve gotten. You take a break inside, and just as you’re ready to go harvest them, it starts pouring rain. You slip on your coat, and step outside. Your shining crops! You can see them! You also can see small puddles, forming those familiar words. “Feathers. Bucket.” You groan, and you notice that the rain looks like it’s only hovering over your land. Better get those feathers, you guess.

quest.title: Feathers VII
quest.cleanDescription: A new ant hill has formed in your yard, and as you start to wash it away, a piece of parchment appears. It isn’t drenched the way normal parchment should be considering it’s been doused with water. You hesitate to pick it up, because it’s surrounded by fire ants. The ants all pile onto the parchment, you assume it’s to save them from drowning. They start to form letters. “F..E..A..”. You already know what’s going on. You grab a bucket, and toss in feathers. The bucket poofs away, and some bugs take its place.

quest.title: Feathers VIII
quest.cleanDescription: It’s been a very long, very strange week for you. You finally think everything will be normal for a few hours…when you trip on a bucket that was left in the middle of the walkway. How did you not see it? You pick it up, and there’s something shiny inside. You try to reach for it, but this bucket goes much deeper than it looks. Your entire arm is inside this bucket, and you’re still nowhere near the bottom. A bird flies by, and drops a bunch of worms in front of you. You already know what’s going on, right? Unsurprised, you look down and see “Feathers” spelled out by the worms, more or less, because the worms are clearly unhappy with the situation.

quest.title: Feathers IX
quest.cleanDescription:
You are walking home from the country store, and in a cloud of feathers, Star appears before you.
“Pranks. franks pranks. The little furball is a little over the top, especially for a Wednesday during a waxing moon. Lemon quartz, of all things. AND LEMONS! Not very gravimetric of him is it? No, not at all. Can you help get the essence of lemon out of everything? Perhaps a nice stew, and something to wash it down with? And NO. LEMONS! OR LEMON QUARTZ! Not that you’d ever think of putting gems in a stew, I know, but… you wouldn’t would you? Nonetheless, I think a fine stew would be most helpful during this troubling time.”
In another cloud of feathers, Star is gone, and a sheet of parchment is in his place. The parchment reads:

5 Tomatoes
5 Potatoes
2 Onions
5 Leeks
2 Steak Kabobs
2 Orange Juice
NO LEMONS

quest.title: Glacier Lake Effect I
quest.cleanDescription:
A strange cold front came through recently from the north. It appeared and vanished within a few hours. After it passed, the temperature dropped swiftly and then bounced back up. The next morning, Beatrix was checking her garden and found that some of her crops froze completely solid. She gathered the crops and attempted to thaw them, but these frozen crops refused to cooperate. Beatrix tried everything she could think of to thaw them, but nothing worked. She even tried some mild explosives.

Now, the frozen crops are gone, but Beatrix is still curious about them. She needs to find more that she can examine. Will you check your fields to see if you have any?

Note: You can get some frozen crops by growing the regular version of the crop and they will drop randomly. You can also get them via Frozen Chest 01 or Frozen Chest 02, which can be obtained from trading with other players (Open at the Locksmith)

quest.title: Glacier Lake Effect II
quest.cleanDescription:
These frozen crops do not hold up well to extreme methods of heating. Will you bring Beatrix some more frozen crops, if you can find them?

Note: You can get some frozen crops by growing the regular version of the crop and they will drop randomly. You can also get them via the Winter Basket, which can be obtained from trading with other players, the 28-day Daily Chores reward, or the January Starter Pack (Open Frozen Chest 02 at the Locksmith)

quest.title: Glacier Lake Effect III
quest.cleanDescription:
Beatrix is still experimenting with thawing the frozen crops. Nothing has worked so far. Either the crop stays frozen or it is destroyed. It’s very discouraging.

Will you find some more frozen crops for her to test?

quest.title: Glacier Lake Effect IV
quest.cleanDescription:
Beatrix has discovered a process for thawing the frozen crops without destroying them! She’s pretty sure. It only worked on the last one she tried, and there were a couple of additional variables in play. However, if you’ll help her one more time by bringing her a large load of frozen crops, she can make sure that her method works.

Beatrix appreciates your continued efforts to help with her curiosities.

quest.title: Glacier Lake Effect V
quest.cleanDescription: Thanks to all of your help, Beatrix figured out how to thaw the frozen crops! It was pepper juice! Anyway, she’s finished experimenting and has quite a few frozen crops left. She doesn’t want them to go to waste. Will you take them?

questlines.title: A Horse Of A Different Color

quest.title: A Horse Of A Different Color
quest.cleanTitle: A Horse Of A Different Color
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy thinks Charles Horsington III could be his friend.  He has something he’d like to build to “catch his attention”.  In exchange, he has some cool bugs he thinks you might like.  This sounds ominous to you, but… why not?

quest.title: A Horse Of A Different Color II
quest.cleanTitle: A Horse Of A Different Color II
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy says his creation is coming along nicely, but he’d like to add some color to it.  Seems fairly innocent.

quest.title: A Horse Of A Different Color III
quest.cleanTitle: A Horse Of A Different Color III
quest.cleanDescription: With the colors done, Buddy thinks there should be some flair for whatever it is he’s building.  He has a list of adornments he’d like you to get for him.

quest.title: A Horse Of A Different Color IV
quest.cleanTitle: A Horse Of A Different Color IV
quest.cleanDescription: Holger has been recruited to help with Buddy’s bizarre building blunders.  Holger needs building materials to complete some carvings.  He has some things he’s found while searching for wood for other projects.

quest.title: A Horse Of A Different Color V
quest.cleanTitle: A Horse Of A Different Color V
quest.cleanDescription: With the work Holger has completed, Buddy says it’s now time to start getting some things out of the way.  He’d like some fairly dangerous tools.  This… is starting to get concerning again.

quest.title: A Horse Of A Different Color VI
quest.cleanTitle: A Horse Of A Different Color VI
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy is very excited.  He says everything seems to be working properly, now it’s time to finish everything up with some hardware.  He gives you fishing nets saying “These aren’t good for horses anyway.”  You feel like Charles Horsington III might be in trouble.

quest.title: A Horse Of A Different Color VII
quest.cleanTitle: A Horse Of A Different Color VII
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy says everything is completed.  He just needs some help getting Charles Horsington III to come visit him in the cave.  He thinks if you bring carrots, he might be able to help get Charles to stop by.

quest.title: Artistic Rosalie I
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie is working on some special paintings, and needs some safety pins and green dye to display them properly. She tells you that Lorn may have some pins.

quest.title: Artistic Rosalie II
quest.cleanDescription: Lorn is happy to give you some safety pins in exchange for some boxes.

quest.title: Artistic Rosalie III
quest.cleanDescription:
Rosalie is thrilled, and thanks you for your help.

The next day, you walk by her house and see a small, green tapestry sitting in front of her garden. A painting of the wishing well is pinned to it. It waves delicately with the breeze.

quest.title: Artistic Rosalie IV
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie wants to add to her collection, and asks you to bring some yarn. She will need more safety pins and a variety of dyes as well.

quest.title: Artistic Rosalie V
quest.cleanDescription: Lorn is willing to part with the rest of his pins for some orange geckos and essence of slime. He explains that they’re great for keeping pests away.

quest.title: Artistic Rosalie VI
quest.cleanDescription:
Rosalie gives you a big hug, and pays you for your time.

The next day, again, you walk by and her garden is adorned with colorful tapestries. Each one displays a painting. There’s even a painting of the two of you.

quest.title: Bug Life I
quest.cleanDescription: Cecil is interested in studying the insect life of the Misty Forest. Will you bring him some bugs?

quest.title: Lorn's Advice I
quest.cleanDescription: Lorn has come to check up on your progress. "Seems like you have the basics of planting down. You know where to buy seeds in town, and you can always sell your crops at the Farmer's Market. You can take this OJ to drink, and try exploring that small cave nearby. You might find something there to bring back to me?"

quest.title: Lorn's Advice II
quest.cleanDescription: Did you find a Mushroom in the small cave? If so, Lorn has some more work for you. "You might have found some stone in that cave. You can use it, along with some Iron you can buy from the Country Store to make Iron Cups. That will help your crafting skill grow fast. Before you can craft, you need to build a Workshop on your farm. I'll loan you this silver to help with that. Here are some materials you can practice with. Bring me back the cups you make, and we will call it even."

quest.title: Lorn's Advice III
quest.cleanDescription:
10 fancy iron cups are just what Lorn is looking for! "I'll take the cups, and call your debt paid. Next, have some bait, and then you can try your hand at fishing. How does that sound? Think you can catch a Yellow Perch for my dinner?

There are a few types of bait here that you can 'swap' between. Later, when you get your own trout farm, you can raise your own minnows and grubs. To fish, when you see a shadow, click on it. Then, click on the moving blue dot to reel it in. Some say it is best to wait for the dot to come to you."

quest.title: Lorn's Advice IV
quest.cleanDescription: With a yellow Perch in hand, Lorn is ready to get cooking! "Thanks for bringing me my dinner! I'll check in on you from time to time. You will find that many other townsfolk will show up as well, as your skills grow, with requests for help too. Being a good neighboor is important!"

quest.title: Lorn's Advice V
quest.cleanDescription:
"Hey, I know you have a lot of work to do, and sometimes these help requests can take a while to complete," Lorn tells you. "If you click that button there, yup, the one that says 'Track Items', I'll track your progress for you!

Of course, if you have everything needed, only 'Collect and Complete' will show up. Oh, and if you hand over a few worms and some stones, I have a treat for you too. It is never too early to get a good breakfast!"

quest.title: Green Initiative I
quest.cleanDescription: frank heard a rumor once about the luckiest carrots that come from soaking in green water. He’s determined to test this theory using the town’s river. He asks you to fetch him some water lilies and other supplies.

quest.title: Green Initiative II
quest.cleanDescription: frank is getting hungry from watching all of your hard work. He’s only thinking in “green”, so he needs a green snack. He also asks you to make him some strong, sturdy boxes near the river, so he can oversee your progress and ensure everything is organized. He needs two boxes to be stacked, so he can watch everything “at an optimal height”. He hops away to go find some of his friends to watch his experiment.

quest.title: Green Initiative III
quest.cleanDescription: frank watches as you gather the various items he requested, and you place them in piles along the riverside. You hear a very soft rumble, and it’s heading your way. You look over, and at least 100 bunnies are hopping towards the river. frank hops down from his watchtower, and greets them. “Glad you could make it!” You feel a bit uneasy with so many beady eyes staring at you.

quest.title: Green Initiative IV
quest.cleanDescription: As you finish gathering all of the things frank has asked for, you watch as his friends start taking everything. They’re more organized than you’d have thought. Impressed, you watch them meticulously place each item around and in the river. Once they are finished, the river does seem to be sparkling with a greener tint than usual.

quest.title: Green Initiative V
quest.cleanDescription: frank doesn’t seem satisfied, as he hasn’t noticed his carrots tasting differently after soaking them in the river. “Must not be green enough.” He sends you off to fetch another batch of green materials, and another snack for him.

quest.title: Green Initiative VI
quest.cleanDescription: You’ve been curious as to how frank intends to move some of these larger items, since he has not asked you to help with that. As you return with another bucket full of emeralds, you see 50 rabbits pulling a rope, attached to a pine tree tied to a plank of wood. You can’t understand them, because they’re rabbits, but one of them must have said something frank didn’t like. You overhear frank calling one of them “lazy”. You shake your head and get back to gathering things.

quest.title: Green Initiative VII
quest.cleanDescription: “It’s gotta be the water itself. It’s not green water, so that has to be why it isn’t working.” frank demands green dye, and assures you it’s safe. “I used to drink that stuff all the time, in my youth.”

quest.title: Green Initiative VIII
quest.cleanDescription: The river is slowly becoming greener. frank seems a little crazed at this point, and he’s saying everyone needs to be wearing green for this to work. You can’t stop now.

quest.title: Green Initiative IX
quest.cleanDescription: frank asks you to pour in the last of the green dyes, while his friends scurry to place everything else around. As the last drop of dye hits the water, a huge gust of wind blows by. A few bunnies tumble over. The green water shimmers, and frank dips his carrots in for the final test.

quest.title: Green Initiative X
quest.cleanDescription: The green water is glowing, and frank dips his carrots in for the final test. His carrots come out, and they’re a shimmering gold! You notice a bubbling spot, right in the center of the river. frank’s friends notice it as well, and retrieve it. It looks like a cauldron, and it’s filled with gold! “Gold? What am I going to do with gold? I can’t eat that.” He offers it to you, though he’s confused about what you would use it for. “If you can’t eat it, sleep on it, or play with it, what’s it good for?”
Wow!  Over 200,000 people have tried their hand at farming around Redbrook.  To celebrate, here are some items that you might find useful.  Thanks for being a part of Farm RPG!

quest.title: 200,000 II
quest.cleanDescription: Amazing!  Over 200,000 people have tried their hand at farming around Redbrook.  To celebrate, here are some items that you might find useful.  Thanks for being a part of Farm RPG!

quest.title: 200,000 III
quest.cleanDescription: Incredible!  Over 200,000 people have tried their hand at farming around Redbrook.  To celebrate, here are some items that you might find useful.  Thanks for being a part of Farm RPG!

quest.title: Schoolhouse Rocks I
quest.cleanDescription:
In all of his travels, the greatest endeavor that Vincent has seen any town embark upon is educating its citizens. Truly great towns not only educate their children, but they also provide opportunities for learning for everyone. Everyone shares what they know.

To encourage such an endeavor in Redbrook, Vincent is gathering signatures to petition the mayor to allow Vincent to lead the building of a schoolhouse. The building will be constructed on the grounds adjacent to the library. Everyone will be welcomed to help with the building process. When the schoolhouse is finished, everyone will be welcome to come and learn and share their knowledge.

Will you join Vincent by signing his petition? He could also use some more parchment for signatures, if you have it handy.

quest.title: Schoolhouse Rocks II
quest.cleanDescription:
Vincent’s petition got an incredible number of signatures. When the mayor saw the stacks and stacks of signatures, he immediately agreed to Vincent’s plan. The mayor’s only demand in exchange for granting the permit was that the schoolhouse be named after him.

Vincent is ready to start construction on the Tridly Von Dritfeld School! He is inviting everyone to gather and bring building materials. Will you bring some wood and stone to help start the foundation?

quest.title: Schoolhouse Rocks III
quest.cleanDescription: The foundation for the schoolhouse needs more stone, and Vincent would also like to get started on collecting boards for the building frame. Will you bring more stone and a load of boards?

quest.title: Schoolhouse Rocks IV
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent’s crew is ready to work on the upper structures and the roof. They need more boards and a load of nails and hammers. Will you help gather the tools and building materials?

quest.title: Schoolhouse Rocks V
quest.cleanDescription: The schoolhouse needs windows now. Will you bring some glass for Vincent and the work crew to make and fit some windows?

quest.title: Schoolhouse Rocks VI
quest.cleanDescription: The schoolhouse is now ready for some hardware, desks, chairs, and tables. Will you bring some materials for Vincent and his crew to build these schoolhouse necessities?

quest.title: Schoolhouse Rocks VII
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent would like to stock the schoolhouse with supplies. Will you help gather some of the items?

quest.title: Schoolhouse Rocks VIII
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent would like to add some color to the supplies. Will you find some colorful parchment?

quest.title: Schoolhouse Rocks IX
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent thinks the school is almost ready. Will you help him gather a few more supplies?

quest.title: Schoolhouse Rocks X
quest.cleanDescription: There is one last thing that Vincent would love to have for the school. A hungry stomach  makes a tired brain. Will you bring some apples for these learners and instructors to snack on?

quest.title: Schoolhouse Rocks XI
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent appreciates all of your contributions to making the school a reality. He would also like to invite you to use the schoolhouse to learn something new. To help with your learning, Vincent would like you to have a copy of the schoolbook that he worked with Lorn to create, for the school.

quest.title: Uptime Dreamin I
quest.cleanDescription:
Neigh….

Charles pushes a card toward you.

“What’s the difference between a computational device and a horse?

A horse can get rid of its bugs…”

quest.title: Uptime Dreamin II
quest.cleanDescription:
Neigh neigh neigh.

Charles pushes another card toward you.

“Thanks for your patience…

While the server was horsing around…”

quest.title: Uptime Dreamin III
quest.cleanDescription:
Neigh neigh neigh, neigh.

Charles pushes another another card toward you.

Hopefully the servers will be more stable ;)

quest.title: Uptime Dreamin IV
quest.cleanDescription: Charles hopes that the rest of the spring egg celebration goes well, without a hitch.

quest.title: Tell-Tale Beat I
quest.cleanDescription: Drum. Tricky letters at indexes…

quest.title: Tell-Tale Beat II
quest.cleanDescription: …done correctly reveal password additions. Stop.

quest.title: Tell-Tale Beat III
quest.cleanDescription: Syllables each move pointer next step.

quest.title: Happy Halloween I
quest.cleanDescription: Ghorgen (no relation to Borgen) would like to wish you a Happy Halloween full of costumes, candy, chocolate, monsters, ghosts, spooky stuff and more!  All he asks of you is a single Ancient Coin.

quest.title: Happy Halloween
quest.cleanDescription: Don’t tell anyone, but Holger is actually dressed up as Lorn today. Unfortunately, Lorn is busy, but he still wanted to give out candy. Happy Halloween!

quest.title: Happy Halloween II
quest.cleanDescription: Mummy loves Halloween so much and hopes you have a great time trick-or-treating.  Here's some extra candy and treat bags you can have.  Just bring him 1 roll of TP.

quest.title: Happy Halloween III
quest.cleanDescription: From everybody in Redbrook, we hope you had a great time celebrating Halloween with us!  Hope these items are useful to you.

quest.title: Fine Fishing I
quest.cleanDescription: Thomas needs a hand. He’s supposed to catch some very elusive fish for a client, but he’s not having any luck finding these rare fish. Would you be willing to catch the fish and sell them to Thomas?

quest.title: Fine Fishing II
quest.cleanDescription: Thomas needs more golden fish. His client purred over the gold drums you caught. Will you check the forest pond for a different golden fish?

quest.title: Fine Fishing III
quest.cleanDescription: The client Thomas is working for loves the fish you’re catching, and by extension his client likes Thomas even more. Will you check Lake Tempest for a new golden fish?

quest.title: Fine Fishing IV
quest.cleanDescription: Will you check the small island for golden fish? Thomas thinks the more variety he provides the more likely his client will keep coming back for more.

quest.title: Fine Fishing V
quest.cleanDescription: Thomas tried fishing for golden fish in the Crystal River, but he didn’t catch anything. Will you try the river?

quest.title: Fine Fishing VI
quest.cleanDescription: Thomas’s client is very finicky and never satisfied. So, he needs a new golden fish. Will you try the Emerald Beach? Thomas would join you, but he’s currently trying to find a golden fish in the pond near Holger’s house.

quest.title: Fine Fishing VII
quest.cleanDescription: Thomas still hasn’t caught a single golden fish. Clearly he needs your help now, more than ever. Plus, his client’s appetite for golden fish is growing. His client won’t eat anything else now. Will you try your luck with the ocean?

quest.title: Fine Fishing VIII
quest.cleanDescription: Thomas isn’t sure if the legendary Lake Minerva actually exists, but if you know a way to fish there, Thomas would love to offer his client an exotic golden fish from Lake Minerva.

quest.title: Fine Fishing IX
quest.cleanDescription: Thomas has a new idea to make his client happy. What if he brings his client some golden coral! Then, his client will be constantly reminded of Thomas and the delicious fish he provides. Will you bring Thomas some gold coral?

quest.title: Be Mine I
quest.cleanDescription: Holger needs some help. Making valentines for all of his friends and family is going to take more time than he has remaining before the day of love. Will you help him make some cards?

quest.title: Be Mine II
quest.cleanDescription: Borgen was so busy this week that he completely forgot to make cards for the day of love. Will you make some cards for him to give out?

quest.title: Be Mine III
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie is trying to make valentines for as many people in town as she possibly can. She has made several thousand cards, so far. Now, she’s hoping she can enlist some of her friends to help make even more cards. Will you join Rosalie in making valentines?

quest.title: Be Mine IV
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie could still use some more help, if you’re interested.

quest.title: Be Mine V
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent is looking for a gift for someone special, but he won’t say who his special person is. Will you bring him some fancy items he could give to his special friend?

quest.title: Be Mine VI
quest.cleanDescription: Jill wants to make some treats for her friends on Valentine’s Day. Will you help her get some additional ingredients?

quest.title: Be Mine VII
quest.cleanDescription:
Thomas ordered an enormous shipment of heart-shaped necklaces. He was hoping to give them out for Valentine’s Day. Unfortunately, the boat carrying the shipment sank off the coast, near the small island.

A replacement shipment is already on its way, overland this time. Thomas hopes it will arrive quickly, but to be safe Thomas would like some cards to give out. Will you bring him some valentines?

quest.title: Be Mine VIII
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie needs another load of cards. Also, she would appreciate it if you could keep them coming. She is fairly certain she’ll need a few more loads.

quest.title: Be Mine IX
quest.cleanDescription:
The replacement shipment Thomas was expecting ran into some trouble. The wagon driver said that he accidentally ran the wagon a little too close to the edge of a cliff along Cane Pole Ridge. Thomas was told that the shipment tumbled and threw its contents all long the floor of the ridge.

Will you help Thomas recover some of his lost necklaces?

quest.title: Be Mine X
quest.cleanDescription: If you’ll bring Rosalie one more big load of cards, she thinks she’ll be able to handle the rest.

quest.title: Be Mine XI
quest.cleanDescription: Will you help Thomas recover some more necklaces? He has a prized possession that he was saving for his cat, but he will gladly give it to you, if you can help him.

quest.title: Find A Way I
quest.cleanDescription:
Captain Thomas has a new plan for finding a way back to his homeworld!

On his homeworld, there is a large island out in the open ocean. He has often gone there to catch fish. In your world, the same island doesn’t exist.

Last night, Captain Thomas was visiting Captain Logan, one of the charter boat captains. Captain Logan told him about your world’s Thomas finding a hidden island. Captain Logan also mentioned that Thomas gave you access to the island.

If you would be willing to take Captain Thomas to this strange island, he would gladly pay you for the time. He’ll also equip you to catch loads of fish while you’re there. Will you take Captain Thomas to the large island?

quest.title: Find A Way II
quest.cleanDescription:
Captain Thomas can’t believe this. After exploring and fishing for hours, he is certain that this island is exactly like the large island of his homeworld. He doesn’t understand why it doesn’t fully exist in your world, but he thinks it may hold a clue to help him to get back home.

Captain Thomas needs to stay on the island on a little longer. Will you help him find a way to stay, even when you leave?

quest.title: Find A Way III
quest.cleanDescription: Captain Thomas is going to stay on the island a little longer. He can’t leave until he finds something to help him. Will you help him set up a permanent place to stay?

quest.title: Find A Way IV
quest.cleanDescription: Captain Thomas almost has a decent shack built. Will you bring him some more building supplies?

quest.title: Find A Way V
quest.cleanDescription: Captain Thomas wants to stock his shack with food for his time on the island. Will you help him get a supply of food to last him several weeks? He'll catch his own fish, but he'll need a variety of other food items.

quest.title: Find A Way VI
quest.cleanDescription: Captain Thomas wants to do some exploring all over the island at night. Will you bring him a load of lanterns he can place all over the island?

quest.title: Find A Way VII
quest.cleanDescription: This request will sound very odd, but Captain Thomas needs two hourglasses and some sand from the mainland.

quest.title: Find A Way VIII
quest.cleanDescription:
Captain Thomas discovered something very strange.

One day he was digging through the sand as the sun was about to set. Right as the sun set, Captain Thomas dropped the sand that was in his hand. Instead of falling straight down, the sand remained in the air for several seconds. It was at least long enough for Captain Thomas to get down on his knees and pinch a grain of sand out of the air.

That's why Captain Thomas needed the hourglasses and the sand from the mainland. He wanted to experiment to see if it would happen again, and he wanted to see if it would happen to sand from the mainland.

The sand from the mainland behaved completely normally in all of Captain Thomas' experiments. The sand from the island behaved completely abnormally at sunset, even inside the hourglass.

Now, Captain Thomas wants to try making some glass from the island's sand. Will you help him get the resources for building and using a kiln and a bellows? He'll also need some additional materials to help him make the glass.

quest.title: Find A Way IX
quest.cleanDescription:
Captain Thomas successfully made glass. He also successfully tested the glass. It behaves just like the sand right after sunset.

Captain Thomas also made a new discovery. One day he was walking around the island with an orb of the glass that he made. He was looking to see if there were any reactions to the glass from other things on the island. Captain Thomas reached the eastern edge of the island a few minutes before the sun came up. As he was walking along the beach he reached down and pulled up a handful of sand. The excess sand falling from his hand stopped falling and remained in the air until the sun appeared. Then, the sand fell to the ground like normal.

Captain Thomas brought some of the western shore sand back to his shack and started experimenting. He discovered that this sand behaved very much like the sand near Thomas' shack, but only right before dawn. He also discovered that the two sands don't mix. They repel each other.

With this new knowledge, Captain Thomas went to explore the middle of the island. Just as he expected, Captain Thomas found that there is a line across the center of the island that is completely devoid of sand.

Captain Thomas would like to make some more glass using sand from both sides of the island. Will you help him get more resources for making glass?

quest.title: Find A Way X
quest.cleanDescription:
Captain Thomas didn't have much luck trying to combine the glass from the different sands together. It was like trying to combine oil and water, very hot water and very hot oil. Nevertheless, he did craft a neat hourglass filled with sand from both sides of the island. The hourglass doesn't keep time at all because the sands just stay suspended against the top and bottom, but it‘s fascinating to look at.

Now, Captain Thomas is out of ideas. The mystery of the island is fascinating, but Captain Thomas doesn't feel like he's making any progress toward getting home. He's going back to his fishing business for a while. He appreciates your help again and he's very sorry for wasting your time.

quest.title: Find A Way XI
quest.cleanDescription:
Captain Thomas would like for you to come fishing with him. He finds that catching fish and enjoying the quiet and peace of nature with a friend helps him clear his head.

Also, in appreciation for your friendship, Captain Thomas wants you to have the hourglass he made. Hopefully, it will be a memento for you to remember him by when he finally makes it home.

quest.title: Just A Pinch I
quest.cleanDescription: Ragvin is celebrating with his crew today. For their dinner feast, the crew requested that their captain make his famous Bounteous Bay Stew. Will you give him a hand landing all the ingredients?

quest.title: Just A Pinch II
quest.cleanDescription:
The stew turned out perfectly! Ragvin appreciates your hard work and assistance.

Now, he needs just a tiny bit of additional help. Will you bring a load of spoons for the celebration? Some of the lads and lasses on the crew invited a few friends to join the feast.

quest.title: Just A Pinch III
quest.cleanDescription: Ragvin needs more drinks for the feast! More folks showed up than expected. Would you lend a hand one more time?

quest.title: The Big Cleanup I
quest.cleanDescription:
As Lorn was walking through the woods near his home, he noticed that an area that usually floods during heavy rain was now dry and covered with trash. He suspects the trash all washed into that area from the stream that floods it.

That set Lorn to thinking. With all of the new folks moving into the area, there is likely a lot more trash being spread around. Before the population boom, it wasn’t hard to keep the woods and streams clean, but Lorn thinks it may take a little more mindful effort now.

Will you pitch in and help gather up some of the trash littered around the area?

quest.title: The Big Cleanup II
quest.cleanDescription:
Lorn appreciates your help with the cleanup.

Now, Lorn thinks it would probably be good to spend a little time clearing some trash from the waterways too. Will you help?

quest.title: A New Year I
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie is preparing for a large party to celebrate the new year. Will you help her gather some things she needs for the celebration?

quest.title: A New Year II
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie needs a few more things for her party. Will you bring her some more seaweed for the appetizers she’s making?

quest.title: A New Year III
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie wants to end the party with an enormous fireworks display. Will you help her get a load of  fireworks?

quest.title: A New Year IV
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie needs drinks for the toast to the new year. Will you help her?

quest.title: Tricks Not Treats I
quest.cleanDescription: Your friend, Buddy, is very concerned about your health. So, Buddy wants to help manage your diet, as best friends do, and protect you from the dangers of candy.

quest.title: Tricks Not Treats II
quest.cleanDescription: Friend Buddy is still very concerned about your candy intake, specifically your unhealthy obsession with lollipops. Buddy is here to protect your molars!

quest.title: Tricks Not Treats III
quest.cleanDescription: Your friend Buddy is very sad. Buddy suspects that you have indulged in the most dangerous candy of all. He’s ready to help you quit! Bring him your candy corn as quick as possible!

quest.title: Tricks Not Treats IV
quest.cleanDescription: Your dearest friend’s health is failing. In his efforts to protect you, Buddy has mortally wounded himself in the digester. If you’ll help him purge the evils within, he’ll show you something fantastic that he found.

quest.title: Fear or Treat I
quest.cleanDescription:
Thomas oath – only worm and rods
Invisible strings

quest.title: Fear or Treat II
