quest.cleanDescription: Searching academic amazed, fisher enviously decided

quest.title: Eggstremely Magical I
quest.cleanDescription:
Rosalie heard a strange tale from Vincent about magical eggs that the two of you found last year. Rosalie must have looked a bit skeptical during the description of the hunt, because Vincent immediately encouraged Rosalie to come to you to hear your side of the tale too.

Would you be willing to show Rosalie the eggs you found?

quest.title: Eggstremely Magical II
quest.cleanDescription:
If you don’t mind, Rosalie would like to attempt a magical investigation of the eggs. Star calls it ethereal delving, and he claims that it’s completely safe, but it is still poking and prodding at the magical matter and energy of a thing. You never know what may happen when you poke and prod things.

Nevertheless, if you are comfortable with it, and if you don’t mind bringing Rosalie a few things to help with the ethereal delving, maybe Rosalie will find more information about these strange eggs.

quest.title: Eggstremely Magical III
quest.cleanDescription:
These eggs are so strange! They are pushing to be aligned in a particular direction, but they are also pulling for balancing forces. Rosalie thinks that the magic feels a bit like a puzzle, as if, with more pieces, some greater whole might take shape.

Additionally, since Rosalie began the delving, the shape of a triangle was imprinted on her mind’s eye and refuses to clear. Actually, it’s three triangles joined at a central point. Rosalie isn’t certain what it means, but it’s intense and distracting.

Since the triangular pattern refuses to leave her brain, Rosalie has an idea that she would like to try. Are you willing to gather more of these strange eggs?

quest.title: Eggstremely Magical IV
quest.cleanDescription:
The image of the triangles is still filling Rosalie’s mind, but it’s different and shifted now.

She arranged all of the eggs into three neat triangles with each triangular group of twelve eggs evenly spaced from the other groups, and with each group pointed toward the golden egg in the middle. As soon as the shape was properly aligned, Rosalie could feel the magic of the eggs settle and shift. That’s when the image in her mind shifted too.

The best way that she can describe it now is three triangles like the eggs, but with a similar pattern repeating within the triangles. It reminds her so much of flowers. Yes! Like petals on a flower.

Rosalie has another idea if you are willing to continue helping. Will you bring her some flowers in primary colors?

quest.title: Eggstremely Magical V
quest.cleanDescription:
Rosalie arranged all the flowers in three triangles filling the empty spaces between the egg group triangles. As soon she finished, the image in Rosalie’s mind vanished and the magic settled in a new way, although it still feels like it is expectantly waiting.

Rosalie isn’t sure what to do next, but she would like to try something, a little spark of energy perhaps. Will you bring her six inferno spheres and one lava sphere?

quest.title: Eggstremely Magical VI
quest.cleanDescription:
Rosalie saw something…a flash and then a vision…she must tell Star…

But first, you deserve an explanation. Rosalie placed each of the inferno spheres at the edge of each triangular group. Then, she moved to the center of the hexagon and held the lava sphere just touching the tip of the golden egg. Nothing happened at first, but then she pulled energy from the inferno spheres into the lava sphere. It started as a trickle and then the energy slipped from her grasp and became a wild torrent. Before she could try to slow it again, a brilliant flash blinded her and she saw a vision. When she could see again, the flowers were gone. The eggs were also gone, except the golden egg, and a strange egg that replaced the lava sphere in her hand.

Rosalie isn’t sure what happened, and she’s very sorry for losing all your eggs and flowers. She…needs to see Star…

Again…she’s so sorry…

quest.title: Candy Mystery I
quest.cleanDescription: Beatrix needs more candy. She bought loads of it, but somehow it has dwindled down over the past couple of weeks. She suspects Holger’s friendly visits may be to blame for the vanishing treats.

quest.title: Candy Mystery II
quest.cleanDescription:
Holger claims he didn’t steal Beatrix’s candy. Beatrix isn’t sure she believes him, but Holger is generally pretty honest. The only other person that Beatrix suspects is Lorn, but he doesn’t really seem like the candy-stealing type.

While Beatrix investigates, will you get her some more lollipops?

quest.title: Candy Mystery III
quest.cleanDescription:
Beatrix is still investigating Lorn. She found several white lollipop sticks while going through his garbage.

In the meantime, Beatrix needs more taffy. Will you bring her as much as you can find?

quest.title: Candy Mystery IV
quest.cleanDescription:
Beatrix confronted Lorn after overhearing him complaining to Doctor Feroc about tooth pain and stomach aches. Lorn owned his treachery instantly.

Lorn said that it all started so innocently. He was just grabbing a piece or two of candy as he left Beatrix’s house each day after tea. Somewhere along the way it escalated to handfuls on his way out the door. Lorn thinks he might have a problem.

If you’ll replenish the candy corn that Lorn purloined, Beatrix would like to compensate you for all your troubles. Lorn would also like to make it up to both of you.

quest.title: Low On Coal I
quest.cleanDescription: Santa needs some coal. His workshop is completely out of it, and, unfortunately, there are a few people that will be receiving coal in their stockings instead of presents this year. Will you help Santa gather wood to make some coal?

quest.title: Low On Coal II
quest.cleanDescription: Santa thinks that making coal from wood is making a depressing task even more loathsome. Will you bring him some coal instead?

quest.title: Low On Coal III
quest.cleanDescription: :( Santa needs more coal. :(

quest.title: Low On Coal IV
quest.cleanDescription: Santa expects this to be the last batch, at least he hopes it will be. He doesn’t want to need anymore coal.

quest.title: Breaking The Ice Even Icier I
quest.cleanTitle: Breaking The Ice Even Icier I
quest.cleanDescription: Many of Captain Logan’s regular net suppliers are still nervous about traveling up to Glacier Lake, even though he assured them that it’s perfectly safe now. Will you help Captain Logan supply his crew with nets?

quest.title: Breaking The Ice Even Icier II
quest.cleanTitle: Breaking The Ice Even Icier II
quest.cleanDescription: The fish of Glacier Lake are a tough lot, and Captain Logan is still struggling to get a reliable supplier of nets and bait. Will you help him out again with supplying his crew?

quest.title: Breaking The Ice Even Icier III
quest.cleanTitle: Breaking The Ice Even Icier III
quest.cleanDescription: Captain Logan has found a permanent net and bait supplier, but they are just starting production. Will you bring Captain Logan’s crew a huge load of supplies to hold them over while the new supplier gets moving?

quest.title: Breaking The Ice Even Icier IV
quest.cleanTitle: Breaking The Ice Even Icier IV
quest.cleanDescription: Captain Logan would love to get his hands on a huge load of Gold Sea Crests. If you’re interested, he’s willing to pay handsomely for them.

quest.title: Islands Are Hard To Catch I
quest.cleanTitle: Islands Are Hard To Catch I
quest.cleanDescription:
Thomas wants to ride with a fishing charter out to the vast ocean. He’s searching for a hidden island. Unfortunately, he doesn’t have any gold to pay for the charter. So, he made a deal with Captain Logan. Thomas is supposed to provide a variety of fish to make up for the lost fishing opportunities the captain will experience while hauling Thomas around, and a little extra.

Will you help Thomas catch the fish he needs? He can’t pay much, but he promises to also share anything exciting he finds on the hidden island.

quest.title: Islands Are Hard To Catch II
quest.cleanTitle: Islands Are Hard To Catch II
quest.cleanDescription:
Thomas needs your help again. During his ride with the charter to search for the hidden island, Thomas had a small accident. Although he could see the hidden island through the mask he found, he couldn’t step onto it. The boat passed right through the island too, as if it wasn’t really there.
In his frustration, Thomas quickly built a tower out of the barrels on the boat and climbed on top of it. He was trying to get a better view of the hidden island through his mask. Unfortunately, he stepped a little too close to the edge of his tower while he was trying to touch a palm tree. The tower leaned with the shift in weight and then tipped over, and Thomas and the barrels fell into the water. A few of the barrels smashed open and the bait went everywhere.
Thomas needs to replace a few barrels of bait. Will you help him gather the bait? He can’t pay much, but he promises that he will figure out how to get to that island, and he will also share everything fantastic he finds with you.

quest.title: Islands Are Hard To Catch III
quest.cleanTitle: Islands Are Hard To Catch III
quest.cleanDescription: Thomas isn’t giving up on getting to that island. He showed the mask to Lorn and explained what happened on his boat trip. Lorn was intrigued and offered to help Thomas find a way onto the island, but Lorn told Thomas that he’s missing a book that could speed up his research. Will you help Thomas find a copy of the Book of Ancients for Lorn to borrow?

quest.title: Islands Are Hard To Catch IV
quest.cleanTitle: Islands Are Hard To Catch IV
quest.cleanDescription: Lorn is still researching the island and the mask, but he told Thomas that getting onto the island may require diligent and repeated experimentation. To that end, Lorn encouraged Thomas to build a boat to eliminate the expense of hiring a vessel for the experiments. Thomas has no clue where to start. Will you help him build a small boat? He can’t pay much, but Thomas promises that you will get to join him on the island, as soon as Lorn figures out how to get there.

quest.title: Islands Are Hard To Catch V
quest.cleanTitle: Islands Are Hard To Catch V
quest.cleanDescription: Thomas wants to try diving at the site where the island appears. He thinks there may be some clues about the island underwater. Will you help him with the dive?

quest.title: Islands Are Hard To Catch VI
quest.cleanTitle: Islands Are Hard To Catch VI
quest.cleanDescription:
Thomas found nothing useful during his dive. While he was underwater, he could still see the island through the mask, but without the mask, there was only ocean.
Thomas is tired of waiting and he’s out of ideas. So, he went to get answers from Lorn today, but Lorn wasn’t home. While Thomas was trying to find Lorn, he accidentally stumbled in through the window to Lorn’s lab. As he was trying to get back outside, Thomas saw the plans for something called a gravitational array on Lorn’s desk. Thomas thinks it must be what Lorn was working on to get to the island.
Will you help Thomas gather the resources to build a gravitational array? As usual, Thomas can’t pay much, but he promises that you will get a share of all the treasures he finds.

quest.title: Islands Are Hard To Catch VII
quest.cleanTitle: Islands Are Hard To Catch VII
quest.cleanDescription:
Thomas accidentally lost the gravitational array. He paddled out to the site of the hidden island and tried to use it with the mask. The gravitational array started glowing when Thomas got close to the island. So, he held it out to make contact with the shore. At that same moment, a fish jumped out of the water right near his face. In surprise, Thomas dropped the array. It sank very quickly. Worst of all, the island was not fazed by the sinking gravitational array.
Thomas wants you to come up with an idea to try. He's open to almost anything at this point.

quest.title: Islands Are Hard To Catch VIII
quest.cleanTitle: Islands Are Hard To Catch VIII
quest.cleanDescription: Lorn has the answer. If you'll help Thomas gather a variety of feathers, Lorn thinks the mask can be fixed.

quest.title: Islands Are Hard To Catch IX
quest.cleanTitle: Islands Are Hard To Catch IX
quest.cleanDescription:
Lorn used a few of the feathers you found to repair the broken feathers on the mask, but the rest are meant for Star Meerif. Lorn invited Star to come help repair the mask, and Lorn always likes to give Star a gift of feathers.
Now, Star needs a few more items to complete the repair spell on the mask. Lorn would like you to help Thomas find everything Star needs.

quest.title: Islands Are Hard To Catch X
quest.cleanTitle: Islands Are Hard To Catch X
quest.cleanDescription:
The mask is repaired!
Star vanished in mid-sentence after the spell was complete. Thomas heard something about "praying mantis DNA", but he didn't understand what Star was talking about.
Now, Thomas would like you to help him get everything he needs for exploring and fishing from the island. He can't pay you much, but he promises that you are welcome to keep anything you find when you come with him to the island.

quest.title: Islands Are Hard To Catch XI
quest.cleanTitle: Islands Are Hard To Catch XI
quest.cleanDescription:
Thomas didn't find anything exciting on the island, but he caught an enormous swordfish from its shores! He says that's even better than a shark. If you'll help Thomas immortalize his catch, he would like to give you his mask. He's sorry that you didn't find or catch anything, but maybe the mask will give you the luck needed to be great at fishing like Thomas.
Before you take the mask, Thomas wants you to be aware that sometimes the mask gets really cold to the touch. It hasn’t happened since Star fixed it, but Thomas didn’t want it to surprise you like it did him.

quest.title: Sandwich Quest I
quest.cleanDescription:
At this time of year, Holger’s favorite thing is a delicious sandwich. If you’ll help him get everything he needs to make the perfect sandwich, or sandwiches, he will reward you generously.

Holger wants to start with the bread so you can gather the other ingredients while it’s fermenting and baking. Then, he can assemble everything as quickly and efficiently as possible.

quest.title: Sandwich Quest II
quest.cleanDescription: The next thing that Holger needs for his sandwiches is a variety of pickled ingredients. If you’ll bring the ingredients, he should be able to do the pickling.

quest.title: Sandwich Quest III
quest.cleanDescription: This is coming along deliciously. Now, Holger is ready for the sandwich contents!

quest.title: Sandwich Quest IV
quest.cleanDescription: The last things that Holger needs are a few ingredients to make his special sandwich sauce. If you’ll help him gather the ingredients, he can finish these glorious sandwiches today. Yum!

quest.title: Sandwich Quest V
quest.cleanDescription: Holger is so thankful for your support in his sandwich building. The sandwiches turned out perfectly. He actually meant to save one for you, but he got a little carried away. Hopefully you won’t mind a different gift as a show of his gratitude.

quest.title: Let’s Do The Time Warp I
quest.cleanTitle: Let’s Do The Time Warp I
quest.cleanDescription:
Something is not right. Something has changed. Star has discovered an aberration in the flow of time. The events of exactly one year ago are leaking into the present. Ghosts of the past are interacting with us here and now. Visions of what was are mingling with the moments before our eyes. They seem harmless, so far, but some things have changed.

Will you help Star get to the bottom of this chronological conundrum before anything truly devastating happens to the present or our future? If you’ll bring him a cogwheel, he should be able to get pointed to the cause of this temporal overflow.

quest.title: Let’s Do The Time Warp II
quest.cleanTitle: Let’s Do The Time Warp II
quest.cleanDescription:
Star has a memory hiding somewhere in his mind that is key to explaining what is happening, at least that’s what his Detector Of Overflowing Time indicates. Unfortunately, the DOOT didn’t show him what memory it was.

Will you bring him some carrots so he can conjur an ocular replay spell?

quest.title: Let’s Do The Time Warp III
quest.cleanTitle: Let’s Do The Time Warp III
quest.cleanDescription: The ocular replay spell is working, but there are a lot of memories to sift through. Will you bring Star some dice so he can focus the spell to a specific date?

quest.title: Let’s Do The Time Warp IV
quest.cleanTitle: Let’s Do The Time Warp IV
quest.cleanDescription: Star found it! He suspects you may not remember this, but you were there! Star was searching for a strange blip in aethereal energy, but he got distracted by a certain lovely young lady and the fashion accessory of choice for witches. In his distraction, Star left his Detector Of Aethereal Blips And Inconsequential Runestones running. The DOABAIR must’ve shorted out and created a tiny temporal leak, only visible in the ultraultraviolet spectrum. If you’ll bring Star some feathers, he should be able to patch it right up.

quest.title: Let’s Do The Time Warp V
quest.cleanTitle: Let’s Do The Time Warp V
quest.cleanDescription: Star discovered a significant change that shifted in our time due to the time leak. The lock for the door of the Haunted House was changed…by someone…or perhaps, some thing. Star is quite certain this change wasn’t his doing, but while he was investigating the new lock, he found that he already had a key that unlocked the door. His investigation of the Haunted House’s interior revealed no changes of major significance, even at a subatomic level. Nevertheless, Star is unsettled by the change to the lock. For now, will you keep the new key to the Haunted House? Ensure it is kept safe and secret until Star calls for it.

quest.title: The Light Continues I
quest.cleanDescription:
As the old year passes and a new year begins, Mariya looks forward to enjoying the tradition of passing the light. This tradition originated with Mithar sharing the light of power with the guardians at the dawn of creation. To celebrate, a burning candle lit in the old year is used to light a new candle at the rising of the sun on the first day of the new year. In this way, the light of the old year is brought into the new year to help all see more clearly.

Mariya wants to make some very special candles for passing the light this year. She wants to bring in the holiday traditions of Redbrook and make them a part of the candles. Will you help her gather some traditional Redbrook holiday items to use in making her candles?

quest.title: The Light Continues II
quest.cleanDescription: Mariya’s candles turned out perfectly. If you’re interested in celebrating passing the light with Mariya, she would love to share some of her candles with you.

quest.title: Intruders Beware I
quest.cleanDescription:
Holger usually doesn’t take anything when he sneaks into Borgen’s wagon. He also doesn’t usually break anything in Borgen’s collections. That’s why Holger is fairly certain that the model ship he stepped on, in Borgen’s wagon, was broken before he got there. Additionally, the crunch he heard when he stepped on the model sounded like something already broken, and not like a fresh break. It was more grind and snap than crunch and pop.

When Holger looked down to see the wreckage of the model ship, it was clear that the model was broken before he stepped on it. It was also clear that there was something stuffed inside the hull. Going against his normal tendency, Holger took the contents of the ship. Holger suspects that Borgen didn’t even know the map was jammed inside the model. So Borgen won’t miss it, but he will likely be very sore about the broken ship.

Will you help Holger put together a gift to make Borgen feel better about his broken model ship? Holger would like a gift for Borgen that will remind him of the sea, but maybe not boats.

quest.title: Intruders Beware II
quest.cleanDescription:
Holger can’t figure out the map that he found in Borgen’s broken model ship. The writing on the map is in a language that Holger doesn’t recognize, but he thinks the map shows a maze of underground tunnels and how to navigate them. However, the entrances to the tunnels, at either end of the maze, are a mystery. Each entrance is drawn as a series of broken squiggles.

Holger has no idea what the squiggles could mean, but he isn’t ready to give up on this mystery. He thinks some food might help him think more clearly. Will you bring him some fish to fry and eat?

quest.title: Intruders Beware III
quest.cleanDescription:
Lorn found a load of wreckage washed up on the beach this morning. He thinks that the storm yesterday may have been unkind to some poor sailor, but Lorn hopes that it was an old wreck stirred up and not a new disaster. Many of the items in the wreckage look quite old. Perhaps Lorn’s hopes are not unfounded.

Lorn is gathering up the interesting and useful items among the wreckage to make them available at the Exchange Center. He has his wagon to carry everything, but he could use help loading and securing the items. Will you help Lorn? He’ll give you a couple of the more interesting and useful items as compensation.

quest.title: Intruders Beware IV
quest.cleanDescription:
Holger hasn’t made any further progress on deciphering the map. He suspects that the entrance squiggles require a legend, or key of some sort, that isn’t on the map.

Since no solutions were presenting themselves, Holger hiked all over the area looking for anything that might be a clue. He was hoping that he would see something that might shake an idea loose in his brain and help him decipher those squiggles. Eventually, he ended up at the Exchange Center and started talking to Lorn about the map.

As Holger was drawing out some of the squiggles, Lorn had an epiphany. Lorn saw a coin once with very similar markings to one of the groups of squiggles. At first, Lorn thought he had one of the coins in the exchange center storeroom, but after searching for several minutes he couldn’t find a coin that matched what he remembered.

Since Lorn couldn’t find the coin, he tried to do a simple drawing of it. Holger has a general idea of what he’s looking for now. If you happen to come across a coin with a skull on it, will you bring it to Holger?

quest.title: Intruders Beware V
quest.cleanDescription:
The coin fit with the squiggles on the map perfectly. There’s even some sort of resistance when Holger removes the coin from its spot on the map. It’s strange, but the coin and the map definitely belong together.

The image created by the map’s squiggles and the coin suggests a cove with a skull-shaped cave as the northern entrance to the maze. Holger’s never seen a place like that, but he remembers a bit of a story from Vincent. Vincent was trying to find a specific runestone to help him find a place called Pirate’s Cove. Maybe that’s the place on this map. Holger thinks it may be worth asking Vincent about.

While Holger talks to Vincent, will you find a runestone like the one Vincent wanted for finding Pirate’s Cove?

quest.title: Intruders Beware VI
quest.cleanDescription:
Vincent wasn’t sure if Pirate’s Cove has a skull-shaped cave. He didn’t get a good look when he was there. Actually, Vincent didn’t want to talk about his time at Pirate’s Cove, but he did tell Holger that he was trying to use the runestone to find Pirate’s Cove.

Speaking of the runestone, Holger has great news! After he returned from talking to Vincent, he noticed that the backside of the runestone, that you found, was similar to the squiggles on the southern entrance on the map. So, he put the runestone face down on the map and lined it up with the squiggles. It fit perfectly! It also had a reaction like the coin, where it resists being removed from the map. Strangely, that resistance doesn’t happen with the runestone face up.

It took Holger a little while to recognize the image created by the runestone and the map, but he’s pretty sure that it’s the small cave not far from Lake Tempest.

Now, Holger wants to go explore the small cave and see if the map is correct. Will you help him prepare for exploring the cave?

quest.title: Intruders Beware VII
quest.cleanDescription:
Holger found Buddy wandering around while he was exploring the small cave, and Buddy decided to join in the search for the tunnels. Oddly, Buddy knew a lot about the map and the tunnels. Buddy also mentioned that he knew Holger’s father a long time ago. Eventually, Buddy stopped and said that it was unsafe to go further. Holger would have continued, but Buddy seemed adamant.

While Holger was consulting the map to figure out a different path, Buddy warned Holger about pursuing any other options. Buddy explained that all of the tunnel entrances are lined with traps, very deadly ones. He also said that he had a tool to disable the traps, but that the pirate magic powering the traps has weakened over the years. Without stabilizing the pirate magic, the shutoff mechanism wouldn’t work.

Buddy suggested that Holger find a load of pirate artifacts and bring them to the cave. The artifacts will still have a little pirate magic in them that can be accumulated together and shared with the trap mechanisms. Then, Buddy can turn off the traps and let Holger through the tunnels.

Will you help Holger gather up old pirate artifacts?

quest.title: Intruders Beware VIII
quest.cleanDescription:
Buddy double-crossed Holger. They got the pirate magic shared from the old artifacts to the trap mechanisms. Suddenly, the entire cave felt electric and Holger could hear gears turning and ropes pulling. It was like all of the traps were being reset. Then, out of nowhere Buddy laughed and vanished.

Holger considered trying his luck with the tunnels without Buddy. He even walked to the point where Buddy stopped during their first exploration of the cave. Then, Holger tossed one of his lanterns several meters into a tunnel. It landed on the tunnel floor and a giant boulder immediately fell from the ceiling. The boulder fell exactly where the lantern fell. At that, Holger decided to come home and have a nice meal.

Will you find Buddy and see if you can get him to turn the traps off in the cave? Maybe you could take Buddy a gift as reminder of your friendship.

quest.title: Intruders Beware IX
quest.cleanDescription:
Buddy doesn’t think that Holger is ready for the treasures and truths that await him at the end of the tunnels. Pirate’s Cove has many secrets that Holger is too immature to understand. However, since you are one of Buddy’s best friends, Buddy will give you the key to disabling the tunnel traps, if you help Holger do one, very important good deed.

Buddy will trade you a powerful stone for a beautiful diamond as proof of your covenant.

quest.title: Intruders Beware X
quest.cleanDescription: Holger isn’t sure what to think about this plan, or about Buddy’s judgment. Nevertheless, he has a perfect idea of what to do for the good deed. All he needs is a replacement model ship.

quest.title: Intruders Beware XI
quest.cleanDescription:
Buddy is satisfied with Holger’s good deed. He thinks Holger and Borgen would make their father pretty proud if he was still around. Buddy wonders if it would be fun to tell Holger and Borgen that he is their father. That may be better left for a trek through the stars, or an intergalactic imperial incursion.

Buddy is glad to give you the key for shutting off the tunnel traps. However, he intends to keep protecting visitors that are exploring the small cave from running into the tunnels. He’ll stop everyone he finds in the cave and try to help them avoid unsafe areas.

Remember, to use the key, stick it in the skull mark on the floor between the tunnel entrance and the cave, and then turn it clockwise. Buddy loves the sound it makes when the traps disengage. He hopes you enjoy it too.

quest.title: A Captain’s Voyage I
quest.cleanDescription:
Captain Thomas is from a town that looks exactly like this one. Since he’s been on this world, Captain Thomas has tried to discover the differences between his town and this one. He found a few cultural differences, but not much else.

Captain Thomas knew you on his homeworld. You were very resourceful over there. Are you the same here?

Will you help Captain Thomas look for other differences between the 2 worlds? He would like to start with examining crops. He needs a pretty good sample size to compare.

quest.title: A Captain’s Voyage II
quest.cleanDescription:
Captain Thomas found no differences between the crops of this world and the crops he remembers from his world.

He has a new idea. Captain Thomas would like to investigate items by color. He thinks that would be an easy characteristic to contrast with his memories of his homeworld.

Will you bring him a variety of yellow items?

quest.title: A Captain’s Voyage III
quest.cleanDescription:
Once again, Captain Thomas could not discover any differences.

Captain Thomas would like to try blue things now.

quest.title: A Captain’s Voyage IV
quest.cleanDescription:
Still, Captain Thomas found no differences in the things of this new world.

He doesn’t expect to find anything, but will you bring him green items?

quest.title: A Captain’s Voyage V
quest.cleanDescription:
Captain Thomas expected there to be differences in this world, but he still can’t find anything.

There is nothing Captain Thomas knows better than fish. As a final attempt to find things different from his homeworld, will you bring Captain Thomas an assortment of fish to examine?

quest.title: A Captain’s Voyage VI
quest.cleanDescription:
From all that Captain Thomas has observed, he has only found 3 differences between the two worlds. The first is the cultural differences. The second, and most obvious is his different self on this world. Thomas on this world is very different.

Captain Thomas would like to examine one more thing before he tells you about the only other difference he found. Will you find a corn runestone for him?

quest.title: A Captain’s Voyage VII
quest.cleanDescription:
Captain Thomas found no differences in the corn runestone. He is also now sure you are the same as your self on his homeworld. You are someone that he can trust.

Captain Thomas isn’t sure what caused him to be transported to this world, but before he stepped foot on your world he saw one of your townsfolk being pulled to the world Captain Thomas just left. The man was pulling on a trident laying on the ground while the gate to Captain Thomas’s world was pulling on the man.

Captain Thomas called to the man and asked if he needed help. The stranger noticed Captain Thomas standing in the gateway and said simply that he didn’t want to leave his trident behind, but the gateway wouldn’t let him take it to the new world.

Captain Thomas waited with the man. While they waited, Captain Thomas introduced himself. The stranger called himself Poseidon and said it was a pleasure to meet Captain Thomas. Then, Poseidon fell quiet again, seemingly deep in thought.

Eventually Poseidon spoke. He told Captain Thomas about some of his greatest adventures. Poseidon traveled to many worlds, but this was to be his last voyage for some time. Then, Poseidon talked about all the friends and family he made on his travels. He said he would continue to watch out for them, but they would wonder where he went. Finally, he asked Captain Thomas to find a new owner for his trident.

Captain Thomas agreed to find a worthy owner for the trident. Then, Captain Thomas attempted to shake Poseidon’s hand. The gateway prevented the contact.

Poseidon thanked Captain Thomas and then released the trident. The gateway and Poseidon vanished. Captain Thomas was left there alone with the trident.

Will you accept the responsibility of this mighty weapon? Will you also bring Captain Thomas a few things to create a memorial for Poseidon on the spot where the trident was left?

quest.title: A Tower Divided
quest.cleanDescription:
*poof*
Star appears again before you quite suddenly, a shower of feathers coming down around him and you.
“Why, good day! Have you noticed anything odd lately? Has Rosalie been snoring again? You see, my tower has been having some issues lately…” He points in the distance and you’re surprised to see a giant tower where there was nothing yesterday!
Upon closer inspection, it looks like the tower has been split in half!
“You see my good fellow, I was enjoying a good rumination on the theory of orchid blooming patterns in non-standard aethereal weather patterns when Geist so rudely slammed into my tower, which for some reason is entirely visible again! Confound it all, I want some tea in peace! I need some help with repairs, and I know you’d be happy to help!”
Star hands you a list of items he needs and disappears without a trace.

quest.title: A Tower Divided II
quest.cleanDescription:
As you gather the last item, Star appears before you in a shower of feathers yet again. He really loves that spell.
“Oh! Excellent, you’ve gotten the base materials! I knew you were the right person for the job. Now, I need to make a new staff, you know, for bigger magic. Big magic requires a lot of gems, could you fetch me some materials so I can make something worthy of my station? I don't want any Lemon Quartz though.”
Star hands you a second list, and all the previous materials (and Star) disappear without a trace. Except a lot of feathers and one wizard hat.

quest.title: A Tower Divided III
quest.cleanDescription:
*poof*
As you put the last piece of Magicite down, Star again appears as if he has been watching you the whole time. Very strange, and he really does love that spell. Feathers, feathers everywhere.
“I’m out of feathers, would you mind collecting some more for me while I get to work on this staff? I can’t teleport anymore!” Star begins to walk, stops, looks at you and laughs, then teleports away in a shower of feathers.
“Just kidding! But seriously, running low on feather juice!” Star’s voice floats in the air in a very odd and melodic way.
Well, you’ve done this much, hopefully the reward is worth it, time to get some feathers.

quest.title: Secretly A Society Summons You I
quest.cleanTitle: Secretly A Society Summons You I
quest.cleanDescription:
You awake to the sound of a terrible rumble coming from town. It gently rattles the glass on your nightstand. Outside your bedroom window, the night sky suddenly becomes bright orange and then dims back to normal pale moonlight.

You slowly get out of bed and reluctantly make your way to the window. A large and very black column of smoke is rising slowly from somewhere in Redbrook. You consider going back to bed, but eventually curiosity gets the better of you. After quickly dressing, you make your way to town.

Near the northern edge of town, a hundred meters behind a few small houses, you find the town fire squad working hard to extinguish a bright and narrow, but furious blaze. You’re surprised at how little damage there is given how loud and bright the explosion was from your farm. It appears there was a small structure here that is nearly obliterated, and a black ring extends out in all directions, around 10 meters from the center of the fire.

As you look around, you see a shadowy figure concealed behind a tree to the north of the blaze. The shadowy person appears to be robed, but has a very familiar, clumpy shape to their silhouette. As you continue to look at the shadow, it extends a hand and beckons to you.

Before you can decide whether to go to the summoning shadow, a member of the fire squad calls out to you that the fire isn’t going out and that they think they’re going to need something stronger. Will you find something stronger than water to help extinguish the fire?

quest.title: Secretly A Society Summons You II
quest.cleanTitle: Secretly A Society Summons You II
quest.cleanDescription:
The town fire squad quickly puts the items you've brought back to good use. Relief crosses their faces one by one as the raging inferno is pushed back and eventually contained to a small area. As the bright orange blaze diminishes, you find yourself remembering a small and insignificant structure in this area, it was never unkempt, but never looked occupied either. Closing your eyes, you remember seeing a symbol on the door handle, but always thought it was just the mark of a tradesman.

After of moment of reverie, you turn your attention back to the north of the fire to see the same clumpy robed figure. You can see two eyes, and they again extend their hand and beckon you to join them.

Deciding to figure out who and what this person could want, you begin to head north when one of the fire squad cries out, "WATCH OUT, A SECONDARY EXPLOSION!"

The entire fire squad dive on the ground and frozen by indecision, you stand as you feel the ground begin to rumble. The figure by the tree moves quicker than you expect, and you're knocked to the ground by none other than Buddy just as a sound and force, similar to what woke you up, wash over you.

Ears ringing, you look over to see Buddy laying on the ground, seemingly unharmed as the fire squad are now fighting a reignited blaze and while you can't hear what they're saying, they seem to be motioning towards you for more materials like what you've provided previously, and you can't help but feel grateful towards Buddy and quickly go to gather more materials to help them out.

quest.title: Secretly A Society Summons You III
quest.cleanTitle: Secretly A Society Summons You III
quest.cleanDescription:
With the additional materials you provided, and a little more time, the fire squad is able to finally contain the reignited fire. Eventually all that remains is a smolder of coals and debris. To your relief, and that of everyone working to put out the blaze, no more large explosions erupt, although several seemingly small ones crackle and pop underground.

While the fire squad is still finishing up their efforts to put out small grass fires that popped up, Buddy grabs your shoulder and points you to the tree he was hiding behind earlier. You understand he wants you to join him away from the excitement, and the two of you quickly and quietly jog to the backside of the tree.

Buddy squats down and you follow his example. Closer now to his massive visage, you notice that there are symbols painted on his face, although they’re hard to fully make out in the pale moonlight. One of the symbols reminds you of the symbol on the door handle you remembered earlier. Before you can ask about it, Buddy whispers.

“Sorry about the ruckus tonight. That wasn’t supposed to happen. I’m glad no one was hurt. I know you have oh so many questions, but I think you should go home and get some rest and meet me back here in the morning. We have a lot of work to do.”

You do, in fact have a lot of questions, but you decide to hold your peace until the morning.

As you stand up to leave, Buddy whispers a request. He wants you to bring a bundle of inferno spheres tomorrow to help eliminate any unexploded devices still remaining in the meeting room.

Now you really do have so many questions, but exhaustion finally saturates your brain and you decide sleep is your only real concern. You wish Buddy a good night, as well as the fire squad heroes as you pass them on your way home.

quest.title: Secretly A Society Summons You IV
quest.cleanTitle: Secretly A Society Summons You IV
quest.cleanDescription:
Sunlight streams through your window, cascading off of the various trinkets in your bedroom in a dazzling display of color. You quickly regret not closing your blinds last night until a thought bolts you upright - you overslept!

Your farm has plenty of morning chores to catch up on, and in the back of your mind, the request from Buddy about explosives, and the strange symbols keep you from focusing fully on the tasks at hand. Your animals seem to take offense to your half-hearted attention as you think about what Buddy could possibly have been doing with such destructive power - and why he had it in the first place.

Chores completed, you realize Buddy never gave you instructions on where to meet him, so you make the assumption to head to the site of the explosion last night and hope to find him there. The area has been largely cordoned off. A few fire squad members wave to you half in exhaustion as you walk by. The area has been decimated and it's a miracle no one was hurt. There is smoke rising from the center of the explosion still, and ash has settled upon the area, a few pieces of misshapen paper and other material strewn about. You think you see a piece of paper with a caricature of a certain friend, but you can't be sure.

As you approach, you notice the tree that Buddy spoke to you behind on the previous night is completely gone. It must have burned up in one of the secondary fires, you think to yourself. You look around a little more and notice another 50 meters further there is another innocuous building and a shadow that beckons you closer. Time for some answers!

"Well, thanks for the spheres matey, but after a quick consultation this morning, I've realized I'm going to need to build some containment units in case we need a more...controlled explosion."

You consider the implication of those words and decide to double the requested materials Buddy needs.

quest.title: Secretly A Society Summons You V
quest.cleanTitle: Secretly A Society Summons You V
quest.cleanDescription:
When you return with the additional supplies, Buddy is waiting for you by the small building where he met you earlier. He invites you to follow him around to the entrance of the building and to bring the items you gathered. At the door, he pauses and explains his plan. He begins with little background, as though you already know what’s about to happen.

“We’ll use this service entrance to access the main corridor. Once we reach the common area, I’ll pick up any unexploded devices and bring them to you. You’ll be waiting with the containment apparatus opened. Then, I’ll put the explosive in the container. You’ll move to the safety of the corridor, and I’ll place the inferno sphere in with the explosive and seal the container. I will then quickly move to the corridor with you.”

“When the timer goes off, I’ll check to make sure the explosive was successfully transferred to the lava pools of the Ember Lagoon. If everything goes well, we should have the common area cleared of unexploded devices within an hour.”

Without waiting for your response to this dangerous plan, Buddy opens the door and leads you into a small empty room lit by two glowing lanterns. At the far end of the room another door stands open and a series of steps lead downward. Buddy continues on to the stairs and begins to descend toward the corridor he mentioned. The stairs are well lit by a series of lanterns, but when you reach the bottom of the stairs and the entrance to the corridor, it is black and void. Buddy pauses at the corridor’s entrance and then turns back to you.

“This is too dangerous to do in the dark. We really need a lot of lights. Will you get us some lanterns and candles and bring them down here? I’ll take a lantern from the stairs and scout out the situation ahead.”

quest.title: Secretly A Society Summons You VI
quest.cleanTitle: Secretly A Society Summons You VI
quest.cleanDescription:
You return with the lanterns, and Buddy has quickly and efficiently setup a containment area in the common room. As you bring more lighting in the room, the damage to the room seems to be immense. You're surprised the entire room hasn't collapsed where the explosion created a gaping hole that is covered in dirt and stone.

The room is lavishly decorated, more reminiscent of something out of a novel than anything you expected. Extremely fancy chairs, tables, and chests are arrayed across the common room, the walls are draped in fine purple silks and murals and paintings of various people you don't recognize, except one - a picture of Buddy is displayed prominently near the edge of the room, close to the cave in.

Before you can ask more questions, Buddy quickly begins shuffling small conical devices towards the container and wordlessly motions you towards the corridor as he sees you surveying the room.

The process takes an hour, but Buddy for all his bluster, seems very adept at this process. Each device goes in the box, followed by a sphere, and a small popping sound follows as the timer hits zero. A little smoke wafts out of the box, and he moves onto the next. The process is impressively efficient.

Buddy finally takes a seat on a chair after the process is over, sweat on his brow. It looks like he could use some refreshments. As you mention it Buddy gives you a big smile, "Yeah, the crew will need a lot to dig this mess back out, bring some extra!"

The crew?

quest.title: Secretly A Society Summons You VII
quest.cleanTitle: Secretly A Society Summons You VII
quest.cleanDescription:
As quickly as you can, you return with refreshments for a “crew” and the tools necessary to start cleaning up the damaged common area. Your curiosity fuels your speedy return.

What is this place? Is Buddy a secret king or the leader of some revolutionary movement? Why were there so many unexploded explosives? What happened to set some of the explosives off last night?

Buddy greets you at the entrance to the common area and interrupts your train of thought to thank you for all the help, and, as if he heard your pondered questions aloud, promises to explain everything very soon. For now, he asks you if you are ready to meet the crew. With your assent, Buddy whisks you into the common area and a waiting crowd.

Before Buddy begins to introduce you to the crew, he steps on top of a wooden crate on the floor. “Friends! This is my very dear friend, {player}!” Buddy pauses for the crowd to all voice a greeting, and then continues. “{player} helped extinguish the fire from last night’s special activity preparations, and then helped me dispose of the other explosives this morning. Now, my dear friend brought us refreshments and tools to begin the great work that lies ahead of us. Please extend your gratitude and a hand of friendship to my friend and a friend to our...organization.”

Barely a breath after finishing his address, Buddy hops off the crate and shepherds you to the waiting crowd. As he introduces you to each member, including many you already know, Buddy distributes the refreshments you brought. Even though the crowd is fairly large, around a hundred people at least, Buddy moves you through the entire group in a matter of minutes. Then, Buddy sits down on the burnt and scarred floor for a quick bite himself. He motions for you to join him as he begins eating.

Buddy pauses between bites and seems to think for a few moments before continuing. Despite his pauses, Buddy finishes eating before you and everyone else. As you continue to enjoy the refreshments, Buddy begins to speak.

“I know I’ve asked a lot of you already, but would you be willing to help us out with restoring the common area to its pre-explosion greatness? While the rest of us are removing all the debris and cleaning everything up, we could really use your help to replace the damaged furniture and some of the artifacts. I promise that after we have finished this project, I will answer all of your questions.”

Buddy gives you a moment to consider, and then flourishes a list as soon as you agree.

quest.title: Secretly A Society Summons You VIII
quest.cleanTitle: Secretly A Society Summons You VIII
quest.cleanDescription:
As you return, you are shocked to find that the entrance you had been using has completely disappeared. You stand for a moment, perplexed by the sudden turn of events.

You look towards the burned area and to the east, you notice a figure leaving a home you could have sworn was abandoned. How strange, you think to yourself. You step closer and a hand grabs your arm. The familiar form of Buddy falls in lock-step with you.

"Thank you for bringing all these wonderful decorations to our room." Buddy looks around conspiratorially before lowering his voice, "Have you figured it out yet? What we're doing?" He grins at you and once again you notice the strange symbol on his breast pocket. You think for a moment before shaking your head no.

"Well, you'll find out soon enough. You're one of us now, afterall. Speaking of, you'll need to pay your dues as well as the initial fees. I spoke with the other heads and we agreed we can waive the gold costs if you're willing to help us redecorate the entrance shack. So, whaddya say?"

You give a bewildered nod before Buddy hands you another list and bounds off, whistling a tune you don't quite recognize.

quest.title: Secretly A Society Summons You IX
quest.cleanTitle: Secretly A Society Summons You IX
quest.cleanDescription:
With the supplies you brought, the members of Buddy’s organization quickly begin rebuilding what looks like a small house, but is actually a shell for the entryway to the hall below. They even restore the door handle with the strange marking you remembered from the building’s previous incarnation.

Since your part in the restoration is completed, Buddy sends you home with the promise that he will visit you in three days with more information and to collect your membership dues.

“Don’t forget to have your dues ready and fully counted when I arrive, friend!”

Three days later, exactly to the minute, Buddy arrives at your farm carrying a large box. You invite him in, and he quickly follows you and takes a seat, still holding the box.

“Hullo, friend! I have all of your membership items here. I hope you enjoy them! We will have your induction ceremony tomorrow evening, assuming you have your dues ready for me now. If not, there may be some trouble, but I’m sure we won’t have to worry about that.”

Buddy places the box on the floor and invites you to verify its contents before going to get your dues. Inside the box, you find a green cloak, a blue coin purse filled with dice, a stack of cards, a journal, some horseshoes, an hourglass, and three pencils. Seeing these items together a possibility slips into place in your mind and you ask Buddy if his organization is a gaming group.

“Of course it is, silly! I figured you knew that from our emblem. The explosions the other night weren’t from our normal games though. We were trying to set up a game of ‘Keep Talking and Nothing Explodes’. Unfortunately, the explosive devices were a little too explosive in our testing. Next time, we’ll use much smaller and weaker explosives. Most of the time our games are much safer and mainstream, but Jenkins was in charge this time and he’s a bit…eccentric.”

This information sets your mind at ease, but now you’re curious about the secrecy of this group. You ask Buddy and he smiles and explains.

“The secrecy is just for fun, plus it’s part of our name. We’re the Secret Gaming Society of Redbrook! Well, you are too now! Ha! Speaking of which, do you have your dues?”

quest.title: Secretly A Society Summons You X
quest.cleanTitle: Secretly A Society Summons You X
quest.cleanDescription:
Dues in hand, you return to the SGSR entrance. The acronym feels...wrong in your brain and you resolve to discuss the matter with Buddy at his earliest convenience. Before you can knock, the door swings open and a member sweeps you inside, chiding you for your lack of discretion in the process.

The entrance hall is now well lit and lavishly decorated. As you descend the stairs, you can hear faint sounds echoing ahead of you. Glass clinking against glass, shouts of exclamation, and other tidbits of sound you can't place rise in a cacophony of chaos ahead of you. As you arrive in the common room, Buddy is seated in a chair, holding rectangular cards with strange drawings on them yelling at a townsfolk across from him that you don't recognize.

"YOU CAN'T RESOLVE MANA TAP AFTER THE REKEEP STEP! THAT'S A CLEAR VIOLATION OF THE STACK RULES WE ESTABLISHED AFTER THE DISASTER THAT WAS JENKIN'S MISTBIND CLIQUE DECK!"

At another table, someone - probably Jenkins - shouts back, "YOU JUST DON'T UNDERSTAND THE COMPLEXITY AND JOY OF LOCKING ANOTHER PLAYER OUT OF THEIR TURN, BUDDY!"

The chaos is completely overwhelming and while you recognize the words they are saying, the meaning is completely incomprehensible to you. Your escort rings a bell at the bottom of the hall, and the common room goes silent as everyone turns towards you.

Buddy stands up and addresses the room, "Fellow gamers, we have a newbie among us. Who would challenge this one to a rite of passage?"

Every hand in the room raises immediately. Buddy smiles and says, "It's a dice-off! {player}, we're going to need a lot of dice."

quest.title: Secretly A Society Summons You XI
quest.cleanTitle: Secretly A Society Summons You XI
quest.cleanDescription:
A dice-off among this secret society is, as you soon find out, a game of dice involving two players rolling two dice each to get closest to seven with the smallest gap between the two numbers rolled. Ties require a re-roll. In this particular format, each matchup is won by getting two wins out of three total rolls.

In this very particular instance, Buddy distributed six dice to every member of the society and then two dice to you. He then instructed all of the society members to roll their three turns onto the table in front of them, separated neatly and clearly for you to come roll against. If there are any ties, the member is expected to re-roll with you until the tie is broken.

“Your mission”, Buddy says, “is to defeat two thirds of the members of this society. Do that, and you’re in. Fail to do it, and you won’t be able to join the SGSR.”

Oh good, a statistically improbable situation.

Despite the odds set against you, you approach each table, roll three times with each member of the society, re-roll ties, and then document whether you won or lost on a scorecard Buddy made for you. After all of your matchups, you find, and Buddy verifies, that you won three matches short of half of the total matches. Nowhere near two thirds.

“It’s ok.” Buddy says. “I don’t think anyone has won two thirds on their first try. The good news is you can keep trying. The bad news is you can’t join the SGSR. The really great news is you are welcome to attend our monthly potluck dinner tomorrow evening, if you’d like.”

quest.title: Secretly A Society Summons You XII
quest.cleanTitle: Secretly A Society Summons You XII
quest.cleanDescription:
Along with your contributions to the potluck dinner, you also bring the box of membership items that Buddy gave you as you return to the society’s secret headquarters. This time, Jenkins greets you at the entryway with a quizzical expression, but motions you onward to the common area.

As you enter the common area, you see a long stretch of tables connected together and covered with such a variety and quantity of food that you’re sure no crowd this size could ever eat it all. You place your potluck contributions on the table and then you and your box go and find a seat at one of the other tables spread around the great hall.

Before you have a chance to start looking around the hall, Buddy is in the seat next to you wondering why you brought your membership box.

“You’re not giving up, are you?”

You assure Buddy that you’re not giving up. Instead, you assumed the society would want their items back until you pass the dice-off test.

“But you just passed the real test!” Buddy interjects. “You didn’t give up! I said you couldn’t join the SGSR, but that’s not us. We’re actually the Gaming And More - Enigmatic Redbrook Society, or GAMERS for short. The test to join GAMERS was just to enjoy gaming and be a good sport about it. I’d say you definitely passed that entry requirement, friend.”

To make it official, Buddy jumps up in his chair and announces you as the newest member of the Gaming And More - Enigmatic Redbrook Society. After a round of applause, various cheers and hoots, and a booming “HURRAY!” from Buddy, Buddy invites everyone to eat.

As the other society members begin to browse the food and fill their plates, Buddy hops off his chair and congratulates you. He then pulls a pair of dice from his pocket and presents them to you.

“Keep these secret and safe. They will allow you to enter the society’s underground headquarters, along with a few other secret locations around Redbrook. You should come play cards at the secret card house!”

Not for the first time, or the last, you wonder if Buddy is this clever on purpose or if he just stumbles into these things.

quest.title: Performance Enhancing Grapes I
quest.cleanDescription:
Something unusual happened to the radishes that Beatrix was growing. She was strolling through her garden, drinking a glass of grape juice, when a thought suddenly popped into her head. The thought told her that she should pour some of the grape juice on the radishes. The thought felt familiar and kind, but Beatrix doesn’t remember ever pouring grape juice on still-growing crops. Beatrix started to dismiss the thought, but it came again, and it felt so comfortable. So, she poured a bit of the grape juice on her very freshly sprouted radishes. Instantly, the radish stems and leaves elongated to their full-grown height.

Beatrix carefully pulled a radish from the ground and examined it. The radish was fully grown and perfectly ripe! Beatrix couldn’t believe it. She pulled the rest of the radishes and all were alike, ripe and fully grown.

Beatrix is now tangled in curiosity. She wants to know more about this phenomenon. Will you help her experiment and learn more? Will you try some grape juice on your radishes?

quest.title: Performance Enhancing Grapes II
quest.cleanDescription: Whenever you finish testing the grape juice, will you bring Beatrix some of the radishes from your experiment? Then, she would like you to try some grape juice on cucumbers.

quest.title: Performance Enhancing Grapes III
quest.cleanDescription:
Beatrix continued experimenting with pouring grape juice on different crops. All of the different seeds she planted finished growing instantly when sprinkled with grape juice. Unfortunately, she discovered a negative effect on the soil if the grape juice was used more than two or three times. So, don’t overuse this method.

Will you bring Beatrix some of the cucumbers you grew with grape juice?

quest.title: Performance Enhancing Grapes IV
quest.cleanDescription:
There doesn’t seem to be anything out of the ordinary with the cucumbers you brought to Beatrix. They appear to be fully grown and ripe, just like the radishes.

Beatrix appreciates your help with learning more about this strange phenomenon. Will you continue experimenting with using grape juice on your crops?

quest.title: Fake Fishing I
quest.cleanDescription: Thomas is actually terrible at fishing but wants everybody to think he isn't.  So if you give him some fish, he'll give you some materials you can use to craft things.

questlines.title: Do You Want to Build A Snowman?

quest.title: Do You Want to Build A Snowman? I
quest.cleanTitle: Do You Want to Build A Snowman? I
quest.cleanDescription:
Buddy enters the town. He looks mischievous, and you feel as though it’s your duty to see what he’s up to. After a few moments, you recognize the house Buddy is approaching is Vincent’s. This seems…bad. You brace yourself for what comes next, but after pounding on the door, Buddy calls out -

“Vincent?
Do you want to build a snowman?
C’mon let’s go and play
I never see you anymore
Come out the door
It’s like you’ve gone away

We could have been best buddies
And yet we’re not
I wish you would tell me why…
Do you wanna build a snowman?”

Vincent opens the door suddenly and shouts, “GO AWAY BUDDY!” He turns and slams the door, and Buddy stands outside looking dejected.
After a moment you hear him call out, “OK, bye.”
Buddy looks to you dejectedly for a moment before he perks up. “Maybe if I start building a giant snowman, Vincent will want to play? Will you help?”

You can’t help yourself.

quest.title: Do You Want to Build A Snowman? II
quest.cleanTitle: Do You Want to Build A Snowman? II
quest.cleanDescription:
The snowman begins to take shape and Buddy, spurred on by your good deed and a seemingly unending well of optimism knocks on Vincent’s door again.

“Vincent?
Do you wanna build a snowman?
Or decorate some Christmas cards
I think some company is overdue
I’ve started making a giant snowman in your yard
Hang in there, buddy

It gets a little lonely
With only one snowman
Just watching the hours tick by”

Vincent opens the door cautiously and his eyes grow wide at the giant snowman that has begun to form in his front yard. He looks at Buddy for a moment before shaking his head and closing the door without a word.

Buddy looks sadly at the door and you can hear a muffled, “OK, bye”

Your heart cannot take the sadness in Buddy’s eyes and you begin gathering more snowballs to help complete his project.

quest.title: Do You Want to Build A Snowman? III
quest.cleanTitle: Do You Want to Build A Snowman? III
quest.cleanDescription:
The snow portion of the snowman is nearing completion, and Buddy again knocks on Vincent’s door.

“Vincent?
Please, I know you’re in there
People have been asking where you’ve been
They tell me “have courage” and I’m trying to
I’ve built a snowman right here for you,
Just let me in!

We could friend each other
Just you and me
What else could we do?
Do you wanna build a snowman?
(It doesn’t have to be a snowman!)”

Suddenly the door swings open and Vincent shoves something in Buddy’s hand and closes the door immediately.

Buddy looks dejectedly on, “OK, bye.”

You look at Buddy’s hand and notice coal and a carrot.

Buddy suddenly notices what he has and his eyes brighten immediately as he looks towards you. “All we need is a giant scarf!”
He glances down again and adds, "Maybe some more coal too."

quest.title: Do You Want to Build A Snowman? IV
quest.cleanTitle: Do You Want to Build A Snowman? IV
quest.cleanDescription: After you bring back a scarf, Vincent comes outside bearing hot chocolate for you and buddy, and a grin on his face.  “Buddy, this is one of the biggest and best snowmen I’ve ever seen, maybe next year we can build one together.  It can be a sequel and we’ll sing a duet into the unknown sky about it!”

quest.title: Unique Fish I
quest.cleanDescription: Thomas would like some unique fish to show his friends.

quest.title: Hoptimistic I
quest.cleanDescription: frank is feeling down after his series of pranks didn't go as planned. “Guess I caused all that rabble for nothin’, huh?”. He chomps down on a couple carrots. You tell him it’s not a big deal, but he doesn't seem convinced. He sulks in your chair, and a pile of carrot shavings starts to form below him. There has to be something you can do to cheer him up.

quest.title: Hoptimistic II
quest.cleanDescription: The extra carrots seemed to help, at least for a few moments. frank hops to the floor to vacuum the carrot shavings up with his mouth. He tells you, between his chomps of dirty-floor-carrot bits, about how he’s never won anything before. “I just have rotten luck. Doesn’t matter how many ladders I walk under, how many mirrors I break, or how much salt I spill. Nothing helps.” You begin to wonder where frank learned about superstitions. He returns to self-loathing on your chair, upside down so his belly is shown. “uuUuUUUugghhhHHhhhhh”, he groans. His pale blue glow looks a bit duller than usual. Maybe something lucky will help frank. You leave some snacks behind, and set off to find some things that might bring frank some luck.

quest.title: Hoptimistic III

I AM A MESS!” frank sinks to the floor, flattening out like a pancake. He slinks to your pantry. “You’re out of carrots? OF COURSE YOU ARE.” You get the feeling that frank is being dramatic. He’s rolling around on the floor, mumbling to himself. You hesitantly leave him again to go ask someone for help on how to bring frank some good luck.

quest.title: Hoptimistic IV

He explains that if frank’s luck is truly that bad, you’ll need some extremely lucky items to help. He suggests you invest in a quarry, if you haven’t yet, as Jade may help your cause. He thumbs through his vast collection of books and pulls out a leather bound diary. He scribbles some things down on a blank page, and sends you on your way.

quest.title: Hoptimistic V
quest.cleanDescription: One of the things on Lorn’s list was Jade, but your quarry just isn’t producing it fast enough. You heard a rumor that the small spring has some hidden treasure chests that might be filled with precious gems.

quest.title: Hoptimistic VI
quest.cleanDescription: You heed Lorn’s advice, and gather everything on his list. You go back home, and decide to just sort of pour everything on top of frank, who is now asleep in a puddle of his own drool on your floor.

quest.title: Hoptimistic VII

You go to look for something to clean his mess, and hear a loud whirring sound. You head back to the room frank was sleeping in, and all the items are gone, aside from the mushrooms. “Mushrooms aren’t very good for me. Too much fungus.” He looks like he’s back to normal, as he’s found another bundle of carrots to munch on. “Mind if I stay here for a while? You grow the best carrots, pal.” He doesn’t wait for an answer, and pulls a giant suitcase from your cupboard. You can tell something in his life has changed, but don’t want to press him right now. You don’t have the heart to tell him he can’t stay, and he’s already unpacking his things anyways. Who knew rabbits owned so much stuff?

quest.title: Hoptimistic VIII
quest.cleanDescription: After frank settles in, he comes over to you with a red, fluffy item. “This was my great-great uncle billy’s. He always had the best luck.” frank pauses. “Or was it great-great uncle peter who had good luck...Well. Either way. I won’t be needing this anymore, since I’m cured, and by the looks of this place you could use it.” You can tell frank is trying to be nice, so you take the red rabbit’s foot. “Hey uh. If I need that back, you’ll still have it, right? It’s kind of a family heirloom, so please don't sell it.”

quest.title: Fishing Tournament I
quest.cleanDescription:
Each year, there is a fishing contest that happens across the world. Any and all figures participate annually, however, this year has a small twist to it: signing up and competing requires a duo! Thus, Thomas has approached you and asked you to be his partner for the fishing tournament this year. You decide to kindly accept even though you know you’ll be doing all the work. Thomas promises that he will help you as much as possible in the tournament so you can *hopefully* win!

A week before the tournament starts, Thomas receives a letter from the tournament committee listing the baits that you must bring to participate in the tourney. Unfortunately, Thomas recently went on a fishing charter and used up all his bait so he is relying on you to gather the bait you two will need to participate. He hands you the list and sends you off.

quest.title: Fishing Tournament II
quest.cleanDescription: Thomas thanks you for getting all the bait needed and then shows you another letter from the tournament committee. It states that too many duos have signed up to enter the tournament. Now duos will need to be approved by the committee to join. Thomas thinks that the best way to get accepted into the tournament is to show off some fishing accomplishments! However, Thomas tells you that his fishing rod broke. So, he needs your help getting enough fish to get into the tournament.

quest.title: Fishing Tournament III
quest.cleanDescription:
Thomas sends the fish to the committee in the wooden box.

A couple of days later, he receives a letter saying the two of you have been accepted into the tournament! By the next day, you and Thomas set sail for the competition.

When you arrive, you see plenty of other duos that look like pros with fancy fishing rods and perfect bait. As you look around, you notice a shady duo in the back that have masks hiding their faces. You can’t make it out clearly but you can see a small tattoo on each of their arms.

Suddenly, a booming voice catches your attention and you notice a large stage where a cloaked figure is standing. He appears to be the organizer of this tournament. He announces that the tournament will consist of a series of rounds. Only the most competent teams will advance after each round. Round one will be held at Small Island!

All of the contestants then head out toward the fishing area. When you arrive, the cloaked figure yells “Begin!” and everyone rushes to a boat to start fishing.

Thomas tells you that this will be an easy round because he finally got his new fishing rod! The two of you begin to fish. You notice that the waters are rough. It won’t be as easy to fish as Thomas thinks.

quest.title: Fishing Tournament IV
quest.cleanDescription:
After about an hour, you hear a blaring alarm that almost makes you drop your rod and everyone stops fishing. You quickly return to the main area where you first arrived. A committee is waiting to pass judgment on everyone’s catches.

Thomas proudly takes your combined fish to the committee and waits…

You notice Thomas’ face drops and he sulks back towards you telling you of the news: you barely scraped by.

After everyone has been judged, they wheel out a leaderboard and Thomas finds your team in the spot fourth from the bottom out of 50 total teams that progressed to the next round.

You notice Thomas trying to fix up his rod, but the cloaked figure exclaims it is time to begin the next round. He nods towards a river near the main stage. As he nods, his cloak hood slips a little and you notice a figure with a sharp jawline and beard, you begin to wonder who it is. It seems nobody else noticed this slip and everyone begins heading in that direction and you end up near a trashy, rapidly flowing river.

You look back to ask Thomas where he would like to fish along the river but he is nowhere in sight. Unfortunately, you spot the clock and the timer has already started, you have to get fishing with or without Thomas.

quest.title: Fishing Tournament V
quest.cleanDescription:
Thomas finally spots you after you have caught all the fish you wanted to and time is about to run out. As he walks up, you notice he also has a good amount of fish, much more than you would expect of Thomas.

As you watch the looming timer hit 0, you prepare for the roaring alarm and then head back to the nearby main stage. The cloaked figure steps forward again and begins judging the groups and their catches with the committee. You notice that you seem to have brought the most fish, and the figure confirms it! This fishing bout jumps you up to ninth place in total!

The cloaked figure announces that 20 more teams have been eliminated and decides it is time for everyone to take a break to eat. Before he steps away from the mic you hear a loud rumble from his stomach… weird.

Then, you hear a loud creaking noise and the main stage begins to open. Inside, there are plenty of seats and food, however, Thomas wants a specific dinner, saying that eating all the healthy food will help you guys catch more fish next round. You reluctantly agree to get what he wants.

quest.title: Fishing Tournament VI
quest.cleanDescription:
After everyone has eaten, the announcer brings multiple barrels and boxes to refill everyone’s bait and prepare for the next rounds. With an up-close view of the announcer, you can almost make out the details of his face; he looks familiar.

Before you know it, you, Thomas, and all the contestants are walking towards a nice, sandy beach where the sun is shining brightly off the rolling waves of the ocean. You and Thomas are ready to start fishing. However, Thomas says his stomach hurts and he goes towards the ocean and pukes. You’re worried that Thomas ate something spoiled so you tend to him for a little bit, but he pushes you away and asks you to continue fishing; he’ll take care of himself.

The shady duo you saw earlier is fishing a couple of spots down from you, but unfortunately now is not the time to investigate.

You quickly grab Thomas’ new rod and begin fishing, throwing all the fish you catch into the barrels behind you without a second glance.

quest.title: Fishing Tournament VII
quest.cleanDescription:
The alarm sounds and you rush to Thomas to see how he is doing. He tells you he feels a lot better and you help him walk back to the stage with your barrels of fish. Your barrels seem light, but you don’t give it a second thought.

Once you get back to the stage everyone else seems to have somewhat empty barrels and you let out a sigh of relief until you notice one team has way more fish than anyone else. Surprisingly, you jump up to fifth place… but you watch the committee remove the teams until only five teams are remaining: you are dead last. You know you will need a huge amount of fish in the next round just to catch up, in hopes of winning the tournament.

The cloaked figure sends you off again towards the coast, but this time you sail on a boat towards the vast blue ocean with nothing else in sight, so it seems…

As Thomas seems to have fully recovered, he exclaims that there are fish practically jumping out at what appears to be a tiny cove in the middle of the ocean. You quickly steer the boat to the area, hand Thomas his fishing rod and grab yours, and rapidly begin fishing.

quest.title: Fishing Tournament VIII
quest.cleanDescription:
You continue to fish, not even worrying about the timer that will soon send a piercing sound across the ocean. By the time the timer runs out, you have nearly double what you had the entire tournament! You set sail back to the main island and land safely. However, you only see three boats: the committee’s, yours, and the top team’s. You return to the main stage and the committee informs you that the other three teams sunk and are therefore disqualified.

You glance over and see the top team smirking… something seems fish-y. Regardless, the committee passes judgment… and you win!

Thomas aggressively celebrates with you, and the committee cheers for you as well. The committee sends the other team home before you get a chance to see them, but you notice a strange letter slip from one of their pockets. You quickly grab the letter but before you read it, the cloaked figure begins approaching you and removes his cloak. It was Holger this whole time!

He thanks you and Thomas for a job well done, and he looks forward to eating the tremendous amount of fish you and the other teams caught for him. He hands you your reward and asks that you leave your barrels and boxes of fish here. He will take them back to town instead.

quest.title: Peaches For Free I
quest.cleanDescription:

As a fellow seller of fine goods, Borgen could relate. So, he reluctantly parted with some of his ancient coins to purchase the entire bin of fruit.

Now, according to the farmer, these peaches should be reaching the peak of ripeness in the next day or so. As they do, Borgen would like to get this new fruit out to several people to test the potential market for these “Peaches of the Unincorporated Southern Arcagos”.

Would you like to try a peach? If you like it, Borgen welcomes you to come back and buy a few more.

quest.title: Peaches For Free II
quest.cleanDescription: Borgen would like to offer you a special deal, if you enjoyed the peach and want a few more of them. Would you like some more peaches?

Unfortunately, the peach juice has an unwanted side effect for a seller of fine goods like Borgen. It makes you invisible for a short duration after you drink it. Nevertheless, maybe you could find a use for this peach juice. Borgen would be happy to share it with you at a very reasonable price.

quest.title: Rapturous Thanksgiving I
quest.cleanDescription:
In the evening before dinner, you see a lantern lighting your path to your home.  Captain Thomas’ familiar frame is illuminated in the early evening hours by a beautiful sunset.  
“Friend, I miss home and you have been so good to me in the past year.  Let me tell you about how we celebrate Thanksgiving where I’m from.”
You invite Captain Thomas into your home and offer to share a meal with him.

quest.title: Rapturous Thanksgiving II
quest.cleanDescription:
After a delicious turkey and side, Captain Thomas puts a foot up by your fireplace and lights a fancy pipe.  
“In my world, Sarafina and I would join in the glorious celebration of cooking raptors for Thanksgiving.  Each year we would find the time to raise raptors and help repopulate the raptor population, but one, that raptor would always be given the tenderest of care.  They weren’t bred for fighting and hunting, like your barbaric Redbrook traditions, but they were for eating.  We gave thanks each year by giving some of that raptor to our closest friends.” 
Captain Thomas wipes a tear from his eye and continues, “And Sarafina, she always cooked the best…”
Captain Thomas stops abruptly and smiles at you.  “Thank you for entertaining my story.  I found this egg, and while I don’t agree with your traditions, I’ll gladly give this one to your care.  Have a happy Thanksgiving.”

quest.title: Excuuuse me, Farmer I
quest.cleanDescription:
Poof! Star appears in your home, stereotypical mess of feathers in tow.

"I'm looking for some rare relics. Langstaff Crests, ya heard of 'em? They're special to me - I'm hoping to use them for a ritual later."

The look of indignation on your face seems to offend Star, "Well, excuuuse me, farmer, I can give you something nice as a reward. These were in my tower after the great watermelon surplus a few years ago, maybe we can trade?"

quest.cleanDescription:

I keep losing these things, something about their residual Romuskan energy makes them hard to find. There's another rare item in it for your trouble.

Rolling your eyes and dusting yourself off, you head back out.

quest.title: Excuuuse me, Farmer III
quest.cleanDescription:

"Hey, listen! You wouldn't believe how hard these things are to keep track of. I hate losing! I'm going to need a few more before the uh, spell evaporates due to ley line dissonance, stat!"

"Well, excuuuuse me, farmer!"

Nothing to be done but help, you think begrudgingly.
