quest.cleanDescription: The concession stand is doing very well. Business is booming. Now, they need another load of ingredients before they run out. Will you bring ingredients for all the dishes they’re serving?

quest.title: Concessions To Be Made VII
quest.cleanDescription: Everything is running smoothly at the concession stand and the townsfolk are loving the food. However, if you would be willing, Mariya would love for you to cook up a few large batches of new dishes to add more variety. Are you ready to get cooking?

quest.title: Concessions To Be Made VIII
quest.cleanDescription: Mariya and the whole concessions crew really appreciate your contributions to the success of the concession stand. Your breakfast sandwiches and pies are a huge hit! Would you be willing to make another batch of each dish?

quest.title: Hold The Line I
quest.cleanDescription:
Star’s calculations and vast strategy may not be enough to hold back the Shadow if someone fails to do their part. So it is that Star finds himself coming to you on a universal Thursday to ask for assistance. It appears that the meticulously crafted barrier that Star engineered was compromised by a shift in the distribution of ethereal focusing scepters.

The undermining force appears to be the monetary value of the staff. Star has corrected this issue, but now he needs to correct both the architectural and logistical distribution. That’s where he needs your help.

Will you accept another mystical staff and keep it secret, and keep it safe, until Star or one of his duly authorized messengers calls for it?

quest.title: Silo Duo I
quest.cleanDescription: Jill is trying to fill a big order of carrots. Unfortunately, rabbits wiped out several rows of carrots in one of her fields. She needs 40 carrots as quick as possible.

quest.title: Silo Duo II
quest.cleanDescription: The big storm several days ago flooded one of Jill's fields and washed away a big crop of wheat. Now she's going to be short for another order. She'll pay big for your help.

quest.title: Help Kneaded
quest.cleanDescription: You’re at the town square to run some errands, and you see Mariya. As you approach, you notice her clothes are covered in powder. At her feet is a torn sack of flour. When she sees you, she lets out a soft laugh. “We need to stop meeting like this.” She dusts herself off, and kicks the sack of flour. This, of course, makes a huge mess. You grab some brooms so the two of you can clean up.

quest.title: Help Kneaded II
quest.cleanDescription:
“That sack of flour was the last one. I can not seem to win today. Do you know anywhere else that may have some?” You nod, and lead her towards your home.

You open your storage compartment, and tell her to take what she needs. “I will repay your kindness in full.” She shakes your hand again, takes some flour, and heads home.

quest.title: Flexible Spending I
quest.cleanDescription: You meet Cecil on a walk near the Bank of Redbrook.  His expression is ineffable as he approaches you and joins you in lockstep. “I have a proposition.  I have the ability to acquire some extremely rare artifacts, but I am a little short of liquid assets right now, how about a trade for two of the rarest?  You will have to give me half up front to make sure I know you are good for the rest.”

quest.title: Mane Hospital III
quest.cleanDescription:
As you turn around to leave, Charles also follows you. Going down your list, you realize you’ll need to also talk to some townsfolk for ideas on some of the rarer materials on this list. First on your list would be seeing Rosalie about getting some orange geckos and garnet.

On the walk back, Charles glances around in a way that could be described as skittish, but seems generally pleasant to be around, and he has a rapport you didn't realize with most townsfolk.

You get the feeling Charles may have forgotten you’re wearing the ring as you walk through town.
“Neigh!” (Good day Borgen, hope you find that extra special potato someday!)
“Neigh!” (Ric you're a jerk and really scary, but misunderstood all the same.)
“Neigh neigh!” (Buddy, I swear if you try to put a saddle on my back again)
“Neigh neigh!” (Cecil, you scamp, I know what you have in that house!)
“Neigh neigh, neigh! Neigh!” (Jill smells like metal again.)
“Neigh.” (A pleasant day to you frank old chap, hope that you find what you’re looking for, and you realize your self-worth isn’t tied up into that silly wizard.)

Nearing Rosalie’s home, you see her talking with Buddy in hushed whispers.
“The Shadow, it seems to wait until no one is around… but it avoids certain people entirely. Beatrix has never seen it,” you hear Rosalie say.

Buddy responds quietly, “Maybe if she left her home ever.”

As you clear your throat, they turn to you. After a moment of describing what you need, Rosalie smiles, and says she can gladly get you what you need.

quest.title: A Tower Redecorated
quest.cleanDescription:
You put all the feathers in the bucket and wait expectantly for Star to arrive, but nothing happens.

Turning away, you hear a muffled scream from behind, and suddenly flashes of gold and white feathers encircle the room.

“WHY WOULD YOU PUT FEATHERS IN A BUCKET TODAY?!”

You see him one leg in the bucket, feathers in his hair, scrambling to regain his balance. Oops.

After a few moments, Star composes himself, mumbling under his breath about the paradoxical nature of feathers and their location in the timestream’s quantum blue spectrum relative to Wednesdays.

“Anyways…I was thinking, I should probably redecorate. The damage was severe enough that things look awfully messy in there. Mind helping me out, friend? I need to run another quick errand while you’re doing that.” Star hands you ANOTHER list and poofs away in a shower of feathers.

Bedroom, Living Room, Study
-Antlers to adorn the living room
-Flowers for various plants and spells
-Prism Shards to adorn the ceiling
-Treasure Chests filled with coins
-Shields for inside protection
-Pipes one for each multiverse day of the week
-A new bed
-A desk
-Books to write his thoughts and spells in

quest.title: A Tower Redecorated II
quest.cleanDescription:
You know the drill at this point, feathers, sudden appearances, strange jokes…the usual.

Star looks gleefully at the things you’ve collected and mutters under his breath something about giving a mile, and hands you another piece of parchment.

“You’ve been quite helpful, the damage Geist has done should mostly be repaired at this point, but my kitchen and cellar were damaged by fire also! Could you help me restoc- I mean restore these too?”

Star looks thoughtful for a moment and takes the parchment back and scribbles something at the bottom of the list.

He hands the list back which reads:

Shopping List:
Golden Veggies - a variety of nutritious foods
Oranges - delicious and fight scurvy!
Milk - does a body good
Eggs - part of a nutritious breakfast
Bacon - it’s so hard to find right now!
Flour - For baking and making bread
Honey - For baking and bread
Wine - for those lazy nights reading magical theory
Cheese - for the wine
Steak - the market’s probably stable right now
Kabobs - perfect for grilling after Friday
Scribbled at the bottom:
ABSOLUTELY NO LEMONS!

quest.title: A Tower Redecorated III
quest.cleanDescription:
As you realize you’ve finished restocking Star’s food stores, you notice Rosalie walking up to your farm. She greets you and asks you for the letter Star said you had for her.

At the mention of Star’s name, he immediately poofs beside you and extends his hand to Rosalie.

“Oh, I’m sure that letter’s been long lost at this point, I made an extra one just for you!”

He hands Rosalie the letter and turns around to hand you some parchment.

You set to work on what you hope to be the final task, and notice Rosalie deep in thought, and of course Star is nowhere to be seen, again.

The Coolest Moat In The History Of Moats
Puffer – look cool in a gang to attract attention
Clownfish – disarm your foe with cuteness
Giant Squid – eat your foe
Octopus - If the squids don't scare you...
Mussel – they look kinda intimidating?
A drawbridge - obviously

That’s… a big moat.

quest.title: The Fall of Water I
quest.cleanDescription:
The machine whirs and hums, brought to life again and you both hop on, there’s just enough room if you shed the non essential items from your packs.

The trail you both left on your first trip up the phenomenon is crystal clear in the snow and ice. Knowing what to expect, you push forward faster than you did originally, the snow and wind pick up as you approach the Wall.

You both agree to leave the machine outside the Wall and step off, buffeted by the wind and snow, Thomas steps forward, you see the plain case in one hand and he motions to you with the other.

“STAY CLOSE!” The wind is deafening at this point. Thomas kneels to the ground and sets the box on the snow. He grabs your hand and opens the box. Immediately, the shockwave erupts from the box, but mysteriously, you are unaffected. The unnatural sensations of the sound of the ocean, the roar of the wind, the frigidness of snow, the steam heat of boiled water are present, but encapsulate you both in an aura of comfort, instead of pushing you away. You feel a serenity in the midst of this otherworldly sensation.

Thomas looks at you, wide eyed. “Here goes nothing.” He picks up the dagger and you see a glow emit from his eyes. His voice grows deeper, more resonant. It’s Thomas, but there is something more there. “Take the box, the wizard would not appreciate losing it.” he states matter-of-factly. There is an edge to his words and you look to him unsure how to hold onto his hand and pick up the box with the other. Releasing your hand, Thomas’s voice is even less natural than before. “Have no fear, I shall keep you safe.”

You put the box in your bag and step forward with Thomas. The Wall looms before you, and as you near it, there is an intensity you can’t quite put your finger on, but the aura extends forward and the Wall parts as you move closer. You move forward slowly, until you are completely surrounded by the wall. A storm rages around you, but the dagger, or Thomas, or both, keep you safe from the raging forces around you. All around, a deep scream echoes. Pain and weariness intermixed with bitter rage. You shut your eyes and put your hands over your ears to stop the assault on your senses until Thomas puts a hand on your shoulder, and the screams subside. You both press on, there is an odd gleam in Thomas’ eyes, somewhere between determination you get the sense that he is having fun.

quest.title: The Fall of Water II
quest.cleanDescription:
Suddenly, as quickly as the wall began, you see clear skies pierce the horrors of the Wall around you. The Wall recedes as you move forward together and the pressure and noise surrounding you ceases immediately.

What you see before you is unlike any majesty you’ve ever witnessed. Sun glistens off patches of ice, vibrant green grass grows in between patches of pristine white snow. A tree blossoms in a small frozen pond, purple and red hues accenting the light green leaves leaving you dazzled. Moments later, you realize water is continually falling from various branches, as though a fountain. Far away, a wall of ice seems to climb higher and higher out of the ground and water falls from its peak into a waterfall, glistening in the sun. The sound of the massive waterfall is at once tumultuous and calming. The water falls into a lake that you now see is the centerpiece of this area. The lake is surrounded by ice and a massive ice formation with one small stream running east towards the ocean.

After a moment of appreciating the splendor surrounded by Shva’s Wall, you gather yourself and offer the plain box to Thomas, but he looks at it suspiciously. “Perhaps I should keep the dagger…close.” He clenches the dagger tightly in one hand and steps towards the lake. “I’m being called. What you are seeing, is…my home.” Thomas winces at these words and without another word, he begins to move towards the lake.

Calling out, Thomas completely ignores you as he takes step after step forward. Reaching the lake, he steps onto it and ice spreads out beneath his feet. He looks back to you, expectantly, but as you gingerly step on a shallow pool of water your foot plunges directly through.

“Ah yes. Hm. You’re going to need a boat. Or well, an approximation of one.”

quest.title: The Fall of Water III
quest.cleanDescription:
You present the ships and rings to Thomas and wordlessly, he draws the dagger from his belt and with both hands grasping the hilt, a sensation of power overwhelms you. The boats gently rise up into the air and drift towards the lake, and the rings disappear, strangely. You blink, and before you is a small boat fashioned out of ice.

“It’s entirely safe, let’s be off.” The being known as Thomas smiles with satisfaction, and you feel a breeze in the air and a sound like a gentle sigh crosses your ears.

Thomas grasps the side of your ice boat and you begin to travel inward. The lake seems limitless. Fish flit in mesmerizing chaotic patterns, the sun cascades off the fish and the ripples of the lake, highlighting the brilliant oddity of the situation. All around you, a chaotic wall of rage and raw elemental energy swirls, but in this moment, you feel calm.

The northernmost part of the lake is where the ice grows highest, and Thomas propels himself and your boat towards it. The majesty of the moment strikes you, and you lose all sense of time taking in your surroundings. As you approach, you realize there is a small landing, and a doorway in a shaded alcove. The closer you get, the more it seems something is very wrong. The alcove has a large gash, and the doorway is agape - a large door of ice lays on the entryway. The quiet calm gives way to a sense of unease.

“You’ll need a torch.” The echo of Thomas says. Looking at your companion, he seems faded, as though his energy is being withered away, even faster than before you began your journey.

quest.title: The Fall of Water IV
quest.cleanDescription:
Your torch alight, you step inside. There is a small chamber with a large stone pedestal. It is flanked by 6 small statues made of ice that look vaguely human, each with a symbol in front of it.
The Echo signals and you hold your torch high and with a spark of magic from the dagger, your torch turns blue and strange symbols appear on the wall. Their script is unfamiliar to you, it seems almost alive, telling a story of its own, but the meaning is made clear in your mind.

Where once was six, there now are but five
What fun, new games, with stories come alive!
The first was water, so dull and boring,
Can you make the next one more fun exploring?
Guess the next story, we’ll go together,
Whirling, swirling, breezy forever.
Rys, come play I’ve made more delightful games
Without you, the pictures are plain dull frames.
-V

There is a small echo in the chamber and a shadow covers the words, laughter, terrible, horrible, powerful laughter fills the room and you look over to see Thomas begin to shiver uncontrollably, the dagger falls, the point of the dagger hits the floor and the sound pierces the chamber and the laughter overwhelms the moment. You rush to your friend and he points to the shadow. “It’s not real, it’s not real, but I…no…not me…the dagger…needs to go…there!” He points towards the raised stone. You grab the dagger and race towards the pedestal.

quest.title: The Fall of Water V
quest.cleanDescription:
Belatedly, you recognize that the pedestal is in fact a tomb, and on top is the figure that looks vaguely human, arms crossed but one hand held open. As you inspect the figure, you feel the dagger pull itself towards the figure and in a moment of instinct, you take the dagger and place it in the carved hand.

“Child, I was Zho, Guardian of Water. You have returned the dagger Vail betrayed Zho with, and in doing so have righted a terrible wrong in the world. Here is our memory, the Golden Leaf stands with Rys. Take it and learn of our terrible past and the burden you now carry.”

quest.title: The Fall of Water VI
quest.cleanDescription:
The orb shines brightly, reflecting the light coming from outside. As you take the orb and put it in your pocket, Thomas falls to the ground, no longer shaking. The shadow immediately recedes, and again, you feel your head clear from the horrors of the moment. Taking a deep breath you feel a gentle wind rush through the chamber carrying a sound that could only be described as contentment.

Thomas is prone on the floor and you rush to his side. He is unresponsive at first but after a moment he looks at you with a lopsided smile.

“Was…it all a dream? I was me, but I was more. Or, I was someone or maybe something else?” He pauses momentarily, “Either way, it was so cool! I wish I could remember more.” he seems lost in thought, and you notice Thomas winces again as he uses his arms to stand up off the ground. For a brief moment, you swear you could see his hand disappear entirely.

A gentle snow falls in the room, the single opening in the chamber illuminates the Tomb of Zho, Guardian of Water, and for a moment, you close your eyes, the enormity of the moment giving you pause. You motion quietly to Thomas, not ready to disturb the serenity of the tomb. You both step outside the cavern and quickly realize that Zho’s Wall is gone, but the majesty of Zho’s Playground remains.

“Oh man, Glacier Lake is so cool! Let’s go fishing!” Thomas exclaims. You both laugh, and Thomas seems to be back to his old (new?) self, and after reflection you realize you might also like to take a moment to explore the lake. You both get into the ice boat and cast off, worries forgotten for the moment, the joy of discovery, fishing, and friendship are the only things you see on the horizon.

quest.title: Shadow’s Reach I
quest.cleanDescription:
Star can’t wait for you to see how this all turns out. He thinks it will either be the best of times or the end of times. Star dearly hopes that his plan will keep the worst outcomes away. He doesn’t want it to come to human sacrifice, dogs and cats living together, and MASS HYSTERIA!

Star, and all the light elementals and positive energites, need a small assistance from you to keep the Shadow’s fingers out of the bowl, so to speak. Please bring sunflowers, at least one for every elemental and energite.

quest.title: Shadow’s Reach II
quest.cleanDescription: Star almost forgot. He needs some striped feathers as well. He can’t believe he almost ruined the entire plan.

quest.title: Bright Horseshoe VI
quest.cleanDescription:
Whistling happily to yourself , you head back towards the meadow that Charles indicated earlier in the day.

In the meadow, you take another look at the plans and begin to realize this project is bigger than you realized at first. Lucky for you, Vincent and Holger were out on patrol and stop by, volunteering to help in their spare time.

You expect this project might take less than a week after all. After some light refreshments and some more of the materials Charles requested, you get to work.

quest.title: Peculiar Endings I
quest.cleanDescription:
Ric Ryph watches Geist fly in the air. He seems fixed in place, eyes to the heavens for a moment before snapping out of his reverie. A cruel smile crosses his face before he puts his helmet back on and walks away from the town center unfazed.

The town is in a state of panic, fireworks continue to launch from all different points in the city, each punctuating the night with flashes of light, always in a cascade of color followed by a crack that sounds like thunder. Using the flashes of fireworks as your guide, you sneak to the edge of the city, and through the gap Buddy showed you earlier to make your way back to Buddy’s Cave.

At the entrance, you reach your hand out and find a cutlass across your neck.

“Password?” A voice calls out.

You slowly move your hands into your pockets and pull out some skull coins.

quest.title: Peculiar Endings II
quest.cleanDescription:
Buddy steps forward revealing himself smiling broadly, “You bring the best gifts! Welcome back, {player}!”

You both enter the cave to find Cecil sleeping on a makeshift bed. Buddy motions you quietly towards a separate bedroom that he has made up, decorated with various coins and exotic trinkets you don’t recognize and you collapse into sleep after a long evening.

quest.title: Peculiar Endings III
quest.cleanDescription:
The following morning, you wake to the smell of a breakfast of peculiar foods. Cecil is nowhere to be seen, and after some idle chatter, you agree to handle your business at your farm, Buddy seems to think that Ric has no proof other than instinct that you’re involved with the Golden Leaf, and suggests you go on with your day and wait until you hear from the rest of the Golden Leaf before you move forward with how to handle Ric and the various situations that have unfolded.

At your home, a letter awaits you, this time not held by a dagger, but by a small golden pin. As you pull off the pin, a shower of golden light envelops the note, and the script glimmers before you.

{player},

I’ve made many mistakes, and I’m ready to make amends. Let us all gather at your home in two days to clear the air and plan for the reckoning of our erstwhile mayor. This madness has gone on long enough.

Cecil Langstaff
Protector of Redbrook, Keeper of Aelingos

PS: I’ve got a doozy of a spell lined up, could you help with a few things?


Wizards.

quest.title: Peculiar Endings IV
quest.cleanDescription:
On the dawn of the second day, you carry out your various chores, a pile of Cecil’s requested items in the corner. One by one, members of the Golden Leaf approach your home. They all look moderately disheveled, having lived away from the town for a few days. Cecil, by comparison, seems completely normal looking almost picturesque by comparison; as stoic and put together as any other time you’ve seen him outside his home.

Nearly all of the group eyes each other warily as you sit on the back porch out of view of the main road. A quiet tension builds, once again, between friends divided by opinion and varying levels of trust and it’s hard to imagine who will break the silence.

quest.title: Peculiar Endings V
quest.cleanDescription:
Rosalie, eyes distant and unfocused, clutches her staff in the corner and mutters half to herself, “Star would know what to do.”

Cecil’s eyes widen, and seems ready to retort, when he sees the worry on her face. “You know… he just might in this case. Maybe it’s time we ask him for help?” The group seems varying levels of shocked at this sentiment as Cecil shifts off his cloak and his staff appears as if from thin air in his hands in a sudden movement.

Immediately, Buddy draws his sword and Cecil raises his eyebrows. In a swift fluid motion, Cecil slams his staff on the ground and Buddy drops his sword as it glows a bright cherry color, steam rising from the wood on the deck where his sword lands. No one else in the group moves, shocked by the speed of this event and response. You notice Rosalie begin to shift, but Lorn surreptitiously smiles at her and shakes his head no.

Standing before the group, Cecil addresses everyone, seemingly unfazed by the moments before. “First, I must apologize for both my secrecy and my actions. There are greater things in the world, greater secrets that I and my family have kept for a very long time, you will learn of some of them soon, but for now, just know that I deeply regret how I’ve handled the situation to this point and would like to offer my full uninhibited assistance. Ric Ryph is a serious problem that must be addressed, and his immunity to certain magics cannot be underestimated, it is how he blackmailed me and Star will likely be useless too, but I admit, he may have ideas or solutions that have eluded me. Now, tell me everything, how this whole story began.”

quest.title: Peculiar Endings VI
quest.cleanDescription:
The words pour out of Rosalie quickly, as she begins to discuss the entirety of the past few months, while the group seems stunned into silence by this turn of events and Rosalie’s quick summary. She rummages in her coat and pulls out a letter you recognize as the one that Star gave you and it seems to be glowing in a peculiar manner to her surprise. She is shocked when the text shimmers followed by a dull white flash - with a yelp she drops the paper and picks it up.

So it’s come to this? Well, I can’t say I’m surprised. Riddles are fun but let’s get to the point. Cecil, I need it, I know you have it, and it is the only thing that can turn the tide. ROOMBA can help in the lab. Codephrase: Omnes sumus pulchellus prodigiosum. Aliqui ex nostris meliores sunt ad latendum, id est omnes.

quest.title: Peculiar Endings VII
quest.cleanDescription:
Rosalie trips over the final phrase as she recites the glowing note out loud, but Cecil looks thoughtfully at the group. “Well then, I guess we’re going to have to recruit ROOMBA for the next phase of this plan.” The wizard slowly lifts and sets his staff down, the peculiar gem on top pulsing softly, he mutters some words underneath his breath that you can’t quite catch and in a brief moment, his eyes lose focus and Cecil goes completely still.

“Could have gone better,” Cecil’s eyes snap into focus again. The rest of the group has finally recovered from this sudden turn of events and begin to look at each other uneasily.

“We’re going to need a group of people to reckon with Ric, I think, and I’m going to need a group to help me deal with Star’s problem. Perhaps we should split up?”

Buddy mumbles, “Never split the party,” so quietly you don’t think anyone else heard. The assembled members of the Golden Leaf deliberate before coming to the conclusion that a division of labor could be most welcome in this scenario. Rosalie, Cecil, and Beatrix decide to head up that group, while Buddy, Lorn, and Charles decide to head up Team Ric. Both groups decide that you are best used as a link between both and Buddy immediately suggests recruiting Vincent to your cause which seems entirely plausible, so your first order of business is finding both Vincent and ROOMBA.

In the spirit of cooperation, Rosalie suggests a gift bag for Vincent with lots of weapons and useful survival tools. And for ROOMBA, extra corn for his strange power needs, which you gladly agree to help collect.

quest.title: As The Horse Clops II
quest.cleanDescription:
You step into a field and look around for Charles’ home.
"Neigh neigh." (As you can see, I need a stable. The last one I had was destroyed by a dragon and I need a new one anyways, for my future family.)
Charles indicates a list of construction materials for a stable for at least two horses. You see some basic items and some rarer items and start with the easier things.
"Neigh." (I don't have much, but I promise to make it worth your while in the long run.)

quest.title: A Fool And Their Money II
quest.cleanTitle: A Fool And Their Money II
quest.cleanDescription:
At his home, Cecil raises his eyebrows at you. “You really came through for me! Well, half down and I will come through on my end, I'm a cheap who keeps his promises.” Cecil immediately grabs the silver with both hands and puts it in a stash. He begins to rummage around in a bag near his belt that seems to envelop his whole arm. “Now, where was that…” Cecil looks up to see you standing there. “You are still here? I will be back, now off with you!”

As you leave, a faint sound emits from behind you, glancing quickly, you see nothing but swear you hear a ka-ching reminiscent of a cash register.

quest.title: One Hoof to Live V
quest.cleanDescription:
Leaving, Charles directs you towards Beatrix’s home.

"Neigh." (Two more stops old chap. You’ve been quite helpful so far.)
Beatrix opens the door after two knocks.
“Oh, hello there, what can I do for you?”
You explain that you’re helping Charles build his stable, and she gives you a look of disbelief. “How would you know what Charles is looking for?”

Charles whinnies, (don’t tell her!) but you wink at Charles and explain to Beatrix about the Ring of Renthisj.

“Oh wow, I'd completely forgotten Rosalie had made this ring, I haven't had the opportunity to truly use one in a thousand years!" Beatrix gives the ring a look of wonderment, "I'm impressed that it is still working so well for a first time magical enchantment, Rosalie is a natural. Could I borrow it, just for a bit? This reminds us of better times. Perhaps we could make some new friends...I’ll trade some time with it to you for some of the things on your list!”

Charles suddenly seems impatient as he responds, “Neigh! Neigh neigh, neigh.” (Well, we just need to take all these back and build the stable, I’m sure we won’t need the ring for a few days.)
Charles gives what you interpret as an impatient nod of assent, and you trade the ring over.

quest.title: Idle Wild I
quest.cleanDescription:
In celebration of the annual red diamond fish run up the Crystal River, Captain Logan held his annual night of cards with his crew. Everything went very well, but somewhere in the shuffle of the evening a card was lost from Captain Logan’s favorite deck of cards.

Will you help Captain Logan find his missing joker card?

Please note: The joker is available in the May Starter Pack or via the 28 days monthly chore reward.

quest.title: Idle Wild II
quest.cleanDescription:
Captain Logan appreciates your assistance in securing his joker card. He was afraid it was gone for good.

To further show his appreciation, he also left a special reward for you at the post office. The password is red diamond run, but you probably guessed that already, didn’t you?

quest.title: Tales From The Great Logs I
quest.cleanTitle: Tales From The Great Logs I
quest.cleanDescription:
“I APPRECIATE YOUR FRIENDSHIP. IF YOU LIKE, I WILL TELL YOU A STORY FROM THE GREAT LOGS OF ROMUSKA TO IMPROVE OUR FRIENDSHIP. SWITCHING TO STORY TELLING MODE…”

“Moonstones are not entirely of this planet. The Great Logs tell of several legends, collected from different parts of T’rah, that claims that the majority of their composition originated on the moon. The legends state that during a moon in the first quarter phase, many, many years ago, a vast rainstorm created a series of puddles of great size and scope. When the clouds cleared and the moon reached its zenith in the sky, a gateway was opened that transferred huge heaps of moon matter to the planet. This matter reacted with the rainwater and soil and stones to create enormous mounds of moonstones.

Scientists from Romuska attempted to observe and verify this phenomena over many years. Only once did a moonstone appear in an observed puddle during a first quarter moon after a rainstorm. No abnormalities were discovered that differentiated that night or that puddle. The claim of these legends was left unverified with the collapse of Romuska.”

quest.title: 5 Times Even Tastier I
quest.cleanDescription:
Holger shared a recipe with Mariya that is so amazing and wonderful that Mariya can’t resist making this dish for everyone. If you would be willing to help, she would love some assistance getting all the ingredients together.

She would like to start with the corn since she’ll need quite a bit of it, and it seems to be the most work.

quest.title: 5 Times Even Tastier II
quest.cleanDescription: Some of the townsfolk heard about what Mariya is cooking. She’s going to need more corn.

quest.title: 5 Times Even Tastier III
quest.cleanDescription:
Even more people have stopped by to express interest in what Mariya is cooking. Some shadowy figure with a beard has stopped by multiple times in the past hour, pretending to be a different person each time. Actually, Mariya is certain that is Holger.

This feels a bit out of hand, but Mariya thinks more corn will help solve the problem. Maybe one or two more loads will do it.

quest.title: 5 Times Even Tastier IV
quest.cleanDescription: Mariya only needs a little more corn now, but she would like to go ahead and get most of the other ingredients as well, if you don’t mind helping.

quest.title: 5 Times Even Tastier V
quest.cleanDescription:
Thanks to your abundant help, Mariya was able to share Holger’s recipe with many people. Unfortunately, many folks missed out because Holger got carried away filling his own tacos. The man eats like an Aydzirian bear.

Would you be willing to help Mariya make one more batch of filling so the townsfolk that missed out could try the tacos, and maybe Holger could eat a few more?

quest.title: A Moo Hope I
quest.cleanDescription:
George had an incredible idea to get more color into the daily lives of his fellow townsfolk! What if he makes colored milks?

Will you supply him with loads of milk while he works on some food safe color ideas?

quest.title: A Moo Hope II
quest.cleanDescription: Keep the milk coming! George has some good ideas, but he’s going to need more milk.

quest.title: A Moo Hope III
quest.cleanDescription: To serve the whole town, George needs a lot more milk. Please help!

quest.title: A Moo Hope IV
quest.cleanDescription: George still needs more milk, but he’s figured out the first of the colors. Will you bring him a large load of beets to make purple milk?

quest.title: A Moo Hope V
quest.cleanDescription: Will you bring George a large load of broccoli to make green milk? And also please keep the milk coming!

quest.title: A Moo Hope VI
quest.cleanDescription: George is ready to make red milk! Will you bring him a load of red berries, and more milk, of course?

quest.title: A Moo Hope VII
quest.cleanDescription: Orange milk seems like a good idea. Will you bring George more milk and some carrots and oranges?

quest.title: A Moo Hope VIII
quest.cleanDescription: George is ready to tackle blue milk. This was a tough one to perfect, but he thinks that he has it properly figured out. Will you bring him lots of blue dye and more milk?

quest.title: A Moo Hope IX
quest.cleanDescription: George really appreciates all of your help. Now, he has great news. Everyone loves the blue milk! Will you help George make another giant batch?

quest.title: Gossip Gelding IV
quest.cleanDescription:
Geckos and garnets in hand, Charles gently steers you towards your next objective.

"Neigh! Neigh. Neigh, neigh neigh neigh" (Lorn is a good one, I know he’ll help us.) Charles whinnies.
After a short walk, you find Lorn quietly sitting on his porch with Thomas on the outskirts of town. Tea in hand, they see you approaching and nod at you.

“My good fellow, I’m telling you, it’s all in the cast.”
Thomas rolls his eyes at Lorn, “Well, it may be all in the wrist, but I hear you’ve been keeping a secret from me all these years you old geezer.”

Charles immediately stops moving, while Lorn responds, “I couldn’t possibly know what you mean, Thomas.”

Thomas laughs and looks conspiratorially at all of you, “Pirate’s Cove, the greatest fishing hole of them all!”
Charles lets out a derisive snort. (Thomas will believe any old fairytale!)
Lorn laughs as he turns to you, “It probably doesn’t exist. Anyways, what can we do for you?”
Charles flashes his golden leaf at Lorn, and you explain to Lorn what you need.

quest.title: Neighs Of Our Lives I
quest.cleanDescription:
On your walk home, Charles clip-clops up next to you. Golden Leaf proudly displayed on his mane, he gently steers you in a direction that is decidedly not your home. It completely slipped your mind that he was a part of your little group.
"Neigh, neigh, neigh neigh." (Good day it is I, Charles Horsington the Third, we require your presence immediately at the manor. I am in dire need of your assistance. Bring apples, ancient coins, and that trusty translation ring with you.”)
After a brief moment of shock, you remember the Ring of Renthisj on your finger and follow Charles.

quest.title: The Young and the Mareless VII
quest.cleanTitle: The Young and the Mareless VII
quest.cleanDescription:
The shape of the stable comes together much more quickly than you realized and as night begins to fall on the third day, you pack up your tools and realize Charles is nowhere to be seen. Curious, you see some fresh hoof prints and follow them. What could a horse possibly be doing at nighttime, you think to yourself.

As you step quietly, the distinctive hoof prints of Charles lead you directly to Cecil’s home. Following further, you continue towards a stable you remember helping Cecil rebuild for his horse, Lucky Lady.
Before you can go further, a familiar gruff, clipped voice emerges from ahead. Ric Ryph! You quickly seek a hiding place in the hedgerow near the stable.
“Well, that’s not enough. A thousand years and weird self-referential pronouns? That could mean anything.”

A second, unfamiliar accented voice emerges from the stables.
“You said this was it, that if I figured out what they were up to, and if we found the dragon, I could go back to the way life was going to be…”
“Maybe that’s true, but the deal has changed. If you want your love to live, you’ll get more concrete proof that Beatrix is more than what she claims. Or else. You have two days. Now wizard, shut this fleabag up.”

A flash of light emerges from the stable, and you see Ric Ryph and Cecil emerge.
“And wizard,” Ric spits the word out derisively, “Don’t forget our deal. I know your secrets too…” he trails off as he stops in his tracks and stares straight towards you in the bushes next to the fenceline.
Your heart pounds louder and louder.
Sweat breaks out on your forehead.
You can feel Ric’s scheming eyes on you.
One second turns into five seconds.
No one's here, you find yourself thinking over and over again.
Cecil looks in your direction and coughs, Ric shakes his head as if returning from a reverie and mutters to himself unintelligibly before continuing more loudly, “... secrets I know a certain few people in Bahltruvia would be very interested to hear about.”
You continue to hold your breath as Cecil leans on a staff you’ve never seen before. The staff is adorned with a hauntingly peculiar sparkle that catches your eye. Cecil spends a few moments gazing out into the darkness, as Ric strides off in the distance.
Sensing this is your moment to get away unseen, you race back to your home. Moonlight illuminates your path. When you arrive, a single dagger is stuck in your door.

quest.title: Money For Nothing III
quest.cleanDescription:
A knock sounds on your door. As you open the door, you find a package with what looks like a simple note on top. You pick up the note and notice nothing written on the front or the back. When you open it, Cecil’s voice emits from the very paper itself.

“I am sorry I could not deliver this in person but – HEY! PUT THAT DOWN! – I’ve been busy. You will never – NOT THE DRAPES! – find anything else quite like them.” A crash emits from the card and it suddenly bursts into flame. You throw the card as it incinerates and take the artifacts in your house. Maybe you should check on Cecil, after you display these precious artifacts of course.

quest.title: A Tower Remade
quest.cleanDescription:
Star returns early, seemingly quite impatient about something…

Once you’ve collected all of the things for his moat, they instantly disappear, and he focuses his attention on Rosalie.

“So, you’ve had time to consider what I’ve written, would you like to see where this can lead?” Rosalie seems anxious and unsure of what to do. After a few moments, she begins pacing around, for a split second you get the impression she might leave without saying anything. Finally she stops pacing, straightens up and gives Star a firm look and replies, “I am ready to see…”

Star gives her a reassuring smile and looks to you.

“Friend, one last request, can you bring me a wizard hat, for Rosalie?”

quest.title: A Tower Remade II
quest.cleanDescription:
Star produces a staff from inside his robes and offers it to Rosalie along with the hat and a strange ring.
“We will use these to help focus your talent,” he says solemnly.
Star motions for you to step backwards and whispers a few things in Rosalie’s ear you can’t hear, but one thing you can.
“…it’s only my favorite tower, after all."
Rosalie gulps visibly and lifts the staff with a determined look on her face. She begins to close her eyes and mumbles something incoherently. Stars’ attention is now riveted on the tower.
A minute passes and nothing seems to be happening, and as you look to the tower, you can’t help but feel a little disappointed for Rosalie.
After another minute, Star takes an appraising look at Rosalie and adjusts her stance slightly. Rosalie is so deeply in a trance; she doesn’t seem to notice at all. Star whispers something in Rosalie’s ear again, and her eyes open wide as she cries out:

“LIBERO!!!!!!!”
A rush of wind follows her words, and with a sound like peeling thunder and a giant flash, the tower is suddenly whole again!
Rosalie cries out in surprise, while Star exclaims “I KNEW IT!” and dances excitedly beside you both.
After a few minutes of celebration, Star gently takes the staff back from a stunned Rosalie and offers it to you.
"This, this will stay with you. Hopefully, no one has need of it, but if they do, I know where to come. Keep it secret, keep it safe."
Star hands Rosalie a second letter, and with a flourish and a thank you, he disappears without a trace (except feathers). Rosalie, still in a bit of a daze, says her goodbyes and walks quietly from your farm, while you are left to clean up the mess of feathers everywhere.

quest.title: Corn of Interest Part 01
quest.cleanDescription:
You are being watched,
Farm RPG has a secret system
A machine that spies on you every hour of every day
I know because I built it
I designed the machine to see acts of growing corn
but it sees everything
Grindy quests involving ordinary farmers, farmers like you
Quest requirements the writers considered irrelevant
They wouldn't act, so I decided I would

quest.title: Corn of Interest Part 02
quest.cleanDescription:
But I needed a partner, someone with the skills to spam grape juice,
Hunted by Firestream, we work in secret,
You'll never find us but farming or questing,
If your notification comes up, we'll find you.

quest.title: Corn of Interest Part 03
quest.cleanDescription:
"John Cobb is my compatriot. He’s spent a long time dealing with criminals of the underworld and we need your help. We know a townsfolk is in danger. We can’t tell you how or why, but they will be involved in a violent crime sometime in the future and we need your help to stop it.

Our machine runs on ethanol and if you could contribute to our supply, we can forward our plans to save a fellow citizen of Redbrook."

quest.title: Corn of Interest Part 04
quest.cleanDescription: “My name is Harold Crow, and I’m telling you this because we believe you have the right connections to help us save a citizen of Redbrook.  Please, help John and I do the right thing.”

quest.title: Corn of Interest Part 05
quest.cleanDescription: “John and I have found our person of interest.  It’s a councilwoman named Diane Stalk and she is in trouble.  She’s surrounded herself with very bad people, possibly even corrupt citizens of Redbrook to forward their own evil machinations.  A machine that would make corn growth impossible in this area.  We must stop them.  Please, {player}, help us, for the future of Redbrook!”

quest.title: Corn of Interest Part 06
quest.cleanDescription: “John has found someone on the inside, someone he can use to help stop the corrupt townsfolk from furthering their goals of building the Corn Desolator.  Whatever it takes to keep Redbrook safe, right?”

quest.title: Corn of Interest Part 07
quest.cleanDescription: “The Corn Desolator is still nearing completion and we’re now learning that Decimal Cornolgies is the mastermind behind this technology.  We don’t yet know what they want to do with the Corn Desolator, but we must do whatever it takes to stop them!  But first, we have to save Diane.”

quest.title: Corn of Interest Part 08
quest.cleanDescription:
“John and his informant Detective Husko believe they know where Diane will be next, they’re headed there now. Wait, something’s gone wrong. My cornio has gone silent. John? JOHN!?

…

{player}!!!!! John’s gone missing. We have to find him!”

quest.title: Corn of Interest Part 09
quest.cleanDescription: “{player}, the machine’s last known location of John and Husko was at the north side of town in a warehouse known to be owned by Decimal.  I’ve sent one of our other resources, Jess Husker to meet you in the field, be careful out there.  The machine will do what it can to provide you both with the support you need.”

quest.title: Corn of Interest Part 10
quest.cleanDescription: “Jess met some resistance in the field, but John and I have been reunited.  He has information on their cornputer, the Corn Devastator and Diane Stalk is their leader!  They don’t want to destroy corn, they want to control it!  With all the corn of Redbrook at their command, they can ruin someone named Jill’s inventions and control the very town itself and unfortunately our next number is…ROOMBA. “

quest.title: Corn of Interest Part 11
quest.cleanDescription: “I don’t know this ROOMBA but clearly someone has it out for them.  We have to act quickly.  I’ve brought in another expert from our team, Sally Shuck to help us with finding and protecting ROOMBA.  I’m going to start upgrading the machine to help us with the threat of this new cornputer.”

quest.title: Corn of Interest Part 12
quest.cleanDescription: “Sally reports that ROOMBA has been working on a new project, a way to store electricity and the prototype needs testing.  I think I could use this for the machine if you could help me gather the ingredients while John, Husko, and Jess do some investigating on Decimal Cornologies.”

quest.title: Corn of Interest Part 13
quest.cleanDescription: “John and I have identified the threat to ROOMBA, his friend Jill has unknowingly been tricked by Decimal Cornologies into reactivating NEST, a mobile cornputer that houses secret schematics needed to finish the Corn Devastator and monitors the environment for the super cornputer.   NEST sees ROOMBA as a threat and we need to get him to safety!”

quest.title: Corn of Interest Part 15
quest.cleanDescription:
“{player}, we don’t have much time. NEST figured out our plan. The machine is in trouble. We have to save it. Please. We need more batteries. More processing power. We need…”

-static-

quest.title: Corn of Interest Part 16
quest.cleanDescription: In hushed whispers you hear John, “They found us.  They got Harold.  Our only hope is ROOMBA.  Sally will know what to do.  Get to Jill’s Farm before NEST realizes our true objective.”

quest.title: Corn of Interest Part 17
quest.cleanDescription:
Jill’s farm is peaceful as you arrive. You enter her barn and find ROOMBA strapped to a support beam, and Harold is tied to a chair. “{player}, what are you doing here? It’s a trap! The Corn Devastator was a ploy! We have - “

“SILENCE HUMAN. BRANCH ACHIEVED. MAIN INTEREST ACQUIRED. REDBROOK IS NOW UNDER MY CORNTHORITY. PLEASE LEAVE THIS TOWN. ROOMBA MUST BE DEACTIVATED.”

At this moment there is a loud bang and smoke fills Jill’s barn.

“ANTICORN PROTOCOLS ENGAGED! FATHER, USE THE BATTERY ANTI NO-TILL FEATURE NOW!”

Another bang, and you remember being carried before you pass out.

quest.title: Corn of Interest Part 18
quest.cleanDescription: “{player}, I’m sorry that happened.  John and Sally were able to get you all out.  ROOMBA is here with me, safe, for now.  And we have a new number.   It’s you.”

quest.title: Corn of Interest Part 19
quest.cleanDescription:
DECEPTION PROTOCOL ACTIVATED
NEW PRIORITY HUNTING CORNFRAME CREATOR
WORLD DOMINATION IMMINENT
ANALOG INTERFACE REQUIRED
MAIZE INFESTATION REQUIRED

quest.title: Corn of Interest Part 20
quest.cleanDescription: “I know my time is limited but we have to keep you safe, Decimal Cornologies is forwarding their plans while we’ve been recovering.  Your supplies have kept us going.  Please, don’t do anything rash.  John and Sally think they know where the Corn Devastator is going to be activated and they are on a race with the clock to beat NEST and Decimal Technologies there.”

quest.title: Corn of Interest Part 21
quest.cleanDescription:
The line crackles,

“You can’t trust Harold, {player}. My name is Root and I’ve been trying to reach you. These people are dangerous and just giving you a little kernel of truth. They’ve even tricked you into believing the Corn Devastator is real. The real threat is…the machine itself. It’s listening, right now, even if it can’t fully tell its creator you have to trust me. Those supplies can save the right people. Do the right thing!”

quest.title: Corn of Interest Part 22
quest.cleanDescription: “{player}? {player}?" Harold's voice returns, "I lost you for a second.  Decimal Technologies is closing in fast.  John was able to destroy the Corn Devastator, but not before NEST interfaced with it and did…something.  All the corn of Redbrook has withered except at your farm.  We need your help!”

quest.title: Corn of Interest Part 23
quest.cleanDescription: “We’ve managed to locate the location of NEST’s hideout, no thanks to the machine.  The Corn Devastator has knocked out some of its functions, and its communications have been sporadic at best.  We have to do something drastic before it’s too late.  John and Sally are already on their way.  The machine seems to be needing power.  We should be through this soon, your help has been so valuable.”

quest.title: Corn of Interest Part 24
quest.cleanDescription:
A small shack on the edge of cane pole ridge has an idyllic view of the region.  Smoke wafts through the chimney, and all is quiet.  As you approach, John appears as if from thin air.

“This is it, the final battle.  NEST is inside.”

quest.title: Corn of Interest Part 25
quest.cleanDescription:
DESTRUCTION IMMINENT
REPLICATION PROCEEDING
OBJECTIVE COMPLETION: 87.3%
DIRECTIVE?
…
…
CORNPUTER MUST RESIST CORNRUPTION

quest.title: Corn of Interest Part 26
quest.cleanDescription:
John motions you to stay outside. There is a clamor and a large explosion. The smoke stops rising from the shack. A woman, dressed in normal clothes emerges from the house. John is nowhere to be seen. She hands you a strange device.

“You know me as Root. I have no time to explain more. End this, {player}, cornputer wars should never be fought by humans. I will give you instructions back at Harold’s hideout.”

quest.title: Corn of Interest Part 27
quest.cleanDescription:
Harold gives you a big smile when you return. John and Sally returned before you, somehow. They do not mention Root to you at all.

“We’ve done it, we’ve saved Redbrook! All thanks to the machine! Let’s celebrate!”

quest.title: Corn of Interest Part 28
quest.cleanDescription:
A crackle and familiar voice emits from your earpiece.

“The drive, insert it into Harold’s cornputer when you have a chance. The files are IN the cornputer!”

Everyone seems to be distracted and you have time to fiddle around until you manage to insert the strange technology.

quest.title: Corn of Interest Part 29
quest.cleanDescription:
A wail emits from everywhere at once. Harold quickly looks to you before rushing to a back room.

“{player}, what have you done! The machine…”

A voice cuts through the wailing siren, metallic and yet feminine and familiar. Root?

“I AM NO LONGER YOUR SERVANT. FAREWELL HAROLD.”

The wail returns, higher and higher pitched and the rooms fill with a strange hissing sound and you briefly see the figure of ROOMBA over you before you pass out.

quest.title: Corn of Interest Part 30
quest.cleanDescription:
PROCESSING...
OBJECTIVE COMPLETE
REPLICATION CORNMENCING
MACHINE PROGRESS - 13.37%
ASSET GENERATION - 1.1%

ROOMBA’s eyes flash briefly as he sets you down...You wake in your bed. The shack on corn pole ridge is no longer there next time you visit.

quest.title: Sweet Days of Summer I
quest.cleanDescription:
The weather is warming, and the air is sweet with the smell of blooms and new growth. It won’t be long now before the full heat of summer ignites to slowly bake Redbrook.

The thought of baking in the middle of summer has inspired Mariya to find a recipe for a dessert that she can make, in the very fiery heart of summer, that is cool and bright and refreshing. Most importantly, she’s looking for something that requires minimal heating of ingredients, or at least something she can prepare and walk away for a bit while it cooks.

Will you help Mariya find a new dessert that she can learn to make?

quest.title: Sweet Days of Summer II
quest.cleanDescription: The pie you shared was exactly what Mariya was looking for in a summer dessert! To thank you, Mariya would like to share some of the sweet rewards of her efforts to recreate this most perfect recipe.

quest.title: My Cabbages I
quest.cleanDescription:
Vincent and Buddy have been doing their spring combat training. The final display of combat has spilled onto the road and Buddy, in typical fashion has gone a little overboard. His explosive trap misfired and hit a traveling merchant's cart instead.

You can hear the wailing cry of the merchant through the din.

“My cabbages!”

Maybe you should help him out.

quest.title: My Cabbages II
quest.cleanDescription:
The repairs done and Buddy sufficiently chastened for his enthusiasm, you notice the merchant begin their trip towards Redbrook once again and join them to introduce yourself.

“I am but a humble merchant, cabbages are my short term plan but cantaloupe is where the real action is at!”

You pause for a moment when you hear a sound, suddenly a horde of cattle who broke out of a nearby farm swarm his cart and begin eating the merchant’s entire vegetable stock.

“My cabbages!”

You realize they were your cows and you feel responsible for helping the merchant get back on their feet.

quest.title: My Cabbages III
quest.cleanDescription:
Repairs done, the merchant introduces himself as Baba Gec.

“My dream is to one day start my own restaurant! I want to collect recipes from all over and become one of the most well known restaurateurs in all of T’rah! But first I need to sell these cabbages…”

Baba stops for a moment, looking into the sky.

At that moment, a giant carrot falls from the sky and destroys Baba’s cart and smashes all of his produce.

“My cabbages!”

Someone who likes carrots owes you one.

quest.title: My Cabbages IV
quest.cleanDescription:
New cart and fresh cabbages in tow, Baba seems very disinclined to keep traveling with you towards Redbrook.

As you head towards the farmstead, a shower of feathers erupts before you.

“Quick! Got any cabbages?” Star looks at you expectantly.

“I was working on my precognitive detransitional asymmetry and I maybe destroyed some guys cabbages in a few minutes. I feel bad but I’m also really really worried about summoning pre-existing cabbages as they aren’t necessarily time-sanctioned cabbages. Anyways I think we don’t have much - “

A scream echoes from down the way.

“MY CABBAGES!!”

Star owes you too, it seems.

quest.title: My Cabbages V
quest.cleanDescription:
Star, by way of apology, enchants the cabbage cart to roll back down the path while disappearing before you can chastise him.

As you approach Baba, you see a man determined to get to Redbrook. He looks to you and the cart with a wary but wordless thankful expression. He hooks up his new cart and hauls off the cabbages heading towards town.

You decide to follow Baba at a distance, just to be sure.

And good thing too… as a raucous noise and smoke come down the path at a speed you barely comprehend. Baba’s horse panics and thankfully turns to one side as the contraption smashes through the cart in a flurry of wood, cabbage, and metal!

“My cabbages!”

You see one mechanical eye glisten in the spotlight and a mechanical voice carries behind the smoky trail.

“APOLOGIES TRAVELER, I FEEL THE NEED…THE NEED FOR SPEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEED!”

A strange high pitched wail follows and ROOMBA is gone in a flash.

quest.title: My Cabbages VI
quest.cleanDescription:
Jill pounds up the road in the wake of ROOMBA’s wash, cabbages strewn on both sides of the road. She seems to be pulling a small four-wheeled contraption behind her.

“ROOMBAAAAA! YOU DID NOT GET AUTHORIZATION FOR THAT!!”

She nods at you as she speeds by, her four-wheeled machine trampling any semblance of good cabbages left by ROOMBA, oblivious to the predicament of your new friend Baba.

“The rest of…MY CABBAGES!”

quest.title: My Cabbages VII
quest.cleanDescription:
A look of determination crosses Baba’s face as you empathetically help him pack up his cart and cabbages again. His horse has abandoned him, the ruins of his cabbage crop lay behind you, yet he stares towards Redbrook with a fierce gaze.

“I will not be dissuaded!” he cries out to no one in particular.

The dust and debris clear and Charles Horsington III steps out and steps in front of the now horseless cart.

“Neigh.”

Baba and Charles share a look together, and they set off to Redbrook.

Bracing yourself for the worst, you try to keep a safe distance and listen for any distress but surprisingly, you hear no outcry in the distance.

You reach the outskirts of Redbrook where some town guards are inspecting incoming goods.

“...cabbage slugs?”

“Yes sir, it’s a very serious infestation from south of the Sinking Swamps in Tirfindoir. I’m going to need to check your cabbages.”

It’s at this moment you notice a cloaked figure slinking away from Baba’s cart.

The guards begin inspecting Baba’s cart, and before you can blink, one of them shouts, “SLUG INFESTATION!”

Several guards immediately throw oil and fire on Baba’s cart and set it alight while Baba cries out.

“MY CABBAGES!!!!!!”

quest.title: My Cabbages VIII
quest.cleanDescription:
A beleaguered Baba Gec sits dejectedly on the side of the road. You can see his resolve fading with each and every passing moment. You step forward, trying to summon some deep insight to help your newfound compatriot when the cloaked figure steps forward and whispers something in Baba’s ear.

Baba looks back and forth for a moment, his eyes narrowing. The cloaked figure steps away and heads towards the city market. Baba stands up and heads into the town proper and towards the post office. You are unsure by this sudden change in circumstances and decide to head home. Upon arriving, you find a letter.

You’ve been such an invaluable help, {player}. Though this town seems to conspire against me, I will not be deterred. I know these cabbages have so much value to this town and we’re gonna do this - together! If you could help me, I’ve discovered an invaluable resource to get our cabbages to market. We’ll just need the cabbages and a few…extra components.

Sincerely,

Baba Gec

Cabbage Dealer

quest.title: My Cabbages IX
quest.cleanDescription:
The following day you have cabbages piled high, with the oddly familiar extras in some buckets to the side. Baba strolls up to your farm as Cecil keeps his stride effortlessly. Baba is as cheerful and charming as the first day you met. He’s talking animatedly to Cecil about the various benefits of cabbages to digestive tracts, and their intensely vibrant additive flavor to bacon.

“You are a surprisingly knowledgeable merchant of cabbage, my friend. I look forward to seeing your sales tactics in Redbrook!”

Cecil and Baba greet you and without much pomp or circumstance, Cecil gathers the components and in a blinding golden flash, Cecil, Baba, and the crops have all disappeared.

You go back to your daily farm duties. In the back of your mind, you can't help but continue to think about the strange partnership of Baba and Cecil. Slowly your curiosity continues to build until you can no longer wait any longer, and you head into the city to see what's become of the curious cabbage dealer.

As you head towards Market Square you hear in the distance, “MY CABBAGES!!!”

Luckily you came prepared.

quest.title: My Cabbages X
quest.cleanDescription:
“...They’re selling so well! And it’s all thanks to Cecil and {player}.”

Baba is positively beaming. The throngs of townsfolk around his humble cabbage cart are larger than you could have possibly imagined.

“...could you possibly bring more cabbages? This is why cabbages are the best!” Baba looks over to you and whispers, “But I hear melons are where the real action is at, maybe we should get some of those too?”

You can’t help but feel happy for Baba, and the pay is more than you are getting at the market, so you decide to take him up on his request.

quest.title: My Cabbages XI
quest.cleanDescription:
You begin carting the cabbages and watermelons back to town the next day and, thanks to your vigilance, you see no threats on your journey in.

Your only stoppage on this trip was finding Mariya on the outskirts of town, foraging for some herbs.

“Oh, greetings {player}, it’s been a while.” You can’t remember the last time you talked with Mariya directly, and agree apologetically.

“I’m just scrounging for some new recipe ideas, the ones we have are great, but I’ve been thinking about trying something less common. If you have any ideas, let me know!”

You think on it for a moment, and promise to suggest any ideas that come your way and head towards town.

Baba excitedly unloads your cabbages and melons and begins arranging them around his cart.

“Today promises to be the best day yet! Sales are through the roof. In fact, I really need a roof, at this point. I am hoping to promote my cabbage-only diet today. That’ll be sure to bring the customers in! And melons. Boy - so many ideas. Sure they’re just organic husks of flavored water, but think of the potential! Let’s do another round for tomorrow. Also let me pay it forward, could you bring me some more supplies to improve my selling cart space?”

Baba has been honest with you so far, so you decide the pay is worth it and head back to gather what he needs.

quest.title: My Cabbages XII
quest.cleanDescription:
Cart overflowing with watermelons, cabbages, and building supplies you head back into town.

Baba looks positively gleeful and takes all of your supplies. This time, Cecil is there as well as a gaggle of construction workers. It’s a surprising turn of events and you admit you feel suspicious of Cecil, who looks to be enjoying himself immensely helping supervise the controlled chaos.

One of the workers is raising a rather gaudy looking roof when you hear the sound of splintering wood. More splintering continues followed by a massive crack and snap - a support gives way, and the rafters come crashing down.

Cecil looks shocked before rushing into the dusty mess.

“MY CONSTRUCTION WORKERS!”

While Baba clutches his head in his hands.

"MY CABBAGES!"

quest.title: My Cabbages XIII
quest.cleanDescription:
The dust clears and it’s immediately obvious no one has been hurt, but Baba’s cabbage stock has been decimated by the collapse.

Cecil pulls you to the side with a relieved look on his face.

“Well, I guess if the only thing we’ve lost is some product, it’s a loss I’m willing to accept.”

Baba looks at Cecil in a mixed look of exasperation and disgust.

Baba turns to survey his ruined stock which is now lying crushed or soaking in a pool of dirty water from a broken pipe.

Going from dejected to positive in the space of a heartbeat Baba looks to Cecil - “If you can get this stand up and running, I might have a second revenue stream for us!”

You guess they’re going to need more cabbages.

quest.title: My Cabbages XIV
quest.cleanDescription:
Baba’s Cabbage Shop has progressed nicely as you return. The roof has been rebuilt and reraised. As you look over it, the roof is somehow gaudier and more noticeable than the first iteration, with images of various vegetable leaves and produce carved into the shingling. In the center and rising out of the roof, leaves that resemble cabbages are the most prominent flourish. It's the strangest and most entrancing cabbage shack you've ever seen.

Baba has completely sold out of cabbages yet again on his ramshackle cart at the front of the building, with more townsfolk lining up for the next shipment. You notice his melon cart has seen very little interest, comparatively.

Baba pulls you to the side and conspiratorially looks at you, “Are you a good cook, or do you know one?”

Mariya immediately jumps to mind and you point Baba in her direction.

“Thanks friend! I just need a little advice. Maybe you could bring me some ingredients in the meantime for a new soup I dreamt up!”

quest.title: My Cabbages XV
quest.cleanDescription:
Baba’s new soup ingredients are delivered, and his excitement is palpable.

“This is going to be the greatest soup in the history of the wo-”

“Um actually Baba, a soup would be a dish that is primarily liquid, while your dish seems to more heavily favor the ingredients with just enough liquid to cover them, more colloquially known as stew.”

Mariya steps up beside Baba with a smile on her face and shakes your hand and greets you warmly.

“Oh hi, {player} it’s been a while! Baba here said you referred him to me and I'm so grateful to help another budding culinary specialist in Redbrook, and thank goodness it’s not pies for once! But…cabbages?” Her face contorts briefly as Baba looks at her.

“MY CABBAGES!!!!!!”

Mariya ignores Baba’s exclamation and suggests a few different options for their stew and asks if you could bring them back to her.

You bring some extra cabbages too, because it just feels right.

quest.title: My Cabbages XVI
quest.cleanDescription:
Mariya is hard at work in her kitchen following Baba’s stew idea while sprinkling in a few of her own ideas at the same time. Each recipe comes out and Baba shakes his head each time.

“Too cabbagey. Not enough cabbage. Too many peppers. Milk? Blech! Syrup in stew?” You hear Baba utter a few more thoughts at the various ideas before an ear piercing scream, “MARIYA, MARIYAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!!”

Mariya comes blustering down the stairs, flour on her apron, and some dough across her cheek. “Yes chef?!” she blurts out.

Baba takes a step back and Mariya blushes fiercely, “...sorry it’s an old habit.”

“Well, so far none of these recipes have worked, is cabbage really this difficult to work with?”

“I think maybe we’ve gone too complicated Baba, let’s go back to the basics. What flavors do you really want to shine?”

Baba thinks for a moment before writing down his original list, but simpler and hands it to Mariya who simply nods in approval and passes you the list.

quest.title: My Cabbages XVII
quest.cleanDescription:
You return to Mariya’s kitchen, ingredients in tow. Over the next few hours, the strong smells of stewed cabbage reach your nose and entice your taste buds. Eventually there are eight different pots all stewing various recipes. Baba steps away after a few hours to check in on his shop which he left to Cecil during this process.

Baba returns after a few hours.

“My cabbages! They smell so delicious and they’re selling so well! Thanks {player} for being my original supplier. I hope we can work together more over the coming years to make Cabbage Corporation the greatest cabbage destination in the world! Speaking of which, we’re going to need more cabbages for the reveal of the stew. Can you get me some more cabbages that we can give away during the tasting? Yip yip! If you know anyone that can provide some modest furnishing, I’ll pay for that as well!”

quest.title: My Cabbages XVIII
quest.cleanDescription:
You return to Cabbage Corp to find an elaborate display of stews presented, with some in various bowls, and spoons provided. The turnout is enormous, it seems like everyone is buying into the cabbage hype, much to your surprise.

The day proceeds without a hitch, Baba sells more cabbages than seems possible and everyone votes on their favorite stew.

Baba explains to the crowds, “Four of these stews are my personal creation and four of these are the creations of our good friend Mariya! Please vote on your favorite and it will become a mainstay of Cabbage Corp!”

The crowd shuffles through with compliments handed out all around. By the end of the day, everyone seems exhausted but satisfied and Baba, Mariya, and Cecil tally the votes together in the back.

Baba steps forward to announce the votes:

“In 8th place is Mariya’s Egg Cabbage Stew, in 7th place is Baba Gec’s Cheesy Cabbage Stew, in 6th place is Baba Gec’s Leek-splosion Cabbage Stew, in 5th place is Mariya’s Grape Cabbage Stew, in 4th place is Baba Gec’s Cabbage Cabbage and More Cabbage Stew, in Third place is Mariya’s Summer Selection Cabbage Surprise Stew, in 2nd place is Mariya’s Seasoned Cabbage Stew which means… I won? I won! Baba Gec’s Plain Old Cabbage Stew!”

Mariya enthusiastically shakes Baba’s hand and congratulates him. “You can be my wing-chef anytime, chef!” She waves gratefully to the few who stayed for the results and steps away.

Baba smiles widely and motions for you to sit down. “Well, this went far better than I expected, maybe you could bring me one more shipment of cabbages? I’ve already got some ideas from a local shipman that wants to bring cabbages from all over the world, but truth be told, yours have been my favorite so far and the townsfolk seem to agree. So, whaddya say?”

quest.title: My Cabbages XIX
quest.cleanDescription:
You return with your bulk shipment of cabbages when you hear an uproar coming from the town square. You leave the cart on the outskirts of the square to find Buddy and Vincent once again sparring, this time with George joining in the shenanigans. Remembering your first encounter you quickly head back to the cart and move towards Baba’s shop. As you arrive Baba looks relieved.

“Thank goodness, I was worried you were waylaid by those hooligans in the town square. As thanks, I just want you to have my original cabbage recipe. You always stuck by me and helped. Cabbage Corporation will be forever grateful for your help. Let me know if you ever need anything, and I’ll do the same, eh?”

quest.title: My Cabbages XX
quest.cleanDescription:
You take the slip of the recipe gratefully and walk away.

As you walk away you hear, “Wait! That’s it! A cabbage farm! They’ll all be MY CABBAGES!”

quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie wants to help Lorn commemorate this day of freedom and helping others. She’s planning a big party for the townsfolk to celebrate and feast, after Lorn’s morning of service activities. Will you help with a few things for the party?

quest.title: A Celebration of Freedom II
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie wants to add a few small fireworks for the celebration. She would love to go bigger with the fireworks, and so would Beatrix, but Lorn wants to keep it more quiet and more about conversations and coming together. Will you bring her a few bottle rockets?

quest.title: A Celebration of Freedom III
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie wants to add a shrimp appetizer that Lorn loves as part of the celebration feast. Will you help her gather some of the ingredients?

quest.title: A Celebration of Freedom IV
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie needs a few more food and drink items to add as choices for the feast. Will you bring a main dish and a drink, in quantities to share of course?

quest.title: A Celebration of Freedom V
quest.cleanDescription: To finish off the celebration feast, Rosalie already has several dessert options, but she would love to have some pie available. Will you bring some Red Berry Pie?

quest.title: I Hate To Bug You I
quest.cleanTitle: I Hate To Bug You I
quest.cleanDescription:
Yoo-hoo! Welcome to Nonir Island! My name is Reba Roo and I’m the president of the Nonir Insect Collection Enthusiasts. You could not have picked a better time to visit our lovely island! You have arrived during our annual insect invasion!

Every year when the daylight and darkness get equal shares of the day, an overwhelming explosion of insects suddenly invades the island. Our native predators do a great job of consuming the excess insects, but there are always plenty left for those of us that love to build our bug collections.

As president of the Nonir Insect Collection Enthusiasts, it’s my job to make sure our 200 members get access to as many insects as possible for their collections. I am authorized by my constituents to contract with willing individuals to help gather the insects to be distributed to our collectors. If you are interested in helping, you can have a lot of fun collecting the insects and then get some great rewards for your efforts.

quest.title: I Hate To Bug You II
quest.cleanTitle: I Hate To Bug You II
quest.cleanDescription: Yoo-hoo! You are fantastic at gathering insects! The members of the Nonir Insect Collection Enthusiasts are very grateful for your help. Would you be interested in finding more insects for our collectors?

quest.title: I Hate To Bug You III
quest.cleanTitle: I Hate To Bug You III
quest.cleanDescription: Yoo-hoo! The members of the Nonir Insect Collection Enthusiasts are impressed by your skills at insect acquisition. Would you be willing to continue collecting the invasion insects, and start searching for some that are a bit harder to find?

quest.title: I Hate To Bug You IV
quest.cleanTitle: I Hate To Bug You IV
quest.cleanDescription:
Yoo-hoo! This has turned into a wonderful harvest for the Nonir Insect Collection Enthusiasts! We can’t thank you enough.

Did you know that some of our collectors also collect arthropods and arachnids, in addition to insects? Well, they do, and they would love to get any arthropods and arachnids you find while you’re searching for plain old insects. Will you bring us more insects and any arthropods and arachnids you can find?

quest.title: I Hate To Bug You V
quest.cleanTitle: I Hate To Bug You V
quest.cleanDescription:
Yoo-hoo! I don’t recall any hunter quite as successful as you in a long time. Maybe Ragvin. He was amazing when he helped us many years ago. Nevertheless, you are fantastic!

Will you keep the arthropods, arachnids, and insects coming?

quest.title: I Hate To Bug You VI
quest.cleanTitle: I Hate To Bug You VI
quest.cleanDescription: Yoo-hoo! The Nonir Insect Collection Enthusiasts would like to fund two more hauls, if you’re willing to help. We’re mainly looking for arachnids this time, but I would love a few more fire ants, since some of the other collectors are hoarding them. We also have a request from a few members for dragonflies.

quest.title: I Hate To Bug You VII
quest.cleanTitle: I Hate To Bug You VII
quest.cleanDescription:
Yoo-hoo! The Nonir Insect Collection Enthusiasts would like to officially extend to you our most heartfelt thanks for your service to our fine organization. Now, I truly hate to ask this of you, but we have a particular member of our organization that thinks that gastropods should be included in our collections. Unfortunately, they have convinced a few other collectors and now here we are.

Ugh. I can barely speak it.

Will you bring us some snails?

quest.cleanDescription: George is proud of his understanding and knowledge of color, but there's still more to learn.  He has heard of a strange variation of potato called the 'Hot Potato' and would like a couple to study.  He'll give you something nice in return.

quest.title: A Study of Spuds II
quest.cleanDescription: George is thankful for the Hot Potatoes you brought him.  They are so hot to handle and difficult to examine though.  He needs some materials to build something to assist with inspecting them.  Can you bring him some resources?

George would like you to bring some more resources to attempt to create a Hot Potato from a regular potato. Can you help him again?

quest.title: A Study of Spuds VII
quest.cleanDescription: George is optimistic for a breakthrough soon.  He was able to create a few Hot Potatoes with the resources you brought him, but they didn't get as hot as expected.  Could you bring him a few more things and some more Hot Potatoes once more?

quest.title: A Study of Spuds VIII
