“That was amazing! Did you see frank get buried? Everyone will be recovering from this snowball fight for a week.”

“We couldn’t have done this without you. And to thank you for all of your help to everyone in this great snowball war, we got together and made a little something special for you.”

questlines.title: Could One Occasion Kindly Involve Everyone?

quest.title: Could One Occasion Kindly Involve Everyone? I
quest.cleanTitle: Could One Occasion Kindly Involve Everyone? I
quest.cleanDescription:
Jill may have gotten herself into a spot of difficulty. She decided to organize a small gathering and share some of her family’s beloved cookies. It was going to be a small affair.

Unfortunately, when she asked Roomba to handle the invitations she said to invite all of their friends, because she assumed that Roomba would have a smaller set of friends than her own. Roomba did not. Roomba has an enormous group of friends. So many friends.

Now, Jill needs more cookies and milk than she planned on, by a very large margin. Roomba is baking as quickly as possible to help too, but it still won’t be enough. Will you lend a hand?

quest.title: Could One Occasion Kindly Involve Everyone? II
quest.cleanTitle: Could One Occasion Kindly Involve Everyone? II
quest.cleanDescription: Things are looking better, but Jill still needs more cookies and milk. Roomba has sooooo many friends.

quest.title: Could One Occasion Kindly Involve Everyone? III
quest.cleanTitle: Could One Occasion Kindly Involve Everyone? III
quest.cleanDescription: Isn’t it usually the case that only half of those invited show up for a party? How many people did Roomba actually invite? Jill is going to be making cookies all night if this keeps up. Will you keep bringing more milk and cookies to help?

quest.title: Could One Occasion Kindly Involve Everyone? IV
quest.cleanTitle: Could One Occasion Kindly Involve Everyone? IV
quest.cleanDescription: More milk and cookies, please! And thank you!

quest.title: Could One Occasion Kindly Involve Everyone? V
quest.cleanTitle: Could One Occasion Kindly Involve Everyone? V
quest.cleanDescription: We’ve done it! Everyone has milk and cookies, and no new guests have shown up in the last half hour. Jill is going to make one last batch to be safe. Will you bring one more batch too, to be extra safe?

quest.title: Could One Occasion Kindly Involve Everyone? VI
quest.cleanTitle: Could One Occasion Kindly Involve Everyone? VI
quest.cleanDescription:
Jill didn’t invite everyone over just to have milk and cookies and celebrate the holidays. This is also a surprise celebration of Roomba’s birthday!

Several months back, Roomba told Jill a story that included a lengthy account of the first time that Roomba’s control core was powered on. That first log in Roomba’s memory occurred on this day, a long, long time ago. So, this is Roomba’s birthday!

Jill planned to have Roomba’s favorite fuel ingredient as a birthday treat for all of the party guests, but she doesn’t have enough for all of Roomba’s friends that showed up. Will you bring more corn for everyone and a little more corn oil for Roomba?

quest.title: Could One Occasion Kindly Involve Everyone? VII
quest.cleanTitle: Could One Occasion Kindly Involve Everyone? VII
quest.cleanDescription: Jill really appreciates all your help. You made Roomba’s special day perfect.

quest.title: Ice Collections I
quest.cleanDescription: Cecil approaches you seeming quite desperate for some frozen specimens that have been appearing recently in various local ponds.  He offers to pay you back with some Frozen Large Nets he has collected.

quest.title: Ice Collections II
quest.cleanDescription: Cecil would like some frozen specimens from other areas like the Small Island and the Crystal River before it's too late!

quest.title: Ice Collections III
quest.cleanDescription: Cecil has one final request.  Could you go to the Emerald Beach and the Vast Ocean to find some other rare frozen specimens?

quest.title: Ice Covers Everything I
quest.cleanDescription:
“Have you ever gone ice fishing? It’s very much like regular fishing, but you usually have to cut through a thick layer of ice to get to the water and the fish. For your efforts, you can often find many new varieties of fish to catch.”

“Unfortunately, it rarely gets cold enough to freeze all the bodies of liquid around the Redbrook area. So I haven’t gotten to go ice fishing in years, and it doesn’t look like it will get cold enough this winter either.”

“However, I have an idea that could work to make it possible for us to have an opportunity to go ice fishing very soon. It may take a little magic and some tech, but I think it could work. Will you help me gather a few items to try an experiment?”

quest.title: Ice Covers Everything II
quest.cleanDescription:
“It’s working! It’s working!”

“With a lot of help from several of our friends, I have found a way that we can lower the temperature of a large body of liquid using ice enhanced nets. Now, it will take a lot of us working together, but with a little time we should get to do some true ice fishing very soon! I can’t wait!”

“One more thing about these ice enhanced nets: they can catch different varieties of fish that only show up in very frigid waters. So, use them wisely and enjoy a small taste of ice fishing as we freeze everything up.”

“Thanks again for your help! ”

quest.title: Crafting Is Easy I
quest.cleanDescription: Roomba has a plan to make use of all of the frozen fish bones that are available from everyone joining in the ice fishing efforts. If you catch any, please bring them and Roomba will exchange for them.

quest.title: Crafting Is Easy II
quest.cleanDescription: Roomba would appreciate your continued patronage of his frozen fish bones exchange, but he also needs a few more items. Will you bring these items?

quest.title: Crafting Is Easy III
quest.cleanDescription: Roomba has almost completed this crafting project, but still needs your help with a few last items. Will you bring Roomba some more frozen bones and few other things?

quest.title: Crafting Is Easy IV
quest.cleanDescription:
Santa will be very pleased that Roomba was able to return Dasher from the incandescent collected ether that accumulated atop Mount Banon. Dasher got stuck there after wandering off from Santa’s workshop.

Roomba appreciates your help and contributions. Crafting the collector of incandescent ether was easy with your assistance.

Now, will you take Dasher back to Santa?

quest.title: Exquisite Cuisine, Iced I
quest.cleanDescription:
Mariya heard about the wild idea that Beatrix had to freeze the lakes and ponds and rivers, enough to go ice fishing. If the plan works and you happen to catch any frozen spyfish, Mariya would love to have some. There is an absolutely wonderful dish she would like to prepare, that she had as a child. It can only be made with frozen spyfish.”

Will you bring Mariya some frozen spyfish?

quest.title: Exquisite Cuisine, Iced II
quest.cleanDescription:
The spyfish was delicious! Mariya is so grateful for your help.

If you find any more frozen spyfish, Mariya would love to have some to put on ice for later. :)

quest.title: A Cold Start I
quest.cleanDescription:
Borgen has decided to start the new year somewhere warm. He’s going to travel south past the Sinking Swamp, possibly to the Southern Reaches. He expects to find some good business ventures while he’s traveling.

Borgen would like to bring a few things to sell from Redbrook. To ensure the items last the long journey and stay fresh he would like everything to be frozen. Will you help him find some frozen items to take on his trip?

Note: The Frozen items requested come from Frozen Chest 01, which can be obtained from trading with other players, the 28-day Daily Chores reward, or the January Starter Pack (Open Frozen Chest 01 at the Locksmith)

quest.title: A Cold Start II
quest.cleanDescription: Borgen would like a few more frozen items to take on his trip, if you can find anything else for him.

quest.title: Best Served Thawed I
quest.cleanDescription: Mariya is in the process of making tomato sauce for a variety of different dishes. Yesterday, she heard from Beatrix that frozen tomatoes, when thawed with pepper juice, make the most flavorful sauce. Mariya would love to compare a frozen tomato based sauce with her regular tomato sauce recipe. Will you help her find some frozen tomatoes and loads of peppers?

quest.title: Best Served Thawed II
quest.cleanDescription: The sauce is amazing! However, Mariya wants to try one more experiment. Will you bring her some more frozen tomatoes and gold peppers instead of red peppers? Mariya thinks a gold pepper sauce may thaw the frozen tomatoes and impart a bit of magic.

quest.title: Best Served Thawed III
quest.cleanDescription:
It worked! This sauce is even better! Thank you so much for all the help.

Now, Mariya is ready to make a serious pot of sauce. Will you bring her a serious load of frozen tomatoes and gold peppers?

quest.title: Half a Million I
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie isn't sure that Redbrook can be considered a town anymore, by definition.  Can you believe there are 500,000 farmers around this place now?  Here's a little something to celebrate the occasion...

quest.title: Half a Million II
quest.cleanDescription: Since you've been here a bit, here's something else for you.  Thanks for being a part of our wonderful community!

quest.title: Half a Million III
quest.cleanDescription: You have been here long enough to see some of the growth we've had.  It's no wonder some of the roads around here are so congested.  Here, maybe these will be of some use to you.

quest.title: Half a Million IV
quest.cleanDescription: Looks like you are really well established here, but have a lot of work ahead of you!  Maybe these items will come in handy for you.

quest.title: Half a Million V
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie still has stuff laying around that isn't needed, will you take this stuff please?

quest.title: Half a Million VI
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie is really impressed with your efforts and the size of your farm.  Keep going!

quest.title: Half a Million VII
quest.cleanDescription: Wow, you are really at the top!  Still, maybe these items would be of some use?

quest.title: The Void and You I
quest.cleanDescription:
Have you ever wondered where items go when they don't have a home? I've been wondering that myself. Is it nothingness? Is it everythingness?

I'd like to cast a spell to see. Would you bring me a few very common items as a part of the spell composition?

quest.title: The Void and You II
quest.cleanDescription: Now that I've got these common items, I will need to juice up the spell with some rarer items to translocate the common ones.  I promise, this won't take long!

quest.title: The Void and You III
quest.cleanDescription: Everything seems to be coming together nicely.  I'll just need some much rarer items to anchor the spell and we will have a nice co-location of where these things are going!  I think...

quest.title: The Void and You IV
quest.cleanDescription:
POP!

"Well, that was unexpected." Rosalie finishes the spell and holds a strange purple bag in her hands.

"I have no idea what just happened, but here's some crystallized void in a bag for you. I have no idea what could be inside though..."

quest.title: Best Stored Frozen I
quest.cleanDescription:
Vincent heard about frozen crops from Beatrix, and he thinks they would be perfect for use at the school. The school uses loads of foodstuffs everyday, and anything that is healthy and that can be stored easily is going to make food preparation significantly easier.

Will you get a nice load of frozen crops together that the school can try out?

quest.title: Best Stored Frozen II
quest.cleanDescription: These frozen crops are perfect for storing and then using for meal preparation at the school. Will you help fill the school’s pantry? If you are willing to help, Vincent would like to break your deliveries into five individual loads to make it easier to get everything properly stowed in the pantry.

quest.title: Best Stored Frozen III
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent is ready for the second load.

quest.title: Best Stored Frozen IV
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent is ready for the third load of frozen crops.

quest.title: Best Stored Frozen V
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent is ready for the fourth load of frozen crops.

quest.title: Best Stored Frozen VI
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent is ready for the final load of frozen crops.

quest.title: Best Stored Frozen VII
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent appreciates all of your help. He just needs one more thing to make this plan work well. Will you bring a large load of peppers?

quest.title: Love At First Bite I
quest.cleanDescription:
Do you think you could find a love potion? All the talk about love at this time of year got Thomas thinking. Maybe a little love potion poured in the water could help him catch more fish. If you manage to find a love potion, will you bring it to Thomas?

Note: The item requested can be found in the Heart-shaped Box 01, which can be obtained from trading with other players, the 25-day Daily Chores reward, or the February Starter Pack (Open Heart-shaped Box 01 at the Locksmith)

quest.title: Love At First Bite II
quest.cleanDescription: This is great! Thomas can’t wait to try the love potion you found to catch some fish. Unfortunately, he’s all out of bait. Will you bring him an assortment of bait to use with the love potion?

quest.title: New Year New Moon I
quest.cleanDescription: Let’s celebrate the beginning on a new lunisolar year! Before the new year begins, FR4NK would like to tidy up. Will you help?

quest.title: New Year New Moon II
quest.cleanDescription: Every celebration deserves fireworks! Will you help FR4NK gather some pyrotechnic items?

quest.title: New Year New Moon III
quest.cleanDescription: Let’s add some color to our celebration! If you bring FR4NK some red dye and red berries, FR4NK will make some lively red decorations.

quest.title: New Year New Moon IV
quest.cleanDescription: Let’s add some light! If you bring FR4NK some materials to make paper lanterns, FR4NK will assemble and decorate the lanterns. These lanterns will look great all over town.

quest.title: New Year New Moon V
quest.cleanDescription: Let’s add some good fortune! Will you bring FR4NK some golden fish?

quest.title: What The Heart Wants I
quest.cleanDescription:
“When I think of love, I think of how much the residents of Redbrook love me. That thought makes me want to show my love for them in a big tangible way. But after making Redbrook greater than it’s ever been, what more could I do for my fellow residents? It has to be something that can stick with them and remind them everyday of my love for them.”

“That’s why I’ve come to you. I need you to craft something that I can give to the people of Redbrook that says, ‘Ric loves you!’”

quest.title: What The Heart Wants II
quest.cleanDescription: “You’ve come up with the perfect gift for the residents of Redbrook, but I’m going to need a lot more of these beautiful necklaces. Keep them coming and you might just become Redbrook Citizen of the Week!”

quest.title: What The Heart Wants III
quest.cleanDescription: “You’re doing great, but I need you to increase the speed of your crafting output. Otherwise, the residents of Redbrook may think that I wasn’t prepared to thoughtfully celebrate them. That would be most unfortunate for both of us.”

quest.title: What The Heart Wants IV
quest.cleanDescription: ”This is wonderful! We’re going to make so many people so happy, and Redbrook will love me even more!”

quest.title: What The Heart Wants V
quest.cleanDescription: “One more load may be just enough to make sure everyone gets a token of their love for me.”

quest.title: What The Heart Wants VI
quest.cleanDescription:
“Farmer, you’ve done yourself and your town a great service. Most importantly, you’ve shown your love and commitment to me. Now, I’m sure you feel Redbrook’s gratitude for your service, and you surely don’t need any thanks from me, but I would like to reward your service with a few things from the town treasury.”

“You did save your receipts? I’ll need those to verify your work before dispensing your rewards.”

quest.title: What The Heart Wants VII
quest.cleanDescription: “Oh! You have extra receipts? I suppose the treasury could handle a few more rewards dispensed to such a loyal follower of Ric Ryph.”

quest.title: Spirit of the Cards I
quest.cleanDescription:
While George was building a house of cards yesterday, a rather powerful gust of wind flung open his front door. The trespassing wind proceeded to swirl all about his front room, and then zipped back out his front door just as quickly as it came. It even slammed the door shut on its way out. George wouldn’t have believed what he saw if the wind hadn’t also swept all of his cards out the door as it left. Hoping to catch his scattering cards, George ran out the door and attempted to follow that rogue wind, but his cards quickly disappeared from view.

Normally, George wouldn’t be too concerned about a lost deck of cards, but this was the deck he used during his free hours as a soldier. These cards were a reminder of good times and lost friends. George has to get them back.

Will you help George search for his lost cards? Even if you can only find a few, he would love to have them back. Most especially, George needs to find the hearts.

quest.title: Spirit of the Cards II
quest.cleanDescription:
George is so happy to have the hearts back! He appreciates all your hard work.

Will you try to find the clubs next?

quest.title: Spirit of the Cards III
quest.cleanDescription:
George has heard tales of your good fortune from others, but he’s amazed to find how very lucky you are. He can’t imagine being able to find these scattered cards without you.

Do you feel up to trying to find the diamonds?

quest.title: Spirit of the Cards IV
quest.cleanDescription:
All George needs now is the spades and the jokers and his deck will be complete again!

George can barely believe what you have accomplished so far, but he is extremely grateful to have these mementos of his friends back. Not that you need it, but George wishes you good luck on finding the spades, and don’t forget the four jokers.

quest.title: Spirit of the Cards V
quest.cleanDescription:
George is so thankful for your help and friendship. It was amazing to have the deck of cards back for a while.

Unfortunately, George’s reunion with his cards was short lived. The day after you got the last of the cards back to George, something unseen yanked the entire box of cards out of George’s hands. Then, the box flew right into his fireplace and up the chimney. George ran outside and caught a brief glimpse of the box of cards streaking through the air westward.

George isn’t sure how to get the cards back, and he has no idea how to keep them safe if he does find them. For now, he’s going to cherish the memories he has until he can figure out what took his cards. He may call on you for help to solve this mystery another day.

quest.title: Emerald Walks Everyday I
quest.cleanDescription:
Baba likes to take a jaunty stroll through his cabbage fields everyday. He does it first thing in the morning as the sun is rising on his leafy emeralds. As he walks through the field, the air fills with cabbagey goodness and Baba finds himself at peace with the world and refreshed for the new day.

The only thing that could make these walks better is a nice walking stick of some sort. Baba needs something that fits perfectly in the hand, that can be used to examine cabbages as he walks, and that can frighten off cabbage munching drorels when necessary. Would you mind helping Baba to find the perfect walking stick?

Note: The item requested can be found in the Green Backpack, which can be obtained from trading with other players, the 28-day Daily Chores reward, or the March Starter Pack (Open Green Backpack at the Locksmith)

quest.title: Emerald Walks Everyday II
quest.cleanDescription:
You were right! My cabbages! You were right! This shillelagh is the perfect walking stick for Baba. He may need to start carrying it with him everywhere he goes. Baba appreciates your efforts to help him make his morning walks perfect.

Now, while you’re here, Baba has one more request for you. He would like some spring flowers for his table. He heard they produce a complementary aroma that’s perfect with any cabbage dish.

quest.title: Lasting Impression IV
quest.cleanDescription:

Signed with a humble thanks,
FarmRPG

"Thank you for all of your art, especially the character designs in Chrono Trigger and Dragon Quest. These two series are among my favorite of all time" - Firestream

“I’ll never forget Dragon Ball Z on Cartoon Network (Toonami!) at my best friend’s house. Thanks for being a part of those wonderful memories, and thanks for sharing your amazing stories!” - Tenfoo

"Your writing and art have captured my imagination from a young age, and I'm forever grateful for your influence in my creative life." - forcepath

"Thank you for the world of Dragon Ball, where imagination knows no bounds and adventures never cease." - coderanger

“Thank you for being one of my biggest art influences and inspirations. I would not be the artist I am today without your creative works. You are a true master, rest easy!” - boobun

quest.title: A Great Way To Unwind I
quest.cleanTitle: A Great Way To Unwind I
quest.cleanDescription:
Jill is pretty stressed out right now. On the days that she gets to work on her mechanical projects, she feels great. On the days she has to work the fields, she has this nagging bundle of discomfort in her stomach. Today is a day in the fields.

What Jill needs is something to do in the fields when she can’t endure the crop work anymore. Then, she can take a quick break to refresh herself and relieve that stomachache.

Jill has the perfect idea! When she was young, Jill’s parents would help her fly kites during the early spring. It was so relaxing and so fun. Now, she could easily fly a kite anytime she gets overwhelmed in the fields. Will you help Jill find a decent kite?

Note: The item requested can be found in the Magical Chest 01, which can be obtained from trading with other players, the 28-day Daily Chores reward, or the April Starter Pack (Open Magical Chest 01 at the Locksmith)

quest.title: A Great Way To Unwind II
quest.cleanTitle: A Great Way To Unwind II
quest.cleanDescription:
This kite kite is amazing! Jill loves both types of kites.

Jill needs one more favor if you’re up for it. Will you bring her some more twine so her kite can unwind even higher?

quest.title: Uneggspected Consequences I
quest.cleanDescription:
“You’ve done it this time! Well, maybe Vincent shares a hand in it too. Nevertheless, I definitely expected you to know better by now than to fiddle with Ethereal Growth Guides. Do you realize what you’ve done…errr…what you and Vincent have done?”

Star looks at you quizzically, and then seems to finally notice that you don’t have a clue what he’s talking about.

“The eggs! You and Vincent brought them all together and unlocked an ethereal progress ramp. Now, the ether in this area is increasing and new ether variations are popping up everywhere. There are some variations that I haven’t seen before and some I’ve only ever read about. This could be extremely dangerous! You thought I was going to say eggstremely dangerous, didn’t you?”

No longer addressing you, Star paces across your living room, muttering under his breath and gesticulating wildly. A small floating quill follows behind the pacing mage, furiously scratching down notes on a long sheet of parchment hovering a few centimeters behind Star’s back.

“I think I have it! Yes! There will be new eggs, a new set of Ethereal Growth Guides. There has to be with all the new ether variations. We’ll find them and use them to help us get control of this process.”

“If you’re up for helping me wrangle some ether, I need you to gather every strange or magical egg you see. We’ll also need some low-level Ethereal Growth Guides and other spell enhancers. I’ll make you a list.”

quest.title: Uneggspected Consequences II
quest.cleanDescription:
“We’re off to an excellent…oh I can’t resist it…we’re off to an eggsellent start!”

“Now, see if you can find a new Ethereal Growth Guide that focuses life energy. I suspect we’ll need a few of them. Maybe look amongst your crops. I’m getting a strong sense of leeks. Or is that something else? It’s probably leeks. Oh, and don’t forget the other things we’ll need from the list.”

quest.title: Uneggspected Consequences III
quest.cleanDescription:
“Eggseptional work! Through your efforts and my magic, we’re starting to get the ether progress ramp under control.”

“Now, I think what we need is earth magic to help make a solid foundation for the stabilizing spell. Look for Ethereal Growth Guides that look like dirt and grass, and of course, don’t forget the other items on the list.”

quest.title: Uneggspected Consequences IV
quest.cleanDescription:
“You are eggselling at this endeavor. I knew I came to the right person!”

“We’ll need water magic now. I have a feeling a friend has found the exact Ethereal Growth Guides we’re looking for. As usual, don’t forget the other items on the list.”

quest.title: Uneggspected Consequences V
quest.cleanDescription:
“This is eggsactly how I hoped this plan would come together. We’re doing great and the ether is stabilizing!”

“Now, let’s add my personal favorite: air magic. You will definitely need help finding the air Ethereal Growth Guides, unless you mastered aviation since last we spoke. Perhaps Geist could give you a wing. Please remember the other items on the list as well.”

quest.title: Uneggspected Consequences VI
quest.cleanDescription:
“How eggs-citing! We’re moving to the last five forms, if my calculations are correct.”

“We must be very careful now. This Ethereal Growth Guide is extremely important and quite dangerous. Cataclysms upon catastrophes! It could give the Shadow a foothold into our world if mishandled! I believe our friend Borgen may have found what we’re looking for already. Please gather the other items on the list as well.”

quest.title: Uneggspected Consequences VII
quest.cleanDescription:
“Eggstraordinary! I was worried about the shadow magic, but you did it. You got the eggs to me safely.”

“We need balance now, quickly. Find the Ethereal Growth Guide of light as swiftly as you can, while getting the other items on the list too, of course.”

quest.title: Uneggspected Consequences VIII
quest.cleanDescription:
“Eggselsior! We have balance! I can rest 3.729% easier now.”

“The final three strains of Ethereal Growth Guides will be a little tougher to come by, but I believe you can find them, if anyone can. Start with ages, and don’t forget the rest of our ever present list.”

quest.title: Uneggspected Consequences IX
quest.cleanDescription:
“Eggsactly what we wanted! The ether progress ramp is becoming stable and almost manageable.”

“Now, I need you to find the Ethereal Growth Guide of space. This one may require the help of the entire community, but you should be able to manage the rest of our list on your own.”

quest.title: Uneggspected Consequences X
quest.cleanDescription:
“You are doing wonderfully! Unfortunately, eggsasperation awaits.”

“I’ve no idea where the chaos magic could have collected. Quite fitting, wouldn’t you say? It’s the last Ethereal Growth Guide we need, but you will be left to your wits to find it. And don’t forget the other items we need. Look to the list!”

quest.title: Uneggspected Consequences XI
quest.cleanDescription: “We did it. The ether progress ramp is completely under control now. An interesting byproduct of my spell is this shiny new egg. It seems to be the anchor for the ether progress ramp. We must keep it safe and secret. Who knows what could be unleashed if someone were to get their ill-intented hands on it. Will you secure it, as you have so many of our other urgent magical artifacts?”

quest.title: The Wind Beneath My Wings I
quest.cleanTitle: The Wind Beneath My Wings I
quest.cleanDescription:
Geist loves tea. This much you may already know. But did you also know that she can drink 50 liters at a single sitting? Unfortunately, that means that she goes through loads of tea leaves too, and they’re quite a bit harder to find than boiled water. Boiled water is easy to find for a dragon.

Would you be willing to help Geist by gathering some tea leaves, and just a spot of honey too? She would be happy to trade you some eggs she recently found floating amongst the clouds in exchange for your help.

quest.title: The Wind Beneath My Wings II
quest.cleanTitle: The Wind Beneath My Wings II
quest.cleanDescription: If you’re still willing to help Geist with her tea supply, she would love some more tea leaves, honey, and a lump or two of coal.

quest.title: The Wind Beneath My Wings III
quest.cleanTitle: The Wind Beneath My Wings III
quest.cleanDescription:
You are wonderful! Thank you for your help.

Geist made a few cauldrons of tea for herself and a cup for Beatrix today. Beatrix quite enjoyed her tea, but mentioned that she is inviting Lorn over tomorrow and he prefers sweet root to honey. Geist would like to make tea for all three of them. Would you be willing to continue trading tea supplies for eggs?

quest.title: The Wind Beneath My Wings IV
quest.cleanTitle: The Wind Beneath My Wings IV
quest.cleanDescription:
Lorn loved the tea! Thanks again for the help.

If you are willing, Geist would love your help stocking up on more tea supplies.

quest.title: The Wind Beneath My Wings V
quest.cleanTitle: The Wind Beneath My Wings V
quest.cleanDescription: Will you do one more tea supply run for Geist?

quest.title: The Wind Beneath My Wings VI
quest.cleanTitle: The Wind Beneath My Wings VI
quest.cleanDescription:
You are a good friend and your friendship has inspired Geist.

Even though Geist isn’t a fan of iced tea, sometimes she likes to drink it with Beatrix just for the shared friendship experience. Will you bring Geist some iced tea?

quest.title: Chums I
quest.cleanDescription:
“What about a feast? You know how people love a good feast? They’ll travel for hours to enjoy a huge meal. Holger would probably fly to the moon for a free sandwich. Maybe I can throw a feast for fish and then catch them all.”

“Will you help me get some buckets of chum together for my Fish Feast? I have a really odd reward for your help, but I think you’ll like it.”

quest.title: Chums II
quest.cleanDescription: “It’s working really well! You’re the best! Will you help me get some more chum to keep Fish Feast going?”

quest.title: Chums III
quest.cleanDescription: “I probably should have tried this in a smaller body of water. The ocean keeps washing my feast out before I can catch all the fish I want. Will you bring me more chum?”

quest.title: Chums IV
quest.cleanDescription: “This is so easy! I love Fish Feast! Will you bring me more chum?”

quest.title: Chums V
quest.cleanDescription: “I thought this would be a lot more exciting. It was at first, but now I think I may have ruined it. The fish don’t seem to be as interested. But I’m going to try one more time, if you’ll help me.”

quest.title: Chums VI
quest.cleanDescription: “Thanks for all your help. You’re a good friend. Fish Feast was fun, but I think I like plain old regular fishing better. Will you bring me some plain old regular worms?

quest.title: Red Diamond Ruined I
quest.cleanDescription:
To celebrate the red diamond fish run this year, one of Captain Logan’s crew members made a very festive cake. It was three layers, white vanilla, and decorated with intricate red diamonds. Unfortunately, there was only enough cake for each crew member of the Zefurea to have one slice. Even more unfortunately, one of the crew members, Mister Murvee, accidentally lost his slice of cake over the railing of the ship, right before the celebratory toast.

Mister Murvee was moved to a table at the center of the ship to prevent further incidents with the railing, but he’s still without cake. Will you find a slice of cake, as quickly as possible, that Mister Murvee could enjoy for the celebratory toast?

quest.title: Red Diamond Ruined II
quest.cleanDescription:
Captain Logan appreciates your help with the slice of cake. Mister Murvee still managed to have another accident with his cake, but it was after the toast and mostly salvageable.

Now, the crew would like some additional liquid refreshments. Will you bring some juices and such for the celebration?

Also, to help you celebrate, and in thanks for all your help, Captain Logan left something for you at the Post Office. You’ll need the password, celebrate, to get it.

questlines.title: The Smell of a Fun Guy

quest.title: The Smell of a Fun Guy I
quest.cleanTitle: The Smell of a Fun Guy I
quest.cleanDescription: Mariya is looking for a new ingredient for her cooking.  The town gala is coming and she wants to showcase something truly unique and wonderful for the residents of Redbrook.  However, she is at a loss on what new ingredient she could find to really make her dish pop.  She wants to ask Holger for his advice, but would like to have a peace offering before she consults him, would you bring some of Holger's favorite things to help smooth their introduction?

quest.title: The Smell of a Fun Guy II
quest.cleanTitle: The Smell of a Fun Guy II
quest.cleanDescription: Holger was of course, delighted by the gifts Mariya brought him.  He immediately suggested that you could try adding potatoes and radishes to your food to make them more interesting.  Mariya seemed a bit skeptical, but she soldiered on, and of course asked you to provide her with the requisite items.

quest.title: The Smell of a Fun Guy III
quest.cleanTitle: The Smell of a Fun Guy III
quest.cleanDescription: Mariya was quite disappointed by the outcome of her radish and potato pie - it didn't at all encapsulate the richness and body that she wanted to showcase her talents with.  She suggests maybe some less traditional ingredients for her dishes, and asks if you'd be interested in helping her with her new idea.

quest.title: The Smell of a Fun Guy IV
quest.cleanTitle: The Smell of a Fun Guy IV
quest.cleanDescription:
"Well, peas excuse me, but that combination didn't work either..."

Mariya seems a bit frustrated, but she was grateful that Charles and frank seemed to enjoy the conglomeration food idea (minus the fish).

You'd like to cheer Mariya up a little bit, maybe some flowers would help her feel better?

quest.title: The Smell of a Fun Guy V
quest.cleanTitle: The Smell of a Fun Guy V
quest.cleanDescription:
Mariya seemed slightly cheered by your thoughtful gift, but also a little distracted as she is whipping up a new idea.

She asks if you could grab her some more items while she's perfecting the ratios in her current idea. You swear she is muttering something about how "Ariathan dishes always had such richness of flavor..."

quest.title: The Smell of a Fun Guy VI
quest.cleanTitle: The Smell of a Fun Guy VI
quest.cleanDescription: Mariya seems positively delighted by your selection of items, but there's still something missing in her mind.  It will have to be something rare you guess, and you suddenly remember frank discussing some odd behavior with your pigs the other day.  You figure frank would want some really odd items so you set about finding some strange things to curry favor.

quest.title: The Smell of a Fun Guy VII
quest.cleanTitle: The Smell of a Fun Guy VII
quest.cleanDescription: "well, i could talk to them for you, but then that would be spoiling the surprise, wouldn't it?" frank seems nonplussed when you ask him for help on the pig situation.  "but, i suppose if you gave me some delightful items for...reasons i could help you out...maybe..."

quest.title: The Smell of a Fun Guy VIII
quest.cleanTitle: The Smell of a Fun Guy VIII
quest.cleanDescription: You bring back a bunch of items frank needs for no obviously nefarious purpose, and in return he gives you a big grin and bunny wink.  "yeah, i can wink, you can get over yourself now.  anyways, i found this in star's basement the other day, and maybe you could take the pigs for a walk, maybe they'll find something special, if you are nice to them every day and feed them."  frank hops around the assortment of items and you hear a sound that sounds like someone yelling in surprise, you turn your head to see where it came from, and when you look back, you see a small collar where frank had been.

quest.title: The Smell of a Fun Guy IX
quest.cleanTitle: The Smell of a Fun Guy IX
quest.cleanDescription: Your pigs seem to quite enjoy the freedom of walks and the feedings, and while it looks a bit ridiculous, when you take them through the forest, sometimes they insistently stop and with some snuffling and squealing, they reveal a mushroom you're not quite familiar with.  You think Mariya might be interested, so you gather a few to bring to her.

quest.title: The Smell of a Fun Guy X
quest.cleanTitle: The Smell of a Fun Guy X
quest.cleanDescription:
Mariya added the white truffles to her dish and was overcome with emotion after her first tasting. After a moment she begins to share how the taste took her back to her hometown, to the Emperor’s Ball. It was on the second night after Emperor Ariathes returned to his ancestral homeland for the first time since ascending the Cascading Throne. It was an amazing time. Actually, it may have started Mariya’s journey to becoming a chef. The celebration food was all so amazing and vibrant and delicious. Mariya dreamed of creating something so spectacular. As the memory washes over her, Mariya sheds a single tear, and you extend your thanks to her for sharing a little bit about her unknown past this day.

Mariya mentions she remembers a different variety of truffles now that her memory has been jogged, and would love to have some of the rarer black truffles, if you come across them.

quest.title: Red Diamond Runathon I
quest.cleanDescription:
“Would you be interested in a little friendly competition? My crew and I are celebrating the red diamond fish run by competing to see who can catch the most red diamond fish. Knowing of your exceptional fishing skills, I decided to see if you’d like to join the fun.”

“To enter our competition, you’ll need to first add your share of the entry fee. If you’re interested, bring 10,000 silver. Then, we’ll give you some nets and bait to get started.”

quest.title: Red Diamond Runathon II
quest.cleanDescription: “How many have you caught so far?”

quest.title: Red Diamond Runathon III
quest.cleanDescription: “You’re going to need quite a few more than that, if you want to win the prize pot.”

quest.title: Red Diamond Runathon IV
quest.cleanDescription: “I don’t want to discourage you, but several of my crew are well ahead of you.”

quest.title: Red Diamond Runathon V
quest.cleanDescription: “You’re catching up! You may pass some of my crew soon.”

quest.title: Red Diamond Runathon VI
quest.cleanDescription: “Amazing! You’ve passed all of my crew!”

quest.title: Red Diamond Runathon VII
quest.cleanDescription: “You passed Lorn! There are only three people ahead of you now!”

quest.title: Red Diamond Runathon VIII
quest.cleanDescription:
“You beat me.”

“There are two more competitors remaining for you to challenge.”

quest.title: Red Diamond Runathon IX
quest.cleanDescription:
“You beat Beatrix! And technically you beat Geist too. They were working together. You should’ve seen it!”

“There is one more competitor left for you.”

quest.title: Red Diamond Runathon X
quest.cleanDescription:
“You are tied with Thomas right now. The two of you might be the greatest catchers of fish I’ve ever seen.”

“This is it! Are you going to beat him?”

quest.title: Red Diamond Runathon XI
quest.cleanDescription:
“Captain Logan wanted me to do the honors and present you with the prize pot. Congratulations! You are the Red Diamond Run winner.”

“You beat me by two fish!”

quest.title: Candy Causes I
quest.cleanDescription: “i just need some candy. there’s no ulterior motives. maybe some interior motives. will you lend a bunny a hand finding some candy?”

quest.title: Candy Causes II
quest.cleanDescription:
“I thought for sure that frank was up to something, just sitting there eating candy. I waited. I watched. I peered into the ethereal windows of time and space and optimized neural networks. There was nothing. Nothing! That hare is just eating candy!”

“I think I just need some candy too. Any chance you might have some candy available?”

quest.title: Candy Causes III
quest.cleanDescription:
“Star passed me on the road today. He gave me his usual, ‘Ahoy, starboard seafarer!’, but that was it. He continued right on, munching from a bag of candy. He didn’t try to examine me for ‘multiversal disturbances and decays’ at all. It was nice.”

“Do you know where I might get some of that same candy Star had? Beary Squishies are some of my favorite candy from home.”

quest.title: Candy Causes IV
quest.cleanDescription: “Captain Thomas joined me for lunch today. He brought some excellent candy that he mentioned you helped procure. It was a wonderful treat. I’m not usually in the mood for candy, but that did hit the spot. Do you think you could find a ration of candy for me?”

quest.title: Candy Causes V
quest.cleanDescription: “George brought me some candy. I used most of it in making experimental cookies. The B for Buddies cookies turned out the best. Now, I’d like to enjoy some candy a little more simply. Will you bring me some?”

quest.title: Candy Causes VI
quest.cleanDescription: “Jill brought me cookies today. It was an odd batch with those little chocolate candies mixed in instead of regular chocolate chips. They were quite excellent. Now, I think I would like to have some more candy. Will you go and find some for me? I promise to make it worth your efforts.”

quest.title: Candy Causes VII
quest.cleanDescription: “Cecil dropped by today to pay me for some items I found for him last week. In an attempt to get me to lower my price a bit, he offered me some candy. I’m not proud to say that I did end up eating the candy and I gave Cecil a two percent discount. To make matters worse, now I want more candy. Would you take Borgen Bucks in exchange for some candy?”

quest.title: Candy Causes VIII
quest.cleanDescription: “I was going through Borgen’s stuff today and accidentally ate all of his candy. Will you help me get some replacement candy before he finds out, and some extra candy for me?”

quest.title: Candy Causes IX
quest.cleanDescription:
“I caught Holger sneaking out of Borgen’s wagon on my way home today. Holger attempted to buy my silence with candy. Can you believe him?”

“Holger also claimed that he didn’t steal the candy from Borgen. He said he bought it from you…Would you be willing to sell me some candy too?”

quest.title: Candy Causes X
quest.cleanDescription: “Friend, I am throwing an elaborate festival for a few of my closest equine associates, as well as a few woodland friends of my Lucky Lady. Rosalie mentioned during my haircut today that you might be able to help me with a supply of sweet treats. What do you say old chum, can I count on you?”

quest.title: Ric's Embrace Falls I
quest.cleanDescription: NEIGH!! NEIGH!! NEIGH!!

quest.title: Problems Start Arising I
quest.cleanDescription: Holger has been busy lately.  He seems less hungry and more stressed.  You’ve caught him at the Raptor Fight Club several times going over stacks of papers.  Maybe some potatoes, soap, and some claws for raptors would cheer him up?

quest.title: Problems Start Arising II
quest.cleanDescription: Holger gives you a small smile and a nod before he’s back tending to various tasks.  You begin to inquire what has been bothering him when he points to Buddy who happens to be walking by and says tersely, “Ask him.”

quest.title: Problems Start Arising III
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy gives a wide-eyed expression of innocence but a stern glare from Holger quickly sobers Buddy up.  “Oh, all right, I guess we should talk about pirates…but first I need to finish this quick meal for the community center, oh and if you could help with some spare clothing supplies too?"

quest.title: Problems Start Arising IV
quest.cleanDescription: At the community center, the food has been prepared, ladled, and served to all who need it, Buddy sits in a chair in the corner, the various villagers swamp him with questions of his old adventures and stories about the evil mayor.  Buddy seems to entertain everyone with his easy smile and friendly personality.  He’s come a long way from when you met him early on in Redbrook.  As you inch closer, you hear him begin to recite a story about northern Bahltruvian eggplants.  He motions you closer and whispers, “Quick, I’m gonna need some special eggplants - and some special effects!"

quest.title: Problems Start Arising V
quest.cleanDescription:
You return to the community center to see Buddy, sword drawn miming a swordfight, “You see, I had a secret too! I also am not left-handed!” Buddy dramatically swishes his cutlass and you toss one of the golden eggplants towards him. He throws the cutlass in the air, catches it with his right hand and deftly cleaves the eggplant in two, both sides falling to his feet dramatically. The crowd gasps and after a moment begin to clap excitedly. As a finale, all of the special effects go off and the crowd is at this point raucously cheering. He bows and smiles and steps away from the crowd.

“Nice timing! We’ve got to do a reconnoiter of the walls after the incident and then I can probably explain why Holger is so upset. “

quest.title: Pirates Start Arriving VI
quest.cleanDescription:
During your patrol, you notice Buddy eyeing the northeastern horizon, towards his home, a distant look in his eyes.

“Watch out!” A voice cries out from behind you. Vincent comes barreling past both of you from seemingly nowhere and charges into the nearby brush. You hear the exhale of breath and a quick cry before Vincent comes back out from the undergrowth, a rough looking man in a puffy shirt in tow.

Buddy scowls, “Drat! Pirates, again.”

quest.title: Pirates Start Arriving VII
quest.cleanDescription:
“Ey yew, yah, yew, ya big ole thumb lookin’ fella. Cap’n Hrakness is lookin’ fer yew. She said yew know wots comin’ and if yew know wots best yew’ll give this teeny tiny town up. It ain’t worf the hassle iffen yew know wot I mean.”

Vincent moves to make the pirate stop talking, but Buddy - with a swish of a cutlass - stops him.

“Oh, I know the Captain all right, but you guys can stay your hand. Redbrook is no home for pirates. Kindly show yourselves back to whatever cave you came from up north. Let her know we are not interested.”

The pirate spits at Buddy derisively. “There’s a plague comin’ mate, best figure out if youse is the contagion or the dead.”

Buddy takes a menacing step towards the pirate and the pirate immediately turns tail and runs.

“Well, now you might have an idea why Holger might be mad at me…”

Vincent suggests rigging some extra defensive measures tonight before the town council meeting.

quest.title: Pirates Start Arriving VIII
quest.cleanDescription: Back in Redbrook, Buddy and Holger look at each other with worried faces as the town council discusses the evening's events.  George, ever the siege expert, suggests you may want more than you expect and doubles the requisition of Vincent, as well as adds a few items of his own.

quest.title: Pirates Start Arriving IX
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy perks up at the mention of cannons, and suggests a few more defensive measures.

quest.title: Pirates Start Arriving X
quest.cleanDescription: Preparations made, Vincent pulls you aside after the meeting and suggests that you should keep an eye on Buddy, in case he does something rash.

quest.title: Pirates Start Arriving XI
quest.cleanDescription: There doesn’t seem to be much you can do but follow Buddy back to his cave.  It’s a dull walk, and after a bit, Buddy seems to have settled into his cave and you see signs of a fire near the mouth of the cave.  You decide it would be a good time to work on some carving and crafting to keep your mind occupied while you keep watch.

quest.title: Pirates Start Arriving XII
quest.cleanDescription: In the morning, George appears beside you, trampling leaves and sticks with all the stealth of a rampaging kraken.  He mumbles something about creativity needing more sleep before offering you some morning juice.   You offer him some food in return, and George suggests after some rest you should unpack yesterday’s events with Vincent and Holger.

quest.title: Pirates Start Arriving XIII
quest.cleanDescription:
“Pirates are bad news, all the way around.” You see Holger half-heartedly picking at some breakfast as George is speaking.

“Well, they wouldn’t be here if it wasn’t for Buddy, as far as I’m concerned,” retorts Holger. The two of them stop as they see you approach and clear their throats.

Vincent gives you an earnest but frustrated look as he addresses you frankly. “We’re just concerned, {player}, what if those pirates attack Redbrook in full force? What greater recourse do we have? By all accounts, there’s multiple crews, multiple ships! I’d rather deal with a dictator than pirates, as frustrating as that is to say out loud. Buddy has proven a stalwart ally, but I worry he is too intimately involved with this crew to be objective.”

A new voice enters the room, stern and authoritative, “He may be intimately involved, but that means he may be your best solution too. Shame on you both for ostracizing someone who has given Redbrook so much over the past few years. I had hoped cooler heads would prevail, but I find you both here stirring dissent instead of solutions.” Cecil stands before the three of you, and sufficiently cowed, you see Holger and Vincent looking apologetic.

Vincent takes a moment before standing, “You’re right, Cecil, we should be using one of the town’s most loyal resources, and I feel terrible that I let personal doubt or mistrust get in the way of a good solution.”

Holger nods, a little more sullenly and adds, “Perhaps we should bring our friend a token of our appreciation and see how he would address this pirate crew.”

quest.title: Pirates Start Arriving XIV
quest.cleanDescription:
You approach Buddy’s cave/home, and George pops out from behind some dense shrubbery. “Ni!” he splutters as he trips and stumbles. After gathering himself he gives a bit of a salute and says, “Nothing to report here! Buddy has had a fire lit since last night, and I’ve just been admiring the landscape!”

Vincent quickly fills George in with the plan, and the four of you step towards Buddy’s cave, and as you enter the mouth of the cave, you see the resplendent view of coins, gems, and other various tokens and baubles that have been placed almost haphazardly. On closer inspection it could almost seem that they had been placed in such a precise and meticulous fashion to dazzle a guest with a blinding display of vibrant colors across the entire room.

Your eyes adjust to the flickering light of a well made fire that is clearly on its last legs, surrounded by some cleverly placed mirrors that seem to enhance the light of the fire to make it look much brighter and fuller than reality.

“Buddy! Where are you?!” Vincent shouts, but only the crackling of the embers of the fire and the echo of Vincent’s voice greet you.

“Stars and stones! He’s gone!” Holger says breathlessly. George takes a moment of looking absolutely befuddled before Vincent spots some tracks heading off to a wall where they end mysteriously.

“Skull coins! I should have known…” Vincent points to the various indentations. It seems you’ll need some coins to open this mysterious passage.

quest.title: Pirates Start Arriving XV
quest.cleanDescription:
The final coin inserted - the passage slides open whisper quiet - the cracks and mechanisms betray the look of stone to be a more modern contraption of some kind but camouflaged. It looks somehow familiar - Romuskan, but at the same time, not. Mysteries for another day, you hope.

The passage leads to a small dock behind a waterfall. There, you see a single boat moored. It looks like it’s seen better days, and you also see a shadow slipping through the waterfall. Buddy!

George, Vincent, and Holger pore over the boat, but it seems more like a skiff to your eyes on second inspection. It would hold all four of you, probably, with some repairs. You all get to repairs as quickly as possible, noting the shadow of Buddy’s boat slipping into the distance in a watery shimmer.

quest.title: Pirates Start Arriving XVI
quest.cleanDescription:
Boat repaired, your erstwhile crew punt into the open water. The water is strangely calm behind the waterfall, and with some of the poles you’ve made, you begin to note the water gets deeper and darker as you approach the waterfall. Shielding yourself from the falling water with your cloak, suddenly, the blue sky and sun arrive and the roar of a waterfall, water coursing from an unknown source is crashing behind you.

Buddy’s boat is barely visible, but with some looking glasses and quick thinking, Vincent steers the boat while you and George take oars and Holger deftly maneuvers the sails.

Mercifully after what seems like hours, George stops rowing, clearly winded. You stop rowing too, your arms and lungs burn ferociously. And yet, despite your efforts you are no closer to Buddy than when you started. Vincent scowls and directs the skiff towards land as he sees you’ve both stopped.

It’s clear you are going to need something with more power if you’re going to catch Buddy or head into any more open waters alone. Vincent looks towards you, “We’ll need some nautical help. I’m sure he was headed towards Pirate’s Cove, but if we’re going to approach there unnoticed, we’ll need the help of someone far more experienced. Someone’s gonna have to convince Ragvin to help us…”

quest.title: Pirates Start Arriving XVII
quest.cleanDescription:
"We’ll need some nautical help. I’m sure he was headed towards Pirate’s Cove, but if we’re going to approach there unnoticed, we’ll need the help of someone far more experienced. Someone’s going to have to convince Ragvin to help us…” Vincent trails off slightly as he docks the skiff near Redbrook. After a moment, he tacks some parchment to the single small mast scrawled in charcoal. “Free to a good home.”
Tracking down Ragvin won’t be an easy task, you discover. You stop by one of the local watering holes and hear that he left port several weeks ago and hasn’t been seen since. Vincent suggests you take a look at the defenses, while George stays behind in the tavern, a strange look in his eye as you leave. Holger is gone quickly towards his pet project with a strange gleam in his eyes.
Of course, having been gone only a few days, a general malaise has come over the constabulary of Redbrook and some repairs will need to be fashioned, which gives you some time to think about how to find Ragvin.

quest.title: Pirates Start Arriving XIX
quest.cleanDescription: After a day or two of ensuring the town defenses are adequate (minus the wall project you just found out about), you pause to search for more leads on tracking down where Ragvin was going and why radishes. George suggests you try a new tack and talk to Captain Logan, who might be up to the task of getting to Pirate’s Cove speedily and stealthily.   It’s a big ask, and you know Captain Logan will need to be shmoozed if he’s going to even consider saying yes.

quest.title: Beaches Are Like Deserts I
quest.cleanDescription:
ROOMBA is going to the beach with Jill tomorrow. When Jill invited ROOMBA, she mentioned that she would like to build a sandcastle during their visit. Unfortunately, ROOMBA has no information on building sandcastles. Based on the data and experience ROOMBA has for castles, ROOMBA expects this to be a major undertaking. Since ROOMBA cannot provide expertise and guidance for the sandcastle architecture and construction, ROOMBA would like to be prepared to provide tools and labor. Will you help ROOMBA find the right tools for the job?

(Hint: The items requested are in Rosalie's Beach Tote which is available in the June Starter pack or by completing 28 days of chores)

quest.title: Beaches Are Like Deserts II
quest.cleanDescription: ROOMBA is unsure about the effectiveness of the tools you provided. Sandcastles are like castles, correct? Would you be willing to bring ROOMBA some tools that could handle a larger scale project, just in case?

quest.title: Freedom Universally I
quest.cleanDescription:
Back home, Captain Thomas loved the Day of Freedom Festival. There were parades, games, food, and lots of dancing. It was the one day each year that even the most serious folks took a break and enjoyed the flow of life.

Captain Thomas would like to throw a little party to celebrate the Day of Freedom, a little like he did back home. Will you give him a hand with the preparations?

quest.title: Freedom Universally II
quest.cleanDescription:
The games are looking good. Captain Thomas appreciates your help setting up the horseshoe pits.

Will you help Captain Thomas with a few food items?

quest.title: Freedom Universally III
quest.cleanDescription:
The food smells fantastic. This is going to be great. Captain Thomas appreciates your help.

Now, Captain Thomas wants to have some treats for the celebration. Will you bring some pies and fruit?

quest.title: Freedom Universally IV
quest.cleanDescription: Captain Thomas is feeling a lot of nostalgia now, but there’s one last thing he would love to have for the celebration. Sarafina always made a Lemon Cream Pie. Captain Thomas misses Sarafina more than anything. Can you find a Lemon Cream Pie for the party?

quest.title: Sunblock I
quest.cleanDescription:
Before Jill and Roomba go on their trip to the beach, Jill would like to find a way to protect her skin from sunburns. She usually wears a hat and clothing that covers most, if not all, of her skin while working in her fields to avoid over exposure to the sun. Jill had some severe sunburns as a child and doesn’t want to ever repeat that.

Through a lot of research Jill found a substance that should be just the thing to protect her skin. Now, she needs to come up with a suspension that will evenly distribute the substance, adhere to the skin, resist washing off in the water, and hopefully be safe for her skin. Jill would like it to smell nice too.

Will you give Jill a hand gathering the ingredients for the suspension?

quest.title: Sunblock II
quest.cleanDescription:
Those flowers smell wonderful!

Now, according to her research, Jill should be able to harvest a particular oil from sunfish to use for the suspension. Will you bring her a load of sunfish to try?

quest.title: Sunblock III
quest.cleanDescription:
The sunfish oil seems like a good addition, but Jill’s concoction needs something more.

To find the best solution, Jill is now working on a few different mixtures. Will you bring her a few more items to try?

quest.title: Sunblock IV
quest.cleanDescription:
Corn and mushroom paste both made interesting additions to the mixtures. The mushroom paste seems to have better potential though.

Will you bring Jill a few more items to try?

quest.title: Sunblock V
quest.cleanDescription: Jill has made a few different mixtures that seem to hold some potential. Will you bring her a few more items to test?

quest.title: Sunblock VI
quest.cleanDescription: Jill thinks she’s found a perfect suspension to use to protect her skin from sunburn at the beach. Now, she needs more of the ingredients to make enough for her trip. Will you help her?

quest.title: Sunblock VII
quest.cleanDescription: That last load was a perfect base. Now, Jill needs a few more ingredients, if you don’t mind.

quest.title: Sunblock VIII
quest.cleanDescription: It’s almost perfect! Jill needs to do some extensive testing now and she’ll need some materials to help with the test. Will you bring her the things she needs?

quest.title: Sunblock IX
quest.cleanDescription:
It’s working! It’s working!

There’s one more test Jill wants to do. Will you help her?

quest.title: Explosively Grand Offer I
quest.cleanDescription:
Cecil wants to contribute to the fireworks celebrations in a big way, but he has not found a grand enough firework to purchase yet. It needs to be something more than just an explosion and bright lights. It has to be different and better, artistic even. Cecil wants something that the eyes of Redbrook will never forget.

If you happen upon something unbelievable, will you bring a couple for Cecil? He would gladly compensate you handsomely.

quest.title: Explosively Grand Offer II
quest.cleanDescription:
The fireworks you brought were perfect. Everyone was extremely impressed by the Green Torpedoes. Cecil appreciates your diligent efforts.

Now, Cecil wants to have some fun. Will you bring him a pack of bottle rockets?

quest.title: Booms, Our Other Monetary System I
quest.cleanTitle: Booms, Our Other Monetary System I
quest.cleanDescription:
Beatrix is loving this Bottle Rocket Brawl! It’s so much fun, and she just loves light explosives, especially handled in a safe way.

To thank everyone for participating and making this so fun for her, she has some rewards for your continued deployment of explosive rockets. Keep up the good work!

quest.title: Booms, Our Other Monetary System II
quest.cleanTitle: Booms, Our Other Monetary System II
quest.cleanDescription:
Did you see when Beatrix fired 100 bottle rockets at once? She didn’t hit anyone, but it was a wonderful cacophony of explosions.

Thanks for keeping the brawl going!

quest.title: Booms, Our Other Monetary System III
quest.cleanTitle: Booms, Our Other Monetary System III
quest.cleanDescription: Beatrix is hopeful that everyone is having as much fun as she is. This may be her favorite fireworks celebration ever!

quest.title: Booms, Our Other Monetary System IV
quest.cleanTitle: Booms, Our Other Monetary System IV
quest.cleanDescription: You’re really getting into this. You must love bottle rockets as much as Beatrix.

quest.title: Booms Open Opportunities, Mark Successes I
quest.cleanTitle: Booms Open Opportunities, Mark Successes I
quest.cleanDescription: Beatrix appreciates everyone making this Bottle Rocket Brawl so much fun. As a token of her appreciation, she would like to help you out in your exploring efforts.

quest.title: Booms Open Opportunities, Mark Successes II
quest.cleanTitle: Booms Open Opportunities, Mark Successes II
quest.cleanDescription: Beatrix really can’t get over how much fun she’s having. As another token of her appreciation, she would like to help you out in your fishing efforts.

quest.title: Booms Open Opportunities, Mark Successes III
quest.cleanTitle: Booms Open Opportunities, Mark Successes III
quest.cleanDescription: Beatrix has another reward for your excellent pyrotechnics in the Bottle Rocket Brawl. It should be useful for exploring.

quest.title: Booms Open Opportunities, Mark Successes IV
quest.cleanTitle: Booms Open Opportunities, Mark Successes IV
quest.cleanDescription: All right. Beatrix has one final reward for you. It should be useful for fishing.

quest.title: The Mystery Triangle I
quest.cleanDescription:
Baba seems to have misplaced his yo-yo. It’s a beautiful green one, the color of fresh cabbages glistening in the morning dew. So, he won’t be able to show you how to do some of his favorite tricks today. However, if you can find a replacement yo-yo for him, he could probably still show you some of the more basic tricks he knows, including walk the capybara and the mystery triangle.

(Hint: The yo-yo is in Baba's Snack Pack which is available in the August Starter Pack or by completing 28 days of chores)

quest.title: The Mystery Triangle II
quest.cleanDescription:
Thanks for letting Baba use your yo-yo. He also hopes you enjoyed seeing his yo-yo tricks.

There are many more amazing tricks Baba has learned to do, but he doesn’t feel confident enough to try them without his yo-yo. Baba’s yo-yo is just the best! The string is perfect. The axle and bearings are perfect. Everything is just perfect.

Where could it be?

Will you bring Baba some apples to boost his energy and clear his head so he can find his yo-yo?

quest.title: The Greater Good I
quest.cleanDescription: “For a small donation to the Redbrook Relief Fund, plus a small handling fee, you can be entered in a raffle to win some prizes. All donations are non refundable. Sound exciting? Excellent! I’m happy to take that donation right now.”

quest.title: The Greater Good II
quest.cleanDescription: “I’d be willing to let you make another small donation to the Redbrook Relief Fund, plus a small handling fee, to get two more entries into the raffle. Don’t forget that all donations are non refundable.”

quest.title: The Greater Good III
quest.cleanDescription: “I suppose I could, for a generous donation to the Redbrook Relief Fund, plus handling fees, give you a few more raffle tickets. Don’t forget that all donations and handling fees are final and cannot be returned or exchanged under any circumstances. Nor may you hold me liable if you aren’t successful in winning a prize.”

quest.title: The Greater Good IV
quest.cleanDescription: “You want a receipt? I can do that, for a small processing fee.”

questlines.title: That Which Hat Bewitches Witches And Wizards

quest.title: That Which Hat Bewitches Witches And Wizards I
quest.cleanTitle: That Which Hat Bewitches Witches And Wizards I
quest.cleanDescription:
It’s been a magical year in Redbrook, but nothing tops Rosalie’s decorations during the Halloween season. You have fond memories when you look at the witch hats lining her home.

Star Meerif appears beside you in a flash of feathers.

“But, could we go,” he pauses for impact, “bigger? For Rosalie? She’s just the best. The bees knees. The star in a diamond. The ocean in a pasture. The sun in the moon. The - well, you get the idea anyway.”

quest.title: That Which Hat Bewitches Witches And Wizards II
quest.cleanTitle: That Which Hat Bewitches Witches And Wizards II
quest.cleanDescription:
You are trudging back from the Haunted House, another haul of hats for Star when Rosalie appears next to you in a shower of multi-colored feathers.

“Okay, so I was thinking, maybe I could scale back the decorations on my house this year? Bigger is better, but maybe something more subtle would work wonders? I was thinking about lining the house with something a little creepier than witch hats.”

She hands you a list that just says, “Jar of Spiders to cover 2160 linear feet.” Suddenly, Rosalie looks at you blithely, “Hey, what are those hats for, anyways?”

You quickly excuse yourself to get some jars and spiders for her before she can ask more questions.

quest.title: That Which Hat Bewitches Witches And Wizards III
quest.cleanTitle: That Which Hat Bewitches Witches And Wizards III
quest.cleanDescription:
You return to Rosalie’s home with more spiders and jars than would be comfortable for even George, and find Rosalie sitting across from Star Meerif.  You’re not sure what exactly they’re saying, it sounds like a foreign language to you.  “Well, the aura of monorecidivism in the colloquial basketweaving of destined death with regards to azure eclipses in the 4th quarter of halloween distribution with a proper sigma to the sixth degree would predicate a lack of color here.”
	They turn to you, faces flush and say in unison, “We’re gonna need more…of everything!”
	Star grabs your hand and whispers in your ear, “And something special - for Rosalie!”

quest.title: That Which Hat Bewitches Witches And Wizards IV
quest.cleanTitle: That Which Hat Bewitches Witches And Wizards IV
quest.cleanDescription:
Returning to Rosalie’s house, Star sits on the front steps, and the nervousness on his face is quite apparent.

“Did you bring it?” he asks.

You nod and Star looks quite relieved.

He enters the house, the diamond and steel band held tightly between two fingers.

In a few moments that feel like eternities, you hear a quiet shuffle, a shriek, and a “Yes!” come from inside her home and Star and Rosalie burst through the entryway.

“Trick…”

quest.title: That Which Hat Bewitches Witches And Wizards V
quest.cleanTitle: That Which Hat Bewitches Witches And Wizards V
quest.cleanDescription:
“OR TREAT!”  They exclaim! 

	“The diamond was for creating a new light refraction technique that we discovered in Romuska!”

	“We totally fooled you!”

quest.title: Reindeer Safety Program I
quest.cleanDescription: “Ho ho ho! I think I need your help again. I’m a little worried about my reindeer. Redbrook seems to have a very large raptor population. Actually, in all my years, I’ve never seen so many raptors! All of them are on the nice list, but I’m worried that there could still be a mixup, and one of my reindeer could lose an antler. Will you help me keep my reindeer safe? Ho ho ho!”

quest.title: Reindeer Safety Program II
quest.cleanDescription:
“Ho ho ho! I’m glad you were watching out for Rudolph. That red nose can sometimes make him an easy target. Ho ho ho!”

“Have you seen Dasher?”

quest.title: Reindeer Safety Program III
quest.cleanDescription:
“Ho ho ho! Great! Dasher is safe. Ho ho ho!”

“Now where is Comet?”

quest.title: Reindeer Safety Program IV
quest.cleanDescription:
“Ho ho ho! Hurray! I knew Comet wouldn’t get into trouble. Ho ho ho!”

“Will you find Vixen now?”

quest.title: Reindeer Safety Program V
quest.cleanDescription:
“Ho ho ho! Vixen! Excellent! Ho ho ho!”

“Let’s find Dancer!”

quest.title: Reindeer Safety Program VI
quest.cleanDescription:
“Ho ho ho! Dancer, my boy, you’re safe! Ho ho ho!”

“Let’s find Cupid now!”

quest.title: Reindeer Safety Program VII
quest.cleanDescription:
“Ho ho ho! I love it! Cupid is safe! Ho ho ho!”

“Will you help me find Blitzen?”

quest.title: Reindeer Safety Program VIII

“Ho ho ho! Blitzen! Great to see you! Ho ho ho!”

“Last, but certainly not least, let’s find Donner!”

quest.title: Reindeer Safety Program IX
quest.cleanDescription:
“Ho ho ho! We did it. Thank you so much for your help! Ho ho ho!”

“Let me share some of my favorite treats with you!”

quest.title: Another Lot Of Trees I
quest.cleanDescription:
With the population boom Redbrook has experienced, Vincent has decided to add another lot for his Christmas tree sales. This lot is even bigger than his original tree lot. Will you help him get it quickly stocked?

The first thing he needs is a load of your finest trees.

quest.title: Another Lot Of Trees II
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent needs stacks of boxes of ornaments now. Please bring him every ornament you can find.

quest.title: Another Lot Of Trees III
quest.cleanDescription: On second thought, Vincent thinks he needs another load of ornaments, just to be safe.

quest.title: Another Lot Of Trees IV
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent would like to offer wreaths and Yule goats for sale along with the trees and ornaments. Will you bring him a supply of holiday wreaths and Yule goats?

quest.title: Another Lot Of Trees V
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent thinks he may need more wreaths and goats. Will you bring him more?

quest.title: Another Lot Of Trees VI
quest.cleanDescription: The lot is looking great. Now, Vincent wants to be fully stocked on decorated trees before he opens for business.

quest.title: Another Lot Of Trees VII
quest.cleanDescription: One more load of decorated trees should fill the lot. Vincent appreciates all of your help!

quest.title: Another Lot Of Trees VIII
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent has one more idea for the grand opening of the new tree lot. Will you bring him loads of treats to give away to his customers?

quest.title: Another Lot Of Trees IX
quest.cleanDescription: If you’ll bring one more load of treats, Vincent will be ready to open the new tree lot. Vincent really appreciates your help. This incredible business would be unmanageable without you!

quest.title: Another Lot Of Trees X
quest.cleanDescription: The tree lot was a huge success! Vincent appreciates all your help. He also wants to give you a share of the profits. Happy holidays!

quest.title: Cuucoo's Awakening I
quest.cleanDescription:
BACAAWWWWWWWW

BOK BOK

BOK

BACAAWWWWWWWW

BOK

BOK BOK BOK?

quest.title: Cuucoo's Awakening II
quest.cleanDescription:
Oh? Can you understand me? Thanks, I was quite hungry!

I don’t know how I got here. It was highly unlikely for me to find someone as empathetic as you though… I’m lost! Will you help me find my way home? I’m looking for someone with a green cap and a sword.

quest.title: Cuucoo's Awakening III
quest.cleanDescription:
BACAAWWWWWWWWW

Close enough! Could you get me a little more food? This feed just goes right through me!

quest.title: Cuucoo's Awakening IV
quest.cleanDescription:
BOK BOK BOK

Oh, that’s much better. Anyways. I was minding my own business when this fella wearing a green cap grabbed me. In a panic, I screeched and flapped my wings as hard as I could! The next thing I knew, I heard some kind of weird flutey song and now I’m here! BOK! Now I just need a small flute and you can play that same song and send me home!

quest.title: Cuucoo's Awakening V
quest.cleanDescription:
Oh good, that seems like a good instrument and it’s quite flutey. Let’s give this a shot. Now um, it’s very simple, just an inverted D triad. Play it twice.

And could you bring a little extra food?

quest.title: Cuucoo's Awakening VI
quest.cleanDescription:
Well, that was a pretty song, it made me think of time, but no matter.  I guess we’ll need to find that green guy after all.  BOK!

I’m told this fella is all about these heart collectibles, can you bring me one?  He won’t be able to resist the pull of such a find!

quest.title: Cuucoo's Awakening VII
quest.cleanDescription: You’re such a helpful person, while I put this trap in place, could you bring me just a little more food?  I’m starving for some reason.

quest.title: Cuucoo's Awakening VIII
quest.cleanDescription:
Gosh, I’m still not full, but you’re so good at keeping me fed, why bother with that green guy? Want to know a secret? I took this from him when he wasn’t looking, you can have it as my way of thanks!

{lafanfare}

quest.title: Baited And Outsmarted I
quest.cleanDescription: The biggest problem with exporting goods has always been waste and spoilage.  Captain Logan heard about your amazing frozen crops and has an idea...

quest.title: Baited And Outsmarted II
quest.cleanDescription:
Captain Logan believes these are showing some significant promise in shipping and spoilage improvements, his fingers seem to be dripping some kind of half frozen gooey pine resin. Or do they seem burnt?

He suggests maybe something to do with the shape and flavor profile? Captain Logan isn't a man of science, but maybe a different frozen crop could help!

quest.title: Baited And Outsmarted III
quest.cleanDescription: Okay.  The peas were far too small, but they radiated cold really well but left Captain Logan feeling unfulfilled.  Maybe a different frozen crop?

quest.title: Baited And Outsmarted IV
quest.cleanDescription: Perhaps your corn field has been overused, but this crop didn't seem to have much impact in Captain Logan's eyes, some strangely mangled corn cobs spill out of his sleeves unceremoniously.  He suggests something different.

quest.title: Baited And Outsmarted V
quest.cleanDescription: Oh my, these worked very well.  But they were just plain too round.  And delectable.  The crew ate them up entirely! Captain Logan suggests something with a larger form factor will do just the thing.

quest.title: Baited And Outsmarted VI
quest.cleanDescription: Captain Logan looks at you very slyly, and you realize it looks like he's been sampling some of the food as you've served it.  He requests one last batch of items, and you notice he hasn't been going to the docks after each shipment, the snow tracks go in another direction...

quest.title: Baited And Outsmarted VII
quest.cleanDescription:
It was Holger all along! You should have known. Drat!

Well, sometimes a man's just gotta eat, you guess.

He thanks you for all the delicious frozen foods and asks for one last thing.

quest.title: 750,000 Farmers I
quest.cleanDescription:

To celebrate, Rosalie is distributing celebration gifts. She hopes you like yours!

quest.title: 750,000 Farmers II

quest.title: 750,000 Farmers III

quest.title: 750,000 Farmers IV
