quest.title: Red Diamond Royal Flush III
quest.cleanDescription: I received another message from Mr. Gloher asking if we could provide wood to smoke the fish from his order too. In my response, I politely informed Mr. Gloher that we would not be able to fill that request because we focus on fishing and transport. However, I also informed him that we are on track to get his fish to him soon. So, let’s finish this order as quickly as we can.

quest.title: Red Diamond Royal Flush IV
quest.cleanDescription: We’re almost there! Thank you much for your help!

quest.title: Red Diamond Royal Flush V
quest.cleanDescription: This is it. One more load of red diamond fish should do it! Thanks again for all the help.

quest.title: Fun in the Sun I
quest.cleanDescription:
Buddy is going to the beach. It is going to be awesome. He’s going to have a whole long day of sand, water, sun, and fun.

He didn’t forget his towels. He didn’t forget his sandals. He didn’t forget his goggles or his snorkel. He didn’t forget his book to read, or his shovel and castle building tools. He didn’t forget snacks, drinks, lunch, or dinner. He didn’t forget extra towels or his sunbrella. He didn’t forget his wagon to haul everything. He didn’t forget shark and squisquatch repellent. He didn’t forget his bucket.

Unfortunately, he did forget his sunglasses and some sunscreen. Will you help Buddy out with some loaner sunglasses and a bottle of sunscreen?

(Hint: The items requested are in Buddy's Beach Bag which is available in the June Starter pack or by completing 28 days of chores)

quest.title: Fun in the Sun II
quest.cleanDescription:
Buddy had a great time at the beach! Unfortunately, he forgot to put on sunscreen. He’s in a lot of pain, but he wanted to return your sunglasses and your sunscreen. He really appreciates your kindness. Now, he needs to go home and rest.

Before Buddy leaves, would you be able to spare some watermelon? Buddy could really use something cool and refreshing, even if it’s just in his belly.

quest.title: Lorn's Awakening I
quest.cleanDescription:
Lorn had an amazing dream last night! He dreamt of an island with a giant egg at the top of a great mountain. On this island, Lorn was an owl and could fly and speak to the other animals.

Lorn is trying very hard to recall the dream fully. Can you help him remember each part? He thinks if you bring him a Yoshi Buddy Doll he can remember what happened next.

Lorn promises to give you back the special items you bring him once he remembers the entire dream and also promises to make it worth your efforts. He feels like there was something very special at the end of his dream!

quest.title: Lorn's Awakening II
quest.cleanDescription:
Lorn takes and holds the Yoshi Buddy Doll, squints his eyes, and remembers the next part of his dream.

He was flying across the island and passed over a small village where he heard a baby lizard crying. Lorn swooped down and landed gently beside the upset baby. Then, Lorn gave the shrieking child a Yoshi Buddy Doll. The baby lizard stopped crying!

Surprised by the sudden silence, the baby lizard's mother came out of a nearby house to check on her child. The baby’s mother immediately recognized Lorn as the generous gift giver and offered Lorn a beautiful Pink Ribbon in appreciation.

Will you bring Lorn a Pink Ribbon to help him remember even more of his dream?

quest.title: Lorn's Awakening III
quest.cleanDescription:
You give Lorn the Pink Ribbon you found. He takes it and ponders for a moment. Lorn recalls that after he received the Pink Ribbon he flew to the east and saw a cat waving at him. After landing on a tree branch just above the friendly feline, the cat asked Lorn for the Pink Ribbon. She felt like it would be a nice accessory to enhance her already peak cuteness. Realizing pink was not really his color, Lorn gave the beautiful ribbon to the cat.

In exchange, the cat generously rewarded Lorn with one of her special meals. Will you bring Lorn this meal? It's nearly lunch time anyways…

quest.title: Lorn's Awakening IV
quest.cleanDescription:
You give Lorn a Cat's Meow and before you can take a breath he has already eaten it. He was really hungry! Lorn makes eye contact with you and looks a bit crazy, but then begins to tell you the next part of his dream.

He remembers after he had the Cat's Meow on the island, he felt really sleepy and decided to take a nap. He was laying out by the beach near a banana tree. Suddenly, a bunch of bananas fell down and hit him on the head!

Will you bring Lorn some bananas? There is no guarantee he won't eat them though...

quest.title: Lorn's Awakening V
quest.cleanDescription:
Lorn takes the bananas and begins to peel one of them.

In his dream, he started to fly to the north and saw a great castle surrounded by a moat, but the bridge to get over the moat was destroyed.

Near the bridge, Lorn saw a monkey, so he flew down to the monkey and offered the monkey a banana. The monkey was so excited and thankful that he called his friends over and they began to repair the bridge!

The bridge was nearly complete, but the monkeys needed a bit more wood to finish it.

Will you bring Lorn some wood to help him remember what happened next?

quest.title: Lorn's Awakening VI
quest.cleanDescription:
After you cart all of the wood to Lorn, he stacks it into a pile next to his house. All of this just to remember a dream? Anyways... Then, Lorn begins to tell you the next part of the dream.

The monkeys finished repairing the bridge to the castle, but Lorn realized he could have just flown across the moat. Oh well!

Lorn crossed the bridge and encountered a group of bears living inside the castle. After greeting Lorn, the bears asked if he had any Honeycomb. They were always looking for delicious Honeycomb.

Will you bring Lorn some Honeycomb for the bears?

quest.title: Lorn's Awakening VII
quest.cleanDescription:
In his dream, Lorn gave the bears the Honeycomb that they asked for and they dug into the sticky, amber colored treat immediately! After that, Lorn left the castle and flew back to the west. Along the way he decided to take another break (flying is hard!) and landed near a small village.

In a clearing near the village, two young rabbits were throwing a carrot back and forth. During their game of catch they were debating whether or not pineapple on pizza is good or not. One of them said they had never tried pineapple on pizza before.

Can you bring Lorn some Pineapple and a slice of Pizza?

quest.title: Lorn's Awakening VIII
quest.cleanDescription:
Lorn takes the Pineapple and Pizza Slice and pulls out a knife, slices up the Pineapple into chunks and sprinkles them all over the pizza. He then scarfs it down without even offering you a bite.

Now, he remembers in his dream that the two rabbits tried the pizza with and without pineapple and still couldn't agree on whether or not pineapple should be on pizza. After that, he traveled to the shores of the strange island and stumbled across a beautiful Purple Flower.

Can you bring Lorn some Purple Flowers?

quest.title: Lorn's Awakening IX
quest.cleanDescription:
Lorn takes the purple flowers from you and places them in front of his house in batches that look really nice in his flower beds. After a few hours of landscaping, he remembers he was supposed to continue telling you about his dream.

In his dream, after finding the purple flowers by the beach, he noticed something shiny out in the water. He waded out carefully past the shore into the ocean and found a bottle with a message inside.

Can you bring Lorn a MIAB?

quest.title: Lorn's Awakening X
quest.cleanDescription:
In his dream, the note in the bottle was written in a strange language Lorn could not understand. He decided to carry it to an old turtle living in a nearby village. The turtle stared at the note and then said it was a shopping list?!

Will you bring the items on the list?

quest.title: Lorn's Awakening XI
quest.cleanDescription:
After bringing Lorn all of the items on his shopping list, he begins to stock his ice box and pantry. You give him a questioning look, but he begins to tell you about his dream again.

In his dream, Lorn left behind the old turtle and traveled to the north again, towards a body of water known as Lake Liahy. When he reached the lake, Lorn landed on a branch hanging out over the water. Suddenly a largemouth bass jumped out of the water and spit a fishing hook at Lorn!

Will you bring Lorn a fishing hook?

quest.title: Lorn's Awakening XII
quest.cleanDescription:
Lorn takes the fishing hook from you and begins to tie it to a line on a fishing pole. He appears to be getting ready to go fishing somewhere. As he is tying an improved clinch knot, he shares what happened next in his dream.

After the shock of having a fishing hook spit at him, Lorn grabbed the hook and carefully stowed it away. At that point, he was ready to go back to his nest for the day, but before he could make his way, he saw a mermaid sitting upon a rock waving at him.

Lorn flew over and landed next to the mermaid. Her name was Martha and she explained that she lost her most special necklace. She wondered if Lorn could fly around and see if he could find it. Martha offered Lorn one of her scales in return.

Will you find a Mermaid's Necklace and bring it to Lorn?

quest.title: Lorn's Awakening XIII
quest.cleanDescription:
After much effort, you manage to find and deliver a Mermaid's Necklace to Lorn. He takes it from you and stares at it in surprise before placing it into a small wooden box. Then, he grabs his fishing supplies and begins to walk away from his home. Before he makes it more than a few steps, he remembers he needs to finish telling you about his dream.

After many hours of searching, Lorn saw something shiny hanging on a small tree branch near the eastern bridge over Lake Liahy. He found the necklace Martha was searching for! As quickly as he could, Lorn returned the necklace to Martha. Then, she graciously pulled out a small scale from her tail and gave it to Lorn.

To your surprise, Lorn opens his palm and shows you a small scale before handing it to you. He then expresses his gratitude for your help with his chores all week, and then explains that now he has extra time to go sit by the lake and fish.

As you start to walk away, Lorn taps your shoulder and then hands you a complete pizza! Cowabunga dude!

quest.title: Lorn's Awakening XIV
quest.cleanDescription:
As you start to walk away, Lorn stops you.

“That’s strange.” he says. “Did you drop the mermaid scale I gave you?”

As Lorn stoops down to pick something up, you confirm the mermaid scale is still in your hand by showing it to him.

“Well, I couldn’t begin to guess where this came from then, but you certainly deserve another one.”

quest.title: Crush of Waves I
quest.cleanDescription:
Rosalie found a young clownfish while she was at the beach. The clownfish was panicked and frightened and sad because he couldn’t find his father. While she attempted to console him, Rosalie also noticed that the little clownfish sounds like he might be a long way from home. If she can, Rosalie would like to help this little guy find his father and make it back to his home.

Will you help Rosalie find some crabs and jellyfish? They aren’t the most reliable sources of information, but they often see things other residents of the sea miss. If nothing else, they’re a good place to start asking questions.

quest.title: Crush of Waves II
quest.cleanDescription:
The crabs were very resistant to sharing information. Rosalie thought about threatening them, but thankfully the jellyfish were more helpful. One of the jellyfish told Rosalie that they almost ate an adult clownfish recently, but the clownfish was rescued at the last moment by some sea turtles. So now, Rosalie needs to find some sea turtles.

If you’ll help Rosalie find sea turtles, she can talk to them and get more clues about where the young clownfish might be from. Sea turtles are great sources of information about the ocean. They travel all over and they live a very long time. They’re also just really friendly. If anyone knows where this clownfish came from, it’ll be the sea turtles.

quest.title: Crush of Waves III
quest.cleanDescription: The sea turtles didn’t know anything firsthand, but they heard rumors about a wild clownfish looking for his kid. Will you find more sea turtles for Rosalie to talk to?

quest.title: Crush of Waves IV
quest.cleanDescription:
This second group of sea turtles didn’t know much either. The only information they had was second hand from a group of vegetarian sharks. The sharks said a clownfish joined their club recently, and despite his denials that he too was a fish eater, he did admit to losing his son. They said the clownfish was searching the whole ocean to find his kid.

That second hand story doesn’t give Rosalie much to go on, but it does point to there really being a clownfish dad out there looking for the little clownfish Rosalie found.

Will you find more sea turtles for Rosalie? She needs more information!

quest.title: Crush of Waves V
quest.cleanDescription:
This group of sea turtles didn’t have any new information. They heard the other rumors and stories, but that was it.

Will you bring Rosalie even more sea turtles? She has to help this little clownfish!

quest.title: Crush of Waves VI
quest.cleanDescription: These sea turtles know the sea turtle that saved the clownfish’s father! Rosalie now needs your help finding that singular sea turtle. Will you help her? Odds are high that you’ll have to search through a lot of sea turtles.

quest.title: Crush of Waves VII
quest.cleanDescription: No luck! Will you keep searching?

quest.title: Crush of Waves VIII
quest.cleanDescription:
We’re getting closer! These sea turtles traveled with the rescuer sea turtle!

Will you find more sea turtles?

quest.title: Crush of Waves IX
quest.cleanDescription:
We found him! The rescuer sea turtle was in the last group of sea turtles you gathered. Most importantly, he knows where the little clownfish’s father should be now. The clownfish dad is looking for his son not far from where Rosalie found the little clownfish.

To help with reuniting this father and son pair, the rescuer sea turtle suggested gathering as many sea turtles as we can to help find the dad and bring him to his son. Unleash the sea turtle network!

quest.title: Crush of Waves X
quest.cleanDescription:
We found the father and the two fish are back together!

Now, will you help gather more sea turtles one last time? The sea turtle network has offered to help get the two clownfish home safely, and they said the more sea turtles that come along the better the trip will be. The sea turtle network would also like to invite some sharks, jellies, and stingrays to run security for the voyage. Will you help gather everyone?

quest.title: Bug Exporter Enterprise I
quest.cleanDescription: Ragvin has a customer on Nonir Island that is interested in receiving a supply of unique bugs that aren’t native to the shores of Nonir. His customer would like to offer these imported bugs to all of the members of her bug collecting organization. Would you be willing to enter into an agreement to supply the bugs for Ragvin’s order? Ragvin and his crew will handle preserving and storing the bugs for shipment.

quest.title: Bug Exporter Enterprise II
quest.cleanDescription: Keep them coming! Ragvin needs a lot more cicadas for this order!

quest.title: Bug Exporter Enterprise III
quest.cleanDescription: Well, that’s a start, but Ragvin needs many more cicadas to fill this order. He needs you to step it up.

quest.title: Bug Exporter Enterprise IV
quest.cleanDescription: Ragvin really needs a lot of these bugs and he needs to make for Nonir Island very soon. Will you bring the cicadas in significantly larger loads to help speed this up?

quest.title: Bug Exporter Enterprise V
quest.cleanDescription: That’s more like it! Keep them coming!

quest.title: Bug Exporter Enterprise VI
quest.cleanDescription:
My friend, if you keep this pace up, we’ll be able to get our order to Nonir right on time.

Will you bring more cicadas, and maybe some of their shells too? Ragvin’s buyer set the shells as an optional bonus in the contract.

quest.title: Bug Exporter Enterprise VII
quest.cleanDescription: This is perfect! Keep it up!

quest.title: Bug Exporter Enterprise VIII
quest.cleanDescription: We’re almost there. Two more loads like your last one should do it.

quest.title: Bug Exporter Enterprise IX
quest.cleanDescription:
One last load and you’ve done it.

Would you mind grabbing a few extra shells while you’re getting the last load of cicadas? Then, Ragvin and his crew can be sure that the order is filled as well as all of the contract options.

quest.title: Shells Hold Extraordinary Little Lives I
quest.cleanTitle: Shells Hold Extraordinary Little Lives I
quest.cleanDescription: Will you find some barnacled shells for Geist’s collection? Geist found two barnacled shells yesterday and really loves them! The barnacles form different patterns on each of the shells in unique patterns. They are so fascinating!

quest.title: Shells Hold Extraordinary Little Lives II
quest.cleanTitle: Shells Hold Extraordinary Little Lives II
quest.cleanDescription: These are so wonderful! Geist really appreciates your help getting more shells for her collection. They remind her so much of home. If you happen to find any more, Geist would love to have them.

quest.title: Shells Hold Extraordinary Little Lives III
quest.cleanTitle: Shells Hold Extraordinary Little Lives III
quest.cleanDescription:
Geist appreciates you so much! How wonderful it is to have such a thoughtful friend like you.

If you find more barnacled shells, Geist would love to get a few more.

quest.title: Noisy Nuisance I
quest.cleanDescription: The buzz.  The incessant hum.  The chirping.  Star wants it to stop.  He is devising a spell that will attune his new hat with the resonant frequency of the cicada to counteract the noise.

quest.title: Noisy Nuisance II
quest.cleanDescription: Star was shocked by just how effective his spell was.  He wants to do the same spell for anyone who wants to stop hearing the cicadas, especially now that he can replicate the ancient stone cicada's natural rhythm when the apex of polarity during phase.  He found this old key he's willing to exchange to you for your help, too.  Even though he knows you'd do all of this out of the goodwill of your heart for no reward at all.

quest.title: Moon Shot I
quest.cleanDescription:
frank wants to get to the moon. That seems like something a magical bunny, such as frank, should be able to do easily. However, frank has not been able to accomplish it through his usual magical means. So, he is now turning to the one thing all woodland creatures loathe: engineering.

frank believes that a well engineered rocket could deliver him safely to the moon. Once there, frank is certain he’ll find moon carrots. He intends to be the first bunny on this planet to eat a moon carrot. Will you help frank find a large enough rocket to get him to the moon?

(Hint: The item requested is in Beatrix's Booming Brawl Box 02 which is available in the July Starter pack or by completing 28 days of chores)

quest.title: Moon Shot II
quest.cleanDescription:
That did not go according to plan…

frank completely understands now why his woodland friends loathe engineering. Honestly, it’s a wonder humans survive day-to-day. Engineering is a menace.

Will you bring frank some carrots to munch while he recovers from this debacle?

quest.title: Uni-que Meals I
quest.cleanDescription: Mariya is looking for sea urchins. She used them occasionally back home for different meals, and she really enjoyed them. Now, she would like to try combining them with some of the local flavors of Redbrook. Will you help her find some sea urchins?

quest.title: Uni-que Meals II
quest.cleanDescription:
Mariya can’t believe you found some sea urchins! They are wonderful!

She ended up preparing some comfort food from home instead of experimenting as she had planned. Will you find more sea urchins for her experiments?

quest.title: Uni-que Meals III
quest.cleanDescription:
Mariya appreciates your help so much!

She hasn’t found the right combination yet in her experimental dishes, but she wants to keep trying. Will you bring Mariya more sea urchins? She also needs more scissors. The sea urchins spines have already destroyed the scissors she had.

quest.title: Patiently Baking I
quest.cleanDescription:
Mariya is completely stressed out! She thought making her own starter would be easy. It’s just flour and water mixed together and fed over time. Although, she did add a little pineapple juice to make the starter more acidic. But the yeast are supposed to love that! Her neighbor said the starter should be ready by now, but it doesn’t smell very good and it isn’t bubbling and rising like her neighbor’s does. Mariya thinks she messed something up, but she has no idea what it could be.

Mariya has never felt so defeated at something cooking related. She just wanted to start making some fresh bread everyday. Why is this so hard?

Will you bring Mariya some fresh bread to drown her failure in?

(Hint: The bread is in Thomas's Tavern Tote which is available in the August Starter pack or by completing 28 days of chores)

quest.title: Patiently Baking II
quest.cleanDescription:
It turns out that Mariya was wrong. Well, sort of. She didn’t do anything wrong in making and caring for the starter. She just wasn’t patient enough. It just needed one more day of growth. It’s alive and well now! Mariya hopes to make loads of bread from it.

Mariya appreciates your patience and help. Would you be willing to help her a little more? She needs more eggs and milk for some of the bread recipes she’s going to try.

quest.title: The Heat Makes It Hotter I
quest.cleanTitle: The Heat Makes It Hotter I
quest.cleanDescription: “Holger’s Hot Pepper Sauce has a nice ring to it, wouldn’t you say? Now, if I’m going to create the most delicious hot pepper sauce ever known, I’m going to need the hottest peppers grown in the hottest heat of the summer. That’s where you come into this enterprise, my fine farming friend. I’ll need lots of regular peppers for flavor, and a few exquisitely hot peppers for heat. Perhaps we could even throw in some gold peppers. Together, I think we’ll make something legendary. Can I count you in? Will you bring the heat?”

quest.title: The Heat Makes It Hotter II
quest.cleanTitle: The Heat Makes It Hotter II
quest.cleanDescription: “Holger’s Hot Pepper Sauce is coming together nicely. Unfortunately, I was only able to make a small batch. It was good, but a bit too mild. So we need more of everything, if you don’t mind continuing to help me.”

quest.title: The Heat Makes It Hotter III
quest.cleanTitle: The Heat Makes It Hotter III
quest.cleanDescription: “Holger’s Hot Pepper Sauce is still not quite hot enough. It’s like a high mild to low medium now. We can do better!”

quest.title: The Heat Makes It Hotter IV
quest.cleanTitle: The Heat Makes It Hotter IV
quest.cleanDescription: “Holger’s Hot Pepper Sauce has reached a solid low-to-mid medium heat. We need to keep going. I don’t want to jump too high too fast, but let’s try more hot peppers.”

quest.title: The Heat Makes It Hotter V
quest.cleanTitle: The Heat Makes It Hotter V
quest.cleanDescription:
“Holger’s Hot Pepper Sauce is getting spicy!”

“I think it’s time for more heat, with a side of safety and some plans for storage.”

quest.title: The Heat Makes It Hotter VI
quest.cleanTitle: The Heat Makes It Hotter VI
quest.cleanDescription: “Holger’s Hot Pepper Sauce still needs more heat. I think it’s almost into hot territory. Let’s keep it going! And let’s stay safety conscious too!”

quest.title: The Heat Makes It Hotter VII
quest.cleanTitle: The Heat Makes It Hotter VII
quest.cleanDescription: “Holger’s Hot Pepper Sauce is really good! Let’s add just a bit more heat and it’s perfect.”

quest.title: The Heat Makes It Hotter VIII
quest.cleanTitle: The Heat Makes It Hotter VIII
quest.cleanDescription: “Holger’s Hot Pepper Sauce is great! Now, let’s make more of it!”

quest.title: The Heat Makes It Hotter IX
quest.cleanTitle: The Heat Makes It Hotter IX
quest.cleanDescription: “Holger’s Hot Pepper Sauce is going to be loved by all who taste it. We need to make more so everyone can taste it!”

quest.title: The Heat Makes It Hotter X
quest.cleanTitle: The Heat Makes It Hotter X
quest.cleanDescription: “Holger’s Hot Pepper Sauce is sold out, partly because I ate too much of it. Let’s make one more big batch.”

quest.title: Book of Dewstar Mastery I
quest.cleanDescription: There's a book I've been meaning to tell you about, but I would be remiss if I didn't ask you to prove your mastery to me by donating to the temple of rewards.  Perhaps you could show me by way of a mysteriously gained certificate?

quest.title: Book of Dewstar Mastery II
quest.cleanDescription: Well, this is certainly a surprise!  But, I think I'll need a little more proof in the pudding.

quest.title: Book of Dewstar Mastery III
quest.cleanDescription: Thank you kindly {player}.  The book is precious to me, and I will need a bit more understanding of your farming mastery.

quest.title: Book of Dewstar Mastery IV
quest.cleanDescription: Again!

quest.title: Book of Dewstar Mastery V
quest.cleanDescription: Obstacles are placed in front of us to see if what we want is truly worth striving for.

quest.title: Book of Dewstar Mastery VI
quest.cleanDescription: You've made it this far, but I believe you must go above and beyond to prove yourself in this instance.

quest.title: Book of Dewstar Mastery VII
quest.cleanDescription: I've heard it said that if hard work is the key to success, most people would rather pick the lock, but you constantly prove me wrong, {player}.

quest.title: Book of Dewstar Mastery VIII
quest.cleanDescription: The temple only rewards those who put in the effort.  Thank you for everything you're doing both for this town, and this world.

quest.title: Book of Dewstar Mastery IX
quest.cleanDescription: The reward for all this work will be worth it, I guarantee it.

quest.title: Book of Dewstar Mastery X
quest.cleanDescription: Once we're done here, perhaps you could teach old Dewstar a lesson or two?   Ha!

quest.title: Book of Dewstar Mastery XI
quest.cleanDescription: The greater the effort, the greater the glory!  I read that somewhere once, but I'm unsure where.

quest.title: Book of Dewstar Mastery XII
quest.cleanDescription: Truly, you are deserving of this book.  I hope that what you find within is as rewarding as the work was along the way.

quest.title: Horse Before The Carton I
quest.cleanDescription:
“Ho there, old chum! Might I trouble you for a moment?”

“frank has enlisted me to help with a new endeavor. He wants to start a school for the woodland creatures in this district. His plan is to make sure that they get as good an education as the human students receive at Vincent’s school. In addition to learning, frank wants to make sure that every animal attending the school receives two meals every day. As part of that effort, frank tasked me with helping the kitchen crew. For my first assignment, the kitchen crew leader, a lovely raccoon named Fritz, wants me to find milk cartons like they have at the human school.”

“Will you help me, and the new school get started in this monumental task?”

quest.title: Horse Before The Carton II
quest.cleanDescription: “My most humble apologies. I forgot to mention that we will also require a supply of glacierstones to keep the milk fresh for the students. Would you be so kind as to bring them swiftly? I am deeply grateful for your support.”

quest.title: Horse Before The Carton III
quest.cleanDescription:
“You are a most excellent supplier. Thank you so much.”

“Now, we have more students enrolled than we expected. Would you be willing to continue to supply us with milk for the students?”

quest.title: Horse Before The Carton IV
quest.cleanDescription: “frank has left us in a spot of difficulty again. He recruited an entire colony of rabbits to join the school. They’re all from the honeycomb burrows, somewhere up on Wigbig Hill. And now frank is demanding milk for these new students, even though they don’t seem particularly keen on it. Will you lend us your expert hands to meet this new demand?”

quest.title: Horse Before The Carton V
quest.cleanDescription:
“My dear friend, I am most grateful for your help, and I apologize in advance for what I must now ask of you.”

“frank has recruited farm animals from every farm in the district, likely including your own farm. The school is now well overrun, but frank insists that we feed them all. Would you be willing to continue your kindness by bringing more milk cartons and glacierstones? You are now most certainly our only hope.”

quest.title: Watermelon Canard Woes IV
quest.cleanDescription:
Holger can’t go on. These lies are keeping him from enjoying the watermelon. He’s not training for a competition. There is no competition! He just wanted to eat a lot of watermelon without the judgment that comes with eating this much watermelon. He’s very sorry for his deception.

If you’ll forgive him, Holger would love to eat some more watermelon, without all of the guilt. What do you say?

quest.title: Watermelon Competitions Worldwide I
quest.cleanDescription: Holger is training for a watermelon eating contest happening in seven days. To prepare, he needs loads of watermelon to eat for practice. Will you bring him as many watermelons as you can? He would really like a mix of red and yellow watermelons because he isn’t sure what type the contest will be using.

quest.title: Watermelon Competitions Worldwide II
quest.cleanDescription: That was a great start for training day one. Will you bring Holger more watermelon for his second day of training? Don’t forget he needs both red and yellow watermelons.

quest.title: Watermelon Competitions Worldwide III
quest.cleanDescription: Holger is ready for day three of training. Will you bring him more watermelons, both red and yellow?

quest.title: The Hardest Apples To Reach I
quest.cleanTitle: The Hardest Apples To Reach I
quest.cleanDescription: Vincent has an apple tree that is full of fruit in dire need of picking. He used a ladder to gather all the apples he could reach, but there are still many apples that are too high to safely pick. As a seasoned orchardist, will you help him find a way to get the last of the apples from his tree?

quest.title: The Hardest Apples To Reach II
quest.cleanTitle: The Hardest Apples To Reach II
quest.cleanDescription:
Thanks! That was just what Vincent needed! With the apple picker, he was finally able to get the apples way up at the top of the tree.

Now, do you have an extra barrel Vincent could have to fill with apples for the school?

quest.title: Threads of Music I
quest.cleanDescription:
While visiting a dig site that he was funding, Cecil found many unique insects in an underground portion of the excavated structure. Most of the insects were milling about in the dirt near the newly exposed opening, but one rather odd insect kept circling a nail in a board protruding out of the ground.

Cecil continued watching this insect for some time. Then, as an experiment, Cecil tried to entice the insect away by moving it several feet from the nail. However, the strange insect always returned to the nail, no matter the distance or direction Cecil placed between the two. Cecil also tried to distract the insect with other objects and pieces of metal, but this strange insect took no notice.

Will you bring Cecil some nails? Perhaps the insect is attracted to the combination of shape and material that a nail presents, and Cecil can draw it away with another random nail.

quest.title: Threads of Music II
quest.cleanDescription:
That did not work.

Will you bring Cecil a hammer so he can free the nail and see how the insect reacts?

quest.title: Threads of Music III
quest.cleanDescription:
As soon as Cecil freed the nail, the insect seized it and hopped away. Cecil followed as quickly as he could, but the insect retreated into a hole in the ground before Cecil could catch it. Peering down into the hole by torchlight, Cecil found what appeared to be a large hollow nest filled with the remains of long dead insects. The strange nail-obsessed insect was nowhere to be seen.

Cecil considered digging into the nest to continue his search for the strange insect, but stopped when he sensed what felt like a very dangerous magic deeper down. For now, he’s going to close off this area to make sure nothing is further disturbed.

Will you help him build a seal over the opening to the nest?

quest.title: Zap of the Sting I
quest.cleanDescription:
Around this time of year on Captain Thomas’ home world, there is an odd species of jellyfish that appears in the ocean near where Captain Thomas does much of his fishing. This type of jellyfish is extremely difficult to catch. It’s also extremely dangerous. These jellyfish can deliver a strong shock like lightning when they’re threatened.

If he hasn’t scared you off yet, Captain Thomas would like to enlist your help in searching this world’s ocean to see if this jellyfish also exists here. Are you interested in joining the search?

quest.title: Zap of the Sting II
quest.cleanDescription:
You did it! You found the jellyfish! It’s the same here as it is on Captain Thomas’ home world. Captain Thomas even got a small jolt from accidentally touching one without his gloves.

Now that Captain Thomas knows they’re here, he would like to try to catch some for a few of his customers. Would you like to continue the hunt with him?

quest.title: Zap of the Sting III
quest.cleanDescription: You have a real knack for jellyfishing! Would you like to keep going with Captain Thomas and see how many you can catch?

quest.title: Zap of the Sting IV
quest.cleanDescription: More of Captain Thomas’ customers have seen the pink jellyfish, and now they all want some. Will you help Captain Thomas fill all of these orders?

quest.title: Zap of the Sting V
quest.cleanDescription:
Star contacted Captain Thomas yesterday about getting a load of these pink jellyfish. He mentioned something about using them to prevent an intergalactic plankton from destroying the Crabby Nebula. Will you help Captain Thomas help Star save a nebula?

Captain Thomas thinks Star makes things up sometimes, but it’s better safe than sorry.

quest.title: Zap of the Sting VI
quest.cleanDescription: Well, if Star is making it up, he is really committing to the story. He asked Captain Thomas for more pink jellyfish. Will you help Captain Thomas continue to help Star wage a good fight for the Crabby Nebula?

quest.title: Zap of the Sting VII
quest.cleanDescription:
Star told Captain Thomas that the battle was going well, but that one final massive push was necessary to save the nebula. That intergalactic plankton is truly devious and dangerous.

Captain Thomas is certain he can’t catch all of the jellyfish Star needs on his own. Will you continue to help him supply the war effort?

quest.title: Zap of the Sting VIII
quest.cleanDescription:
Whew! That was a lot of work!

Star told Captain Thomas that the Crabby Nebula is saved and that the intergalactic plankton was vanquished, or maybe it was vanished. Either way, Star was very appreciative of all of the help. And Captain Thomas very much appreciates all of your help.

Captain Thomas has really enjoyed catching all of these jellyfish with you. What do you say to catching some more just for fun?

quest.title: Sweet Tooth I
quest.cleanDescription: George has a secret - he loves sweets.  He divulged this information to you one day while telling you some secrets about exploring the forest.   He was hoping you'd bring him some sugar cane to help curb his sweet tooth.

quest.title: Sweet Tooth II
quest.cleanDescription: George really appreciated the sweetness of the sugar cane.  It reminded him of the treats he was allowed to have during long campaigns in the wilderness.  He's asked you to bring a little more, in exchange for a recipe he heard about from a tracker during the campaign of Onir'emir many branches ago.

quest.title: Sweet Tooth III
quest.cleanDescription: George heard that certain wildlife was more likely to appear in the presence of a mix of sugar and acorns, and shows you a recipe.   It's titled "Acorn Pie".  It lists several ingredients you've only recently learned how to make.

quest.title: King of Apples I
quest.cleanDescription:
“Don’t try to look directly at me when I’m talking to you. Why do all humans try to do that? Most of you can’t even see us. Even if you can, you’ll probably only see my faelight. So just stop looking around and listen up.”

“I need King Apples, and I don’t know how to get them. I usually work with peppers and easy to find crops. And before you ask, no, I don’t know why they picked me to get the King Apples, and I don’t know what Eebeeeebee wants with them. Augh. What a mess. I didn’t wake up today expecting to have to deal with a human.”

“I’m going to make this real simple for you. You go get King Apples for me and I give you some stuff that humans like. Ok? Ok. Go find ten for me so I know you understand the task.”

quest.title: King of Apples II
quest.cleanDescription:
“Oh? You actually came back and you completed the test?”

“Well, let’s get to it. I need to fill an entire underground storage cave. Bring me as many King Apples as you can.”

quest.title: King of Apples III
quest.cleanDescription: “That’s probably a good start for a human, but I need you to think more like a faerie. Eebeeeebee wants an entire storage cave filled with King Apples! So you have to put some magic into it.”

quest.title: King of Apples IV
quest.cleanDescription: “That’s a little better, but hey, did I mention it’s a storage cave? It’s not a cavity. It’s a whole cave. And I’m pretty sure I’ve said Eebeeeebee multiple times. Does that name not mean anything around here?”

quest.title: King of Apples V
quest.cleanDescription: “I’m glad you’re starting to take this seriously. Once you began helping me, you became just as much in danger of Eebeeeebee’s wrath as I am. Not that we have anything to worry about. You just keep those King Apples coming.”

quest.title: King of Apples VI
quest.cleanDescription: “You know, you’re not horrible for a human.”

quest.title: King of Apples VII
quest.cleanDescription: “Please go faster. I know humans usually can’t, but we really need to finish this quickly.”

quest.title: King of Apples VIII
quest.cleanDescription: “So far, Eebeeeebee is pleased with our progress. Actually, it’s really difficult to tell. He smiles so much, but you never know if he’s going to turn someone into a newt at any moment. Let’s just keep going as quickly as we can.”

quest.title: King of Apples IX
quest.cleanDescription:
“All right. I’m tired. Let’s hurry this along. I still have my regular work to do. Have a little sprinkle of faerie magic to help you.”

A slight breeze blows across your face

quest.title: King of Apples X
quest.cleanDescription: “One more load like that last one should fill the storage cave completely. I appreciate your help. Maybe you’ve earned me a day off or a bowl of milk or something. Eebeeeebee gives weird gifts.”

quest.title: Ghosts of Candies Past I
quest.cleanDescription: There was a candy many years ago that Baba absolutely loved. It was usually only available for a month or two in the fall. Each mystery flavored candy was wrapped in a ghost costume, and you never knew what flavor you would get. Some were fruit flavored. Some were nut and chocolate flavored. Every piece was delicious. Baba hasn’t been able to find it for a couple of years now. So, if you happen to find some, will you bring a few pieces to Baba?

quest.title: Ghosts of Candies Past II
quest.cleanDescription: That was just as amazing as Baba remembered! If you happen to find some more, will you share a few more pieces with Baba?

quest.title: Keep Scarecrows Always Masked I
quest.cleanDescription:
Jill needs 500 masks for the scarecrows scattered around her fields. Her hope is that they will look festive for Halloween, but also that they will really put a scare into the crows, faeries, and burrowbarons that keep stealing her crops.

Will you bring her 200 masks to start?

quest.title: Keep Scarecrows Always Masked II
quest.cleanDescription: Jill is ready for the next 200 masks whenever you have them.

quest.title: Keep Scarecrows Always Masked III
quest.cleanDescription:
The masks appear to be working quite well. Roomba and FR4NK painted many of them to make them even more terrifying. Jill appreciates all of your help.

If you will, Jill just needs 100 more masks to finish the last of the scarecrows.

quest.title: Candy And Non Dairy Yummies I
quest.cleanTitle: Candy And Non Dairy Yummies I
quest.cleanDescription:
Charles is starting up a candy delivery service. He intends to bring candy right to the door of anyone that orders through his service. He would like to do same day delivery eventually, but for now he’s starting with next day deliveries. At first, the candy selection he provides will be pretty basic, but it should be enough to get his business going.

Now, he needs a supplier of candy. Would you be interested in serving as his supplier? You can start with just candy, lollipops, taffy, and candy corn.

quest.title: Candy And Non Dairy Yummies II
quest.cleanTitle: Candy And Non Dairy Yummies II
quest.cleanDescription:
There were some hiccups and lost candies on the first day of deliveries, but overall Charles’ candy delivery service is looking to be a big hit. It doesn’t hurt that Redbrook has grown so substantially over the years.

While you are preparing the next load for Charles, will you try to think of a clever name for this candy delivery service? Charles came up with a few names, but Lucky Lady felt none of them were quite right.

quest.title: Candy And Non Dairy Yummies III
quest.cleanTitle: Candy And Non Dairy Yummies III
quest.cleanDescription:
What do you think of the name Horse Powered Deliveries? Or maybe Universal Pony Service? Filly-Friend Express? Hot Hooves Delivery? No. You’re right. Those aren’t quite right.

Well, maybe you can think of something better before your next drop of candy for Charles. He just can’t find the perfect name.

quest.title: Candy And Non Dairy Yummies IV
quest.cleanTitle: Candy And Non Dairy Yummies IV
quest.cleanDescription:
Charles likes your idea to call his delivery service Sweet Stepper Express. He’s going to run it by Lucky Lady as soon as he gets home.

Charles also really appreciates your help with supplying candy. It makes the delivery service much easier to run knowing that he has a reliable supply of candy.

quest.title: Candy And Non Dairy Yummies V
quest.cleanTitle: Candy And Non Dairy Yummies V
quest.cleanDescription: Lucky Lady had a good chuckle over your suggestion, but she thinks you and Charles are still circling the perfect idea. See if your next supply of candy inspires anything.

quest.title: Candy And Non Dairy Yummies VI
quest.cleanTitle: Candy And Non Dairy Yummies VI
quest.cleanDescription:
Charles Delivers is perfect! It’s simple and it is very clear what the service is about. Charles can even use it for delivering other items besides candy. Lucky Lady said she’s also glad it doesn’t sound like an old stallion joke.

Charles appreciates all of your help and support. You are a fantastic candy supplier and a wonderful friend.

quest.title: Grill And Thrill I
quest.cleanDescription: Holger would like to get some raw meat to use as part of his Halloween decorations. He built a full-size werewolf statue and he wants to use the raw meat as viscera in the werewolf’s claws. It shouldn’t take too much, if you’re willing to lend him a hand.

quest.title: Grill And Thrill II
quest.cleanDescription:
Well, Holger got distracted and hungry, and he ended up grilling the meat and eating it all with grilled corn and baked potatoes. It was a fantastic feast!

So, Holger will need another stack of meat, if you can spare it.

quest.title: Grill And Thrill III
quest.cleanDescription:
Holger messed up again. He decided to grill some shrimp before finishing his Halloween decorations. Suddenly, the idea struck him to have some surf and turf, and the raw meat was just sitting there…marinating in a lovely aromatic herb marinade. It was more temptation than he could bear. Before Holger could get a hold on himself, he finished the entire package of meat you brought him.

Once again, he is returning to beg for your assistance as he tries again to finish his werewolf statue.

quest.title: Grill And Thrill IV
quest.cleanDescription:
Holger gave up on adding the raw meat to the werewolf statue. It’s too difficult to resist grilling and eating the meat. However, he truly appreciates your efforts to help him.

Now, would you be so kind as to bring him a little more meat so he can make a consolation meal?

quest.title: Strange Currency I
quest.cleanDescription:
“Eebeeeebee is currently losing it. Someone is stealing rubees from his vault every hour, like clockwork. They aren’t taking much, but Eebeeeebee knows the exact count and he has a spell that reports that exact count every ten minutes. The last count was 5,291,074,143,289,288. I know you were wondering.”

“Anyway, I have once again been stuck with a foolish task on top of my regular harvesting. I have to replace the lost rubees. Meanwhile, an entire team of faeries is working to seal the vault and capture the thief. I don’t really want to waste my time on this, but here we are. If you find any rubees, I will trade you for them.”

quest.title: Strange Currency II
quest.cleanDescription:
“The current count is 5,291,074,143,289,328. Listen. I know you don’t care, but if I have to suffer through this, you should too.”

“They found fur from a wolf in the vault. That’s most likely the culprit then, or something wearing a wolf pelt. It’s an easy spell to seal out a wolf. Hopefully, that means we won’t have to find too many more rubees. The trouble will be catching the wolf, if it is a wolf. Wolves are notoriously troublesome creatures. I think they have some sort of fae sense or something. What a mess.”

“I have an entire pepper harvest to haul in today. Keep after those rubees for me.”

quest.title: Strange Currency III
quest.cleanDescription:
“New count coming at you! It’s 5,291,074,143,289,368. You know what that means, right? The seal is not working. Whatever it is, it’s still getting in the vault. Ugh.”

“This is so frustrating. I just want to be with my cucumbers and carrots, harvesting in the sunshine. I don’t want to waste time on Eebeeeebee’s pride projects.”

“Anyway, if you keep the rubees coming, I’ll keep trading with you.”

quest.title: Strange Currency IV
quest.cleanDescription:
“It’s 5,291,074,143,289,420! That means it stopped! I may be able to stop visiting you every day!”

“In all seriousness, you aren’t bad for a human, but I just don’t want to be around you more than I have to be. Was that too mean to say? I don’t mean it in a bad way. It’s just most humans aren’t great, in the grander sense. You are probably an excellent human, but you can’t ever measure up to a plant, especially a good crop producer.”

“Well, thanks for all the help. If you’ll bring me 52 more rubees, we can satisfy Eebeeeebee and go our separate ways.”

quest.title: Toil And Trouble I
quest.cleanDescription: There is a very dangerous concoction that can be made to enhance various magic spells. Rosalie would like to make some and learn more about it, but the recipe makes her feel a little squeamish. Will you follow the recipe for Witch’s Brew and bring her as much as you can make?

quest.title: Toil And Trouble II
quest.cleanDescription:
Rosalie tried using the Witch’s Brew with a very simple levitation spell and all of it vanished. Every last drop! And the cauldrons!

Will you bring her some more so she can try again?

quest.title: Toil And Trouble III
quest.cleanDescription:
All of the Witch’s Brew vanished again!

This time Rosalie tried the simplest spell she could think of: a candle lighting spell. As soon as she cast it, the candle incinerated into nothing and all of the brew vanished with it.

Rosalie has decided to try one more time before giving up on learning about Witch’s Brew. Will you bring her one more batch?

quest.title: Toil And Trouble IV
quest.cleanDescription:
Rosalie did some reading before trying more magic. She found out that Witch’s Brew is just absolute chaos. It causes whatever magic it’s paired with to behave in the least expected way. So, trying to observe it in action made it vanish instead.

With her newfound knowledge, Rosalie went to run a few more experiments. This time she expected the brew to vanish when she cast a small weed killing spell. Instead the weeds all grew long thorns and sprouted tiny cubes of ice.

Rosalie also tried a spell to make a very large cloud. Instead a small puddle formed filled with tiny trout. Then, she tried a spell to dig a small hole. A large bewildered nautilus appeared on the intended dig spot, sprouted wings, and flew away.

For all of the brew you brought, that’s all Rosalie was able to try, just three spells. It goes so quickly.

Rosalie would really like to try a few more times, now that she knows what she’s doing. Would you mind whipping up some more Witch’s Brew?

quest.title: Toil And Trouble V
quest.cleanDescription:
Rosalie saw more of the same nonsense as before from very basic spells, but this time her closet was caught in the unfortunate effects. Everything in it turned into stone and the gravity inside the closet flipped sideways. It’s going to be a real problem, but Rosalie has a plan to fix it.

Will you bring her one more batch of Witch’s Brew? If this works, Rosalie is never touching this stuff again.

quest.title: Toil And Trouble VI
quest.cleanDescription: Well, that seems to have set everything right. All the tiny trout and the puddle vanished. The flying nautilus lost its wings, fell from the sky into the ocean, and it zipped off into the deep. The ice cube weeds lost their thorns and their ice cubes. Most importantly, Rosalie’s closet is back to normal, except for one wall that seems to be painted an impervious and immutable yellow. Oh well. Rosalie really appreciates your help.

quest.title: So Hot Right Now I
quest.cleanDescription: “Pumpkin Spice is so hot right now,” exclaims Star to you excitedly. “I’m only tuned into several omni-dimensions but it’s crazy that more people haven’t heard of it.  Let’s change that!  First, I’m going to need some pumpkins.”

quest.title: So Hot Right Now II
quest.cleanDescription: We’ve got some pumpkins, and my sources in the netherworld say that everyone flavors their steamed milk with pumpkin spice!  Let’s try it.  I’ll just need a few more things to make it happen!

quest.title: So Hot Right Now III
quest.cleanDescription: “Now, let’s share this with everyone in Redbrook!  Pumpkin Spiced Milk for all!”

quest.title: So Hot Right Now IV
quest.cleanDescription: It's a hit!  Redbrook loves Pumpkin Spiced Milk!  Now, let's grow this business. Maybe we ask Rosalie for help?

quest.title: So Hot Right Now V
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie has used a combination of magic and marketing to set expectation for pumpkin spiced milk off the charts.  Even Cecil is thinking about investing at this point!  We'll need to make sure our supplies are stocked up.  Can you help?

quest.title: So Hot Right Now VI
quest.cleanDescription: Well, I think it's official.  We need to start a milk bar.  I'm going to need some stuff for decorations, and some more PSM.

quest.title: So Hot Right Now VII
quest.cleanDescription: Well, that wasn't enough decorations or PSM. Can you help?

quest.title: So Hot Right Now VIII
quest.cleanDescription: It turns out people want the merch as they want the PSM!

quest.title: So Hot Right Now IX
quest.cleanDescription: This is the last shipment for now.  October and pumpkin spiced milk, what an iconic duo!  The nether dimensions are gonna be talking about us next October instead.  Thanks for all your help, {player}!

quest.title: Gratitude and Gravy I
quest.cleanDescription:
Holger is sending out notes to everyone to share with them all of the things he is thankful for in his life. He humbly requests that you also send him a return note that lists any items you are thankful for. You can even use his note as a guide to help you prepare your reply.

“Dear friend,

I find myself at this time of year reflecting on the passing of time and what brings true meaning to life. Much of my efforts each day focus on baser things tied to mere survival. The securing of shelter, safety, and food and water occupy much of my time. With any time I have remaining, I find myself mostly focused on food.

For better or worse, food has become something that is intertwined in all I do. In some ways, my life is very much like a feast filled with delicious dishes and food is the gravy that ties it all together.

Oh gravy. Have you ever had a really fine and perfectly balanced gravy? It’s a completely fantastic thing. It can take every item in the meal and tie them all together, all while it elevates them to new heights. It adds savor and salt and fat to everything it touches. What more could anyone want?

Now, I know what you’re thinking. What about gravy on sweet dishes? Friend, I’ve already done the research. When I say gravy makes everything better and ties everything together, I’ve not forgotten desserts and sweet dishes. I mean it. I have yet to find a single entree, side item, or dessert that wasn’t made better by gravy.

…”

Holger’s thankful note continues like this for four more pages, but perhaps this is enough to whet your appetite for writing a return thankful note to Holger.

quest.title: Gratitude and Gravy II
quest.cleanDescription: Holger is really hungry for some gravy now. Will you prepare some for him while he prepares the rest of the meal? He promises to share some of the food.

quest.title: A Pearl Jam I
quest.cleanDescription:
When Holger was very young, his grandmother would pay Holger and Borgen a fat pouch of ancient coins each to go and explore all around the area in search of pearl berries. Holger and Borgen usually only filled a single basket after several long days of exploring. These extremely rare berries were very difficult to find, but, according to Holger, the taste was not to be found anywhere else.

Holger also told Rosalie about some of the recipes that his grandmother created with the pearl berries. They were all delicious, but Holger’s absolute favorite was the pearl berry jam.

All of these stories from Holger made Rosalie excited to taste the pearl berries and to try them in her cooking. Unfortunately, she can’t find a single berry.

Will you help Rosalie search, and if you find any berries, will you bring a couple for her to taste?

quest.title: A Pearl Jam II
quest.cleanDescription:
Rosalie loves the pearl berries! If you can find several more, she would love to try making a red and pearl berry pie like Holger’s grandmother baked.

While you’re searching for more pearl berries, Rosalie will work on everything else for the pie.

quest.title: A Pearl Jam III
quest.cleanDescription:
Rosalie intended to share a slice of the pie with you, but she made the mistake of inviting Holger and Borgen over to try it first. Rosalie got one slice of the pie, and it was amazing. Borgen had two slices. Then, while Rosalie was gone to the kitchen to refill everyone’s milk, Holger finished his first slice and then ate the entire rest of the pie. Borgen tried to stop him, but Holger was faster than a frog gulping down a fly.

Rosalie would like to try making the pie again. This time she would like to make a few pies to ensure you get a chance to try the fruits of your hard work. Will you bring her a larger load of pearl berries?

quest.title: A Pearl Jam IV
quest.cleanDescription:
Rosalie tried. She really, truly tried. She’s still not even sure how it happened. The pies were protected with a spell that should have kept everyone out, except maybe a Star Meerif-level mage or a guardian. Yet, there was Holger passed out on her floor with empty pie pans all around him. He ate all the pie again!

Rosalie sent Holger on his way with a little bit of yelling and a spell to rain on him for the next three days. It wasn’t her finest moment, but she held back from sending worse spells after him.

Rosalie is not giving up! This time she plans to make more pies and hide them until she can get one to you, and a few other folks.

Will you find some more pearl berries, and avoid Holger?

quest.title: A Pearl Jam V
quest.cleanDescription:
Rosalie doesn’t understand how Holger is doing this. She went to Cecil’s house, to his servant’s kitchen, to make the pies. Then, she placed the pies in a pocket universe wrapped in a baker’s dozen security spells to cool. When she returned to get the pies, they were all gone and Holger was covered in a baker’s dozen maladies.

It’s maddening!

Rosalie is ready to give it one more shot, if you’re willing to bring more pearl berries.

quest.title: A Pearl Jam VI
quest.cleanDescription:
None of this should be possible! Holger is like some sort of inevitable force of nature.

This time, Rosalie pulled the pies from the oven, teleported herself and the pies 100 kilometers away and 2 kilometers into the air, and then cast a spell to transfix her gaze on the pies while they cooled. The pies vanished in midair while Rosalie stared at them, and then she watched as Holger slowly drifted to the ground attached to a parachute. He immediately fell asleep when he landed, snuggled into his parachute. Rosalie watched in awe, but she couldn’t do anything.

Rosalie is done with trying to make a pie. However, will you bring her more berries? She has a plan.

quest.title: A Pearl Jam VII
quest.cleanDescription: That’s a good start! Will you bring more pearl berries?

quest.title: A Pearl Jam VIII
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie is sorry for the secrecy. She really wants to tell you what she’s doing, but for now she just needs your trust and more pearl berries.

quest.title: A Pearl Jam IX
quest.cleanDescription:
Rosalie did it!

She made one more pie as a distraction. Then, while Holger was busy, she managed to finish making some pearl berry jam. She even had enough to give you a jar!

Please be careful when you go to enjoy it. There’s no telling how Holger will react when you open that jar.

quest.title: A Little Cheer I
quest.cleanDescription:
Vincent is exhausted. The past few months were extremely busy, and there seems to be no end in sight. If he can make it to the winter break for the school, he should have a chance to catch his breath. At the very least, Vincent will only be working one job during the break. He can do this.

Will you find something to help lift Vincent’s spirit? A little treat should be enough to buoy him up and help him feel loved.

quest.title: A Little Cheer II
quest.cleanDescription:
That was perfect! Vincent loved the cake, and your thoughtfulness really lifted his spirit. Vincent appreciates you.

If you have any more of those holiday cakes, Vincent would love another one. It was delicious!

quest.title: A Little Cheer III
quest.cleanDescription: For your generosity and kindness, Vincent wanted to give you one more gift. It’s a little something you can use to bring more cheer into the world. Enjoy!

quest.title: 1,000,000 Farmers I
quest.cleanDescription:
Rosalie can hardly believe it, Redbrook has reached another incredible milestone! Over 1,000,000 farmers now call the Redbrook area home!

To celebrate, Rosalie is handing out special gifts. She hopes you enjoy yours!

quest.title: 1,000,000 Farmers II
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie is giving a few extra gifts to residents who’ve been here a bit longer. Your support has helped Redbrook grow. Thank you for being part of our wonderful community!

quest.title: 1,000,000 Farmers III
quest.cleanDescription: You’ve stood by Redbrook through all its early quirks and growing pains. You truly deserve a little something extra for the journey.

quest.title: 1,000,000 Farmers IV
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie would like to give you a few more gifts. You’ve contributed a lot to the community, and still have a lot to give.

quest.title: 1,000,000 Farmers V
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie insisted you should have a few more gifts. She loves spoiling her favorite residents!

quest.title: 1,000,000 Farmers VI
quest.cleanDescription: Redbrook wouldn’t be as great as it is without you! You need a few more gifts.

quest.title: 1,000,000 Farmers VII
quest.cleanDescription: You’re incredible! Do you feel like an old timer yet? Have some more gifts!

quest.title: 1,000,000 Farmers VIII
quest.cleanDescription: Rosalie has a few more gifts for you. She appreciates you and all you’ve done to make Redbrook a wonderful home. Your hard work and dedication have brought you a long way. Here’s to even more success down the road!

quest.title: 1,000,000 Farmers IX
quest.cleanDescription: At this moment, you’re truly on top of the world, and an essential part of the Redbrook community. Thank you for all the kindness and support you’ve shown.

quest.title: Home For The Holidays I
quest.cleanDescription: Captain Thomas would like to spread some of his world’s Christmas Cheer.   He wanted to go around putting out various Christmas decorations throughout the lands and asked you for your help.

quest.title: Home For The Holidays II
quest.cleanDescription: Captain Thomas is reminded of how holidays can bring together friends and enemies, and wants to bring extra decorations for a few special townsfolk.

quest.title: Home For The Holidays III
quest.cleanDescription: Beatrix loved her gifts.  She asked that you pass it forward to another townsfolk.  Maybe one who needs to see the joy of the holidays more than most...

quest.title: Home For The Holidays IV
quest.cleanDescription: A hallmark of giving is recognizing those who may need some extra holiday cheer and Ric Ryph was touched and humbled by your gift.  He suggests another who might be in need of cheer this year.

quest.title: Home For The Holidays V
quest.cleanDescription: Charles jumped and stomped and clomped and whinnied as you began decorating his home.   “Neigh!”

quest.title: Home For The Holidays VI
quest.cleanDescription: Buddy, ever cheerful begins to decorate his cave and the surrounding area joyfully.   He wistfully remembers the times when he and his friends would see lights off in the distance at sea…

quest.title: Home For The Holidays VII
quest.cleanDescription: Captain Logan has always enjoyed the various festivities of wintertime.  They give an opportunity to reflect on some of the better moments of T’rah and those that reside within.   Perhaps even those who have existed for a long time and in another world before him would enjoy some decorations?

quest.title: Home For The Holidays VIII

He suggests passing a little more cheer to someone who might have seen a few winters themself.

quest.title: Ice Cleared Everywhere I
quest.cleanDescription:
This ice is getting so frustrating. Jill has a door handle that is constantly getting covered in it. Then, she can’t open the door until she manages to find some grip, or she discovers a random tool lying around to help her. It’s infuriating!

She has engineered several solutions to reduce or eliminate the ice, but she doesn’t like any of them. They all have some drawback. Some are too dangerous. Some use too many resources or too much energy. Some are just impractical. Will you help her come up with a simple solution that will help reduce her ice struggles?

quest.title: Ice Cleared Everywhere II
quest.cleanDescription:
That ice scraper was a genius idea! Jill appreciates your help. She hung the scraper on a nail right by the door, and now it’s always ready to clear away the ice.

Now, Jill has a new idea. Will you bring her some corn? She has a plan for a synthetic coating derived from corn, and other things, that she can put on surfaces to prevent ice buildup. She may never have to deal with ice again!

quest.title: The Masonry Requires Attention XVIII
quest.cleanDescription:
In the whirlwind of the past few days, various scouts have left reports on the community boards of Redbrook that no shady characters have been spotted in the general limits of Redbrook, but various wildlife has been noticeably active in moving away from the Pirate’s Cove Cane Pole Ridge and Highland Hills.

No one has heard from Ragvin after he left the city with a shipment of Redbrook Radishes in tow.

Meanwhile, in the town square, a large poster has been plastered on the announcement board.

"PROTECT OUR FAIR CITY. REDBROOK NEEDS STURDIER WALLS. LET US REPAIR THE MASONRY. WE CAN BECOME STRONGER THAN OUR ENEMIES. ALL DONATIONS WELCOME. -Holger"

quest.title: Problems Still Abound XX
quest.cleanDescription:
“Well, it’s an intriguing offer, I suppose, but I find very little in this situation that does anything for me or my expeditionary team. I’ve not been bothered by these so-called pirates, so perhaps you’re the instigators?”

Vincent winces in frustration at Captain Logans words. He has been growing more impatient with each passing hour since Logan declined helping.

“He’s out there without us! What if he does something foolish? What if they catch him? Even more worryingly, what if he does something useful before we’re ready?”

Your ragtag team comes up with the most odd of solutions and realize you’ll have to see if Jill could advise you on a speedy solution to your problems using her growing mechanical prowess. Thankfully, you know a few things she might like to make her more amenable to your immediate needs.

quest.title: Problems Still Abound XXII
quest.cleanDescription: Jill smiles as the last of the corn enters her silo.  She lays out a parchment on a table nearby with a picture of something titled “stealth boat.”  It uses underwater propellers and engines that utilize corn oil to create energy, not unlike ROOMBA.  “It’ll be slower than the wind, and theoretically quieter, too.”  She won’t guarantee the overall efficacy of her ship, but the design seems solid enough, and there doesn’t seem to be any more options.  You set to work and rush to get the things she’ll need to get her project underway.  She suggests you work on this in Buddy’s cave.  How she knows about his secret cave and the dock there is a mystery to you.

quest.title: The Masonry Requires Action XXI
quest.cleanDescription:
You see a poster.  It's no longer in the town square, but in an alleyway.  You feel compelled to help.

"PROTECT OUR FAIR CITY. REDBROOK NEEDS STURDIER WALLS. LET US REPAIR THE MASONRY.  WE CAN BECOME STRONGER THAN OUR ENEMIES.  ALL DONATIONS WELCOME. 

-Holger"

quest.title: Augment Redbrook Through Masonry XXIII
quest.cleanDescription:
"PROTECT OUR FAIR CITY. REDBROOK NEEDS STURDIER WALLS. LET US REPAIR THE MASONRY. WE CAN BECOME STRONGER THAN OUR ENEMIES. ALL DONATIONS WELCOME.

-A Redbrook Citizen"

The handwritten posters have been appearing in more places. You can't help but want to help.

questlines.title: You Must Build A Stealth Boat

quest.title: You Must Build A Stealth Boat I
quest.cleanTitle: You Must Build A Stealth Boat I
quest.cleanDescription:
Returning to Buddy’s Cave with everything Jill claimed she would need, you head back. Once at the cave, you hear the distinct sounds of a hammer hitting metal and some choice words from Jill as a crash comes from another room. “ROOMBA! I told you! The system will go over here! How can a robot with such fantastical knowledge have no actual idea how this will work?!” Her exasperation is plain as you step into the drydock of Buddy’s cave.

“I AM MERELY ATTEMPTING TO RECALIBRATE YOUR RUDIMENTARY ENGINE SYSTEM TO UTILIZE A CLEANER SOURCE OF FUEL FOR A MORE SUSTAINABLE BOATING SOLUTION. THERE IS A NON-ZERO CHANCE THIS VESSEL WILL BE LOST IN THE FUTURE. PREPARATIONS MUST BE MADE.”

Jill’s resigned sigh echoes in the cavernous area. “Well, I guess we’ll need some of this clean fuel, and while you’re getting that together, ROOMBA and I will finish this contraption up, with some more modifications.”

quest.title: You Must Build A Stealth Boat II
quest.cleanTitle: You Must Build A Stealth Boat II
quest.cleanDescription:
After some time, you see a metal abomination inexplicably floating in the water. It looks like a giant arch in the water, with the deck sitting in between the arches. While you try to make sense of this, ROOMBA continues to zip back and forth alternating between strange alterations of the boat, and cleaning up any mess Jill has made.

“Well, it’s not the cleanest, but this little guy does know his stuff. The angles of the ship should now cut the water in such a way as to keep both wind and water from making any noise as you move forward. The strange contraption underneath is an improvement on the original engine design way back from when you started exploring Jundland and brought back pieces, intended to propel the vessel forward without needing wind, and rotors push the water in such a way that keeps the need for wind at a minimum without any noise. It should work!”

Jill has taken a step back from the work to admire her boat. The satisfaction on her face is plain.

She continues, “Now that we’re nearly done, ROOMBA and I are going to need some more metal, and a few more odds and ends to help finish up the construction. We should be ready soon, and bring those companions of yours too. Hopefully Buddy has kept those pirates at bay…”

quest.title: You Must Build A Stealth Boat III
quest.cleanTitle: You Must Build A Stealth Boat III
quest.cleanDescription:
You return, companions flanking you. Their awestruck expressions mirror yours when you originally stepped into the dock yesterday.

Jill greets everyone, and after a moment she says, “Well, we’ve got this baby as ready as she’ll ever be. Just needs a name.” ROOMBA speaks up, “MY DATABANKS INDICATE AN APPROPRIATE MONIKER FOR SUCH A FINE CRAFT SHOULD BE THE SPARROW.”

No one seems to disagree, so the SPARROW is christened.

“HUMANS, I ASSUME YOU HAVE BROUGHT SUSTENANCE AND FUEL FOR THE JOURNEY? I WILL REQUIRE SOME ADDITIONAL POWER AS WELL.”

quest.title: You Must Build A Stealth Boat IV
quest.cleanTitle: You Must Build A Stealth Boat IV
quest.cleanDescription:
ROOMBA pours the last of the fuel into the tank and rolls on board. Vincent, George, and Holger step on board apprehensively, and finally you are the last one embark. ROOMBA points to a small red button on the console of the SPARROW and Vincent deftly stands at the front and presses the button. The machine whirrs to life, a soundless steady vibration under your feet.

With the gentle thrum of the deck beneath you, Vincent accelerates the SPARROW with ROOMBA giving tips behind him. Luckily, in the enclosed main cabin, there are plenty of plush chairs for the rest of the crew to relax. Vincent directs Holger to keep an eye out for vessels on the horizon, and your craft steers into the ocean, eerily silent as the waves break around you. Pirate’s Cove awaits…

quest.title: Rage Against Tattered Masonry XXIV
quest.cleanDescription:
"TATTERED MASONRY DOESN'T STAY TATTERED FOR LONG

IT GETS HELP FROM PEOPLE AS THE TATTERS GROW STRONG

-COUNCIL FOR A BETTER REDBROOK"

quest.title: The Masonry Requires Activity XXV
quest.cleanDescription:
"BROTHERS AND SISTERS OF REDBROOK. WE MUST MAKE OUR WALLS PROUD LIKE THEY HAVE NEVER BEEN PROUD BEFORE. FOR A GREATER TOMORROW!

-REDBROOK ACTIVISM COALITION"

quest.title: The Ramparts Mended Anew XXVI
quest.cleanDescription:
"WE REQUIRE ONE LAST DONATION! FOR A BETTER REDBROOK!

-REDBROOK CITIZENS BRIGADE"

quest.title: Pirate Stealth Arrival XXVII
quest.cleanDescription: The journey is slower than expected, as the SPARROW seems to have traded speed for stealth.  Your erstwhile crew passes the time by playing various games.  Vincent is surprisingly good at dice games when he's not watching the horizon.  Holger seems to prefer card games.  The journey is slow but steady, and you begin to see the cove on the horizon.  The group decides to fill their stomachs one last time before arriving.

quest.title: Pirate Stealth Arrival XXVIII
quest.cleanDescription:
Approaching the cove, aided by the cover of night, your party sees the flicker of campfires. A sprawling set of ships is arrayed around the cove - almost too many to count. The raucous din is only interrupted by loud bangs and the occasional ship to ship contact, a wooden crash and creak of boats moored too close together.

One bonfire near the center of the cove that leads out towards Highland Hills stands higher than the rest. Vincent notes that is likely where the leaders are all together, and suggests any reconnaissance is focused on that area. Remembering some of the old routes that Buddy knew of in previous adventures, you lead your companions towards a small inlet in the cove and find the boat that Buddy sailed off with several days ago docked in the same inlet. Chance, it seemed, was on your group’s side!

Stepping into the grotto, you get a closer look at Buddy’s boat and realize belatedly that several parts of the hull haves been smashed, and the entire boat is in quite significant disrepair. There is crude writing of warnings across the bow. Too late, you realize, that this area was known to the pirates. A scuffle breaks out behind you, and before you can blink, pirates have bound and gagged your companions. One looks to you and as you backpedal towards the wall, he gives a malicious laugh. You feel the wall behind you, when suddenly it melts away, and you feel a hand roughly cover your mouth.

Everything goes dark and you hear behind you, “Shhh…”

quest.title: Pretty Abrupt Save XXIX
quest.cleanDescription:
After a moment of confusion, you spin around to see Buddy, eyepatch and bandana covering a majority of his face, but his outline is unmistakable.

“We’ll save them, don’t you worry,” he whispers. The echoes of his whispers bounce off the tunnel in strange ways, making it sound like Buddy was talking to you from many directions.

He raises a finger to his lips to signal staying quiet and motions you to follow. You grab a torch to follow him.

The tunnel is silent but for the occasional drip of water and your footsteps. After about 5 minutes, Buddy stops suddenly, and you peer around to see that you’ve exited a tunnel into a wider space. It is littered with broken boxes, rotted treasure chests, and other detritus.

“We’ll be safe here. Jayante and I used this place for storage before. That smuggler’s hatch came in handy yet again! If I know Hrakness, we're going to need some serious bribery material to get her to leave Redbrook alone..."

quest.title: Iced Crops Examination I
quest.cleanDescription: “official woodland league: agricultural use and wetlands examination leader coming through! i hope you’re ready for your inspection. we’ve heard about the frozen crops you’re growing. they sound like a real drain on the soil and water resources of this area. I’m going to need samples of each of the frozen crops you’re growing. then, i’ll examine them with my associates and we’ll make a determination on whether you’re ruining everything. maybe, just maybe, we’ll let you keep your farm, assuming you aren’t ruining everything.”

quest.title: Iced Crops Examination II
quest.cleanDescription: “i wouldn’t mind a snack while i’m waiting. how about a nice bucket of carrots while you get the other frozen crops?”

quest.title: Iced Crops Examination III
quest.cleanDescription: “hold on a minute! my bucket of carrots is getting way too low. i need a free refill when you have a chance.”

quest.cleanDescription: “sheesh. who knew growing crops would take so long? i’m going to need my bucket filled again.”

quest.title: Iced Crops Examination V
quest.cleanDescription: “when you bring the frozen cabbages, go ahead and drop a regular cabbage or two in the bucket to keep me busy. I think I’m good on carrots for now.”

“speaking of bottoms, i see the bottom of my bucket again. could i get another free refill?”

quest.title: Iced Crops Extreme Examination I
quest.cleanDescription: “i’m back! and i figured it out! we have to go deeper. we need a lot more crops to get to the truth. the folks back at the lab asked me to stop, but i told them i’m not stopping until they analyze these new samples. at this point, they’ll do almost anything to get me to leave them alone. so I’ve got you right where i want you. now, i want 10 times the frozen crops as samples, and 3 free refill buckets while i wait.”

quest.cleanDescription: “the analysis is taking too long! so i’m going to go put a hurry on the techs at o.w.l. meanwhile, i’ve enlisted Gary to collect the frozen crops samples. he’s been authorized to smash things if you cause any problems, mostly just rocks and stuff, but still. now, i need my free refills before i go, please and thank you.”

quest.cleanTitle: Iced Crops Extreme Examination Extra Extremey I
quest.cleanDescription: “bah. they’ve found nothing. nothing! can you believe that? it’s like there’s nothing to find. it’s like you’re running a legit operation here. i feel so defeated, or maybe that’s bloated. i can’t tell. will you at least do me a favor and bring me one last load of all the frozen crops? i’ll analyze them myself. and maybe let’s hold the free refill down to just the carrots this time.”

quest.title: Iced Crops Extreme Examination Extra Extremey II
quest.cleanTitle: Iced Crops Extreme Examination Extra Extremey II

quest.title: Just As Sweet I
quest.cleanDescription:
“I think I’m in love.”

“Last night I went to a dinner party with some of my crew. We had a great time and great food. Then, I ended up talking all night with an old friend of my first mate. Her name is Cass and she is wonderful. She has the most amazing smile and sense of humor, and she’s fascinating and so fun to talk with. We were literally the last two people to leave the party. I didn’t want the party to end! I could have stayed up all night talking with Cass!”

“Oh, It was amazing! I have to see her again.”

“I have to bring her a gift. Will you help me find something lovely for Cass?”

quest.title: Just As Sweet II
quest.cleanDescription:
“That didn’t go like I thought it would.”

“Cass just wants to be friends. I feel like a complete idiot. I got a little carried away there didn’t I?”

“I need to go fishing, I think. Have any bait handy?”

quest.title: Happy Neigh Year VII
quest.cleanDescription: “Well, old chum, we’ve come to it. We’ve gathered a decent variety for the party, but now we need the favorite treat of horses everywhere. Will you find some sugar cubes for the party?”

quest.title: Happy Neigh Year VIII

quest.title: Belt out of Shape I
quest.cleanDescription: Holger has always been a bit envious of his brother's belt collection. Do you think you could bring him a few specfic belts so that he can start his own collection?

quest.title: Belt out of Shape II

quest.title: Belt out of Shape III

quest.title: Belt out of Shape IV

He's sure there will be other belts to add to his collection down the road, but for now if you can bring this belt, he will give you something special he found.

quest.title: A Slime Covered Wish I
quest.cleanDescription: Gleeep... gloop gloop... SLIIIIME BUDDDDDDY DOOOOLLLLLL... sloop splorp blishhh slort... ANNNNNCIENT COOOOOOOOOIN...

quest.cleanDescription:

quest.title: Stickiness of Friendship I
quest.cleanDescription:
“Goo bert goo.”

“I’m so glad that I found you, friend. While I love the swamp, it can be a lonely place. You make it not as much lonely. Together, we are like a pocket of swamp gas finding a magic spark.”

“Goo goo bert.”

“I’m also glad the swamp hasn’t hurt you. It’s a very dangerous place. When you get a little more comfortable with the swamp, maybe I can take you down the undertow road. It’s a little more dangerous than the rest of the swamp, but very mysterious.”

“Goo goo bert goo goo bert.”

quest.title: Catch Them All I
quest.cleanDescription:
Cecil has loved collecting things for many years. Some might even say 30 years.

He heard about a creature that collects lightning by holding its tail in the air and desperately wants one. Will you help him be the very best?

quest.title: Catch Them All II
quest.cleanDescription: Tracking the creature has been tough, but while searching the forest, you found a bunch of apples that had been burnt to a crisp, and realize it could be the creature. Maybe they like apples? Cecil is quite excited by this revelation.

quest.title: Catch Them All III
quest.cleanDescription:
On your next trek to the forest, you find the creature in a clearing taking a nap. Your hair stands on end with the electrical energy in the area. As you take a step towards it, the creature jolts awake and yells

“CHAPIKUUUUU!”

Lightning strikes all around you, and after a brief moment it falls fast asleep again. Cecil mutters something behind you, and in his hand appears two perfect replicas of the creature. He hands one to you and says “It’s too cute and dangerous to be captive, but we may as well celebrate this unique creature anyways!”

quest.title: A Little Luckier I

He’s also concerned that his fabulous good looks are waning too. Don’t look directly at him! Just find his hat as quickly as possible!

quest.title: A Little Luckier II
quest.cleanDescription: You really saved the day! Leafy is feeling his luck coming back quickly. He’s also 20% warmer, and he feels at least 20% more confident. Now, Leafy just needs a little something to help restore his youthful good looks. Will you bring him some seaweed to soak on his face? A nice green mask should do the trick.

quest.title: Drink in the Green I

quest.title: Drink in the Green II
quest.cleanDescription:
The shamrock milk is surprisingly good! It has just the right sweetness and a delightful hint of legume. Mariya likes it!

Now, Mariya has some ideas for recipes she might try it in, especially to add some green in celebration of spring. Will you bring her some more shamrock milk to use in a few culinary experiments?

quest.title: Drink in the Green III
quest.cleanDescription: Mariya’s first experiments worked out pretty well, but she has some ideas that may be even better. Will you bring her some more shamrock milk and a few other ingredients she needs?

quest.title: Drink in the Green IV
quest.cleanDescription:
That turned out really well! Mariya made a variation on a red berry pie topped with a green whipped cream.

Now, Mariya would like to make a peach cobbler with some shamrock milk touches. Will you help her out with a few ingredients and some more shamrock milk?

quest.title: Drink in the Green V
quest.cleanDescription: The peach cobbler was wonderful, but it felt more like summer than spring. Fortunately, Mariya has another idea that should taste like all the wonders of spring in one delicious dessert.
